00010: async function bootstrapSnapshot(lottery = "PT_RIO") {
00011: 
00012:   const draws = await fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes({
00013:     lottery,
00014:     pageSize: 500,
00015:   });
00016: 
00017:   console.log("Draws carregados:", draws.length);
00018: 
00019:   const built = buildRanking(draws);
00020: 
00021:   const ranking = Array.isArray(built?.ranking)
00022:     ? built.ranking
00023:     : [];

00025:   const rankingScored = applyScoreEngine(ranking);
00026: 
00027:   await writeStatisticsSnapshot({
00028:     uf: lottery,
00029:     scope: "dashboard_full",

00031:       version: 1,
00032:       totalDraws: built.totalDraws,
00033:       uniqueDays: built.uniqueDays,
00034:       totalOcorrencias: built.totalOcorrencias,
00035:       countMode: built.countMode,
00036:       ranking,
00037:       rankingScored,
00038:       top3: rankingScored.slice(0,3),
00039:       integrityIssues: built.integrityIssues || [],
00040:       generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
00041:     },
00042:   });
00043: 
00044:   return {
00045:     draws: draws.length,
00046:     ranking: ranking.length,
00047:     top3: rankingScored.slice(0,3),

00001: "use strict";
00002: 
00003: const { getAdminDb } = require("./statisticsEngine");
00004: 
00005: function normalizeLottery(lottery) {
00006:   return String(lottery || "PT_RIO").trim().toUpperCase();
00007: }
00008: 
00009: function normalizeGrupo(v) {
00010:   const n = Number(v);
00011:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 25 ? n : null;
00012: }
00013: 
00014: function normalizePosition(v) {
00015:   const n = Number(v);
00016:   return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 10 ? n : null;
00017: }
00018: 
00019: async function fetchPrizesForDrawRef(drawRef) {
00020:   const snap = await drawRef.collection("prizes").get();
00021: 
00022:   return snap.docs
00023:     .map((doc) => {
00024:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00025:       return {
00026:         id: doc.id,
00027:         ...data,
00028:         grupo: normalizeGrupo(data.grupo),
00029:         position: normalizePosition(data.position),
00030:       };
00031:     })
00032:     .filter((p) => p.grupo && p.position);
00033: }
00034: 
00035: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, concurrency, mapper) {
00036:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00037:   const out = new Array(arr.length);
00038:   let index = 0;
00039: 
00040:   async function worker() {
00041:     while (index < arr.length) {
00042:       const i = index++;
00043:       out[i] = await mapper(arr[i], i);
00044:     }
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   await Promise.all(
00048:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, worker)
00049:   );
00050: 
00051:   return out;
00052: }
00053: 
00054: async function fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes({
00055:   lottery = "PT_RIO",
00056:   pageSize = 250,
00057:   prizeConcurrency = 12,
00058: } = {}) {
00059:   const db = getAdminDb();
00060:   const lk = normalizeLottery(lottery);
00061: 
00062:   const admin = require("firebase-admin");
00063:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00064: 
00065:   const draws = [];
00066:   let lastDoc = null;
00067:   let page = 0;
00068: 
00069:   while (true) {
00070:     page++;
00071: 
00072:     let q = db
00073:       .collection("draws")
00074:       .where("lottery_key", "==", lk)
00075:       .orderBy("ymd", "asc")
00076:       .orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc")
00077:       .limit(pageSize);
00078: 
00079:     if (lastDoc) q = q.startAfter(lastDoc);
00080: 
00081:     console.log(`[BOOTSTRAP] Buscando página ${page}...`);
00082: 
00083:     const snap = await q.get();
00084: 
00085:     if (snap.empty) break;
00086: 
00087:     const pageDraws = await mapWithConcurrency(
00088:       snap.docs,
00089:       prizeConcurrency,
00090:       async (doc) => {
00091:         const data = doc.data() || {};
00092:         const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDrawRef(doc.ref);
00093: 
00094:         return {
00095:           id: doc.id,
00096:           drawId: doc.id,
00097:           ...data,
00098:           prizes,
00099:         };
00100:       }
00101:     );
00102: 
00103:     draws.push(...pageDraws);
00104: 
00105:     console.log(
00106:       `[BOOTSTRAP] Página ${page}: ${snap.docs.length} draws | total=${draws.length}`
00107:     );
00108: 
00109:     lastDoc = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
00110: 
00111:     if (snap.docs.length < pageSize) break;
00112:   }
00113: 
00114:   return draws;
00115: }
00116: 
00117: module.exports = {
00118:   fetchAllDrawsWithPrizes,
00119: };

00001: "use strict";
00002: 
00003: const { buildFrequencyEvidence } = require("./frequencyEvidence");
00004: const { buildContextEvidence } = require("./contextEvidence");
00005: 
00006: /**
00007:  * Evidence Engine
00008:  *
00009:  * Centraliza todos os módulos de evidência.
00010:  * Cada módulo produz fatos; nenhum decide o resultado.
00011:  */
00012: 
00013: const MODULES = {
00014:   frequency: buildFrequencyEvidence,
00015:   context: buildContextEvidence,
00016: };
00017: 
00018: function collectEvidence({
00019:   item = {},
00020:   context = {},
00021:   config = {},
00022: } = {}) {
00023: 
00024:   const evidence = [];
00025:   const enabled = config.evidenceModules || {};
00026: 
00027:   for (const [name, builder] of Object.entries(MODULES)) {
00028: 
00029:     if (!enabled[name]?.enabled) {
00030:       continue;
00031:     }
00032: 
00033:     try {
00034: 
00035:       const result = builder(item, context);
00036: 
00037:       if (result) {
00038:         evidence.push(result);
00039:       }
00040: 
00041:     } catch (err) {
00042: 
00043:       evidence.push({
00044:         module: name,
00045:         error: true,
00046:         message: err.message,
00047:       });
00048: 
00049:     }
00050: 
00051:   }
00052: 
00053:   return {
00054: 
00055:     count: evidence.filter(e => !e.error).length,
00056: 
00057:     modules: evidence
00058:       .filter(e => !e.error)
00059:       .map(e => e.module),
00060: 
00061:     evidence,
00062: 
00063:   };
00064: 
00065: }
00066: 
00067: module.exports = {
00068:   collectEvidence,
00069: };

00039: 
00040: function buildReasons(frequency, percent, level) {
00041:   const reasons = [];
00042: 
00043:   reasons.push(`Frequência histórica: ${frequency}`);
00044: 
00045:   if (percent > 0) {
00046:     reasons.push(`Participação: ${percent.toFixed(1)}%`);
00047:   }
00048: 
00049:   switch (level) {
00050:     case "very_high":
00051:       reasons.push("Frequência muito elevada.");
00052:       break;
00053: 
00054:     case "high":
00055:       reasons.push("Frequência elevada.");
00056:       break;
00057: 
00058:     case "medium":
00059:       reasons.push("Frequência intermediária.");
00060:       break;
00061: 
00062:     case "low":
00063:       reasons.push("Frequência baixa.");
00064:       break;
00065: 
00066:     default:
00067:       reasons.push("Pouca evidência de frequência.");
00068:   }
00069: 
00070:   return reasons;
00071: }
00072: 
00073: function buildFrequencyEvidence(item = {}, context = {}) {
00074:   const frequency = normalize(
00075:     item.frequency ??
00076:     item.total ??
00077:     item.count ??
00078:     item.appearances
00079:   );
00080: 
00081:   const totalUniverse = normalize(
00082:     context.totalDraws ??
00083:     context.windowSize ??
00084:     context.sampleSize
00085:   );
00086: 
00087:   const percent =
00088:     totalUniverse > 0
00089:       ? normalizePercent((frequency / totalUniverse) * 100)
00090:       : normalizePercent(
00091:           item.frequencyPercent ??
00092:           item.frequencyRate
00093:         );
00094: 
00095:   const level = classifyFrequency(percent);
00096: 
00097:   return {
00098:     module: "frequency",
00099: 
00100:     value: percent,
00101: 
00102:     evidence: {
00103:       frequency,
00104:       percent,
00105:       level,
00106:       totalUniverse,
00107: 
00108:       window: context.window || null,
00109:       lotteryKey: context.lotteryKey || null,
00110:       position: context.position || null,
00111:       weekday: context.weekday || null,
00112:       hour: context.hour || null,
00113:     },
00114: 
00115:     reasons: buildReasons(frequency, percent, level),
00116:   };
00117: }
00118: 
00119: module.exports = {
00120:   buildFrequencyEvidence,
00121: };

00005: function normalizeWeekday(value) {
00006:   if (value == null) return null;
00007: 
00008:   const map = {
00009:     domingo:0,
00010:     segunda:1,
00011:     terca:2,
00012:     terça:2,
00013:     quarta:3,
00014:     quinta:4,
00015:     sexta:5,
00016:     sabado:6,
00017:     sábado:6,
00018:   };
00019: 
00020:   const s = String(value).trim().toLowerCase();
00021:   return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(map, s) ? map[s] : null;
00022: }
00023: 
00024: function getWeekday(ymd) {
00025:   const d = new Date(`${ymd}T12:00:00-03:00`);
00026:   return d.getDay();
00027: }
00028: 
00029: /**
00030:  * Query Engine
00031:  *
00032:  * Futuras otimizações:
00033:  * - cache por consulta
00034:  * - paginação
00035:  * - consultas paralelas
00036:  * - filtros compostos
00037:  */
00038: async function queryOccurrences({
00039:   lotteryKey,
00040:   entityType,
00041:   entityValue,
00042:   filters = {},
00043:   limitSamples = 20,
00044: } = {}) {
00045: 
00046:   if (!lotteryKey) throw new Error("lotteryKey obrigatório");
00047:   if (!entityType) throw new Error("entityType obrigatório");
00048: 
00049:   const db = getDb();
00050: 
00051:   let q = db.collection("draws")
00052:     .where("lottery_key","==",lotteryKey);
00053: 
00054:   if (filters.closeHour) {
00055:     q = q.where("close_hour","==",filters.closeHour);
00056:   }
00057: 
00058:   const draws = await q.get();
00059: 
00060:   const cache = {
00061:     draws: draws.size,
00062:     analyzed: 0,
00063:     matched: 0,
00064:   };
00065: 
00066: 
00067:   const wantedWeekday = normalizeWeekday(filters.weekday);
00068: 
00069:   let drawsAnalyzed = 0;
00070:   let occurrences = 0;
00071:   const matches = [];
00072: 
00073:   for (const draw of draws.docs) {
00074: 
00075:     const data = draw.data();
00076: 
00077:     if (wantedWeekday !== null) {
00078:       if (getWeekday(data.ymd) !== wantedWeekday) {
00079:         continue;
00080:       }
00081:     }
00082: 
00083:     drawsAnalyzed++;
00084:     cache.analyzed++;
00085: 
00086: 
00087:     let prizesQuery = draw.ref.collection("prizes");
00088: 
00089:     if (filters.position != null) {
00090:       prizesQuery = prizesQuery.where("position","==",Number(filters.position));
00091:     }
00092:

00006: /**
00007:  * Score Engine V2 inicial
00008:  *
00009:  * Consome evidências.
00010:  * Não aplica regra cega isolada.
00011:  */
00012: 
00013: function normalizeEvidenceValue(value) {
00014:   const n = Number(value);
00015:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
00016:   return n;
00017: }
00018: 
00019: function calculateEvidenceStrength(evidenceList = []) {
00020:   const list = Array.isArray(evidenceList) ? evidenceList : [];
00021: 
00022:   if (!list.length) {
00023:     return {
00024:       score: 0,
00025:       confidence: 0,
00026:       reasons: ["Sem evidências suficientes."],
00027:       signals: {},
00028:     };
00029:   }
00030: 
00031:   const values = list.map((e) => normalizeEvidenceValue(e.value));
00032:   const total = values.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
00033:   const max = Math.max(...values, 1);
00034: 
00035:   const score = Math.min(100, Math.round((total / max) * 50));
00036:   const confidence = Math.min(100, Math.round(score * Math.min(1, list.length / 3)));
00037: 
00038:   const reasons = list.flatMap((e) => Array.isArray(e.reasons) ? e.reasons : []);
00039: 
00040:   const signals = {};
00041:   for (const e of list) {
00042:     signals[e.module] = e.evidence || {};
00043:   }
00044: 
00045:   return {
00046:     score,
00047:     confidence,
00048:     reasons,
00049:     signals,
00050:   };
00051: }
00052: 
00053: function scoreItem(item = {}, context = {}) {
00054:   const collected = collectEvidence({
00055:     item,
00056:     context,
00057:     config: scoreConfig,
00058:   });
00059: 
00060:   const strength = calculateEvidenceStrength(collected.evidence);
00061: 
00062:   return {
00063:     ...item,
00064:     score: strength.score,
00065:     confidence: strength.confidence,
00066:     reasons: strength.reasons,
00067:     signals: strength.signals,
00068:     evidenceCount: collected.count,
00069:     evidenceModules: collected.modules,
00070:   };
00071: }
00072: 
00073: function scoreRanking(items = [], context = {}) {
00074: 
00075:   return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])
00076:     .map(item => scoreItem(item, context))
00077:     .sort((a, b) => {
00078: 
00079:       if (b.score !== a.score)
00080:         return b.score - a.score;
00081: 
00082:       if (b.confidence !== a.confidence)
00083:         return b.confidence - a.confidence;
00084: 
00085:       return (Number(b.scoreProb || 0) - Number(a.scoreProb || 0));
00086: 
00087:     });
00088: 
00089: }

00051:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00052:     const d = input.toDate();
00053:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00054:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00055:         d.getUTCDate()

00065:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00066:       ? Number(input.seconds)

00072:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00073:         d.getUTCDate()
00074:       )}`;

00080:       input.getUTCDate()

00147:   const ascSnap = await base
00148:     .orderBy(field, "asc")
00149:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc")
00150:     .limit(scanLimit)
00151:     .get();
00152: 
00153:   const descSnap = await base
00154:     .orderBy(field, "desc")
00155:     .orderBy(DOC_ID, "desc")
00156:     .limit(scanLimit)
00157:     .get();
00158: 
00159:   if (ascSnap.empty || descSnap.empty) {
00160:     return {
00161:       ok: false,
00162:       source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
00163:     };
00164:   }
00165: 
00166:   function pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(docs, fieldName) {
00167:     for (const doc of docs || []) {
00168:       const v = doc?.data()?.[fieldName];
00169:       const y = normalizeToYMD(v);
00170: 
00171:       if (y && isISODateStrict(y)) {
00172:         return { ymd: y, docId: doc.id, raw: v };
00173:       }
00174:     }
00175: 
00176:     return { ymd: null, docId: null, raw: null };
00177:   }
00178: 
00179:   const minPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(ascSnap.docs, field);
00180:   const maxPick = pickFirstValidYmdFromDocs(descSnap.docs, field);
00181: 
00182:   return {
00183:     ok: !!(minPick.ymd && maxPick.ymd),
00184:     minYmd: minPick.ymd,
00185:     maxYmd: maxPick.ymd,
00186:     source: `where(lottery_key)+orderBy(${field})+docId(scan=${scanLimit})`,
00187:     minDocId: minPick.docId,
00188:     maxDocId: maxPick.docId,
00189:   };
00190: }

00192: /* ======================================================
00193:    FALLBACK
00194: ====================================================== */
00195: 
00196: async function fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lotteryKey, edgeLimit) {
00197:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00198: 
00199:   const base = db.collection("draws").where("lottery_key", "==", lotteryKey);
00200: 
00201:   const ascSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limit(edgeLimit).get();
00202:   const descSnap = await base.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc").limitToLast(edgeLimit).get();
00203: 
00204:   const merged = [...ascSnap.docs, ...descSnap.docs];
00205: 
00206:   const { minYmd, maxYmd } = pickMinMaxFromDocs(merged);
00207: 
00208:   return {
00209:     ok: !!(minYmd && maxYmd),
00210:     minYmd: minYmd || null,
00211:     maxYmd: maxYmd || null,
00212:     source: `fallback_edges_docId(limit=${edgeLimit})`,
00213:     sampleCount: merged.length,
00214:     firstDocId: ascSnap.docs[0]?.id || null,
00215:     lastDocId: descSnap.docs[descSnap.docs.length - 1]?.id || null,
00216:   };
00217: }

00219: /* ======================================================
00220:    COMPUTE BOUNDS
00221: ====================================================== */
00222: 
00223: async function computeBounds(db, lotteryKey, opts = {}) {
00224:   const lk = normalizeLotteryKey(lotteryKey);
00225: 
00226:   const scanLimit = Number.isFinite(Number(opts.scanLimit))
00227:     ? Math.max(10, Number(opts.scanLimit))
00228:     : 50;
00229: 
00230:   const edgeLimit = Number.isFinite(Number(opts.edgeLimit))
00231:     ? Math.max(200, Number(opts.edgeLimit))
00232:     : 800;
00233: 
00234:   let result = null;
00235:   let warn = null;
00236: 
00237:   try {
00238:     result = await tryBoundsByField(db, lk, "ymd", scanLimit);
00239:   } catch (e) {
00240:     warn = e;
00241:   }
00242: 
00243:   if (!result || !result.ok) {
00244:     try {
00245:       const r2 = await tryBoundsByField(db, lk, "date", scanLimit);
00246:       if (r2?.minYmd && r2?.maxYmd) {
00247:         result = { ...r2, source: r2.source + " (normalized)" };
00248:       }
00249:     } catch (e) {
00250:       warn = warn || e;
00251:     }
00252:   }
00253: 
00254:   if (!result || !result.ok) {
00255:     result = await fallbackBoundsByDocIdEdges(db, lk, edgeLimit);
00256:   }
00257: 
00258:   return { lk, result, warn };
00259: }

00025: function getExpectedHours(lottery, date, hasFederal) {
00026:   if (lottery !== "PT_RIO") return [];
00027: 
00028:   const dt = new Date(`${date}T12:00:00`);
00029:   const dow = dt.getDay(); // 0 = domingo
00030: 
00031:   // Domingo: só 09, 11, 14, 16
00032:   if (dow === 0) {
00033:     return ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00"];
00034:   }
00035: 
00036:   // Base fixa todos os outros dias
00037:   const expected = ["09:00", "11:00", "14:00", "16:00"];
00038: 
00039:   // 21h existe fora domingo
00040:   expected.push("21:00");
00041: 
00042:   // 18h só se NÃO tiver Federal no dia
00043:   if (!hasFederal) {
00044:     expected.push("18:00");
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   return expected.sort();
00048: }

00088: function isISODate(s) {
00089:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00090:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00091: 
00092:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00093:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00094: 
00095:   return (
00096:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00097:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00098:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00099:   );
00100: }

00102: function isHHMM(s) {
00103:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00104:   const m = str.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00105:   if (!m) return false;
00106: 
00107:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00108:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00109: 
00110:   return hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59;
00111: }

00113: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00114:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00115:   if (!s) return "";
00116: 
00117:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;
00118: 
00119:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00120:   if (m1) {
00121:     const hh = Number(m1[1]);
00122:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23) return `${String(hh).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00123:     return "";
00124:   }
00125: 
00126:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00127:   if (m2) {
00128:     const hh = Number(m2[1]);
00129:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23) return `${String(hh).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00130:     return "";
00131:   }
00132: 
00133:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00134:   if (m3) {
00135:     const hh = Number(m3[1]);
00136:     const mm = Number(m3[2]);
00137:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59) {
00138:       return `${String(hh).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(mm).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00139:     }
00140:     return "";
00141:   }
00142: 
00143:   return "";
00144: }

00188: function parsePositionsParam(v) {
00189:   const raw = String(v ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
00190:   if (!raw) return { positions: null, maxPos: null };
00191: 
00192:   const m = raw.match(/^(\d+)\s*(?:\-|\.\.)\s*(\d+)$/);
00193:   if (m) {
00194:     const a = Math.max(1, Number(m[1]));
00195:     const b = Math.max(1, Number(m[2]));
00196:     const lo = Math.min(a, b);
00197:     const hi = Math.max(a, b);
00198:     const positions = [];
00199:     for (let i = lo; i <= hi; i += 1) positions.push(i);
00200:     return { positions, maxPos: hi };
00201:   }
00202: 
00203:   const parts = raw
00204:     .split(",")
00205:     .map((s) => Number(String(s).trim()))
00206:     .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1);
00207: 
00208:   if (!parts.length) return { positions: null, maxPos: null };
00209: 
00210:   const uniq = Array.from(new Set(parts)).sort((a, b) => a - b);
00211:   return { positions: uniq, maxPos: uniq[uniq.length - 1] };
00212: }

00231: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00232:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00233:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00234:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00235:   let idx = 0;
00236: 
00237:   async function worker() {
00238:     while (true) {
00239:       const current = idx;
00240:       idx += 1;
00241:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00242:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00243:     }
00244:   }
00245: 
00246:   await Promise.all(
00247:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00248:   );
00249: 
00250:   return results;
00251: }

00433: async function handleDay(req, res) {
00434:   try {
00435:     const db = getDb();
00436: 
00437:     const date = String(req.query.date || "").trim();
00438:     const lottery = getLotteryFromQuery(req);
00439: 
00440:     if (!requireLotteryOr400(lottery, res)) return;
00441:

00443:       return res.status(400).json({
00444:         ok: false,
00445:         error: "Parâmetro inválido: date (use YYYY-MM-DD)",
00446:       });
00447:     }
00448: 
00449:     const win = getWindowFromQuery(req);
00450:     if (win.error) return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: win.error });

00453:     const positionsInfo = parsePositionsParam(req.query.positions);

00457:     const hasFederal = hasFederalInDraws(rawDraws);

00459:     const byLottery = applyLotteryFilter(rawDraws, lottery).sort(sortDrawsByHourOnly);
00460:     const drawsWindow = applyHourWindow(byLottery, win.from || "", win.to || "");
00461:     const draws = await loadPrizesForDraws(db, drawsWindow, includePrizes, positionsInfo);
00462:

00464:

00467:       mode: "day",
00468:       integrity,
00469:       date,
00470:       lottery,
00471:       from: win.from || null,
00472:       to: win.to || null,
00473:       includePrizes,
00474:       count: draws.length,
00475:       draws,
00476:     });
00477:   } catch (e) {
00478:     return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: e?.message || "erro" });
00479:   }
00480: }

00482: async function handleRange(req, res) {
00483:   try {
00484:     const db = getDb();
00485: 
00486:     const dateFrom = String(req.query.dateFrom || "").trim();
00487:     const dateTo = String(req.query.dateTo || "").trim();
00488:     const lottery = getLotteryFromQuery(req);
00489: 
00490:     if (!requireLotteryOr400(lottery, res)) return;
00491: 
00492:     if (!isISODate(dateFrom) || !isISODate(dateTo)) {
00493:       return res.status(400).json({
00494:         ok: false,
00495:         error: "Parâmetro inválido: dateFrom/dateTo (use YYYY-MM-DD)",
00496:       });
00497:     }
00498: 
00499:     if (dateFrom > dateTo) {
00500:       return res.status(400).json({
00501:         ok: false,
00502:         error: "Parâmetro inválido: dateFrom não pode ser maior que dateTo",
00503:       });
00504:     }
00505: 
00506:     const win = getWindowFromQuery(req);
00507:     if (win.error) return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: win.error });
00508: 
00509:     const includePrizes = parseIncludePrizes(req.query.includePrizes, false);
00510:     const positionsInfo = parsePositionsParam(req.query.positions);
00511: 
00512:     const snap = await db
00513:       .collection("draws")
00514:       .where("ymd", ">=", dateFrom)
00515:       .where("ymd", "<=", dateTo)
00516:       .orderBy("ymd", "asc")
00517:       .get();
00518: 
00519:     const rawDraws = snap.docs.map(normalizeDrawDoc);
00520:     const byLottery = applyLotteryFilter(rawDraws, lottery).sort(sortDrawsByDateThenHour);
00521:     const drawsWindow = applyHourWindow(byLottery, win.from || "", win.to || "");
00522:     const draws = await loadPrizesForDraws(db, drawsWindow, includePrizes, positionsInfo);
00523: 
00524:     const groupedIntegrity = {};
00525:     if (lottery === "PT_RIO") {
00526:       const rawByDay = rawDraws.reduce((acc, d) => {
00527:         const ymd = String(d.ymd || d.date || "").trim();
00528:         if (!ymd) return acc;
00529:         if (!acc[ymd]) acc[ymd] = [];
00530:         acc[ymd].push(d);
00531:         return acc;
00532:       }, {});
00533: 
00534:       const filteredByDay = draws.reduce((acc, d) => {
00535:         const ymd = String(d.ymd || d.date || "").trim();
00536:         if (!ymd) return acc;
00537:         if (!acc[ymd]) acc[ymd] = [];
00538:         acc[ymd].push(d);
00539:         return acc;
00540:       }, {});
00541: 
00542:       const allDays = Array.from(
00543:         new Set([
00544:           ...Object.keys(rawByDay),
00545:           ...Object.keys(filteredByDay),
00546:         ])
00547:       ).sort();
00548: 
00549:       for (const ymd of allDays) {
00550:         const dayRaw = rawByDay[ymd] || [];
00551:         const dayFiltered = filteredByDay[ymd] || [];
00552:         const hasFederal = hasFederalInDraws(dayRaw);
00553:         groupedIntegrity[ymd] = checkDrawIntegrity(dayFiltered, lottery, ymd, hasFederal);
00554:       }
00555:     }
00556: 
00557:     return res.json({
00558:       ok: true,
00559:       mode: "range",
00560:       integrityByDay: groupedIntegrity,
00561:       dateFrom,
00562:       dateTo,
00563:       lottery,
00564:       from: win.from || null,
00565:       to: win.to || null,
00566:       includePrizes,
00567:       count: draws.length,
00568:       draws,
00569:     });
00570:   } catch (e) {
00571:     return res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: e?.message || "erro" });
00572:   }
00573: }

00446: function readGapsMap(lottery, opts) {
00447:   const key = upTrim(lottery || "PT_RIO") || "PT_RIO";
00448:   const reload = !!(opts && opts.reload);

00450:   const cached = _gapsCache.get(key);
00451:   if (!reload && cached && Date.now() - cached.loadedAt < GAPS_TTL_MS) {
00452:     return cached.map;

00455:   const p = path.join(DEFAULT_GAPS_DIR, `${key}.json`);
00456:   let map = {};

00458:     if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
00459:       const raw = fs.readFileSync(p, "utf8");
00460:       const j = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
00461:       if (j && typeof j === "object") map = j;
00462:     }
00463:   } catch {
00464:     map = {};
00465:   }

00501: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00502:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00503:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00504:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00505:   let idx = 0;
00506: 
00507:   async function worker() {
00508:     while (true) {
00509:       const current = idx;
00510:       idx += 1;
00511:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00512:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00513:     }
00514:   }
00515: 
00516:   await Promise.all(
00517:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00518:   );
00519:   return results;
00520: }

00526: function buildCalendarStatus({ slotsSummary, blocked = false, blockedReason = "", isToday = false }) {
00527:   const expected = Number(slotsSummary?.expectedTotal || 0);
00528:   const found = Number(slotsSummary?.foundTotal || 0);
00529:   const missing = Number(slotsSummary?.missingTotal || 0);
00530: 
00531:   let status = "empty";
00532:   if (blocked) status = blockedReason === "future_date" ? "future" : "blocked";
00533:   else if (isToday && missing > 0) status = "pending";
00534:   else if (expected > 0 && missing === 0) status = "complete";
00535:   else if (found > 0 && missing > 0) status = "partial";
00536:   else if (expected > 0 && found === 0) status = "empty";
00537: 
00538:   return {
00539:     status,
00540:     expected,
00541:     found,
00542:     missing,
00543:     completionPct: Number(slotsSummary?.completionPct ?? 0),
00544:   };
00545: }

00547: function buildSlots(opts) {
00548:   const {
00549:     scheduleAll,
00550:     byHour,
00551:     baseSoft,
00552:     removedHardApplied,
00553:     removedSoftApplied,
00554:     expectedHard,
00555:     expectedSoft,
00556:     expectedHardPublished,
00557:     expectedSoftPublished,
00558:     capToday,
00559:     isToday,
00560:     nowMinBR,
00561:     slotGraceMin,
00562:   } = opts || {};
00563: 
00564:   return (Array.isArray(scheduleAll) ? scheduleAll : []).map((hh) => {
00565:     const draw = byHour?.get ? byHour.get(hh) || null : null;
00566: 
00567:     const isSoft = Array.isArray(baseSoft) && baseSoft.includes(hh);
00568:     const kind = isSoft ? "soft" : "hard";
00569: 
00570:     if (removedHardApplied?.has?.(hh) || removedSoftApplied?.has?.(hh)) {
00571:       return { hour: hh, kind, status: "gap", reason: "source_gap", draw: null };
00572:     }
00573: 
00574:     if (draw) return { hour: hh, kind, status: "valid", draw };
00575: 
00576:     if (
00577:       capToday &&
00578:       isToday &&
00579:       ((expectedHard && expectedHard.includes(hh)) || (expectedSoft && expectedSoft.includes(hh)))
00580:     ) {
00581:       const published = isSlotPublishedToday(hh, nowMinBR, slotGraceMin);
00582:       if (!published) {
00583:         return { hour: hh, kind, status: "future", reason: "not_yet_published", draw: null };
00584:       }
00585:     }
00586: 
00587:     if (expectedHardPublished && expectedHardPublished.includes(hh)) {
00588:       return { hour: hh, kind: "hard", status: "missing", draw: null };
00589:     }
00590:     if (expectedSoftPublished && expectedSoftPublished.includes(hh)) {
00591:       return { hour: hh, kind: "soft", status: "soft_missing", draw: null };
00592:     }
00593: 
00594:     return { hour: hh, kind, status: "gap", reason: "not_expected", draw: null };
00595:   });
00596: }

00008: /**
00009:  * Helpers (robustos e previsíveis)
00010:  */
00011: function pad2(n) {
00012:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00013: }
00014: 
00015: function isISODate(s) {
00016:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00017:   const m = str.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
00018:   if (!m) return false;
00019: 
00020:   const y = Number(m[1]);
00021:   const mo = Number(m[2]);
00022:   const d = Number(m[3]);
00023: 
00024:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, mo - 1, d));
00025:   return (
00026:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00027:     dt.getUTCMonth() === mo - 1 &&
00028:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00029:   );
00030: }
00031: 
00032: function isHHMM(s) {
00033:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00034:   const m = str.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00035:   if (!m) return false;
00036: 
00037:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00038:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00039: 
00040:   return hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59;
00041: }
00042: 
00043: // aceita "21", "21h", "21:0", "21:00"
00044: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00045:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00046:   if (!s) return "";
00047: 
00048:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;
00049: 
00050:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00051:   if (m1) {
00052:     const hh = Number(m1[1]);
00053:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23) return `${pad2(hh)}:00`;
00054:     return "";
00055:   }
00056: 
00057:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00058:   if (m2) {
00059:     const hh = Number(m2[1]);
00060:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23) return `${pad2(hh)}:00`;
00061:     return "";
00062:   }
00063: 
00064:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00065:   if (m3) {
00066:     const hh = Number(m3[1]);
00067:     const mm = Number(m3[2]);
00068:     if (hh >= 0 && hh <= 23 && mm >= 0 && mm <= 59) {
00069:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${pad2(mm)}`;
00070:     }
00071:     return "";
00072:   }
00073: 
00074:   return "";
00075: }
00076: 
00077: function normalizeLotteryKey(v) {
00078:   const s = String(v ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
00079: 
00080:   if (s === "RJ" || s === "RIO" || s === "PT-RIO" || s === "PT_RIO") return "PT_RIO";
00081:   if (s === "FED" || s === "FEDERAL" || s === "BR") return "FEDERAL";
00082: 
00083:   return "";
00084: }

00009: function isISODate(s) {
00010:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00011:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00012: 
00013:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00014:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00015: 
00016:   return (
00017:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00018:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00019:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00020:   );
00021: }

00023: function ymdInTimeZone(date, timeZone = "America/Sao_Paulo") {
00024:   if (!(date instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
00025: 
00026:   try {
00027:     const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
00028:       timeZone,
00029:       year: "numeric",
00030:       month: "2-digit",
00031:       day: "2-digit",
00032:     }).formatToParts(date);
00033: 
00034:     const y = parts.find((p) => p.type === "year")?.value;
00035:     const m = parts.find((p) => p.type === "month")?.value;
00036:     const d = parts.find((p) => p.type === "day")?.value;
00037: 
00038:     if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
00039:     const out = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
00040:     return isISODate(out) ? out : null;
00041:   } catch {
00042:     // fallback local timezone do servidor (menos ideal)
00043:     const y = date.getFullYear();
00044:     const m = pad2(date.getMonth() + 1);
00045:     const d = pad2(date.getDate());
00046:     const out = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
00047:     return isISODate(out) ? out : null;
00048:   }
00049: }

00051: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00052:   if (input == null) return null;
00053: 
00054:   // Firestore Timestamp (admin) / FieldValue com toDate()
00055:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00056:     const d = input.toDate();
00057:     return ymdInTimeZone(d, "America/Sao_Paulo");
00058:   }
00059: 
00060:   // Timestamp-like {seconds} ou {_seconds}
00061:   if (
00062:     typeof input === "object" &&
00063:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
00064:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00065:   ) {
00066:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00067:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00068:       : Number(input._seconds);
00069: 
00070:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00071:     return ymdInTimeZone(d, "America/Sao_Paulo");
00072:   }
00073: 
00074:   // Date
00075:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00076:     return ymdInTimeZone(input, "America/Sao_Paulo");
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   // String
00080:   const s = String(input || "").trim();
00081:   if (!s) return null;
00082: 
00083:   // ISO (aceita com hora, mas valida o dia)
00084:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00085:   if (iso) {
00086:     const out = `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00087:     return isISODate(out) ? out : null;
00088:   }
00089: 
00090:   // BR dd/mm/yyyy
00091:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00092:   if (br) {
00093:     const out = `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00094:     return isISODate(out) ? out : null;
00095:   }
00096: 
00097:   return null;
00098: }

00007: /**
00008:  * Formata Date -> YYYY-MM-DD no timezone informado (padrão: America/Sao_Paulo).
00009:  * Evita “virada de dia” quando o servidor roda em UTC mas o dado é local (BRT).
00010:  */
00011: function formatDateToYMDInTZ(date, timeZone = "America/Sao_Paulo") {
00012:   if (!(date instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return null;
00013: 
00014:   // formatToParts => { year, month, day } no TZ pedido
00015:   const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
00016:     timeZone,
00017:     year: "numeric",
00018:     month: "2-digit",
00019:     day: "2-digit",
00020:   }).formatToParts(date);
00021: 
00022:   const map = Object.fromEntries(parts.map((p) => [p.type, p.value]));
00023:   const y = map.year, m = map.month, d = map.day;
00024:   if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
00025:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
00026: }
00027: 
00028: function isISODateStrict(s) {
00029:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00030:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00031:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00032:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00033:   return dt.getUTCFullYear() === y && dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 && dt.getUTCDate() === d;
00034: }
00035: 
00036: function normalizeToYMD(input, timeZone = "America/Sao_Paulo") {
00037:   if (!input) return null;
00038: 
00039:   // Firestore Timestamp (admin.firestore.Timestamp)
00040:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00041:     const d = input.toDate();
00042:     const ymd = formatDateToYMDInTZ(d, timeZone);
00043:     if (ymd) return ymd;
00044:   }
00045: 
00046:   // objetos {seconds} / {_seconds}
00047:   if (
00048:     typeof input === "object" &&
00049:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00050:   ) {
00051:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ? Number(input.seconds) : Number(input._seconds);
00052:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00053:     const ymd = formatDateToYMDInTZ(d, timeZone);
00054:     if (ymd) return ymd;
00055:   }
00056: 
00057:   // Date
00058:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00059:     const ymd = formatDateToYMDInTZ(input, timeZone);
00060:     if (ymd) return ymd;
00061:   }
00062: 
00063:   // strings
00064:   const s = String(input || "").trim();
00065:   if (!s) return null;
00066: 
00067:   // ISO com ou sem hora: pega só YYYY-MM-DD do começo
00068:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00069:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00070: 
00071:   // BR: DD/MM/YYYY
00072:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00073:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00074: 
00075:   return null;
00076: }

00155: async function fetchRowsForRange(db, { lotteryKey, fromYmd, toYmd, pageSize = 2000, maxPages = 80 } = {}) {
00156:   const lot = lotteryKey ? String(lotteryKey).trim().toUpperCase() : null;
00157: 
00158:   // 1) tentativa indexada (aceita range parcial)
00159:   try {
00160:     let q = db.collection("draws");
00161:     if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00162:     if (fromYmd) q = q.where("ymd", ">=", fromYmd);
00163:     if (toYmd) q = q.where("ymd", "<=", toYmd);
00164: 
00165:     const snap = await q.get();
00166:     const rows = snap.docs.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, ...(d.data() || {}) }));
00167:     return { rows, source: "query: where(lottery_key)+where(ymd>=/<=)", usedFallback: false };
00168:   } catch (e) {
00169:     if (!isIndexError(e)) throw e;
00170:   }
00171: 
00172:   // 2) fallback sem índice: pagina por docId e filtra em memória
00173:   const DOC_ID = admin.firestore.FieldPath.documentId();
00174:   let q = db.collection("draws");
00175:   if (lot) q = q.where("lottery_key", "==", lot);
00176:   q = q.orderBy(DOC_ID, "asc");
00177: 
00178:   let last = null;
00179:   const out = [];
00180: 
00181:   for (let page = 1; page <= maxPages; page++) {
00182:     let qq = q.limit(pageSize);
00183:     if (last) qq = qq.startAfter(last);
00184: 
00185:     const snap = await qq.get();
00186:     if (snap.empty) break;
00187: 
00188:     for (const doc of snap.docs) {
00189:       const data = doc.data() || {};
00190:       const ymd = normalizeToYMD(data.ymd ?? data.date ?? data.draw_date ?? data.close_date ?? data.dt ?? data.data);
00191:       if (!ymd || !isISODateStrict(ymd)) continue;
00192:       if (fromYmd && ymd < fromYmd) continue;
00193:       if (toYmd && ymd > toYmd) continue;
00194:       out.push({ id: doc.id, ...data });
00195:     }
00196: 
00197:     last = snap.docs[snap.docs.length - 1];
00198:   }
00199: 
00200:   return { rows: out, source: "fallback: paginate by docId + filter(ymd)", usedFallback: true };
00201: }

00248:   for (const r of schedule.ranges) {

00250:     if (r.from <= ymd && (r.to == null || ymd <= r.to)) {
00251:       picked = r;
00252:     }
00253:   }
00254:   return picked;
00255: }
00256: 
00257: function expectedHoursFromSchedule(schedule, ymd, dow) {
00258:   const r = pickRangeForDate(schedule, ymd);
00259:   if (!r) return null;
00260: 
00261:   const dd = String(dow);
00262:   const rule = r.dow?.[dd] || r.dow?.[Number(dd)] || null;
00263: 
00264:   if (!rule || typeof rule !== "object") {
00265:     return {
00266:       expectedHard: [],
00267:       expectedSoft: [],
00268:       mode: "schedule",
00269:       range: { from: r.from, to: r.to },
00270:     };
00271:   }
00272: 
00273:   const expectedHard = normalizeHourList(rule.hard);
00274:   const expectedSoft = normalizeHourList(rule.soft);
00275: 
00276:   return {
00277:     expectedHard,
00278:     expectedSoft,
00279:     mode: "schedule",
00280:     range: { from: r.from, to: r.to },
00281:   };
00282: }

00284: // =====================
00285: // ✅ SCHEDULE DIGEST (não infla JSON)
00286: // =====================
00287: function buildScheduleDigestFromFileOrNull(scheduleFile) {
00288:   try {
00289:     const sf = String(scheduleFile || "").trim();
00290:     if (!sf || !fs.existsSync(sf)) return null;
00291: 
00292:     const raw = safeReadJson(sf, null);
00293:     if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
00294: 
00295:     const ranges = Array.isArray(raw.ranges) ? raw.ranges : [];
00296:     const oneoffs = [];
00297:     let hardSlotsTotal = 0;
00298:     let softSlotsTotal = 0;
00299: 
00300:     for (const r of ranges) {
00301:       if (r && r.from && r.to && String(r.from) === String(r.to) && isISODate(r.from)) {
00302:         oneoffs.push(String(r.from));
00303:       }
00304: 
00305:       const dow = r && typeof r.dow === "object" && r.dow ? r.dow : {};
00306:       for (const k of Object.keys(dow)) {
00307:         const obj = dow[k] || {};
00308:         const h = Array.isArray(obj.hard) ? obj.hard : [];
00309:         const s = Array.isArray(obj.soft) ? obj.soft : [];
00310:         hardSlotsTotal += h.length;
00311:         softSlotsTotal += s.length;
00312:       }
00313:     }
00314: 
00315:     const stat = fs.statSync(sf);
00316:     const uniqOneoffs = Array.from(new Set(oneoffs)).sort();
00317: 
00318:     return {
00319:       rangesCount: ranges.length,
00320:       oneOffCount: uniqOneoffs.length,
00321:       oneOffDays: uniqOneoffs,
00322:       hardSlotsTotal,
00323:       softSlotsTotal,
00324:       file: sf,
00325:       mtimeMs: Number(stat.mtimeMs || 0),
00326:     };
00327:   } catch {
00328:     return null;
00329:   }
00330: }
00331: 
00332: // =====================
00333: // ✅ GAPS (API_NO_SLOT)
00334: // =====================
00335: function loadGapsOrNull(lotteryKey, gapsFileArg) {
00336:   const gapsFile =
00337:     String(gapsFileArg || "").trim() ||
00338:     path.join(DEFAULT_GAPS_DIR, `${lotteryKey}.json`);
00339: 
00340:   if (!fs.existsSync(gapsFile)) return { gaps: null, gapsFile };
00341: 
00342:   const gaps = safeReadJson(gapsFile, null);
00343:   if (!gaps || typeof gaps !== "object") return { gaps: null, gapsFile };
00344: 
00345:   const lk = String(gaps.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00346:   if (lk && lk !== lotteryKey) return { gaps: null, gapsFile };
00347: 
00348:   const gapsByDay =
00349:     gaps.gapsByDay && typeof gaps.gapsByDay === "object" ? gaps.gapsByDay : {};
00350: 
00351:   gaps.lotteryKey = lotteryKey;
00352:   gaps.gapsByDay = gapsByDay;
00353: 
00354:   return { gaps, gapsFile };
00355: }
00356: 
00357: function gapSetForDate(gaps, ymd) {
00358:   if (!gaps || !gaps.gapsByDay) return null;
00359:   const v = gaps.gapsByDay?.[ymd];
00360:   if (!v) return null;
00361: 
00362:   const set = new Set();
00363: 
00364:   const pushHour = (h) => {
00365:     const m = String(h ?? "").match(/\d{1,2}/);
00366:     if (!m) return;
00367:     const n = Number(m[0]);
00368:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 23) return;
00369:     const hh = pad2(n);
00370:     if (/^\d{2}$/.test(hh)) set.add(hh);
00371:   };
00372: 
00373:   // ✅ formato antigo: gapsByDay[ymd] = ["18","21"]
00374:   if (Array.isArray(v)) {
00375:     for (const h of v) pushHour(h);
00376:     return set.size ? set : null;
00377:   }
00378: 
00379:   // ✅ formato novo: gapsByDay[ymd] = { removedHard:[18], removedSoft:[..] }
00380:   if (v && typeof v === "object") {
00381:     const rh = Array.isArray(v.removedHard) ? v.removedHard : [];
00382:     const rs = Array.isArray(v.removedSoft) ? v.removedSoft : [];
00383:     for (const h of rh) pushHour(h);
00384:     for (const h of rs) pushHour(h);
00385:     return set.size ? set : null;
00386:   }
00387: 
00388:   return null;
00389: }
00390: 
00391: function removeGaps(expectedHard, expectedSoft, gapSet) {
00392:   if (!gapSet) return { expectedHard, expectedSoft, removedHard: 0, removedSoft: 0 };
00393: 
00394:   const hard2 = [];
00395:   let removedHard = 0;
00396:   for (const hh of expectedHard) {
00397:     if (gapSet.has(hh)) removedHard += 1;
00398:     else hard2.push(hh);
00399:   }
00400: 
00401:   const soft2 = [];
00402:   let removedSoft = 0;
00403:   for (const hh of expectedSoft) {
00404:     if (gapSet.has(hh)) removedSoft += 1;
00405:     else soft2.push(hh);
00406:   }
00407: 
00408:   return { expectedHard: hard2, expectedSoft: soft2, removedHard, removedSoft };
00409: }
00410: 
00411: // =====================
00412: // ✅ NO_DRAW (holiday_no_draw / blocked)
00413: // =====================
00414: function loadNoDrawOrNull(lotteryKey, noDrawFileArg) {
00415:   const noDrawFile =
00416:     String(noDrawFileArg || "").trim() ||
00417:     path.join(DEFAULT_NO_DRAW_DIR, `${lotteryKey}.json`);
00418: 
00419:   if (!fs.existsSync(noDrawFile)) return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00420: 
00421:   const noDraw = safeReadJson(noDrawFile, null);
00422:   if (!noDraw || typeof noDraw !== "object") return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00423: 
00424:   const lk = String(noDraw.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00425:   if (lk && lk !== lotteryKey) return { noDraw: null, noDrawFile };
00426: 
00427:   const daysArr = Array.isArray(noDraw.days) ? noDraw.days : [];
00428:   const set = new Set();
00429:   for (const d of daysArr) {
00430:     const ymd = String(d || "").trim();
00431:     if (isISODate(ymd)) set.add(ymd);
00432:   }
00433: 
00434:   noDraw.lotteryKey = lotteryKey;
00435:   noDraw.days = Array.from(set).sort();
00436: 
00437:   return { noDraw: { daysSet: set, days: noDraw.days }, noDrawFile };
00438: }
00439: 
00440: function noDrawSetHas(noDraw, ymd) {
00441:   if (!noDraw || !noDraw.daysSet) return false;
00442:   return noDraw.daysSet.has(ymd);
00443: }

00445: // =====================
00446: // Time helpers (local)
00447: // =====================
00448: function getLocalYmd(d) {
00449:   const x = d ? new Date(d) : new Date();
00450:   return `${x.getFullYear()}-${pad2(x.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(x.getDate())}`;
00451: }
00452: function getLocalNowMinutes(d) {
00453:   const x = d ? new Date(d) : new Date();
00454:   return x.getHours() * 60 + x.getMinutes();
00455: }
00456: function hourToMinutes(h) {
00457:   const n = Number(h);
00458:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n * 60 : NaN;
00459: }
00460: 
00461: // ✅ NOVO: parse "HH:mm" -> minutos
00462: function parseHmToMinutes(hm) {
00463:   const s = String(hm || "").trim();
00464:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
00465:   if (!m) return null;
00466:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00467:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00468:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;
00469:   if (hh < 0 || hh > 23 || mm < 0 || mm > 59) return null;
00470:   return hh * 60 + mm;
00471: }

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }
00037:

00075: async function main() {

00022: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00023:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00024:   if (/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(s)) return s;
00025: 
00026:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00027:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00028: 
00029:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00030:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00031: 
00032:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00033:   if (m3) return `${String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0")}`;
00034: 
00035:   return "";
00036: }

00063:

00101:   return list[0] || null;

00104: async function auditDate(date) {
00105:   const payload = await fetchKingResults({ date, lotteryKey: LOTTERY_KEY });
00106:   const sourceDraws = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [];
00107:

00710: async function verifySlotPersistedViaBackend({ date, slotHHMM }) {

00716:       timeout: 15000,
00717:       validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00718:       headers: { "User-Agent": "palpitaco-autoImportToday" },
00719:     });

00729:     const hh = hhFromSlotHHMM(slotHHMM);

00732:       const v = (s && (s.hour || s.close_hour || s.closeHour || s.close || s.slot || s.time || s.close_hour_raw)) ?? "";
00733:       const t = String(v).trim();
00734:       return t.startsWith(hh);
00735:     });
00736:

00738: 
00739:     return { ok: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND", drawsCount: draws.length, slotsCount: slots.length };
00740:   } catch (e) {
00741:     const code = e?.code || e?.cause?.code || "";
00742:     const msg = e?.message || e?.cause?.message || String(e);

00181: function pickLogFile({ kind, lottery, start, end }) {
00182:   const lot = String(lottery || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00183:   const s = String(start || "").trim();
00184:   const e = String(end || "").trim();
00185: 
00186:   const dir = LOG_DIR;
00187:   const files = listFilesSafe(dir);
00188:   if (!files.length) return null;
00189: 
00190:   // e.g. auditSlots-PT_RIO-2022-06-07_to_2026-02-28.json
00191:   const baseRe = new RegExp(
00192:     `^${kind}-${lot}-\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}_to_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.json$`,
00193:     "i"
00194:   );
00195: 
00196:   const candidates = files
00197:     .filter((f) => baseRe.test(f))
00198:     .map((f) => {
00199:       const m = f.match(
00200:         new RegExp(`^${kind}-${lot}-(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})_to_(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})\\.json$`, "i")
00201:       );
00202:       const fStart = m?.[1] || "";
00203:       const fEnd = m?.[2] || "";
00204:       const full = path.join(dir, f);
00205:       return { f, full, fStart, fEnd, mtimeMs: statMtimeMsSafe(full) };
00206:     });
00207: 
00208:   if (!candidates.length) return null;
00209: 
00210:   // 1) match exato
00211:   const exact = candidates.filter((c) => c.fStart === s && c.fEnd === e);
00212:   if (exact.length) {
00213:     exact.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);
00214:     return exact[0].full;
00215:   }
00216: 
00217:   // 2) fallback: mais recente (do lottery)
00218:   candidates.sort((a, b) => b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs);
00219:   return candidates[0].full;
00220: }

00007: function isYmdStrict(s) {
00008:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00009:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00010: 
00011:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map((n) => Number(n));
00012:   if (!Number.isFinite(y) || !Number.isFinite(m) || !Number.isFinite(d)) return false;
00013:   if (m < 1 || m > 12) return false;
00014:   if (d < 1 || d > 31) return false;
00015: 
00016:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00017:   return (
00018:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00019:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00020:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00021:   );
00022: }

00028: function pickYmd(item) {

00032:     const s = slice10(item);
00033:     return isYmdStrict(s) ? s : null;
00034:   }
00035:

00037:     if (!item.length) return null;

00039:     return isYmdStrict(s) ? s : null;

00047:       item.d ??

00053:     return isYmdStrict(s) ? s : null;
00054:   }
00055: 
00056:   return null;
00057: }

00074:       h -= 1;
00075:       m += 60;

00079:     }

00082:

00084:   }

00214: function resolveUfFromLotteryKey(lotteryKey) {
00215:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00216:   if (!lk) return null;
00217:   if (lk === RJ_LOTTERY_KEY) return RJ_STATE_CODE;
00218:   if (lk === FEDERAL_LOTTERY_KEY) return FEDERAL_STATE_CODE;
00219:   // se for uma UF padrão de 2 letras (SP, MG, DF etc.), preserva
00220:   if (/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(lk)) return lk;
00221: 
00222:   // fallback: não inventa UF
00223:   return null;

00236: function todayYMDLocal() {
00237:   try {
00238:     const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
00239:       timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo",
00240:       year: "numeric",
00241:       month: "2-digit",
00242:       day: "2-digit",
00243:     });
00244:     return fmt.format(new Date()); // YYYY-MM-DD
00245:   } catch {
00246:     const d = new Date();
00247:     return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
00248:   }
00249: }

00296: /** Regra do Jogo do Bicho: dezena 00 => grupo 25; senão ceil(dezena/4) */
00297: function dezenaToGrupo(dezena2) {
00298:   const n = Number(dezena2);
00299:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return null;
00300:   if (n === 0) return 25;
00301:   return Math.ceil(n / 4);
00302: }

00304: function normalizePrize(raw) {
00305:   const milhar = pad4(raw);
00306:   const centena = milhar.slice(-3);
00307:   const dezena = milhar.slice(-2);
00308:   const grupo = dezenaToGrupo(dezena);
00309:   const animal = grupo ? GRUPO_TO_ANIMAL[grupo] : null;
00310:   return { raw: String(raw), milhar, centena, dezena, grupo, animal };

00313: function isISODate(s) {
00314:   return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
00315: }

00317: function isHHMM(s) {
00318:   return /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(String(s || "").trim());
00319: }
00320: 
00321: /**
00322:  * Normaliza horário para HH:MM (raw)
00323:  * Aceita: "10", "10h", "10:9", "10:09"
00324:  */
00325: function normalizeHHMM(value) {
00326:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00327:   if (!s) return "";
00328: 
00329:   if (isHHMM(s)) return s;
00330: 
00331:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00332:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00333: 
00334:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00335:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00336: 
00337:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00338:   if (m3) {
00339:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00340:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00341:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00342:   }
00343: 
00344:   return "";
00345: }
00346: 
00347: /**
00348:  * ✅ Normaliza close_hour para SLOT (campo de negócio)
00349:  * - Para PT_RIO: força minutos = 00 (09:09 -> 09:00)
00350:  * - Para outros: preserva raw
00351:  *
00352:  * Correção crítica:
00353:  * - A API do PT_RIO costuma devolver HH:09 como "marcação" e NÃO um minuto real.
00354:  * - Portanto, para PT_RIO, se raw terminar em ":09", tratamos como "sem minuto real"
00355:  *   e NÃO persistimos close_hour_raw (vira "").
00356:  *
00357:  * Retorna:
00358:  * - raw: HH:MM (normalizado) OU "" quando for "sintético" (PT_RIO HH:09)
00359:  * - slot: HH:MM (normalizado para o que o sistema deve usar em consultas/ID)
00360:  */
00361: function normalizeCloseHourForLottery(value, lotteryKey) {
00362:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00363:   const raw0 = normalizeHHMM(value);
00364:   if (!raw0 || !isHHMM(raw0)) return { raw: "", slot: "" };
00365: 
00366:   // ✅ FEDERAL: slot de negócio é sempre 20:00, mas preserva o raw
00367:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00368:     return { raw: raw0, slot: "20:00" };
00369:   }
00370: 
00371:   if (lk === "PT_RIO") {
00372:     const hh = raw0.slice(0, 2);
00373:     const mm = raw0.slice(3, 5);
00374: 
00375:     // ✅ se vier HH:09, é marcação (não minuto real) -> não grava close_hour_raw
00376:     const raw = mm === "09" ? "" : raw0;
00377:     return { raw, slot: `${hh}:00` };
00378:   }
00379: 
00380:   return { raw: raw0, slot: raw0 };
00381: }
00382: 
00383: /**
00384:  * ✅ Normaliza o parâmetro closeHour (do CLI/scheduler) e evita log enganoso.
00385:  * - Para FEDERAL: qualquer coisa vira slot=20:00, mas mantemos "requested" para log.
00386:  */
00387: function normalizeRequestedCloseHour(closeHour, lotteryKey) {
00388:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00389:   const requested = closeHour ? normalizeHHMM(closeHour) : null;
00390:   const requestedIsValid = requested ? isHHMM(requested) : false;
00391: 
00392:   if (!requested) {
00393:     return { requested: null, slot: null, note: null };
00394:   }
00395:   if (!requestedIsValid) {
00396:     return { requested, slot: null, note: "invalid" };
00397:   }
00398: 
00399:   // FEDERAL: slot único 20:00 (não fingir que o usuário pediu 20:00)
00400:   if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00401:     const slot = "20:00";
00402:     const note = requested !== slot ? `FEDERAL_slot_fixed(${requested}->${slot})` : null;
00403:     return { requested, slot, note };
00404:   }
00405: 
00406:   // outros: normalização normal por lotteryKey (PT_RIO min->00 etc.)
00407:   const slot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(requested, lk).slot;
00408:   return { requested, slot: slot || null, note: null };
00409: }

00495: function buildResultsUrl({ date, lotteryKey, lotteryId = null }) {
00496:   const base = "https://app_services.apionline.cloud/api/results";
00497:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00498:   const lotteries = LOTTERIES_BY_KEY[lk];
00499: 
00500:   if (!lotteries?.length) {
00501:     if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00502:       throw new Error(
00503:         `FEDERAL sem lotteryIds. Defina KING_LOTTERIES_FEDERAL="uuid1,uuid2,..." (ex.: o UUID do draw FEDERAL 20HS).`
00504:       );
00505:     }
00506:     throw new Error(`lotteryKey inválida: ${lk}`);
00507:   }
00508: 
00509:   const params = new URLSearchParams();
00510:   params.append("dates[]", date);
00511: 
00512:   // ✅ se lotteryId for fornecido -> 1 request por lottery
00513:   if (lotteryId) {
00514:     params.append("lotteries[]", lotteryId);
00515:     return `${base}?${params.toString()}`;
00516:   }
00517: 
00518:   // modo antigo (todos lotteries no mesmo request)
00519:   for (const id of lotteries) params.append("lotteries[]", id);
00520:   return `${base}?${params.toString()}`;
00521: }

00523: function sleep(ms) {
00524:   return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
00525: }
00526: 
00527: function shouldRetryAxiosError(err) {
00528:   const code = String(err?.code || "").toLowerCase();
00529:   const status = Number(err?.response?.status);
00530: 
00531:   if (
00532:     code.includes("etimedout") ||
00533:     code.includes("econnreset") ||
00534:     code.includes("enotfound")
00535:   ) {
00536:     return true;
00537:   }
00538: 
00539:   // 429 / 5xx
00540:   if (
00541:     Number.isFinite(status) &&
00542:     (status === 429 || (status >= 500 && status <= 599))
00543:   ) {
00544:     return true;
00545:   }
00546: 
00547:   return false;
00548: }

00550: async function axiosGetJson(url) {
00551:   let lastErr = null;
00552: 
00553:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= HTTP_RETRIES; attempt++) {
00554:     try {
00555:       const { data } = await axios.get(url, {
00556:         headers: {
00557:           Accept: "application/json, text/plain, */*",
00558:           Origin: "https://app.kingapostas.com",
00559:           Referer: "https://app.kingapostas.com/",
00560:         },
00561:         timeout: 30000,
00562:         validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 300,
00563:       });
00564: 
00565:       if (!data?.success || !Array.isArray(data?.data)) {
00566:         throw new Error("Resposta inesperada da API (success/data).");
00567:       }
00568: 
00569:       return data;
00570:     } catch (e) {
00571:       lastErr = e;
00572: 
00573:       const canRetry = attempt < HTTP_RETRIES && shouldRetryAxiosError(e);
00574:       if (!canRetry) break;
00575: 
00576:       const backoff = HTTP_RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt);
00577:       console.warn(
00578:         `[HTTP] tentativa ${attempt + 1}/${HTTP_RETRIES + 1} falhou (${
00579:           e?.response?.status || e?.code || "err"
00580:         }). retry em ${backoff}ms...`
00581:       );
00582:       await sleep(backoff);
00583:     }
00584:   }
00585: 
00586:   throw lastErr || new Error("Falha ao buscar API.");
00587: }

00607: async function axiosGetText(url) {
00608:   let lastErr = null;
00609: 
00610:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= HTTP_RETRIES; attempt++) {
00611:     try {
00612:       const { data } = await axios.get(url, {
00613:         headers: {
00614:           Accept:
00615:             "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
00616:           Origin: "https://app.kingapostas.com",
00617:           Referer: "https://app.kingapostas.com/",
00618:           "User-Agent":
00619:             "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120 Safari/537.36",
00620:         },
00621:         timeout: 30000,
00622:         responseType: "text",
00623:         validateStatus: (s) => s >= 200 && s < 400,
00624:       });
00625:       return String(data || "");
00626:     } catch (e) {
00627:       lastErr = e;
00628:       const canRetry = attempt < HTTP_RETRIES && shouldRetryAxiosError(e);
00629:       if (!canRetry) break;
00630: 
00631:       const backoff = HTTP_RETRY_BASE_MS * Math.pow(2, attempt);
00632:       console.warn(
00633:         `[HTTP] tentativa ${attempt + 1}/${HTTP_RETRIES + 1} (HTML) falhou (${
00634:           e?.response?.status || e?.code || "err"
00635:         }). retry em ${backoff}ms...`
00636:       );
00637:       await sleep(backoff);
00638:     }
00639:   }
00640: 
00641:   throw lastErr || new Error("Falha ao buscar HTML");
00642: }

00644: /**
00645:  * Detecta se o HTML é uma página de login/redirect (evita falso positivo).
00646:  */
00647: function detectDetailsHtmlKind(html) {
00648:   const h = String(html || "");
00649:   const low = h.toLowerCase();
00650: 
00651:   // sinais comuns:
00652:   if (low.includes("/login/sign-in") || low.includes("formlogin")) return "login";
00653:   if (low.includes("bailout_to_client_side_rendering")) return "csr_bailout";
00654:   if (low.includes("app/login") || low.includes("sign-in")) return "login_like";
00655: 
00656:   // fallback: parece uma página de results
00657:   if (low.includes("results/details") || low.includes("kingapostas"))
00658:     return "results_like";
00659: 
00660:   return "unknown";
00661: }

00663: // Heurística: só diagnosticar se o HTML "parece" ter o slot e algum conteúdo de prêmios
00664: function parseDetailsHtmlForSlot(html, slotHHMM) {
00665:   const out = {
00666:     hasSlot: false,
00667:     hasAnyPrize: false,
00668:     kind: "unknown",
00669:   };
00670:   const h = String(html || "");
00671:   const slot = String(slotHHMM || "").trim();
00672:   if (!h || !slot) return out;
00673: 
00674:   out.kind = detectDetailsHtmlKind(h);
00675: 
00676:   // Se é login/redirect, não confia em nada
00677:   if (out.kind === "login" || out.kind === "login_like") {
00678:     return out;
00679:   }
00680: 
00681:   if (h.toLowerCase().includes(slot.toLowerCase())) out.hasSlot = true;
00682: 
00683:   // mantém heurística, mas só vale quando não for login
00684:   if (/(prize[_\s-]?\d+)|(\b\d{4}\b)/i.test(h)) out.hasAnyPrize = true;
00685: 
00686:   return out;
00687: }

00689: async function tryHtmlDetailsFallback({ date, lotteryKey, closeHour }) {
00690:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();

00713: /**
00714:  * ✅ Merge + dedup de draws vindos de múltiplos requests
00715:  * Dedup key: date + close_hour(SLOT) + lottery_id (se existir)
00716:  */
00717: function mergeAndDedupDraws(arrays, lotteryKey) {
00718:   const map = new Map();
00719: 
00720:   for (const a of arrays) {
00721:     const list = Array.isArray(a) ? a : [];
00722:     for (const d of list) {
00723:       const date = String(d?.date || "").trim();
00724:       const { slot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d?.close_hour || "", lotteryKey);
00725: 
00726:       const lid =
00727:         pickLotteryId(d) ||
00728:         String(d?.lottery_name || d?.name || "").trim() ||
00729:         "NA";
00730:       const key = `${date}__${slot}__${lid}`;
00731: 
00732:       if (!map.has(key)) {
00733:         map.set(key, d);
00734:       } else {
00735:         // se duplicado, preferir o que tiver mais prizes preenchidos
00736:         const prev = map.get(key);
00737:         const prevCount = countPrizesInDraw(prev);
00738:         const curCount = countPrizesInDraw(d);
00739:         if (curCount > prevCount) map.set(key, d);
00740:       }
00741:     }
00742:   }
00743: 
00744:   return Array.from(map.values());
00745: }
00746: 
00747: function countPrizesInDraw(draw) {
00748:   let c = 0;
00749:   for (let i = 1; i <= 15; i++) {
00750:     const v = draw?.[`prize_${i}`];
00751:     if (v === null || v === undefined || String(v).trim() === "") continue;
00752:     c++;
00753:   }
00754:   return c;
00755: }

00757: function summarizeCloseHours(draws, lotteryKey) {
00758:   const set = new Set();
00759:   for (const d of draws) {
00760:     const { slot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d?.close_hour || "", lotteryKey);
00761:     if (slot) set.add(slot);
00762:   }
00763:   return Array.from(set).sort();
00764: }

00766: /**
00767:  * ✅ Fetch robusto:
00768:  * - Por default faz 1 request por lotteryId e mescla (evita “cap”/consolidação do endpoint)
00769:  * - Se KING_FETCH_PER_LOTTERY=0 -> faz 1 request único (modo antigo)

00771: async function fetchKingResults({ date, lotteryKey }) {
00772:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00773:   const lotteries = LOTTERIES_BY_KEY[lk];
00774:   if (!lotteries?.length) {
00775:     if (lk === "FEDERAL") {
00776:       throw new Error(
00777:         `FEDERAL sem lotteryIds. Defina KING_LOTTERIES_FEDERAL="uuid1,uuid2,..." para habilitar fetch.`
00778:       );
00779:     }
00780:     throw new Error(`lotteryKey inválida: ${lk}`);
00781:   }
00782: 
00783:   if (!FETCH_PER_LOTTERY) {
00784:     const url = buildResultsUrl({ date, lotteryKey: lk });
00785:     return await axiosGetJson(url);
00786:   }
00787: 
00788:   // ✅ 1 request por lottery (sequencial: mais estável e respeita rate-limit)
00789:   const parts = [];
00790:   const errors = [];
00791: 
00792:   // helper local: extrai e normaliza closes vindos nesse UUID
00793:   const closeFromDraw = (d) =>
00794:     normalizeHHMM(d?.close_hour ?? d?.closeHour ?? d?.horario ?? d?.close ?? "");
00795: 
00796:   const summarizeCloseHoursPart = (list) => {
00797:     const set = new Set();
00798:     for (const d of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
00799:       const c = closeFromDraw(d);
00800:       if (c) set.add(c);
00801:     }
00802:     return Array.from(set).sort();
00803:   };
00804: 
00805:   for (const lotteryId of lotteries) {
00806:     const url = buildResultsUrl({ date, lotteryKey: lk, lotteryId });
00807: 
00808:     try {
00809:       const data = await axiosGetJson(url);
00810: 
00811:       // ✅ carimba o UUID do request em cada draw (a API nem sempre retorna lottery_id)
00812:       if (data && Array.isArray(data.data)) {
00813:         data.data = data.data.map((d) => ({
00814:           ...d,
00815:           lottery_id: d?.lottery_id || lotteryId,
00816:           lotteryId: d?.lotteryId || lotteryId,
00817:         }));
00818:       }
00819:       const list = Array.isArray(data?.data) ? data.data : [];
00820:       parts.push(list);
00821: 
00822:       if (KING_FETCH_DEBUG) {
00823:         const closesPart = summarizeCloseHoursPart(list);
00824:         console.log(
00825:           `[FETCH:PART] ${lk} ${date} lotteryId=${lotteryId} draws=${list.length} close_hours=[${closesPart.join(
00826:             ", "
00827:           )}]`
00828:         );
00829:       }
00830:     } catch (e) {
00831:       const msg = e?.response?.status
00832:         ? `HTTP_${e.response.status}`
00833:         : e?.code || e?.message || "ERR";
00834: 
00835:       errors.push({ lotteryId, msg });
00836: 
00837:       console.warn(
00838:         `[FETCH:PART] ${lk} ${date} lotteryId=${lotteryId} ERROR=${msg} (seguindo...)`
00839:       );
00840: 
00841:       // segue para não travar o dia inteiro por 1 UUID
00842:       continue;
00843:     }
00844:   }
00845: 
00846:   const merged = mergeAndDedupDraws(parts, lk);
00847:   const closes = summarizeCloseHours(merged, lk);
00848:   const errInfo =
00849:     KING_FETCH_DEBUG && errors.length
00850:       ? ` errors=${errors.length} ids=[${errors.map((x) => x.lotteryId).join(",")}]`
00851:       : "";
00852: 
00853:   console.log(
00854:     `[FETCH] ${lk} ${date} per-lottery=${lotteries.length} -> merged_draws=${
00855:       merged.length
00856:     } close_hours=[${closes.join(", ")}]${errInfo}`
00857:   );
00858:   return { success: true, data: merged };
00859: }

00908: /**
00909:  * Prova forte de “já completo”:
00910:  * - draw existe
00911:  * - prizesCount > 0 (ou) existe ao menos 1 doc na subcoleção prizes
00912:  */
00913: async function checkAlreadyComplete(drawRef) {
00914:   try {
00915:     const dSnap = await drawRef.get();
00916:     if (!dSnap.exists) return false;
00917: 
00918:     const data = dSnap.data() || {};
00919:     if (Number(data.prizesCount) > 0) return true;
00920: 
00921:     // fallback: olha 1 doc de prizes
00922:     const pSnap = await drawRef.collection("prizes").limit(1).get();
00923:     return !pSnap.empty;
00924:   } catch {
00925:     return false;
00926:   }
00927: }

00929: /**
00930:  * ✅ Prova forte por SLOT (anti-índice composto)
00931:  * - Query filtra SOMENTE por date
00932:  * - close_hour + lottery_key/lotteryKey filtrados em memória
00933:  *
00934:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00935:  * - Normaliza o close_hour armazenado (pode existir legado "09:09")
00936:  *   e compara por SLOT (HH:00), para não “perder” doc existente.
00937:  */
00938: async function checkSlotCompletion({ date, closeHour, lotteryKey }) {
00939:   try {
00940:     const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00941:     const targetSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(closeHour || "", lk).slot;
00942:     if (!targetSlot || !isHHMM(targetSlot)) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00943: 
00944:     // query mínima
00945:     const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
00946:     if (snap.empty) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00947: 
00948:     const refs = [];
00949:     snap.forEach((doc) => {
00950:       const d = doc.data() || {};
00951: 
00952:       const lkSnake = String(d.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00953:       const lkCamel = String(d.lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00954: 
00955:       if (lkSnake !== lk && lkCamel !== lk) return;
00956: 
00957:       // ✅ compara por SLOT normalizado (pega legado "09:09" como "09:00")
00958:       const storedSlot = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(d.close_hour || "", lk).slot;
00959:       if (storedSlot !== targetSlot) return;
00960: 
00961:       refs.push(doc.ref);
00962:     });
00963: 
00964:     if (!refs.length) return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00965: 
00966:     let complete = 0;
00967:     for (const ref of refs) {
00968:       const ok = await checkAlreadyComplete(ref);
00969:       if (ok) complete += 1;
00970:     }
00971: 
00972:     return { docs: refs.length, complete };
00973:   } catch {
00974:     return { docs: 0, complete: 0 };
00975:   }
00976: }

00978: /**
00979:  * Importa payload para o Firestore.
00980:  * closeHour (opcional): se informado, importa SOMENTE draws daquele horário (SLOT).

00982:  * Opts extras:
00983:  * - skipIfAlreadyComplete (boolean): se true, e o draw do closeHour já estiver completo no FS,

00986: async function importFromPayload({
00987:   payload,
00988:   lotteryKey,
00989:   closeHour = null,
00990:   skipIfAlreadyComplete = false,
00991: } = {}) {
00992:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00993:   const uf = resolveUfFromLotteryKey(lk); // ✅ UF correta (ex.: RJ)
00994: 
00995:   let batch = db.batch();
00996:   let ops = 0;
00997: 
00998:   let totalDrawsFromApi = 0;
00999:   let totalDrawsMatchedClose = 0;
01000:   let totalDrawsValid = 0;
01001: 
01002:   let totalDrawsUpserted = 0;
01003:   let totalDrawsSaved = 0;
01004: 
01005:   let totalPrizesUpserted = 0;
01006:   let totalPrizesSaved = 0;
01007: 
01008:   let skippedInvalid = 0;
01009:   let skippedEmpty = 0;
01010:   let skippedCloseHour = 0;
01011:   let skippedAlreadyComplete = 0;
01012: 
01013:   // Provas úteis para o scheduler (quando closeHour é informado)
01014:   const proof = {
01015:     filterClose: null,
01016: 
01017:     apiHasPrizes: false,
01018:     apiReturnedTargetDraws: 0, // draws válidos do closeHour com prizes
01019:     targetDrawIds: [],
01020:     inferredDate: null, // date do slot (inferido a partir do payload)
01021: 
01022:     expectedTargets: 0, // = max(1, apiReturnedTargetDraws)
01023:     slotDocsFound: 0,
01024:     alreadyCompleteCount: 0,
01025:     alreadyCompleteAny: false,
01026:     alreadyCompleteAll: false,
01027: 
01028:     targetWriteCount: 0,
01029:     targetSavedCount: 0,
01030:   };
01031: 
01032:   // ✅ filtro deve ser SLOT também
01033:   const filterClose = closeHour
01034:     ? normalizeCloseHourForLottery(closeHour, lk).slot
01035:     : null;
01036:   if (filterClose && !isHHMM(filterClose)) {
01037:     throw new Error('Parâmetro "closeHour" inválido. Use HH:MM.');
01038:   }
01039:   proof.filterClose = filterClose;
01040: 
01041:   const apiArr = Array.isArray(payload?.data) ? payload.data : [];
01042: 
01043:   for (const draw of apiArr) {
01044:     totalDrawsFromApi++;
01045: 
01046:     const date = String(draw?.date || "").trim();
01047:     const { raw: closeRaw, slot: closeSlot } = normalizeCloseHourForLottery(
01048:       draw?.close_hour || "",
01049:       lk
01050:     );
01051: 
01052:     // filtro por horário (SLOT)
01053:     if (filterClose) {
01054:       if (closeSlot !== filterClose) {
01055:         skippedCloseHour++;
01056:         continue;
01057:       }
01058:     }
01059: 
01060:     totalDrawsMatchedClose++;
01061: 
01062:     // validações mínimas (slot precisa ser HH:MM)
01063:     if (!isISODate(date) || !isHHMM(closeSlot)) {
01064:       skippedInvalid++;
01065:       continue;
01066:     }
01067: 
01068:     // prizes existentes
01069:     const prizes = extractPrizes(draw);
01070: 
01071:     // Se não tem prize nenhum, NÃO grava
01072:     if (!prizes.length) {
01073:       skippedEmpty++;
01074:       continue;
01075:     }
01076: 
01077:     totalDrawsValid++;
01078: 
01079:     if (filterClose) {
01080:       proof.apiHasPrizes = true;
01081:       proof.apiReturnedTargetDraws += 1;
01082:       proof.inferredDate = proof.inferredDate || date;
01083:     }
01084: 
01085:     const { drawId, drawRef, lotteryName, lotteryIdFromDraw } = buildDrawRef({
01086:       draw,
01087:       lotteryKey: lk,
01088:     });
01089: 
01090:     if (filterClose) proof.targetDrawIds.push(drawId);
01091: 
01092:     // Em closeHour: checa “já completo” e, se configurado, pula escrita (por draw)
01093:     if (filterClose) {
01094:       const already = await checkAlreadyComplete(drawRef);
01095:       if (skipIfAlreadyComplete && already) {
01096:         skippedAlreadyComplete++;
01097:         continue;
01098:       }
01099:     }
01100: 
01101:     // métrica "novo" (opcional — custa reads)
01102:     let isNewDraw = false;
01103:     if (CHECK_EXISTENCE) {
01104:       try {
01105:         const snap = await drawRef.get();
01106:         isNewDraw = !snap.exists;
01107:       } catch {
01108:         isNewDraw = false;
01109:       }
01110:     }

01113: 
01114:     batch.set(
01115:       drawRef,
01116:       {
01117:         source: "kingapostas",

01120:         lottery_key: lk,
01121: 
01122:         lottery_name: lotteryName,
01123:         lottery_id: lotteryIdFromDraw || null,
01124:         drawId,
01125: 
01126:         date,
01127:         ymd,
01128: 
01129:         // ✅ campo de negócio (SLOT)
01130:         close_hour: closeSlot,
01131: 
01132:         // ✅ compat: campos usados no front (evita undefined)
01133:         hour: closeSlot ? String(closeSlot).slice(0, 2) : null,
01134:         close: closeSlot || null,
01135: 
01136:         // ✅ guarda o que veio da API SOMENTE quando fizer sentido
01137:         // (PT_RIO HH:09 vira "", então cai em null)
01138:         close_hour_raw: closeRaw || null,
01139:

01141:         importedAt: admin.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
01142:       },

01144:     );
01145:     ops++;
01146:     totalDrawsUpserted++;
01147:     if (isNewDraw) totalDrawsSaved++;
01148: 
01149:     if (filterClose) proof.targetWriteCount += 1;
01150: 
01151:     for (const p of prizes) {
01152:       const n = normalizePrize(p.value);
01153:       const prizeId = `p${String(p.position).padStart(2, "0")}`;
01154:       const prizeRef = drawRef.collection("prizes").doc(prizeId);
01155: 
01156:       let isNewPrize = false;
01157:       if (CHECK_EXISTENCE) {
01158:         try {

01160:           isNewPrize = !psnap.exists;
01161:         } catch {
01162:           isNewPrize = false;
01163:         }
01164:       }
01165: 
01166:       batch.set(
01167:         prizeRef,
01168:         {
01169:           position: p.position,
01170:           ...n,
01171:         },
01172:         { merge: true }
01173:       );
01174:       ops++;
01175:       totalPrizesUpserted++;
01176:       if (isNewPrize) totalPrizesSaved++;
01177: 
01178:       if (filterClose) proof.targetWriteCount += 1;
01179: 
01180:       if (ops >= 420) {
01181:         await batch.commit();
01182:         batch = db.batch();
01183:         ops = 0;
01184:       }
01185:     }
01186:   }
01187: 
01188:   if (ops > 0) await batch.commit();
01189: 
01190:   // ✅ flags finais de complete (por SLOT via query anti-índice)
01191:   if (proof.filterClose) {
