01193:     proof.expectedTargets = Math.max(1, Number(proof.apiReturnedTargetDraws || 0));
01194: 
01195:     if (slotDate) {
01196:       const { docs, complete } = await checkSlotCompletion({
01197:         date: slotDate,
01198:         closeHour: proof.filterClose,
01199:         lotteryKey: lk,
01200:       });
01201: 
01202:       proof.slotDocsFound = docs;
01203:       proof.alreadyCompleteCount = complete;
01204:       proof.alreadyCompleteAny = complete > 0;
01205:       proof.alreadyCompleteAll = complete >= proof.expectedTargets;
01206:     } else {
01207:       proof.slotDocsFound = 0;
01208:       proof.alreadyCompleteCount = 0;
01209:       proof.alreadyCompleteAny = false;
01210:       proof.alreadyCompleteAll = false;
01211:     }
01212: 
01213:     // savedCount “forte” para o scheduler:
01214:     if (!proof.apiHasPrizes) {
01215:       proof.targetSavedCount = 0;
01216:     } else if (skipIfAlreadyComplete && proof.alreadyCompleteAll) {
01217:       proof.targetSavedCount = 0;
01218:     } else {
01219:       proof.targetSavedCount = proof.targetWriteCount;
01220:     }
01221:   }
01222: 
01223:   console.log(
01224:     `[IMPORT] API draws=${totalDrawsFromApi} | match_close=${totalDrawsMatchedClose} | validos=${totalDrawsValid}` +
01225:       ` | draws_upserted=${totalDrawsUpserted} | draws_novos=${totalDrawsSaved}` +
01226:       ` | prizes_upserted=${totalPrizesUpserted} | prizes_novos=${totalPrizesSaved}` +
01227:       ` | skip_vazio=${skippedEmpty} | skip_invalido=${skippedInvalid} | skip_close=${skippedCloseHour}` +
01228:       ` | skip_complete=${skippedAlreadyComplete}` +
01229:       ` | CHECK_EXISTENCE=${CHECK_EXISTENCE ? "ON" : "OFF"}` +
01230:       ` | uf=${uf || "NULL"} lottery_key=${lk}` +

01233:         : "")
01234:   );

01256: /**
01257:  * ✅ Cleanup automático: remove docs legados (lottery_id null) quando existe doc UUID no mesmo date+slot.
01258:  * - Usa query mínima por date (sem índice composto)
01259:  * - Seguro: só apaga legado se existe UUID no slot
01260:  */
01261: async function cleanupLegacyDrawsForDate({ date, lotteryKey }) {
01262:   const lk = String(lotteryKey || "").trim().toUpperCase();
01263:   if (!date || !isISODate(date) || !lk)
01264:     return { ok: false, deleted: 0, slots: 0, reason: "bad_args" };
01265: 
01266:   const snap = await db.collection("draws").where("date", "==", date).get();
01267:   const rows = snap.docs.map((doc) => ({ ref: doc.ref, id: doc.id, ...doc.data() }));
01268: 
01269:   const mine = rows.filter(
01270:     (r) => String(r.lottery_key || "").trim().toUpperCase() === lk
01271:   );
01272: 
01273:   const bySlot = new Map();
01274:   for (const r of mine) {
01275:     const slot = String(r.close_hour || "").trim();
01276:     if (!slot) continue;
01277:     if (!bySlot.has(slot)) bySlot.set(slot, []);
01278:     bySlot.get(slot).push(r);
01279:   }
01280: 
01281:   let deleted = 0;
01282:   let slots = 0;
01283:   let batch = db.batch();
01284:   let ops = 0;
01285: 
01286:   for (const [slot, arr] of bySlot.entries()) {
01287:     const hasUuid = arr.some((x) => x.lottery_id && String(x.lottery_id).includes("-"));
01288:     if (!hasUuid) continue;
01289: 
01290:     const leg = arr.filter((x) => !x.lottery_id);
01291:     if (!leg.length) continue;
01292: 
01293:     for (const d of leg) {
01294:       batch.delete(d.ref);
01295:       deleted += 1;
01296:       ops += 1;
01297:       if (ops >= 450) {
01298:         await batch.commit();
01299:         batch = db.batch();
01300:         ops = 0;
01301:       }
01302:     }
01303:     slots += 1;
01304:   }
01305: 
01306:   if (ops > 0) await batch.commit();
01307: 
01308:   return { ok: true, deleted, slots };
01309: }

00086: function sleepMs(ms) {
00087:   const n = Number(ms);
00088:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return;
00089: 
00090:   // Bloqueante sem consumir CPU (bom para CLI)
00091:   try {
00092:     Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, n);
00093:   } catch {
00094:     // fallback (muito raro): busy-wait
00095:     const end = Date.now() + n;
00096:     while (Date.now() < end) {}
00097:   }
00098: }

00105: function parseDate(s) {
00106:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00107:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return null;
00108: 
00109:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map(Number);
00110:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00111: 
00112:   if (
00113:     dt.getUTCFullYear() !== y ||
00114:     dt.getUTCMonth() !== m - 1 ||
00115:     dt.getUTCDate() !== d
00116:   ) {
00117:     return null;
00118:   }
00119:   return dt;
00120: }

00122: function parseYear(s) {
00123:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00124:   if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(str)) return null;
00125: 
00126:   const y = Number(str);
00127:   if (!Number.isFinite(y) || y < 2000 || y > 2100) return null;
00128:   return y;
00129: }

00174:  * - se env GLOBAL_MAX_DATE válida => usa ela
00175:  * - senão => hoje (local) + MAX_FUTURE_DAYS
00176:  */
00177: function resolveGlobalMaxDate() {
00178:   if (ENV_GLOBAL_MAX_DATE) {
00179:     const parsed = parseDate(ENV_GLOBAL_MAX_DATE);
00180:     if (!parsed) {
00181:       console.error(

00183:       );
00184:       process.exit(1);
00185:     }
00186:     return parsed;
00187:   }
00188: 
00189:   const today = todayLocalDate();
00190:   return addDays(today, Math.max(0, MAX_FUTURE_DAYS));
00191: }
00192: 
00193: function normLotteryKey(v) {
00194:   const s = String(v || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00195:   if (s === "RJ" || s === "RIO" || s === "PT-RIO") return "PT_RIO";
00196:   return s || "PT_RIO";
00197: }

00199: /**
00200:  * =========================
00201:  * Runner por dia (com retry/timeout)
00202:  * =========================
00203:  */
00204: function runImportDay(importApostasPath, date, lotteryKey) {
00205:   const maxAttempts = 1 + Math.max(0, IMPORT_RETRIES);
00206: 
00207:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
00208:     const head =
00209:       attempt === 1
00210:         ? `[RUN] ${date} (${lotteryKey})`
00211:         : `[RETRY ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}] ${date} (${lotteryKey})`;
00212: 
00213:     console.log(head);
00214: 
00215:     const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [importApostasPath, date, lotteryKey], {
00216:       stdio: "inherit",
00217:       timeout: IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS,
00218:       env: process.env,
00219:     });
00220: 
00221:     const ok = r && r.status === 0;
00222:     if (ok) return { ok: true, attempt, status: r.status };
00223: 
00224:     // spawnSync: se timeout, r.error pode ser ETIMEDOUT e status null
00225:     const timedOut =
00226:       (r &&
00227:         r.error &&
00228:         (r.error.code === "ETIMEDOUT" || r.error.code === "ETIMEOUT")) ||
00229:       (r && (r.signal === "SIGTERM" || r.signal === "SIGKILL") && r.status === null);
00230: 
00231:     if (timedOut) {
00232:       console.error(
00233:         `[FALHA] timeout após ${IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS}ms em ${date} (${lotteryKey}).`
00234:       );
00235:     } else {
00236:       const code = r?.status;
00237:       console.error(`[FALHA] status=${code} em ${date} (${lotteryKey}).`);
00238:     }
00239: 
00240:     if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
00241:       if (IMPORT_RETRY_DELAY_MS > 0) {
00242:         console.log(
00243:           `[AGUARDA] ${IMPORT_RETRY_DELAY_MS}ms antes de tentar novamente...`
00244:         );
00245:         sleepMs(IMPORT_RETRY_DELAY_MS);
00246:       }
00247:       continue;
00248:     }
00249: 
00250:     return {
00251:       ok: false,
00252:       attempt,
00253:       status: r?.status ?? null,
00254:       signal: r?.signal ?? null,
00255:       errorCode: r?.error?.code ?? null,
00256:     };
00257:   }
00258: 
00259:   return { ok: false, attempt: 0 };
00260: }
00261: 
00262: /**
00263:  * =========================
00264:  * Main
00265:  * =========================
00266:  */
00267: async function main() {

00269:   const a2 = process.argv[3];
00270:   const a3 = process.argv[4];

00318:     );

00329:     console.error(

00065:       mm <= 59

00025: function isValidYMD(ymd) {
00026:   const s = String(ymd || "").trim();
00027:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s)) return false;
00028: 
00029:   const [Y, M, D] = s.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00030:   if (!Number.isFinite(Y) || !Number.isFinite(M) || !Number.isFinite(D)) return false;
00031:   if (M < 1 || M > 12 || D < 1 || D > 31) return false;
00032: 
00033:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D));
00034:   return (
00035:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === Y &&
00036:     dt.getUTCMonth() + 1 === M &&
00037:     dt.getUTCDate() === D
00038:   );
00039: }
00040: 
00041: /**
00042:  * Converte Date -> YYYY-MM-DD considerando timezone fixo (SP).
00043:  * Evita “virar o dia” quando roda em UTC.
00044:  */
00045: function dateToYMD_TZ(d, timeZone = TZ) {
00046:   if (!(d instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
00047: 
00048:   try {
00049:     const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
00050:       timeZone,
00051:       year: "numeric",
00052:       month: "2-digit",
00053:       day: "2-digit",
00054:     });
00055: 
00056:     const parts = fmt.formatToParts(d);
00057:     const y = parts.find((p) => p.type === "year")?.value;
00058:     const m = parts.find((p) => p.type === "month")?.value;
00059:     const da = parts.find((p) => p.type === "day")?.value;
00060: 
00061:     const ymd = `${y}-${m}-${da}`;
00062:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00063:   } catch {
00064:     const y = d.getUTCFullYear();
00065:     const m = String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
00066:     const da = String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
00067:     const ymd = `${y}-${m}-${da}`;
00068:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00069:   }
00070: }

00072: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00073:   if (input == null) return null;
00074: 
00075:   // Firestore Timestamp (Admin SDK) ou objeto com toDate()
00076:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00077:     return dateToYMD_TZ(input.toDate());
00078:   }
00079: 
00080:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
00081:   if (
00082:     typeof input === "object" &&
00083:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
00084:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00085:   ) {
00086:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00087:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00088:       : Number(input._seconds);
00089:     return dateToYMD_TZ(new Date(sec * 1000));
00090:   }
00091: 
00092:   // Date
00093:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00094:     return dateToYMD_TZ(input);
00095:   }
00096: 
00097:   // Number-like (ms ou seconds)
00098:   if (typeof input === "number" && Number.isFinite(input)) {
00099:     const ms = input > 1e12 ? input : input * 1000;
00100:     return dateToYMD_TZ(new Date(ms));
00101:   }
00102: 
00103:   const s = String(input).trim();
00104:   if (!s) return null;
00105: 
00106:   // Numeric string (ms ou seconds)
00107:   if (/^\d{10,13}$/.test(s)) {
00108:     const n = Number(s);
00109:     const ms = s.length >= 13 ? n : n * 1000;
00110:     return dateToYMD_TZ(new Date(ms));
00111:   }
00112: 
00113:   // ISO: YYYY-MM-DD...
00114:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:[T\s].*)?$/);
00115:   if (iso) {
00116:     const ymd = `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00117:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00118:   }
00119: 
00120:   // ISO com barra: YYYY/MM/DD
00121:   const isoSlash = s.match(/^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})(?:\D.*)?$/);
00122:   if (isoSlash) {
00123:     const ymd = `${isoSlash[1]}-${isoSlash[2]}-${isoSlash[3]}`;
00124:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00125:   }
00126: 
00127:   // BR: DD/MM/YYYY (com ou sem hora)
00128:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})(?:\D.*)?$/);
00129:   if (br) {
00130:     const ymd = `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00131:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00132:   }
00133: 
00134:   // BR com hífen: DD-MM-YYYY (com ou sem hora)
00135:   const brDash = s.match(/^(\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{4})(?:\D.*)?$/);
00136:   if (brDash) {
00137:     const ymd = `${brDash[3]}-${brDash[2]}-${brDash[1]}`;
00138:     return isValidYMD(ymd) ? ymd : null;
00139:   }
00140: 
00141:   return null;
00142: }

00094: function walkFiles(dir, { maxFiles = 8000 } = {}) {
00095:   const out = [];
00096:   const stack = [dir];
00097: 
00098:   while (stack.length) {
00099:     const cur = stack.pop();
00100:     let entries = [];
00101:     try {
00102:       entries = fs.readdirSync(cur, { withFileTypes: true });
00103:     } catch {
00104:       continue;
00105:     }
00106: 
00107:     for (const ent of entries) {
00108:       const fp = path.join(cur, ent.name);
00109:       if (ent.isDirectory()) {
00110:         if (ent.name === "node_modules" || ent.name === ".git") continue;
00111:         stack.push(fp);
00112:       } else if (ent.isFile()) {
00113:         out.push(fp);
00114:         if (out.length >= maxFiles) return out;
00115:       }
00116:     }
00117:   }
00118: 
00119:   return out;
00120: }

00122: /**
00123:  * Auto-descobre o audit “melhor” PARA UMA LOTERIA:
00124:  * - filtra por lottery (nome ou json)
00125:  * - ordena por (hardCount desc, mtime desc)
00126:  */
00127: function findBestAuditFileForLottery(lottery) {
00128:   const L = normalizeLotteryKey(lottery, "PT_RIO");
00129: 
00130:   const candidatesDirs = [
00131:     path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "data"),
00132:     path.join(process.cwd(), "backend", "logs"),
00133:     path.join(process.cwd(), "backend"),
00134:   ];
00135: 
00136:   const candidates = [];
00137: 
00138:   for (const d of candidatesDirs) {
00139:     if (!fs.existsSync(d)) continue;
00140: 
00141:     const files = walkFiles(d, { maxFiles: 8000 }).filter((fp) => {
00142:       const name = path.basename(fp).toLowerCase();
00143:       return name.endsWith(".json") && name.includes("audit");
00144:     });
00145: 
00146:     for (const fp of files) {
00147:       let st;
00148:       try {
00149:         st = fs.statSync(fp);
00150:       } catch {
00151:         continue;
00152:       }
00153: 
00154:       const j = safeReadJson(fp);
00155:       if (!looksLikeAuditJson(j)) continue;
00156: 
00157:       const lot = inferLotteryFromJsonOrName(fp, j);
00158:       if (lot !== L) continue;
00159: 
00160:       candidates.push({ fp, mtimeMs: st.mtimeMs, hard: hardCount(j) });
00161:     }
00162:   }
00163: 
00164:   candidates.sort((a, b) => (b.hard - a.hard) || (b.mtimeMs - a.mtimeMs));
00165:   return candidates.length ? candidates[0].fp : null;
00166: }

00168: async function getFetch() {
00169:   if (typeof fetch === "function") return fetch;
00170: 
00171:   try {
00172:     // eslint-disable-next-line global-require
00173:     const mod = require("node-fetch");
00174:     return mod.default || mod;
00175:   } catch (e) {
00176:     throw new Error(
00177:       "Este Node não possui fetch global e o pacote 'node-fetch' não está instalado. " +
00178:         "Use Node 18+ ou instale: npm i node-fetch"
00179:     );
00180:   }
00181: }
00182: 
00183: /**
00184:  * fetch JSON com timeout + retry
00185:  * ENV:
00186:  * - FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS (default 15000)
00187:  * - FETCH_RETRIES (default 2)
00188:  * - FETCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS (default 600)
00189:  */
00190: async function fetchJson(url) {
00191:   const _fetch = await getFetch();
00192: 
00193:   const TIMEOUT_MS = envInt("FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS", 15000);
00194:   const RETRIES = envInt("FETCH_RETRIES", 2);
00195:   const DELAY_MS = envInt("FETCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS", 600);
00196: 
00197:   const maxAttempts = 1 + Math.max(0, RETRIES);
00198: 
00199:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
00200:     const ctrl =
00201:       typeof AbortController !== "undefined" ? new AbortController() : null;
00202:     const t = ctrl ? setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), TIMEOUT_MS) : null;
00203: 
00204:     try {
00205:       const r = await _fetch(url, {
00206:         headers: { accept: "application/json" },
00207:         signal: ctrl ? ctrl.signal : undefined,
00208:       });
00209: 
00210:       const txt = await r.text();
00211:       let j = null;
00212:       try {
00213:         j = JSON.parse(txt);
00214:       } catch {}
00215: 
00216:       if (!r.ok) {
00217:         const msg = j && j.error ? j.error : txt || `HTTP ${r.status}`;
00218:         throw new Error(msg);
00219:       }
00220: 
00221:       // ✅ IMPORTANT: API pode responder 200 com ok:false
00222:       if (j && j.ok === false) {
00223:         const msg = j.error || j.message || "Resposta ok:false";
00224:         throw new Error(msg);
00225:       }
00226: 
00227:       return j;
00228:     } catch (e) {
00229:       const isLast = attempt === maxAttempts;
00230:       const msg =
00231:         e?.name === "AbortError"
00232:           ? `timeout após ${TIMEOUT_MS}ms`
00233:           : e?.message || String(e);
00234: 
00235:       if (isLast) throw new Error(`${msg} (url=${url})`);
00236: 
00237:       // retry
00238:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
00239:       console.warn(
00240:         `[WARN] fetch falhou (${attempt}/${maxAttempts}) url=${url} => ${msg}`
00241:       );
00242:       if (DELAY_MS > 0) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, DELAY_MS));
00243:     } finally {
00244:       if (t) clearTimeout(t);
00245:     }
00246:   }
00247: 
00248:   throw new Error("fetchJson: falha inesperada");
00249: }
00250: 
00251: function isDayNoDraw({ blocked, dayStatus, blockedReason }) {
00252:   const ds = String(dayStatus || "").trim();
00253:   const br = String(blockedReason || "").trim();
00254: 
00255:   if (ds === "holiday_no_draw") return true;
00256:   if (blocked === true && ds === "holiday_no_draw") return true;
00257:   if (blocked === true && (br === "holiday_no_draw" || br === "day_no_draw"))
00258:     return true;
00259: 
00260:   return false;
00261: }

00023:   return new Date(String(ymd) + "T00:00:00Z").getUTCDay();

00026: function pad2(n) {
00027:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00028: }
00029: 
00030: /**
00031:  * Normaliza horários para HH:MM (robusto)
00032:  * Aceita: "11", "11h", "11hs", "11:09", "11:9", "11:09:00", etc.
00033:  * Retorna "HH:MM" ou null
00034:  */
00035: function normalizeHHMM(v) {
00036:   const s = safeStr(v);
00037:   if (!s) return null;
00038: 
00039:   // HH:MM:SS (aceita mm/ss 1-2 dígitos)
00040:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00041:   if (m1) {
00042:     const hh = Number(m1[1]);
00043:     const mm = Number(m1[2]);
00044:     const ss = Number(m1[3]);
00045:     if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || hh < 0 || hh > 23) return null;
00046:     if (!Number.isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 59) return null;
00047:     if (!Number.isFinite(ss) || ss < 0 || ss > 59) return null;
00048:     return `${pad2(hh)}:${pad2(mm)}`;
00049:   }
00050: 
00051:   // HH:MM (aceita minuto 1-2 dígitos, ex: 11:9)
00052:   const m0 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00053:   if (m0) {
00054:     const hh = Number(m0[1]);
00055:     const mm = Number(m0[2]);
00056:     if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || hh < 0 || hh > 23) return null;
00057:     if (!Number.isFinite(mm) || mm < 0 || mm > 59) return null;
00058:     return `${pad2(hh)}:${pad2(mm)}`;

00074:     return `${pad2(hh)}:00`;

00076:  * - mantém ordem: baseMin0 (0,+1,+2,-1,-2), depois baseMin9 (9,+1,+2,-1,-2)
00077:  */

00079:   const h = Number(hh);
00080:   const tol = Math.max(0, Number(tolMin) || 0);
00081:   const deltas = [0];
00082:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(+i);
00083:   for (let i = 1; i <= tol; i++) deltas.push(-i);
00084: 
00085:   const out = [];
00086:   for (const bm of baseMins) {
00087:     const base = Number(bm);
00088:     for (const d of deltas) {
00089:       const mm = base + d;
00090:       if (mm < 0 || mm > 59) continue;
00091:       out.push(`${pad2(h)}:${pad2(mm)}`);
00092:     }
00093:   }

00095: }

00090: function normalizePrivateKey(sa) {
00091:   if (sa && typeof sa.private_key === "string") {
00092:     // render/railway/vercel frequentemente salvam como "\n"
00093:     sa.private_key = sa.private_key.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
00094:   }
00095:   return sa;
00096: }

00098: function isValidServiceAccount(sa) {
00099:   if (!sa || typeof sa !== "object") return false;
00100: 
00101:   return (
00102:     typeof sa.project_id === "string" &&
00103:     typeof sa.client_email === "string" &&
00104:     typeof sa.private_key === "string" &&
00105:     sa.client_email.includes("@") &&
00106:     sa.private_key.includes("BEGIN PRIVATE KEY") &&
00107:     sa.private_key.includes("END PRIVATE KEY")
00108:   );
00109: }

00111: /**
00112:  * Procura candidatos comuns quando GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS está errado.
00113:  * - backend/*.json com "firebase-adminsdk" no nome
00114:  * - backend/serviceAccount*.json
00115:  * - backend/serviceAccount.json
00116:  * - <repo>/_secrets/palpitaco/firebase-admin.json (se existir)
00117:  */
00118: function findCredentialCandidates() {
00119:   const candidates = new Set();
00120: 
00121:   const backendDir = path.resolve(__dirname, ".."); // .../backend
00122:   const repoDir = path.resolve(backendDir, ".."); // .../palpitaco
00123: 
00124:   // 1) backend/
00125:   try {
00126:     const files = fs.readdirSync(backendDir, { withFileTypes: true });
00127:     for (const f of files) {
00128:       if (!f.isFile()) continue;
00129:       const name = String(f.name || "");
00130:       const lower = name.toLowerCase();
00131: 
00132:       if (!lower.endsWith(".json")) continue;
00133: 
00134:       // padrões comuns
00135:       if (lower.includes("firebase-adminsdk") || lower.startsWith("serviceaccount")) {
00136:         candidates.add(path.join(backendDir, name));
00137:       }
00138:       if (lower === "serviceaccount.json") {
00139:         candidates.add(path.join(backendDir, name));
00140:       }
00141:     }
00142:   } catch {
00143:     // ignora
00144:   }
00145: 
00146:   // 2) _secrets/palpitaco/firebase-admin.json
00147:   try {
00148:     const p = path.join(repoDir, "_secrets", "palpitaco", "firebase-admin.json");
00149:     if (fs.existsSync(p)) candidates.add(p);
00150:   } catch {
00151:     // ignora
00152:   }
00153: 
00154:   // determinístico
00155:   return Array.from(candidates).sort((a, b) => String(a).localeCompare(String(b)));
00156: }

00158: function resolveCredentialsPath() {
00159:   const rawEnv = String(process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS || "").trim();
00160:   if (!rawEnv) return null;
00161: 
00162:   // remove aspas externas
00163:   let p = rawEnv.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "").trim();
00164: 
00165:   // normaliza separadores
00166:   p = path.normalize(p);
00167: 
00168:   // Se veio relativo, resolve a partir do repo (palpitaco),
00169:   // mas também aceitamos relativo ao backend.
00170:   if (!path.isAbsolute(p)) {
00171:     const backendDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..");
00172:     const repoDir = path.resolve(backendDir, "..");
00173: 
00174:     const asBackend = path.resolve(backendDir, p);
00175:     const asRepo = path.resolve(repoDir, p);
00176: 
00177:     if (fs.existsSync(asBackend)) {
00178:       p = asBackend;
00179:     } else {
00180:       p = asRepo;
00181:     }
00182:   }
00183: 
00184:   if (!fs.existsSync(p)) {
00185:     const found = findCredentialCandidates();
00186: 
00187:     // Se achou exatamente 1, usa automaticamente (evita travar dev)
00188:     if (found.length === 1) {
00189:       const auto = found[0];
00190:       process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = auto;
00191:       console.warn(
00192:         "[WARN] GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS inválido. Usando automaticamente:",
00193:         auto
00194:       );
00195:       return auto;
00196:     }
00197: 
00198:     const hint =
00199:       found.length === 0
00200:         ? "Nenhum JSON candidato encontrado em backend/ ou _secrets."
00201:         : "Encontrei mais de um candidato. Defina explicitamente no .env.local.";
00202: 
00203:     const list =
00204:       found.length > 0 ? "\nCandidatos:\n- " + found.join("\n- ") : "";
00205: 
00206:     fail(
00207:       `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS aponta para caminho inexistente:\n${p}\n\n` +
00208:         `${hint}${list}\n\n` +
00209:         `✅ Ajuste no .env.local, exemplo:\n` +
00210:         `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=C:\\Users\\glaub\\palpitaco\\backend\\SEU_ARQUIVO.json`
00211:     );
00212:   }
00213: 
00214:   return p;
00215: }

00217: function readServiceAccountFromEnv() {
00218:   if (process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_SA_JSON) {
00219:     const sa = safeJsonParse(process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_SA_JSON);
00220:     if (!sa) fail("FIREBASE_ADMIN_SA_JSON existe, mas NÃO é JSON válido.");
00221: 
00222:     normalizePrivateKey(sa);
00223:     if (!isValidServiceAccount(sa)) {

00095:  * Aceita:
00096:  * - 18
00097:  * - "18"

00099:  * - "GRUPO 18"
00100:  * - "Grupo 04"

00103:  * Proteção extra:
00104:  * - evita "GRUPO 1 E 2" virar 12

00106: function coerceGrupoNumber(input) {
00107:   if (input == null) return null;
00108: 
00109:   if (typeof input === "number") {
00110:     const g = Math.trunc(input);
00111:     if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
00112:     if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
00113:     return g;
00114:   }
00115: 
00116:   const str = String(input || "").trim();
00117:   if (!str) return null;
00118: 
00119:   // pega o PRIMEIRO match de 1 ou 2 dígitos
00120:   const m = str.match(/\d{1,2}/);
00121:   if (!m) return null;
00122: 
00123:   const g = Number(m[0]);
00124:   if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
00125:   if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
00126:   return g;
00127: }

00022: function isValidHourFormat(h) {

00026: function sortHoursAsc(arr) {
00027:   return [...arr].sort((a, b) => {
00028:     const [ha, ma] = a.split(":").map(Number);
00029:     const [hb, mb] = b.split(":").map(Number);
00030:     return ha * 60 + ma - (hb * 60 + mb);
00031:   });
00032: }

00157:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hhmm);
00158: 
00159:     const key = hasLogical
00160:       ? lotteryCode
00161:         ? `${ymd}__${hhmm}__${lotteryCode}`
00162:         : `${ymd}__${hhmm}`
00163:       : `id__${id || `idx_${i}`}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00166:       byKey.set(key, d);
00167:       order.push(key);
00168:       continue;
00169:     }
00170: 
00171:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00172:     if (score(d) > score(prev)) {
00173:       byKey.set(key, d);
00174:     }
00175:   }
00176: 
00177:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00178: }

00196: function clampMs(n, min, max) {
00197:   const x = Number(n);
00198:   if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return min;
00199:   return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, x));

00202: function clampYmdToBounds(ymd, minYmd, maxYmd) {
00203:   if (!ymd) return null;
00204: 
00205:   const n = ymdToNumber(ymd);
00206:   const a = ymdToNumber(minYmd);
00207:   const b = ymdToNumber(maxYmd);
00208: 
00209:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return null;
00210: 
00211:   if (Number.isFinite(a) && n < a) return minYmd;
00212:   if (Number.isFinite(b) && n > b) return maxYmd;
00213:   return ymd;
00214: }
00215: 
00216: function clampRangeToBounds(ymdFrom, ymdTo, minYmd, maxYmd) {
00217:   let a = ymdFrom || null;
00218:   let b = ymdTo || null;
00219: 
00220:   if (minYmd || maxYmd) {
00221:     a = clampYmdToBounds(a, minYmd, maxYmd);
00222:     b = clampYmdToBounds(b, minYmd, maxYmd);
00223:   }
00224: 
00225:   const na = ymdToNumber(a);
00226:   const nb = ymdToNumber(b);
00227:   if (Number.isFinite(na) && Number.isFinite(nb) && na > nb) {
00228:     return { ymdFrom: b, ymdTo: a };
00229:   }
00230: 
00231:   return { ymdFrom: a, ymdTo: b };
00232: }

00234: function normalizeBucketInput(bucket) {

00238:   if (m) return `${String(m[1]).padStart(2, "0")}h`;
00239:   return s;
00240: }

00035: export function diffDaysCeil(fromIso, toIso) {

00049: }
00050: 
00051: export function normalizePhoneDigits(v) {
00052:   return digitsOnly(v).slice(0, 11);

00057:   return s.length === 10 || s.length === 11;

00060: // (xx) xxxx-xxxx (10) | (xx) 9 xxxx-xxxx (11)
00061: export function formatPhoneBR(digits) {
00062:   const d = normalizePhoneDigits(digits);
00063:   if (!d) return "";
00064: 
00065:   if (d.length <= 2) return `(${d}`;
00066:   const dd = d.slice(0, 2);
00067: 
00068:   // 10 dígitos
00069:   if (d.length <= 10) {
00070:     const a = d.slice(2, 6);
00071:     const b = d.slice(6, 10);
00072:     if (d.length <= 6) return `(${dd}) ${a}`;
00073:     return `(${dd}) ${a}${b ? `-${b}` : ""}`;
00074:   }
00075: 
00076:   // 11 dígitos
00077:   const ninth = d.slice(2, 3);
00078:   const a = d.slice(3, 7);
00079:   const b = d.slice(7, 11);
00080:   if (d.length <= 3) return `(${dd}) ${ninth}`;
00081:   if (d.length <= 7) return `(${dd}) ${ninth} ${a}`;
00082:   return `(${dd}) ${ninth} ${a}${b ? `-${b}` : ""}`;
00083: }
00084:

00086:    Texto / Perfil
00087: ========================= */

00089: export function computeInitials(name) {
00090:   const nm = String(name || "").trim();
00091:   if (!nm) return DEFAULT_INITIALS;
00092: 
00093:   const parts = nm.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
00094:   const a = parts[0]?.[0] || DEFAULT_INITIALS[0];
00095:   const b = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1]?.[0] || "" : "";
00096:   return (a + b).toUpperCase();
00097: }

00195:     if (!digits) continue;
00196: 
00197:     return digits
00198:       .slice(-4)
00199:       .padStart(4, "0");
00200:   }
00201: 
00202:   return "";
00203: }

00205: function groupFromDezena(dezena) {
00206:   const value = Number(dezena);
00207: 
00208:   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
00209:     return null;
00210:   }
00211: 
00212:   if (value === 0) return 25;
00213: 
00214:   return Math.ceil(value / 4);
00215: }

00224:     normalized.slice(-2)

00228: function groupFromPrize(prize) {
00229:   const explicitCandidates = [
00230:     prize?.grupo,
00231:     prize?.group,
00232:     prize?.animalGroup,
00233:     prize?.grupoNumero,

00238: 
00239:     if (
00240:       Number.isInteger(value) &&
00241:       value >= 1 &&
00242:       value <= 25
00243:     ) {
00244:       return value;
00245:     }

00253:     milhar.slice(-2)

00257: async function mapWithConcurrency(
00258:   items,
00259:   concurrency,
00260:   worker
00261: ) {
00262:   const output = new Array(items.length);
00263:   let cursor = 0;
00264: 
00265:   async function run() {
00266:     while (true) {
00267:       const index = cursor;
00268:       cursor += 1;
00269: 
00270:       if (index >= items.length) {
00271:         return;
00272:       }
00273: 
00274:       output[index] = await worker(
00275:         items[index],
00276:         index
00277:       );
00278:     }
00279:   }
00280: 
00281:   const runners = Array.from(
00282:     {
00283:       length: Math.max(
00284:         1,
00285:         Math.min(concurrency, items.length)
00286:       ),
00287:     },
00288:     run
00289:   );
00290: 
00291:   await Promise.all(runners);
00292: 
00293:   return output;
00294: }
00295: 
00296: async function loadHistoricalPrizes(
00297:   onProgress
00298: ) {
00299:   if (historicalCache) {
00300:     return historicalCache;
00301:   }
00302: 
00303:   if (historicalPromise) {
00304:     return historicalPromise;
00305:   }
00306: 
00307:   historicalPromise = (async () => {
00308:     const boundsRaw = await getKingBoundsByUf(
00309:       LOTTERY_KEY
00310:     );
00311: 
00312:     const bounds = normalizeBounds(boundsRaw);
00313: 
00314:     if (
00315:       !isYmd(bounds.minYmd) ||
00316:       !isYmd(bounds.maxYmd)
00317:     ) {
00318:       throw new Error(
00319:         "Não foi possível identificar os limites da base histórica."
00320:       );
00321:     }
00322: 
00323:     const chunks = splitRange(
00324:       bounds.minYmd,
00325:       bounds.maxYmd
00326:     );
00327: 
00328:     if (!chunks.length) {
00329:       throw new Error(
00330:         "A base histórica não gerou períodos válidos."
00331:       );
00332:     }
00333: 
00334:     let completed = 0;
00335: 
00336:     const results = await mapWithConcurrency(
00337:       chunks,
00338:       3,
00339:       async (chunk) => {
00340:         const response =
00341:           await getKingResultsByRange({
00342:             uf: LOTTERY_KEY,
00343:             dateFrom: chunk.from,
00344:             dateTo: chunk.to,
00345:             closeHour: null,
00346:             positions: POSITIONS,
00347:             mode: "detailed",
00348:           });
00349: 
00350:         const prizes = collectPrizes(response);
00351: 
00352:         completed += 1;
00353: 
00354:         onProgress?.({
00355:           completed,
00356:           total: chunks.length,
00357:           label:
00358:             `Carregando histórico ` +
00359:             `(${completed}/${chunks.length})`,
00360:         });
00361: 
00362:         return prizes;
00363:       }
00364:     );
00365: 
00366:     historicalCache = {
00367:       prizes: results.flat(),
00368:       minYmd: bounds.minYmd,
00369:       maxYmd: bounds.maxYmd,
00370:       chunks: chunks.length,
00371:     };
00372: 
00373:     return historicalCache;
00374:   })();
00375: 
00376:   try {
00377:     return await historicalPromise;
00378:   } finally {
00379:     historicalPromise = null;
00380:   }
00381: }

00383: function formatScore(value) {
00384:   const number = Number(value);
00385: 
00386:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
00387:     return "0,000";
00388:   }
00389: 
00390:   return number.toLocaleString("pt-BR", {
00391:     minimumFractionDigits: 3,
00392:     maximumFractionDigits: 3,
00393:   });
00394: }

00396: function formatPercent(value) {
00397:   const number = Number(value);
00398: 
00399:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
00400:     return "0,00%";
00401:   }
00402: 
00403:   return (number * 100).toLocaleString(
00404:     "pt-BR",
00405:     {
00406:       minimumFractionDigits: 2,
00407:       maximumFractionDigits: 2,
00408:     }
00409:   ) + "%";
00410: }

00004: export function pad2(n) {
00005:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");

00008: /**
00009:  * ✅ YYYY-MM-DD estrito (formato + data válida)
00010:  * - evita aceitar 2026-99-99, 2026-02-31 etc
00011:  */
00012: export function isYMD(s) {
00013:   const str = String(s || "").trim();
00014:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(str)) return false;
00015: 
00016:   const [y, m, d] = str.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00017:   if (!Number.isFinite(y) || !Number.isFinite(m) || !Number.isFinite(d)) return false;
00018:   if (m < 1 || m > 12) return false;
00019:   if (d < 1 || d > 31) return false;
00020: 
00021:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00022:   return (
00023:     dt.getUTCFullYear() === y &&
00024:     dt.getUTCMonth() === m - 1 &&
00025:     dt.getUTCDate() === d
00026:   );
00027: }

00030:   const m = String(ymd || "").trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
00031:   if (!m) return "";
00032:   return `${m[3]}/${m[2]}/${m[1]}`;
00033: }

00036:   const m = String(ymd || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
00037:   if (!m) return null;
00038:   return new Date(Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3])));
00039: }

00067: export function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00068:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
00069:   if (!s0) return "";
00070:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
00071: 
00072:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
00073:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
00074: 
00075:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00076:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
00077: 
00078:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00079:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
00080: 
00081:   return s0.trim();
00082: }

00084: /**
00085:  * Bucketiza para HH:00, ignorando minutos/segundos.
00086:  * Ex: "21:10" -> "21:00", "21h" -> "21:00", "09:00" -> "09:00"
00087:  */
00088: export function toHourBucketHH00(value) {
00089:   const norm = normalizeHourLike(value);
00090:   if (!norm) return "";
00091:   const m = String(norm).match(/^(\d{2})/);
00092:   if (!m) return "";
00093:   const hh = m[1];
00094:   const n = Number(hh);
00095:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 23) return "";
00096:   return `${hh}:00`;
00097: }

00099: export function extractHourFromText(text) {
00100:   const s = String(text ?? "").trim();
00101:   if (!s) return "";
00102:   const mh = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2})\s*(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)\b/i);
00103:   if (mh) return `${pad2(mh[1])}:00`;
00104:   const mIso = s.match(/\b(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\b/);
00105:   if (mIso) return `${pad2(mIso[1])}:${pad2(mIso[2])}`;
00106:   const mBare = s.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})(?:\D|$)/);
00107:   if (mBare) {
00108:     const n = Number(mBare[1]);
00109:     if (Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 23) return `${pad2(n)}:00`;
00110:   }
00111:   return "";
00112: }

00316: /* ========= chunking ========= */
00317: // default seguro (mesmo número que você usa no view)
00318: const DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS = 45;
00319: 
00320: export function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) {
00321:   const out = [];
00322:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
00323:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
00324: 
00325:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
00326:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
00327:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, Number(chunkDays || DEFAULT_CHUNK_DAYS) - 1);
00328:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
00329:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
00330:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
00331:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
00332:     curFrom = next;
00333:   }
00334:   return out;
00335: }

00342:   if (Array.isArray(maybe?.results)) return maybe.results;
00343:   return [];
00344: }

00424: export async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00425:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00426:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 3);
00427:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00428: 
00429:   let idx = 0;
00430: 
00431:   async function worker() {
00432:     // ✅ claim seguro do próximo índice
00433:     // (evita disputa em cenários com yield/microtasks)
00434:     // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
00435:     while (true) {
00436:       const current = idx;
00437:       idx += 1;
00438:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00439:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00440:     }
00441:   }
00442: 
00443:   await Promise.all(
00444:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00445:   );
00446: 
00447:   return results;
00448: }

00454:   if (!s) return "";
00455:   return s.replace(/_(64|96|128)\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$/i, `_${target}.$2`);
00456: }

00322: function splitRangeIntoChunks(fromYmd, toYmd, chunkDays = CHUNK_DAYS) {
00323:   const out = [];
00324:   if (!isYMD(fromYmd) || !isYMD(toYmd)) return out;
00325:   if (fromYmd > toYmd) return out;
00326: 
00327:   let curFrom = fromYmd;
00328:   while (curFrom <= toYmd) {
00329:     const curTo = addDaysUTC(curFrom, chunkDays - 1);
00330:     const boundedTo = curTo > toYmd ? toYmd : curTo;
00331:     out.push({ from: curFrom, to: boundedTo });
00332:     const next = addDaysUTC(boundedTo, 1);
00333:     if (next <= curFrom) break;
00334:     curFrom = next;
00335:   }
00336:   return out;
00337: }

00794:               }

00797:               if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { ymd, hourNorm, hourBucket, prizes: [] });

00048: export function pickMilharFromPrize(prize) {
00049:   if (!prize || typeof prize !== "object") return "";
00050: 
00051:   const candidates = [
00052:     prize.milhar4,
00053:     prize.milhar,
00054:     prize.numero,
00055:     prize.number,
00056:     prize.num,
00057:     prize.n,
00058:     prize.valor,
00059:     prize.value,
00060:     prize.resultado,
00061:     prize.result,
00062:     prize.raw,
00063:   ];
00064: 
00065:   for (const candidate of candidates) {
00066:     const milhar = normalizeMilhar4(candidate);
00067:     if (milhar) return milhar;
00068:   }
00069: 
00070:   return "";
00071: }

00073: export function buildMilharCandidates(centena) {
00074:   const centena3 = normalizeCentena3(centena);
00075:   if (!centena3) return [];
00076: 
00077:   return Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, prefix) => ({
00078:     prefix: String(prefix),
00079:     centena: centena3,
00080:     milhar: `${prefix}${centena3}`,
00081:   }));
00082: }
00083: 
00084: function normalizeRatio(value, maxValue) {
00085:   const n = Number(value) || 0;
00086:   const max = Number(maxValue) || 0;
00087: 
00088:   if (max <= 0) return 0;
00089:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / max));
00090: }
00091: 
00092: function normalizeWeights(customWeights = {}) {
00093:   const merged = {
00094:     ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
00095:     ...(customWeights && typeof customWeights === "object"
00096:       ? customWeights
00097:       : {}),
00098:   };
00099: 
00100:   const keys = Object.keys(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS);
00101:   const total = keys.reduce(
00102:     (sum, key) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(merged[key]) || 0),
00103:     0
00104:   );
00105: 
00106:   if (total <= 0) return { ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS };
00107: 
00108:   return keys.reduce((out, key) => {
00109:     out[key] = Math.max(0, Number(merged[key]) || 0) / total;
00110:     return out;
00111:   }, {});
00112: }

00114: export function rankMilharCandidates({
00115:   centena,
00116:   prizes = [],
00117:   fallbackPrizes = [],
00118:   weights = DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
00119: } = {}) {
00120:   const centena3 = normalizeCentena3(centena);
00121:   const candidates = buildMilharCandidates(centena3);
00122: 
00123:   if (!centena3 || !candidates.length) return [];
00124: 
00125:   const dezena = centena3.slice(-2);
00126:   const rows = [];
00127: 
00128:   for (let index = 0; index < prizes.length; index += 1) {
00129:     const milhar = pickMilharFromPrize(prizes[index]);
00130:     if (!milhar) continue;
00131: 
00132:     rows.push({
00133:       milhar,
00134:       prefix: milhar.slice(0, 1),
00135:       centena: milhar.slice(-3),
00136:       dezena: milhar.slice(-2),
00137:       sequence: index + 1,
00138:     });
00139:   }
00140: 
00141:   const fallbackRows = [];
00142: 
00143:   for (
00144:     let index = 0;
00145:     index < fallbackPrizes.length;
00146:     index += 1
00147:   ) {
00148:     const milhar = pickMilharFromPrize(
00149:       fallbackPrizes[index]
00150:     );
00151: 
00152:     if (!milhar) continue;
00153: 
00154:     fallbackRows.push({
00155:       milhar,
00156:       prefix: milhar.slice(0, 1),
00157:       centena: milhar.slice(-3),
00158:       dezena: milhar.slice(-2),
00159:       sequence: index + 1,
00160:     });
00161:   }
00162: 
00163:   /*
00164:    * Hierarquia da evidência:
00165:    *
00166:    * 1. ocorrências da própria centena no recorte atual;
00167:    * 2. ocorrências históricas da própria centena;
00168:    * 3. contexto de prefixos do recorte atual;
00169:    * 4. contexto histórico, quando o recorte estiver vazio.
00170:    *
00171:    * Assim, todas as 40 centenas recebem uma milhar sem voltar
00172:    * a aplicar mecanicamente um único prefixo ao grupo inteiro.
00173:    */
00174:   const currentCentenaRows = rows.filter(
00175:     (row) => row.centena === centena3
00176:   );
00177: 
00178:   const historicalCentenaRows = fallbackRows.filter(
00179:     (row) => row.centena === centena3
00180:   );
00181: 
00182:   const centenaRows = currentCentenaRows.length
00183:     ? currentCentenaRows
00184:     : historicalCentenaRows;
00185: 
00186:   const contextRows = rows.length
00187:     ? rows
00188:     : fallbackRows;
00189: 
00190:   if (
00191:     centenaRows.length === 0 &&
00192:     contextRows.length === 0
00193:   ) {
00194:     return [];
00195:   }
00196: 
00197:   const totalRows = centenaRows.length;
00198: 
00199:   const exactCount = new Map();
00200:   const exactLastSeen = new Map();
00201:   const prefixSameDezenaCount = new Map();
00202:   const prefixOverallCount = new Map();
00203: 
00204:   for (
00205:     let index = 0;
00206:     index < centenaRows.length;
00207:     index += 1
00208:   ) {
00209:     const row = centenaRows[index];
00210: 
00211:     exactCount.set(
00212:       row.milhar,
00213:       (exactCount.get(row.milhar) || 0) + 1
00214:     );
00215: 
00216:     exactLastSeen.set(
00217:       row.milhar,
00218:       index + 1
00219:     );
00220:   }
00221: 
00222:   for (const row of contextRows) {
00223:     prefixOverallCount.set(
00224:       row.prefix,
00225:       (prefixOverallCount.get(row.prefix) || 0) + 1
00226:     );
00227: 
00228:     if (row.dezena === dezena) {
00229:       prefixSameDezenaCount.set(
00230:         row.prefix,
00231:         (prefixSameDezenaCount.get(row.prefix) || 0) + 1
00232:       );
00233:     }
00234:   }
00235: 
00236:   const maxExact = Math.max(
00237:     0,
00238:     ...candidates.map((candidate) => exactCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0)
00239:   );
00240: 
00241:   const maxPrefixSameDezena = Math.max(
00242:     0,
00243:     ...candidates.map(
00244:       (candidate) => prefixSameDezenaCount.get(candidate.prefix) || 0
00245:     )
00246:   );
00247: 
00248:   const maxPrefixOverall = Math.max(
00249:     0,
00250:     ...candidates.map(
00251:       (candidate) => prefixOverallCount.get(candidate.prefix) || 0
00252:     )
00253:   );
00254: 
00255:   const normalizedWeights = normalizeWeights(weights);
00256: 
00257:   const ranking = candidates.map((candidate) => {
00258:     const countExact = exactCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;
00259:     const countPrefixSameDezena =
00260:       prefixSameDezenaCount.get(candidate.prefix) || 0;
00261:     const countPrefixOverall =
00262:       prefixOverallCount.get(candidate.prefix) || 0;
00263:     const lastSeen = exactLastSeen.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;
00264: 
00265:     const exactFrequency = normalizeRatio(countExact, maxExact);
00266:     const prefixSameDezena = normalizeRatio(
00267:       countPrefixSameDezena,
00268:       maxPrefixSameDezena
00269:     );
00270:     const prefixOverall = normalizeRatio(
00271:       countPrefixOverall,
00272:       maxPrefixOverall
00273:     );
00274:     const exactRecency = totalRows > 0
00275:       ? normalizeRatio(lastSeen, totalRows)
00276:       : 0;
00277: 
00278:     const score =
00279:       exactFrequency * normalizedWeights.exactFrequency +
00280:       prefixSameDezena * normalizedWeights.prefixSameDezena +
00281:       prefixOverall * normalizedWeights.prefixOverall +
00282:       exactRecency * normalizedWeights.exactRecency;
00283: 
00284:     return {
00285:       ...candidate,
00286:       score: Number((score * 100).toFixed(4)),
00287:       evidence: {
00288:         exactFrequency: {
00289:           count: countExact,
00290:           normalized: Number(exactFrequency.toFixed(6)),
00291:         },
00292:         prefixSameDezena: {
00293:           count: countPrefixSameDezena,
00294:           normalized: Number(prefixSameDezena.toFixed(6)),
00295:         },
00296:         prefixOverall: {
00297:           count: countPrefixOverall,
00298:           normalized: Number(prefixOverall.toFixed(6)),
00299:         },
00300:         exactRecency: {
00301:           lastSeen,
00302:           totalRows,
00303:           normalized: Number(exactRecency.toFixed(6)),
00304:         },
00305:       },
00306:     };
00307:   });
00308: 
00309:   ranking.sort((a, b) => {
00310:     if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
00311: 
00312:     const aExact = a.evidence.exactFrequency.count;
00313:     const bExact = b.evidence.exactFrequency.count;
00314:     if (bExact !== aExact) return bExact - aExact;
00315: 
00316:     /*
00317:      * O prefixo já participa do score.
00318:      * Não pode voltar a dominar o desempate.
00319:      */
00320:     const aLastSeen = a.evidence.exactRecency.lastSeen;
00321:     const bLastSeen = b.evidence.exactRecency.lastSeen;
00322:     if (bLastSeen !== aLastSeen) return bLastSeen - aLastSeen;
00323: 
00324:     return Number(a.prefix) - Number(b.prefix);
00325:   });
00326: 
00327:   return ranking.map((item, index) => ({
00328:     position: index + 1,
00329:     ...item,
00330:   }));
00331: }

00501: export function diversifyMilharRecommendations(
00502:   rows = [],
00503:   {
00504:     maxPerPrefix = 4,
00505:     repeatPenalty = 12,
00506:   } = {}
00507: ) {
00508:   const source = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [];
00509:   const usage = new Map();
00510: 
00511:   return source.map((row) => {
00512:     const centena = normalizeCentena3(row?.centena);
00513: 
00514:     const candidatesRaw = Array.isArray(
00515:       row?.recommendation?.candidates
00516:     )
00517:       ? row.recommendation.candidates
00518:       : [];
00519: 
00520:     const candidates = candidatesRaw
00521:       .filter((item) => {
00522:         const milhar = normalizeMilhar4(item?.milhar);
00523: 
00524:         return (
00525:           milhar &&
00526:           milhar.slice(-3) === centena
00527:         );
00528:       })
00529:       .map((item) => ({
00530:         ...item,
00531:         milhar: normalizeMilhar4(item.milhar),
00532:         prefixo: String(
00533:           item?.prefixo ??
00534:           normalizeMilhar4(item.milhar).slice(0, 1)
00535:         ),
00536:         score: Number(item?.score || 0),
00537:       }));
00538: 
00539:     if (!candidates.length) {
00540:       return row;
00541:     }
00542: 
00543:     const ranked = candidates
00544:       .map((candidate) => {
00545:         const used = Number(
00546:           usage.get(candidate.prefixo) || 0
00547:         );
00548: 
00549:         return {
00550:           ...candidate,
00551:           used,
00552:           adjustedScore:
00553:             candidate.score -
00554:             used * Number(repeatPenalty || 0),
00555:         };
00556:       })
00557:       .sort((a, b) => {
00558:         const aBelowLimit =
00559:           a.used < Number(maxPerPrefix || 4);
00560:         const bBelowLimit =
00561:           b.used < Number(maxPerPrefix || 4);
00562: 
00563:         if (aBelowLimit !== bBelowLimit) {
00564:           return aBelowLimit ? -1 : 1;
00565:         }
00566: 
00567:         if (b.adjustedScore !== a.adjustedScore) {
00568:           return b.adjustedScore - a.adjustedScore;
00569:         }
00570: 
00571:         if (b.score !== a.score) {
00572:           return b.score - a.score;
00573:         }
00574: 
00575:         return Number(a.prefixo) - Number(b.prefixo);
00576:       });
00577: 
00578:     const selected = ranked[0];
00579: 
00580:     usage.set(
00581:       selected.prefixo,
00582:       Number(usage.get(selected.prefixo) || 0) + 1
00583:     );
00584: 
00585:     return {
00586:       ...row,
00587:       milhar: selected.milhar,
00588:       recommendation: {
00589:         ...(row?.recommendation || {}),
00590:         milhar: selected.milhar,
00591:         prefixo: selected.prefixo,
00592:         diversified: true,
00593:         originalMilhar:
00594:           row?.recommendation?.milhar || null,
00595:         diversity: {
00596:           prefixUsageBefore: selected.used,
00597:           adjustedScore: Number(
00598:             selected.adjustedScore.toFixed(4)
00599:           ),
00600:           maxPerPrefix: Number(maxPerPrefix || 4),
00601:           repeatPenalty: Number(repeatPenalty || 0),
00602:         },
00603:       },
00604:     };
00605:   });
00606: }

00287: function normalizeWeightsV3(weights = {}) {
00288:   const merged = {
00289:     ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS_V3,
00290:     ...(weights || {}),

00293:   const sanitized = {};
00294: 
00295:   for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS_V3)) {
00296:     sanitized[key] = Math.max(
00297:       0,
00298:       safeNumber(merged[key], 0)
00299:     );
00300:   }

00302:   const total = Object.values(sanitized)
00303:     .reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

00307:       ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS_V3,

00312:     Object.entries(sanitized).map(
00313:       ([key, value]) => [key, value / total]

00315:   );
00316: }

00384:     safeNumber(targetPosition, 0);

00387:     normalizeWeightsV3(weights);

00390:   const hourCount = new Map();
00391:   const weekdayCount = new Map();
00392:   const positionCount = new Map();
00393:   const recentCount = new Map();
00394:   const recentPrefixCount = new Map();
00395:   const lastSeenSequence = new Map();
00396: 
00397:   const relevantRows = rows.filter(
00398:     (row) => row.centena === centena3
00399:   );
00400: 
00401:   const windowSize = Math.max(
00402:     20,
00403:     Math.floor(
00404:       safeNumber(
00405:         recentWindow,
00406:         DEFAULT_RECENT_WINDOW
00407:       )
00408:     )
00409:   );
00410: 
00411:   const recentRows = rows.slice(-windowSize);
00412:   const recentRelevantRows = recentRows.filter(
00413:     (row) => row.centena === centena3
00414:   );
00415: 
00416:   for (const row of relevantRows) {
00417:     increment(exactCount, row.milhar);

00420:       row.milhar,
00421:       row.sequence
00422:     );

00425:       targetHourNormalized &&

00432:       targetWeekday !== null &&
00433:       row.weekday === targetWeekday

00435:       increment(weekdayCount, row.milhar);
00436:     }
00437: 
00438:     if (
00439:       targetPositionNumber > 0 &&
00440:       row.position === targetPositionNumber
00441:     ) {
00442:       increment(positionCount, row.milhar);
00443:     }
00444:   }
00445: 
00446:   for (const row of recentRelevantRows) {
00447:     increment(recentCount, row.milhar);
00448:   }
00449: 
00450:   for (const row of recentRows) {
00451:     increment(recentPrefixCount, row.prefix);
00452:   }
00453: 
00454:   const maxExact = maxMapValue(exactCount);
00455:   const maxHour = maxMapValue(hourCount);
00456:   const maxWeekday = maxMapValue(weekdayCount);
00457:   const maxPosition = maxMapValue(positionCount);
00458:   const maxRecent = maxMapValue(recentCount);
00459:   const maxRecentPrefix =
00460:     maxMapValue(recentPrefixCount);
00461: 
00462:   const maxSequence = Math.max(
00463:     0,
00464:     ...Array.from(lastSeenSequence.values())
00465:   );

00468:     const exactRaw =
00469:       exactCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00472:       hourCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00475:       weekdayCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00478:       positionCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00481:       recentCount.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00484:       recentPrefixCount.get(candidate.prefix) || 0;

00487:       lastSeenSequence.get(candidate.milhar) || 0;

00498:       },

00544:       evidence.exactFrequency.normalized *
00545:         normalizedWeights.exactFrequency +
00546:       evidence.hourFrequency.normalized *
00547:         normalizedWeights.hourFrequency +
00548:       evidence.weekdayFrequency.normalized *
00549:         normalizedWeights.weekdayFrequency +
00550:       evidence.positionFrequency.normalized *

00585:       b.evidence.weekdayFrequency.count +
00586:       b.evidence.positionFrequency.count;
00587: 
00588:     const aContext =
00589:       a.evidence.hourFrequency.count +
00590:       a.evidence.weekdayFrequency.count +
00591:       a.evidence.positionFrequency.count;
00592: 
00593:     if (bContext !== aContext) {
00594:       return bContext - aContext;
00595:     }
00596: 
00597:     if (
00598:       b.evidence.recentTrend.count !==
00599:       a.evidence.recentTrend.count
00600:     ) {
00601:       return (
00602:         b.evidence.recentTrend.count -
00603:         a.evidence.recentTrend.count
00604:       );
00605:     }
00606: 
00607:     if (
00608:       b.evidence.exactFrequency.count !==
00609:       a.evidence.exactFrequency.count
00610:     ) {
00611:       return (
00612:         b.evidence.exactFrequency.count -
00613:         a.evidence.exactFrequency.count

00038: /** ✅ Normaliza "qualquer data" para YYYY-MM-DD (ou null). */
00039: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00040:   if (!input) return null;
00041: 
00042:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
00043:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00044:     const d = input.toDate();
00045:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00046:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00047:         d.getUTCDate()
00048:       )}`;
00049:     }
00050:   }
00051: 
00052:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
00053:   if (
00054:     typeof input === "object" &&
00055:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
00056:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00057:   ) {
00058:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00059:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00060:       : Number(input._seconds);
00061: 
00062:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00063:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00064:       return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00065:         d.getUTCDate()
00066:       )}`;
00067:     }
00068:   }
00069: 
00070:   // Date
00071:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00072:     return `${input.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00073:       input.getUTCDate()
00074:     )}`;
00075:   }
00076: 
00077:   const s = String(input).trim();
00078:   if (!s) return null;
00079: 
00080:   // YYYY-MM-DD...
00081:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00082:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00083: 
00084:   // DD/MM/YYYY
00085:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00086:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00087: 
00088:   return null;
00089: }

00151: /** ✅ Normaliza close_hour para HH:MM */
00152: function normHHMM(value) {
00153:   const s0 = String(value || "").trim();
00154:   if (!s0) return null;
00155: 
00156:   const s = s0.toLowerCase();
00157: 
00158:   // "09:00h" / "09:00"
00159:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?\s*h?$/i);
00160:   if (mISO) {
00161:     const hh = String(mISO[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00162:     const mm = String(mISO[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00163:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00164:   }
00165: 
00166:   // "09h00" / "9h00" / "09h00m"
00167:   const mhm = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*(\d{1,2})?\s*(m|min)?\s*s?$/i);
00168:   if (mhm) {
00169:     const hh = String(mhm[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00170:     const mm = String(mhm[2] ?? "0").padStart(2, "0");
00171:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00172:   }
00173: 
00174:   // "9h" / "09h" / "09hs"
00175:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*h\s*s?$/i);
00176:   if (mh) return `${String(mh[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00177: 
00178:   // "9" / "09"
00179:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00180:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00181: 
00182:   return null;
00183: }
00184: 
00185: /** ✅ Mapeia HH:MM -> BUCKET "09h" etc. */
00186: function hhmmToBucket09h(value) {
00187:   const hhmm = normHHMM(value);
00188:   if (!hhmm) return null;
00189:   const hh = hhmm.slice(0, 2);
00190:   if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(hh)) return null;
00191:   return `${hh}h`;
00192: }

00194: function safeNumber(n) {
00195:   const x = Number(n);
00196:   return Number.isFinite(x) ? x : 0;
00197: }

00209: /** ✅ DEDUPE conservador (sem colapsar draws reais) */
00210: function dedupeDraws(drawsRaw) {
00211:   const arr = Array.isArray(drawsRaw) ? drawsRaw : [];
00212:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00213: 
00214:   const seen = new Set();
00215:   const out = [];
00216: 
00217:   const prizeSig = (draw) => {
00218:     const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00219:     if (!prizes.length) return "noprz";
00220:     const parts = prizes
00221:       .slice(0, 12)
00222:       .map((pz) => {
00223:         const pos = String(pz?.posicao ?? pz?.position ?? "").trim();
00224:         const g = String(pz?.grupo ?? pz?.group ?? pz?.g ?? "").replace(
00225:           /\D/g,
00226:           ""
00227:         );
00228:         const n = String(
00229:           pz?.milhar ??
00230:             pz?.milhar4 ??
00231:             pz?.numero ??
00232:             pz?.number ??
00233:             pz?.num ??
00234:             pz?.num4 ??
00235:             ""
00236:         )
00237:           .replace(/\D/g, "")
00238:           .slice(-4);
00239:         return `${pos}:${g}:${n}`;
00240:       })
00241:       .join("|");
00242:     return parts || "noprz";
00243:   };
00244: 
00245:   for (const d of arr) {
00246:     const idKey =
00247:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId).trim()) ||
00248:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id).trim()) ||
00249:       "";
00250: 
00251:     if (idKey) {
00252:       if (seen.has(`id:${idKey}`)) continue;
00253:       seen.add(`id:${idKey}`);
00254:       out.push(d);
00255:       continue;
00256:     }
00257: 
00258:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d) || "";
00259:     const hhmm = normHHMM(getDrawCloseHour(d)) || "";
00260:     const lot = getDrawLotteryKey(d) || "";
00261:     const sig = prizeSig(d);
00262: 
00263:     if (!ymd || !hhmm) {
00264:       out.push(d);
00265:       continue;
00266:     }
00267: 
00268:     const key = `logic:${ymd}__${hhmm}__${lot}__${sig}`;
00269:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00270:     seen.add(key);
00271:     out.push(d);
00272:   }
00273: 
00274:   return out;
00275: }

00329: /** ✅ Detecta se um draw "contém" o grupo selecionado (qualquer posição) */
00330: function drawHasGrupo(draw, selectedGrupo) {
00331:   const gSel = Number(selectedGrupo);
00332:   if (!Number.isFinite(gSel) || gSel < 1 || gSel > 25) return false;
00333: 
00334:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00335:   for (const pz of prizes) {

00342: /** ✅ Conta aparições do grupo selecionado (por posição) e total */
00343: function countGrupoAparicoes(draws, selectedGrupo, expectedPositions) {
00344:   const gSel = Number(selectedGrupo);
00345:   if (!Number.isFinite(gSel) || gSel < 1 || gSel > 25) {
00346:     return { total: 0, byPos: [] };
00347:   }
00348: 
00349:   const posList =
00350:     Array.isArray(expectedPositions) && expectedPositions.length
00351:       ? expectedPositions
00352:           .map((n) => Number(n))
00353:           .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0)
00354:       : [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
00355: 
00356:   const map = new Map(posList.map((p) => [p, 0]));
00357:   let total = 0;
00358: 
00359:   const safeDraws = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00360:   for (const d of safeDraws) {
00361:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00362:     for (const pz of prizes) {
00363:       const g = getPrizeGrupo(pz);
00364:       if (g !== gSel) continue;
00365: 
00366:       const pos = getPrizePos(pz);
00367:       if (!pos || !map.has(pos)) continue;
00368: 
00369:       map.set(pos, (map.get(pos) || 0) + 1);
00370:       total += 1;
00371:     }
00372:   }
00373: 
00374:   const byPos = posList.map((p) => ({
00375:     label: prettyPosLabel(p),
00376:     value: map.get(p) || 0,
00377:   }));
00378:   return { total, byPos };
00379: }

00381: /** ✅ Conta APARIÇÕES no draw com recortes coerentes */
00382: function countAparicoesInDraw(
00383:   draw,
00384:   { selectedGrupo, selectedPosOrNull, expectedPositions } = {}
00385: ) {
00386:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00387:   if (!prizes.length) return 0;
00388: 
00389:   const gSel = Number(selectedGrupo);
00390:   const hasGrupo = Number.isFinite(gSel) && gSel >= 1 && gSel <= 25;
00391: 
00392:   const posDomain =
00393:     Array.isArray(expectedPositions) && expectedPositions.length
00394:       ? new Set(
00395:           expectedPositions
00396:             .map((n) => Number(n))
00397:             .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0)
00398:         )
00399:       : new Set([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]);
00400: 
00401:   const posFilter = Number(selectedPosOrNull);
00402:   const hasPosFilter = Number.isFinite(posFilter) && posFilter > 0;
00403: 
00404:   let c = 0;
00405:   for (const pz of prizes) {
00406:     const pos = getPrizePos(pz);
00407:     if (!pos || !posDomain.has(pos)) continue;
00408:     if (hasPosFilter && pos !== posFilter) continue;
00409: 
00410:     if (hasGrupo) {
00411:       const g = getPrizeGrupo(pz);
00412:       if (g !== gSel) continue;
00413:     }
00414: 
00415:     c += 1;
00416:   }
00417:   return c;
00418: }

00420: /** ✅ OPÇÃO B (insight) — original (apenas quando NÃO há selectedGrupo) */
00421: function buildPosAnimalRanking(draws, expectedPositions, selectedPosOrNull) {
00422:   const safeDraws = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00423: 
00424:   const posList =
00425:     Array.isArray(expectedPositions) && expectedPositions.length
00426:       ? expectedPositions
00427:           .map((n) => Number(n))
00428:           .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0)
00429:       : [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
00430: 
00431:   const map = new Map();
00432:   for (const p of posList) map.set(p, new Map());
00433: 
00434:   const pickPrizeAnimalLabel = (prize) => {
00435:     if (!prize) return "";
00436: 
00437:     const grupo =
00438:       prize?.grupo ??
00439:       prize?.group ??
00440:       prize?.grupo1 ??
00441:       prize?.grupo_1 ??
00442:       prize?.g ??
00443:       null;
00444: 
00445:     const animal =
00446:       prize?.animal ??
00447:       prize?.animal2 ??
00448:       prize?.bicho ??
00449:       prize?.nome ??
00450:       prize?.name ??
00451:       prize?.an ??
00452:       null;
00453: 
00454:     let label = "";
00455:     try {
00456:       label = getAnimalLabel({ grupo, animal });
00457:     } catch {
00458:       label = "";
00459:     }
00460: 
00461:     const base = String(label || animal || grupo || "").trim();
00462:     return base ? base : "";
00463:   };
00464: 
00465:   for (const d of safeDraws) {
00466:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00467:     for (const pz of prizes) {
00468:       const pos = getPrizePos(pz);
00469:       if (!pos) continue;
00470:

00473:

00475:       if (!aLabel) continue;
00476:

00478:       posMap.set(aLabel, (posMap.get(aLabel) || 0) + 1);
00479:     }
00480:   }
00481: 
00482:   const sortStable = (a, b) => {
00483:     const dv = safeNumber(b.value) - safeNumber(a.value);
00484:     if (dv !== 0) return dv;
00485:     return String(a.label || "").localeCompare(String(b.label || ""), "pt-BR");
00486:   };
00487: 
00488:   if (selectedPosOrNull) {
00489:     const m = map.get(selectedPosOrNull) || new Map();
00490:     const items = Array.from(m.entries())
00491:       .map(([label, value]) => ({ label, value }))
00492:       .sort(sortStable)
00493:       .slice(0, 10);

00496:       mode: "single",
00497:       header: `Top animais — ${prettyPosLabel(selectedPosOrNull)}`,
00498:       items,
00499:     };
00500:   }
00501: 
00502:   const out = [];
00503:   for (const pos of posList) {
00504:     const m = map.get(pos) || new Map();
00505:     const sorted = Array.from(m.entries())
00506:       .map(([label, value]) => ({ label, value }))
00507:       .sort(sortStable);
00508: 
00509:     const top = sorted[0] || null;
00510:     if (!top) {
00511:       out.push({ pos, animal: "—", value: 0 });
00512:       continue;
00513:     }
00514:     out.push({ pos, animal: top.label, value: top.value });
00515:   }
00516:

00518:     mode: "all",
00519:     header: "Top animal por posição",
00520:     items: out,
00521:   };
00522: }

00524: /** ✅ GLOBAL: aparições por grupo (01..25), IGNORANDO filtros e selectedGrupo */

00649: function BarChartHorizontalMonthPremium({ data }) {
00650:   const W = 900;
00651:   const safeData = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
00652:   const rows = Math.max(1, safeData.length);
00653:   const H = calcMonthViewH(rows);
00654:

00657:   const valueCol = 110;

00663:   const rowGap = 10;
00664:   const rowH = (innerH - rowGap * (rows - 1)) / rows;
00665:   const barH = clamp(rowH * 0.76, 18, 34);
00666: 
00667:   const max = Math.max(0, ...safeData.map((d) => safeNumber(d.value)));
00668:

00670:   const fontVal = 14;

00673:     <div style={{ ...ui.svgFill, height: "100%" }}>
00674:       <svg
00675:         viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
00676:         width="100%"
00677:         height="100%"
00678:         style={{ display: "block" }}
00679:         preserveAspectRatio="none"
00680:       >
00681:         {safeData.map((d, i) => {
00682:           const v = safeNumber(d.value);
00683:           const pct = max > 0 ? v / max : 0;
00684: 
00685:           const rowTop = pad.t + i * (rowH + rowGap);
00686:           const cy = rowTop + rowH / 2;
00687:

00696:               <text
00697:                 x={xLabel + 2}

00712:                   width={fillW}
00713:                   height={barH}

00760:     ? clamp(130 + rows * 52, 380, 600)

00874: /**
00875:  * ✅ Horário (barras verticais) — com fonte GRANDE
00876:  * Espera data = [{ label:"14h", value: 192 }, {label:"Total", value: 192}]
00877:  */
00878: function WaterfallHourChart({ data }) {
00879:   const safeData = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
00880:   if (!safeData.length) return <EmptyState label="" />;
00881: 
00882:   const W = 900;
00883:   const H = 420;
00884: 
00885:   const pad = { l: 26, r: 26, t: 28, b: 58 };
00886:   const innerW = W - pad.l - pad.r;
00887:   const innerH = H - pad.t - pad.b;
00888: 
00889:   const gap = 24;
00890:   const n = safeData.length;
00891:   const barW = clamp((innerW - gap * (n - 1)) / n, 90, 240);
00892: 
00893:   const max = Math.max(1, ...safeData.map((d) => safeNumber(d.value)));
00894:   const scaleMax = max;
00895: 
00896:   const fontValue = 14;
00897:   const fontLabel = 14;
00898: 
00899:   return (
00900:     <div style={{ ...ui.svgFill, height: "100%" }}>

00902:         viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`}
00903:         width="100%"
00904:         height="100%"
00905:         style={{ display: "block" }}
00906:         preserveAspectRatio="none"
00907:       >
00908:         {safeData.map((d, i) => {
00909:           const v = safeNumber(d.value);
00910: 
00911:           const x = pad.l + i * (barW + gap);
00912:           const yBase = pad.t + innerH;
00913:           const y = yBase - (v / scaleMax) * innerH;
00914:           const h = Math.max(14, yBase - y);
00915: 
00916:           return (

00919:                 x={x}
00920:                 y={y}
00921:                 width={barW}
00922:                 height={h}
00923:                 rx="16"
00924:                 fill={PP.gold}
00925:                 stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.20)"
00926:                 strokeWidth="1"

00928:                   filter: "drop-shadow(0 12px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.55))",
00929:                 }}
00930:               />
00931: 
00932:               <text
00933:                 x={x + barW / 2}
00934:                 y={y - 12}
00935:                 textAnchor="middle"
00936:                 fontSize={fontValue}
00937:                 fontWeight="950"
00938:                 fill={PP.text}
00939:               >
00940:                 {fmtIntPT(v)}
00941:               </text>
00942: 
00943:               <text
00944:                 x={x + barW / 2}
00945:                 y={H - 20}
00946:                 textAnchor="middle"
00947:                 fontSize={fontLabel}
00948:                 fontWeight="900"
00949:                 fill={PP.text2}
00950:               >
00951:                 {String(d.label)}
00952:               </text>
00953:             </g>
00954:           );
00955:         })}
00956:       </svg>
00957:     </div>
00958:   );

01157: /* =========================
01158:    Stats (APARIÇÕES)
01159: ========================= */
01160: 
01161: function computeStats({ drawsRawView, drawsRawGlobal, filters, selectedGrupo }) {
01162:   const drawsView = dedupeDraws(drawsRawView);
01163:   const drawsGlobal = dedupeDraws(drawsRawGlobal);
01164: 
01165:   const gSel = Number(selectedGrupo);
01166:   const hasSelected = Number.isFinite(gSel) && gSel >= 1 && gSel <= 25;
01167: 
01168:   const expectedPositions = parseExpectedPositionsFromFilters(filters);
01169:   const selectedPosOrNull = normalizePosFilter(filters);
01170: 
01171:   const draws = hasSelected
01172:     ? drawsView.filter((d) => drawHasGrupo(d, gSel))
01173:     : drawsView;
01174: 
01175:   const yearsSet = new Set();
01176:   for (const d of draws) {
01177:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
01178:     if (!ymd) continue;
01179:     const y = Number(ymd.slice(0, 4));
01180:     if (Number.isFinite(y) && y > 1900) yearsSet.add(y);
01181:   }
01182:   const isMultiYear = yearsSet.size > 1;
01183: 
01184:   const monthOrder = [
01185:     "Janeiro",
01186:     "Fevereiro",
01187:     "Março",
01188:     "Abril",
01189:     "Maio",
01190:     "Junho",
01191:     "Julho",
01192:     "Agosto",
01193:     "Setembro",
01194:     "Outubro",
01195:     "Novembro",
01196:     "Dezembro",
01197:   ];
01198: 
01199:   let totalAparicoesNoRecorte = 0;
01200:   for (const d of draws) {
01201:     totalAparicoesNoRecorte += countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
01202:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
01203:       selectedPosOrNull,
01204:       expectedPositions,
01205:     });
01206:   }
01207: 
01208:   const monthMap = new Map();
01209:   for (const d of draws) {
01210:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
01211:     const m = ymd ? getMonthPT(ymd) : null;
01212:     if (!m) continue;
01213: 
01214:     const apar = countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
01215:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
01216:       selectedPosOrNull,
01217:       expectedPositions,
01218:     });
01219: 
01220:     monthMap.set(m, (monthMap.get(m) || 0) + apar);
01221:   }
01222: 
01223:   const monthDataDisplay = monthOrder.map((m) => ({
01224:     label: m,
01225:     value: monthMap.get(m) || 0,
01226:   }));
01227: 
01228:   const wdOrder = [
01229:     { key: "Dom", label: "domingo" },
01230:     { key: "Seg", label: "segunda-feira" },
01231:     { key: "Ter", label: "terça-feira" },
01232:     { key: "Qua", label: "quarta-feira" },
01233:     { key: "Qui", label: "quinta-feira" },
01234:     { key: "Sex", label: "sexta-feira" },
01235:     { key: "Sáb", label: "sábado" },
01236:   ];
01237: 
01238:   const wdMap = new Map(wdOrder.map((k) => [k.key, 0]));
01239: 
01240:   for (const d of draws) {
01241:     const ymd = getDrawDate(d);
01242:     if (!ymd) continue;
01243: 
01244:     const [y, m, dd] = ymd.split("-").map(Number);
01245:     if (!y || !m || !dd) continue;
01246: 
01247:     const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, dd));
01248:     const w = dt.getUTCDay();
01249:     const map = ["Dom", "Seg", "Ter", "Qua", "Qui", "Sex", "Sáb"];
01250:     const wd = map[w] || null;
01251:     if (!wd) continue;
01252: 
01253:     const apar = countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
01254:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
01255:       selectedPosOrNull,
01256:       expectedPositions,
01257:     });
01258: 
01259:     wdMap.set(wd, (wdMap.get(wd) || 0) + apar);
01260:   }
01261: 
01262:   const weekdayData = wdOrder.map((it) => ({
01263:     label: it.label,
01264:     value: wdMap.get(it.key) || 0,
01265:   }));
01266: 
01267:   const ALLOWED_BUCKETS = ["09h", "11h", "14h", "16h", "18h", "21h"];
01268:   const hourMap = new Map(ALLOWED_BUCKETS.map((b) => [b, 0]));
01269:   let aparicoesComHoraTotal = 0;
01270: 
01271:   for (const d of draws) {
01272:     const bucket = hhmmToBucket09h(getDrawCloseHour(d));
01273:     if (!bucket) continue;
01274:     if (!hourMap.has(bucket)) continue;
01275: 
01276:     const apar = countAparicoesInDraw(d, {
01277:       selectedGrupo: hasSelected ? gSel : null,
01278:       selectedPosOrNull,
01279:       expectedPositions,
01280:     });
01281: 
01282:     hourMap.set(bucket, (hourMap.get(bucket) || 0) + apar);
01283:     aparicoesComHoraTotal += apar;
01284:   }
01285: 
01286:   const hourData = ALLOWED_BUCKETS.map((label) => ({
01287:     label,
01288:     value: hourMap.get(label) || 0,
01289:   })).filter((x) => safeNumber(x.value) > 0);

00031: function pad2(n) {
00032:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00033: }
00034: 
00035: function isISODate(s) {
00036:   return /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.test(String(s || ""));
00037: }
00038: 
00039: function formatBR(iso) {
00040:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return "";
00041:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-");
00042:   return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
00043: }
00044: 
00045: function toUTCDate(iso) {
00046:   if (!isISODate(iso)) return null;
00047:   const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
00048:   if (!y || !m || !d) return null;
00049:   return new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d));
00050: }
00051: 
00052: function fromUTCDate(dt) {
00053:   if (!(dt instanceof Date) || !Number.isFinite(dt.getTime())) return null;
00054:   const y = dt.getUTCFullYear();
00055:   const m = pad2(dt.getUTCMonth() + 1);
00056:   const d = pad2(dt.getUTCDate());
00057:   return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
00058: }
00059: 
00060: function clamp(n, a, b) {
00061:   return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));
00062: }
00063: 
00064: function clampDateISO(iso, minISO, maxISO) {
00065:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
00066:   const minDt = toUTCDate(minISO);
00067:   const maxDt = toUTCDate(maxISO);
00068: 
00069:   if (!minDt || !maxDt) return isISODate(iso) ? iso : null;
00070:   if (!dt) return maxISO;
00071: 
00072:   const clamped = new Date(clamp(dt.getTime(), minDt.getTime(), maxDt.getTime()));
00073:   return fromUTCDate(clamped) || maxISO;
00074: }
00075: 
00076: function daysBetweenUTC(aISO, bISO) {
00077:   const a = toUTCDate(aISO);
00078:   const b = toUTCDate(bISO);
00079:   if (!a || !b) return 0;
00080:   const ms = b.getTime() - a.getTime();
00081:   if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return 0;
00082:   return Math.floor(ms / 86400000);
00083: }
00084: 
00085: function addDaysUTC(iso, days) {
00086:   const dt = toUTCDate(iso);
00087:   if (!dt) return iso;
00088:   dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate() + Number(days || 0));
00089:   return fromUTCDate(dt);
00090: }

00024: function pad2(n) {
00025:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00026: }
00027: 
00028: /**
00029:  * ✅ FIX (UTC-safe):
00030:  * Gera YMD usando getters UTC para evitar "virar o dia" por timezone (-03).
00031:  */
00032: function ymdFromDateUTC(d) {
00033:   return `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getUTCDate())}`;
00034: }
00035: 
00036: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00037:   if (!input) return null;
00038: 
00039:   // Firestore Timestamp-like: { toDate() }
00040:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00041:     const d = input.toDate();
00042:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00043:       return ymdFromDateUTC(d);
00044:     }
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   // Timestamp-like: { seconds } / { _seconds }
00048:   if (
00049:     typeof input === "object" &&
00050:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00051:   ) {
00052:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00053:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00054:       : Number(input._seconds);
00055: 
00056:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00057:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00058:       return ymdFromDateUTC(d);
00059:     }
00060:   }
00061: 
00062:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00063:     return ymdFromDateUTC(input);
00064:   }
00065: 
00066:   const s = String(input).trim();
00067:   if (!s) return null;
00068: 
00069:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00070:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00071: 
00072:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00073:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00074: 
00075:   return null;
00076: }
