00087:     draw.data ??
00088:     draw.dt ??
00089:     draw.day ??
00090:     null;
00091: 
00092:   return normalizeToYMD(raw);
00093: }

00028: function digitsOnly(v) {
00029:   const s = String(v ?? "").trim();
00030:   if (!s) return "";
00031:   return s.replace(/\D+/g, "");
00032: }
00033: 
00034: function toMilhar4(v) {
00035:   const d = digitsOnly(v);
00036:   if (!d) return null;
00037:   return d.length >= 4 ? d.slice(-4).padStart(4, "0") : d.padStart(4, "0");
00038: }

00040: function safeNumber(n) {
00041:   const x = Number(n);
00042:   return Number.isFinite(x) ? x : 0;
00043: }

00047:     r?.total ??
00048:       r?.apar ??
00049:       r?.aparicoes ??
00050:       r?.aparições ??
00051:       r?.count ??
00052:       r?.value ??
00053:       0
00054:   );
00055: }

00060:     return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(x);
00061:   } catch {
00062:     return String(x);

00066: function normalizeGrupoNumber(v) {
00067:   const s = String(v ?? "").trim();
00068:   if (!s) return 0;
00069:   const n = Number(s);
00070:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
00071: }

00073: function grupoTo2(g) {
00074:   const n = normalizeGrupoNumber(g);
00075:   return String(n).padStart(2, "0");
00076: }

00078: function uniq(arr) {
00079:   return Array.from(new Set(arr.filter(Boolean)));
00080: }

00083:   return String(v ?? "").trim();

00086: /** ✅ Gera candidatos de imagem (robusto) */
00087: function buildImgCandidates(getImgFromGrupo, grupo) {
00088:   const base96 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 96));
00089:   const base128 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 128));
00090:   const base64 = safeStr(getImgFromGrupo(grupo, 64));
00091: 
00092:   const bases = [base128, base96, base64].filter(Boolean);
00093: 
00094:   const out = [];
00095:   for (const src of bases) {
00096:     out.push(src);
00097: 
00098:     if (/\.png(\?|#|$)/i.test(src)) {
00099:       out.push(src.replace(/\.png(\?|#|$)/i, ".jpg$1"));
00100:       out.push(src.replace(/\.png(\?|#|$)/i, ".jpeg$1"));
00101:     }
00102: 
00103:     if (/\.jpe?g(\?|#|$)/i.test(src)) {
00104:       out.push(src.replace(/\.jpe?g(\?|#|$)/i, ".png$1"));
00105:     }
00106:   }
00107: 
00108:   return uniq(out);
00109: }

00086: function ensureSizeVariants(baseNoQuery) {
00087:   const out = [];
00088: 
00089:   // se já tem _64/_96/_128 no nome, tenta os outros
00090:   const has64 = /_64\./.test(baseNoQuery);
00091:   const has96 = /_96\./.test(baseNoQuery);
00092:   const has128 = /_128\./.test(baseNoQuery);
00093: 
00094:   if (has96) {
00095:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 96, 128));
00096:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 96, 64));
00097:   }
00098:   if (has128) {
00099:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 128, 96));
00100:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 128, 64));
00101:   }
00102:   if (has64) {
00103:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 64, 96));
00104:     out.push(swapSizeInPath(baseNoQuery, 64, 128));
00105:   }
00106: 
00107:   // se NÃO tiver size no nome, tenta inserir antes da extensão
00108:   if (!has64 && !has96 && !has128) {
00109:     const m = baseNoQuery.match(/^(.*)\.(png|PNG|jpg|jpeg)$/);
00110:     if (m) {
00111:       const stem = m[1];
00112:       const ext = m[2];
00113:       out.push(`${stem}_96.${ext}`);
00114:       out.push(`${stem}_128.${ext}`);
00115:       out.push(`${stem}_64.${ext}`);
00116:     }
00117:   }
00118: 
00119:   return out;
00120: }

00122: function makeImgVariants(src) {
00123:   const current = normalizeImgSrc(src);
00124:   if (!current) return [];
00125: 
00126:   const baseNoQuery = current.split("?")[0];
00127:   const out = [];
00128: 
00129:   // principal
00130:   out.push(baseNoQuery);
00131: 
00132:   // variações de size (muito comum o erro ser pedir _96 e existir _128)
00133:   out.push(...ensureSizeVariants(baseNoQuery));
00134: 
00135:   // alterna case/extensão
00136:   if (baseNoQuery.match(/\.png$/)) out.push(baseNoQuery.replace(/\.png$/, ".PNG"));
00137:   if (baseNoQuery.match(/\.PNG$/)) out.push(baseNoQuery.replace(/\.PNG$/, ".png"));
00138: 
00139:   // tenta jpg/jpeg
00140:   out.push(baseNoQuery.replace(/\.(png|PNG)$/i, ".jpg"));
00141:   out.push(baseNoQuery.replace(/\.(png|PNG|jpg)$/i, ".jpeg"));
00142: 
00143:   // também troca extensão nas variantes de size (caso stem exista só em jpg etc)
00144:   const extra = [];
00145:   for (const p of out) {
00146:     extra.push(p.replace(/\.(png|PNG)$/i, ".jpg"));
00147:     extra.push(p.replace(/\.(png|PNG|jpg)$/i, ".jpeg"));
00148:     if (p.match(/\.png$/)) extra.push(p.replace(/\.png$/, ".PNG"));
00149:     if (p.match(/\.PNG$/)) extra.push(p.replace(/\.PNG$/, ".png"));
00150:   }
00151: 
00152:   return Array.from(new Set([...out, ...extra].filter(Boolean)));
00153: }

00181: function normalizeHourBucket(h) {
00182:   const raw = String(h ?? "").trim();
00183:   if (!raw || raw.toLowerCase() === "todos") return null;
00184:

00186:

00188:   if (m) return `${String(m[1]).padStart(2, "0")}h`;
00189: 
00190:   m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?$/);

00192:

00475: function clampRangeToBounds(next, minDate, maxDate) {
00476:   const f = next?.from;
00477:   const t = next?.to;
00478: 
00479:   if (!isISODate(f) || !isISODate(t)) return null;
00480:   if (!minDate || !maxDate) return null;
00481:   if (!isISODate(minDate) || !isISODate(maxDate)) return null;
00482: 
00483:   let from = f < minDate ? minDate : f;
00484:   let to = t > maxDate ? maxDate : t;
00485: 
00486:   if (from > to) to = from;
00487:   return { from, to };
00488: }

00490: function normalizeLoteriaKey(v) {
00491:   const raw = String(v ?? "").trim();
00492: 
00493:   if (!raw) return "PT_RIO";
00494: 
00495:   const key = raw
00496:     .toLowerCase()
00497:     .normalize("NFD")
00498:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
00499:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
00500:     .trim();
00501: 
00502:   if (key === "federal" || key === "fed" || key === "br" || key === "brasil") return "FEDERAL";
00503:   if (key === "rj" || key === "rio" || key === "pt_rio" || key === "pt-rio") return "PT_RIO";
00504: 
00505:   const out = key
00506:     .toUpperCase()
00507:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "_")
00508:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");
00509: 
00510:   return out || "PT_RIO";
00511: }

00538: function yearRangeToDates(minY, maxY, floorISO, ceilISO) {
00539:   const y1 = Number(minY);
00540:   const y2 = Number(maxY);
00541:   if (!Number.isFinite(y1) || !Number.isFinite(y2)) return null;
00542: 
00543:   const a = Math.min(y1, y2);
00544:   const b = Math.max(y1, y2);
00545: 
00546:   let from = `${a}-01-01`;
00547:   let to = `${b}-12-31`;
00548: 
00549:   if (isISODate(floorISO) && from < floorISO) from = floorISO;
00550:   if (isISODate(ceilISO) && to > ceilISO) to = ceilISO;
00551: 
00552:   if (isISODate(from) && isISODate(to) && from > to) to = from;
00553:   return { from, to };
00554: }

00608: function dedupeDrawsForKpi(list, ufKey) {
00609:   const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
00610:   if (!arr.length) return [];
00611:   const seen = new Set();
00612:   const out = [];
00613: 
00614:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00615:     const d = arr[i];
00616:     const k = getDrawUniqKeyForKpi(d, ufKey, i);
00617:     if (!k) continue;
00618:     if (seen.has(k)) continue;
00619:     seen.add(k);
00620:     out.push(d);
00621:   }
00622: 
00623:   return out;
00624: }

00626: function buildYearsAvailable(minISO, maxISO) {

00633:   const out = [];

00209: function clampYmd(ymd, minDate, maxDate) {
00210:   const d = normalizeToYMD(ymd);
00211:   if (!isYMD(d)) return null;
00212: 
00213:   let out = d;
00214: 
00215:   if (isYMD(minDate) && out < minDate) out = minDate;
00216:   if (isYMD(maxDate) && out > maxDate) out = maxDate;
00217: 
00218:   return out;

00221: function normalizeRangeWithBounds(fromIn, toIn, minDate, maxDate) {
00222:   let from = clampYmd(fromIn, minDate, maxDate);
00223:   let to = clampYmd(toIn, minDate, maxDate);
00224: 
00225:   const fallback = clampYmd(todayYMDLocal(), minDate, maxDate) || maxDate || minDate || todayYMDLocal();
00226: 
00227:   if (!from) from = fallback;
00228:   if (!to) to = from;
00229: 
00230:   if (from > to) [from, to] = [to, from];

00298:   const blob = new Blob([array], {
00299:     type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
00300:   });
00301: 
00302:   downloadBlob(filename, blob);

00305: function exportExcelXls({ filename, title, metaLines, columns, rows, textCols }) {
00306:   const esc = (s) =>
00307:     String(s ?? "")
00308:       .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
00309:       .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
00310:       .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
00311:       .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
00312: 
00313:   const isTextCol = (idx) => Array.isArray(textCols) && textCols.includes(idx);
00314: 
00315:   const thead = `<tr>${columns.map((c) => `<th>${esc(c)}</th>`).join("")}</tr>`;
00316:   const tbody = rows
00317:     .map((r) => {
00318:       const tds = r
00319:         .map((v, idx) => {
00320:           const style = isTextCol(idx) ? ` style="mso-number-format:'\\@';"` : "";
00321:           return `<td${style}>${esc(v)}</td>`;
00322:         })
00323:         .join("");
00324:       return `<tr>${tds}</tr>`;
00325:     })
00326:     .join("");
00327: 
00328:   const metaHtml = (metaLines || [])
00329:     .map((l) => `<div style="margin:2px 0;">${esc(l)}</div>`)
00330:     .join("");
00331: 
00332:   const html = `
00333:   <html xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office"
00334:         xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel"
00335:         xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-html40">
00336:     <head>
00337:       <meta charset="utf-8" />
00338:       <!--[if gte mso 9]><xml>
00339:         <x:ExcelWorkbook>
00340:           <x:ExcelWorksheets>
00341:             <x:ExcelWorksheet>
00342:               <x:Name>resultados</x:Name>
00343:               <x:WorksheetOptions>
00344:                 <x:Print><x:ValidPrinterInfo/></x:Print>
00345:               </x:WorksheetOptions>
00346:             </x:ExcelWorksheet>
00347:           </x:ExcelWorksheets>
00348:         </x:ExcelWorkbook>
00349:       </xml><![endif]-->
00350:     </head>
00351:     <body>
00352:       <div style="font-family: Arial; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px;">
00353:         ${esc(title || "Exportação")}
00354:       </div>
00355:       <div style="font-family: Arial; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
00356:         ${metaHtml}
00357:       </div>
00358:       <table border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5" style="border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Arial; font-size: 12px;">
00359:         <thead style="font-weight:700;background:#f2f2f2;">${thead}</thead>

00369: async function exportPdfReal({
00370:   filename,
00371:   title,
00372:   metaLines,
00373:   columns,
00374:   rows,
00375:   orientation = "landscape",
00376: }) {
00377:   const jsPDFMod = await import("jspdf");
00378:   const jsPDF = jsPDFMod?.jsPDF ?? jsPDFMod?.default ?? jsPDFMod;
00379: 
00380:   const autoTableMod = await import("jspdf-autotable");
00381:   const autoTable = autoTableMod?.default ?? autoTableMod?.autoTable ?? autoTableMod;
00382: 
00383:   const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation, unit: "pt", format: "a4", compress: true });
00384: 
00385:   const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
00386:   const marginX = 34;
00387:   const marginTop = 34;
00388: 
00389:   doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
00390:   doc.setFontSize(14);
00391:   doc.text(String(title || "Relatório"), marginX, marginTop);
00392: 
00393:   const metas = Array.isArray(metaLines) ? metaLines : [];
00394:   doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
00395:   doc.setFontSize(10);
00396: 
00397:   let y = marginTop + 16;
00398:   for (const line of metas) {
00399:     const s = String(line ?? "");
00400:     if (!s) continue;
00401:     const wrapped = doc.splitTextToSize(s, pageWidth - marginX * 2);
00402:     doc.text(wrapped, marginX, y);
00403:     y += wrapped.length * 12;
00404:   }
00405: 
00406:   y += 10;
00407: 
00408:   const head = [columns.map((c) => String(c ?? ""))];
00409:   const body = (rows || []).map((r) => (r || []).map((v) => String(v ?? "")));
00410: 
00411:   if (typeof doc.autoTable !== "function") {
00412:     if (typeof autoTable === "function") {
00413:       autoTable(doc, {
00414:         startY: y,
00415:         head,
00416:         body,
00417:         theme: "grid",
00418:         styles: { font: "helvetica", fontSize: 9, cellPadding: 4, overflow: "linebreak", valign: "middle" },
00419:         headStyles: { fontStyle: "bold" },
00420:         margin: { left: marginX, right: marginX },
00421:         tableWidth: pageWidth - marginX * 2,
00422:       });
00423:     } else {
00424:       throw new Error("Falha ao carregar 'jspdf-autotable'. Confirme: npm i jspdf-autotable");
00425:     }
00426:   } else {
00427:     doc.autoTable({
00428:       startY: y,
00429:       head,
00430:       body,
00431:       theme: "grid",
00432:       styles: { font: "helvetica", fontSize: 9, cellPadding: 4, overflow: "linebreak", valign: "middle" },
00433:       headStyles: { fontStyle: "bold" },
00434:       margin: { left: marginX, right: marginX },
00435:       tableWidth: pageWidth - marginX * 2,
00436:     });
00437:   }
00438: 
00439:   const pageCount = doc.getNumberOfPages();
00440:   doc.setFontSize(9);
00441:   doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
00442: 
00443:   for (let i = 1; i <= pageCount; i += 1) {
00444:     doc.setPage(i);
00445:     const footer = `Página ${i} / ${pageCount}`;
00446:     const w = doc.getTextWidth(footer);
00447:     doc.text(footer, pageWidth - marginX - w, doc.internal.pageSize.getHeight() - 18);
00448:   }
00449: 
00450:   const arrayBuffer = doc.output("arraybuffer");
00451:   const blob = new Blob([arrayBuffer], { type: "application/pdf" });
00452:   downloadBlob(filename, blob);
00453: }

00082: /**
00083:  * Normaliza entradas como:
00084:  * "09h" / "09HS" / "9" / "09:10" -> "09:00" ou "09:10"
00085:  */
00086: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00087:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
00088:   if (!s0) return "";
00089: 
00090:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
00091:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
00092:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
00093: 
00094:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00095:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
00096: 
00097:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00098:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
00099: 
00100:   return s0.trim();
00101: }

00107:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
00108:   const m = String(s).match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00109:   if (!m) return null;
00110:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00111:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00112:   if (!Number.isFinite(hh) || !Number.isFinite(mm)) return null;
00113:   return hh * 60 + mm;

00144:  */
00145: function pickLatestCloseHour(drawsLike) {
00146:   const arr = unwrapDraws(drawsLike);
00147:   let best = null;
00148:   let bestMin = -1;
00149: 
00150:   for (const d of arr) {
00151:     const ch = normalizeHourLike(d?.close_hour || d?.closeHour || d?.hour || d?.hora || "");
00152:     const min = hourToMinutes(ch);
00153:     if (min == null) continue;
00154:     if (min > bestMin) {
00155:       bestMin = min;
00156:       best = { ymd: d?.ymd || d?.date || "", closeHour: ch || "" };
00157:     }
00158:   }
00159: 
00160:   return best;
00161: }
00162: 
00163: // escolhe "mais recente" entre (ymd + closeHour)
00164: function isMoreRecent(a, b) {
00165:   const ay = String(a?.lastYmd || "");
00166:   const by = String(b?.lastYmd || "");
00167:   if (ay && by && ay !== by) return ay > by;
00168: 
00169:   const am = hourToMinutes(a?.lastCloseHour || "");
00170:   const bm = hourToMinutes(b?.lastCloseHour || "");
00171:   if (am != null && bm != null && am !== bm) return am > bm;
00172: 
00173:   if (ay && !by) return true;
00174:   if (!ay && by) return false;
00175: 
00176:   return false;
00177: }

00179: // merge de múltiplas consultas (ex: 1º ao 5º) => pega a última aparição mais recente por grupo
00180: function mergeLateLists(lists, baseYmd) {
00181:   const byGrupo = new Map();
00182: 
00183:   for (const list of lists) {
00184:     const arr = Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
00185:     for (const r of arr) {
00186:       const g = Number(r?.grupo);
00187:       if (!isValidGrupo(g)) continue;
00188: 
00189:       const candidate = {
00190:         grupo: g,
00191:         lastYmd: r?.lastYmd || null,
00192:         // ✅ normaliza aqui (evita “09h/09HS/9”)
00193:         lastCloseHour: r?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(r.lastCloseHour) : "",
00194:       };
00195: 
00196:       if (!byGrupo.has(g)) {
00197:         byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
00198:         continue;
00199:       }
00200: 
00201:       const prev = byGrupo.get(g);
00202:       if (isMoreRecent(candidate, prev)) byGrupo.set(g, candidate);
00203:     }
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const out = [];
00207:   for (let g = 1; g <= 25; g += 1) {
00208:     const rec = byGrupo.get(g) || { grupo: g, lastYmd: null, lastCloseHour: "" };
00209:     const lastYmd = rec?.lastYmd || null;
00210:     const lastCloseHour = rec?.lastCloseHour ? normalizeHourLike(rec.lastCloseHour) : "";
00211:     const daysLate = lastYmd ? diffDaysUTC(lastYmd, baseYmd) : null;
00212: 
00213:     out.push({
00214:       grupo: g,
00215:       grupo2: toGrupo2(g),
00216:       lastYmd,
00217:       lastCloseHour,
00218:       daysLate,
00219:     });
00220:   }
00221: 
00222:   // ordenação: atraso desc, depois hora asc, depois grupo asc
00223:   out.sort((a, b) => {
00224:     const aa = a.daysLate == null ? 999999 : a.daysLate;
00225:     const bb = b.daysLate == null ? 999999 : b.daysLate;
00226:     if (bb !== aa) return bb - aa;
00227: 
00228:     const ma = hourToMinutes(a.lastCloseHour);
00229:     const mb = hourToMinutes(b.lastCloseHour);
00230:     if (ma != null && mb != null && ma !== mb) return ma - mb;
00231:     if (ma == null && mb != null) return 1;
00232:     if (ma != null && mb == null) return -1;
00233: 
00234:     return a.grupo - b.grupo;
00235:   });
00236: 
00237:   return out.map((r, idx) => ({ ...r, pos: idx + 1 }));
00238: }

00244: function clampYmd(ymd, minYmd, maxYmd) {
00245:   const d = safeStr(ymd);
00246:   if (!isYMD(d)) return null;
00247: 
00248:   let out = d;
00249:   const min = safeStr(minYmd);
00250:   const max = safeStr(maxYmd);
00251: 
00252:   if (isYMD(min) && out < min) out = min;
00253:   if (isYMD(max) && out > max) out = max;
00254: 
00255:   return out;
00256: }

00258: function normalizeSingleDateWithBounds(dateIn, minYmd, maxYmd) {
00259:   const d = clampYmd(dateIn, minYmd, maxYmd);
00260:   if (d) return d;
00261: 
00262:   const fallback =
00263:     clampYmd(todayYMDLocal(), minYmd, maxYmd) ||
00264:     (isYMD(maxYmd) ? maxYmd : null) ||
00265:     (isYMD(minYmd) ? minYmd : null) ||
00266:     todayYMDLocal();
00267: 
00268:   return fallback;
00269: }

00271: /* =========================

00274: function normalizeBoundsResponse(b) {
00275:   const minRaw = safeStr(b?.minYmd || b?.minDate || b?.min || "");
00276:   const maxRaw = safeStr(b?.maxYmd || b?.maxDate || b?.max || "");
00277:   const minYmd = isYMD(minRaw) ? minRaw : null;
00278:   const maxYmd = isYMD(maxRaw) ? maxRaw : null;
00279:   return { minYmd, maxYmd, source: safeStr(b?.source || "") };
00280: }

00534:     out.push("09:00");
00535:   }
00536: 
00537:   return out;
00538: }
00539: 
00540: function shouldShowExpectedHour(ymd, hour) {
00541:   const hNum = hourToNum(hour);
00542:   if (hNum < 0) return true;
00543: 
00544:   if (safeStr(ymd) !== todayYMDLocal()) return true;
00545: 
00546:   return hNum <= currentHourNumLocal();
00547: }
00548: 
00549: function buildExpectedDrawsForScope(scopeKey, orderedDraws, ymd) {
00550:   const list = Array.isArray(orderedDraws) ? orderedDraws : [];
00551:   const byHour = new Map();
00552: 
00553:   for (const d of list) {
00554:     const h = normalizeHourLike(
00555:       d?.close_hour || d?.closeHour || d?.hour || d?.hora || ""
00556:     );
00557:     if (!h) continue;
00558:     if (!byHour.has(h)) byHour.set(h, d);
00559:   }
00560: 
00561:   if (scopeKey === SCOPE_FEDERAL) {
00562:     return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
00563:       const ha = hourToNum(
00564:         a?.__slotHour || a?.close_hour || a?.closeHour || a?.hour || a?.hora
00565:       );
00566:       const hb = hourToNum(
00567:         b?.__slotHour || b?.close_hour || b?.closeHour || b?.hour || b?.hora
00568:       );
00569:       return hb - ha;
00570:     });
00571:   }
00572: 
00573:   const expectedHours =
00574:     scopeKey === SCOPE_RJ ? getExpectedRjHoursDesc(ymd) : [];
00575: 
00576:   const visibleExpectedHours = expectedHours.filter((hour) =>
00577:     shouldShowExpectedHour(ymd, hour)
00578:   );
00579: 
00580:   const result = visibleExpectedHours.map((hour) => {
00581:     const found = byHour.get(hour);
00582:     if (found) return found;
00583: 
00584:     return {
00585:       __placeholder: true,
00586:       __slotHour: hour,
00587:       __placeholderKind: "compact",
00588:       drawId: `placeholder_${scopeKey}_${hour}`,
00589:       id: `placeholder_${scopeKey}_${hour}`,
00590:       close_hour: hour,
00591:       closeHour: hour,
00592:       prizes: [],
00593:     };
00594:   });
00595: 
00596:   const extraActual = list.filter((d) => {
00597:     const h = normalizeHourLike(
00598:       d?.close_hour || d?.closeHour || d?.hour || d?.hora || ""
00599:     );
00600:     return h && !visibleExpectedHours.includes(h);
00601:   });
00602: 
00603:   return [...result, ...extraActual].sort((a, b) => {
00604:     const ha = hourToNum(
00605:       a?.__slotHour || a?.close_hour || a?.closeHour || a?.hour || a?.hora
00606:     );
00607:     const hb = hourToNum(
00608:       b?.__slotHour || b?.close_hour || b?.closeHour || b?.hour || b?.hora
00609:     );
00610:     return hb - ha;
00611:   });
00612: }
00613: 
00614: function monthDaysWithDraws(draws) {
00615:   const out = new Set();
00616:   for (const d of Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []) {
00617:     const y = safeStr(d?.ymd || d?.date || "");
00618:     if (isYMD(y)) out.add(y);
00619:   }
00620:   return out;
00621: }

00185: function splitRangeYmd(from, to, chunkDays = 60) {
00186:   if (!isYMD(from) || !isYMD(to)) return [];
00187:   if (from > to) return [];
00188: 
00189:   const out = [];
00190:   let cur = from;
00191: 
00192:   while (cur <= to) {
00193:     const endCandidate = addDaysUtc(cur, chunkDays - 1);
00194:     const end = endCandidate && endCandidate < to ? endCandidate : to;
00195:     out.push({ from: cur, to: end });
00196:     const next = addDaysUtc(end, 1);
00197:     if (!next) break;
00198:     cur = next;
00199:   }
00200:   return out;
00201: }

00307:     if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

00315:       if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
00316:     }

00337: function pickPrizeFromDrawByPos(draw, pos) {
00338:   const i = Number(pos);
00339:   const digits = pickPrizeDigits(draw, i);
00340:   const grupo = pickPrizeGrupo(draw, i);
00341: 
00342:   if (!digits && !Number.isFinite(Number(grupo))) return null;

00345:     position: i,
00346:     grupo: Number.isFinite(Number(grupo)) ? Number(grupo) : null,
00347:     numero: digits,
00348:     milhar4: digits && digits.length === 4 ? digits : null,
00349:     centena3: digits && digits.length === 3 ? digits : null,
00350:     milhar: digits && digits.length === 4 ? digits : null,
00351:   };

00376: function buildSlots(digits) {
00377:   const d = String(digits || "").slice(0, 4);
00378:   const len = d.length;
00379: 
00380:   if (len < 2) return ["", "", "", ""];
00381: 
00382:   const slots = ["", "", "", ""];
00383: 
00384:   if (len === 2) {
00385:     slots[0] = "*";
00386:     slots[1] = "*";
00387:     slots[2] = d[0];
00388:     slots[3] = d[1];
00389:     return slots;
00390:   }
00391: 
00392:   if (len === 3) {
00393:     slots[0] = "*";
00394:     slots[1] = d[0];
00395:     slots[2] = d[1];
00396:     slots[3] = d[2];
00397:     return slots;
00398:   }
00399: 
00400:   slots[0] = d[0];
00401:   slots[1] = d[1];
00402:   slots[2] = d[2];
00403:   slots[3] = d[3];
00404:   return slots;
00405: }

00490: /* =========================
00491:    Pool (concorrência limitada)
00492: ========================= */
00493: 
00494: async function runPool(items, worker, concurrency = 3) {
00495:   const queue = [...items];
00496:   const runners = Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, concurrency) }, async () => {
00497:     while (queue.length) {
00498:       const it = queue.shift();
00499:       // eslint-disable-next-line no-await-in-loop
00500:       await worker(it);
00501:     }
00502:   });
00503:   await Promise.all(runners);
00504: }

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036:   return base + add;
00037: }

00040:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00041:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00042:   if (!y || !h) return "";
00043:   return `${y}|${h}`;
00044: }

00046: function dedupeAndSort(draws) {
00047:   const map = new Map();
00048: 
00049:   for (const d of Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []) {

00052:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, d);
00053:   }
00054: 
00055:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawTs(a) - drawTs(b));
00056: }

00027: function drawTs(draw) {
00028:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00029:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00030:   if (!y || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00031: 
00032:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00033:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00034:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00035:   const add = mins >= 0 ? mins * 60 * 1000 : 0;
00036: 
00037:   return base + add;
00038: }
00039: 
00040: function drawKey(draw) {
00041:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00042:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00043:   if (!y || !h) return "";
00044:   return `${y}|${h}`;
00045: }
00046: 
00047: function dedupeAndSort(draws) {
00048:   const map = new Map();
00049: 
00050:   for (const d of Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []) {
00051:     const key = drawKey(d);
00052:     if (!key) continue;
00053:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, d);
00054:   }
00055: 
00056:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawTs(a) - drawTs(b));
00057: }
00058: 
00059: function top5Groups(draw) {
00060:   const out = [];
00061: 
00062:   for (const p of Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : []) {
00063:     const pos = Number(guessPrizePos(p));
00064:     const g = Number(guessPrizeGrupo(p));
00065: 
00066:     if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 5) continue;
00067:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) continue;
00068: 
00069:     out.push({ pos, grupo: g });
00070:   }
00071: 
00072:   return out.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
00073: }
00074: 
00075: function pct(n, d) {
00076:   return d ? ((n / d) * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
00077: }

00006: /**
00007:  * Evidence Engine
00008:  *
00009:  * Centraliza todos os módulos de evidência.
00010:  * Cada módulo produz fatos; nenhum decide o resultado.
00011:  */
00012: 
00013: const MODULES = {
00014:   frequency: buildFrequencyEvidence,
00015:   context: buildContextEvidence,
00016: };
00017: 
00018: function collectEvidence({
00019:   item = {},
00020:   context = {},
00021:   config = {},
00022: } = {}) {
00023: 
00024:   const evidence = [];
00025:   const enabled = config.evidenceModules || {};
00026: 
00027:   for (const [name, builder] of Object.entries(MODULES)) {
00028: 
00029:     if (!enabled[name]?.enabled) {
00030:       continue;
00031:     }
00032: 
00033:     try {
00034: 
00035:       const result = builder(item, context);
00036: 
00037:       if (result) {
00038:         evidence.push(result);
00039:       }
00040: 
00041:     } catch (err) {
00042: 
00043:       evidence.push({
00044:         module: name,
00045:         error: true,
00046:         message: err.message,
00047:       });
00048: 
00049:     }
00050: 
00051:   }
00052: 
00053:   return {
00054: 
00055:     count: evidence.filter(e => !e.error).length,
00056: 
00057:     modules: evidence
00058:       .filter(e => !e.error)
00059:       .map(e => e.module),
00060: 
00061:     evidence,
00062: 
00063:   };
00064: 
00065: }
00066: 
00067: export {
00068: collectEvidence,
00069: };

00008:  *
00009:  * Consome evidências.
00010:  * Não aplica regra cega isolada.
00011:  */

00013: function normalizeEvidenceValue(value) {
00014:   const n = Number(value);
00015:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return 0;
00016:   return n;
00017: }
00018: 
00019: function calculateEvidenceStrength(evidenceList = []) {
00020:   const list = Array.isArray(evidenceList) ? evidenceList : [];
00021: 
00022:   if (!list.length) {
00023:     return {
00024:       score: 0,
00025:       confidence: 0,
00026:       reasons: ["Sem evidências suficientes."],
00027:       signals: {},
00028:     };
00029:   }
00030: 
00031:   const values = list.map((e) => normalizeEvidenceValue(e.value));
00032:   const total = values.reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 0);
00033:   const max = Math.max(...values, 1);
00034: 
00035:   const score = Math.min(100, Math.round((total / max) * 50));
00036:   const confidence = Math.min(100, Math.round(score * Math.min(1, list.length / 3)));
00037: 
00038:   const reasons = list.flatMap((e) => Array.isArray(e.reasons) ? e.reasons : []);
00039: 
00040:   const signals = {};
00041:   for (const e of list) {
00042:     signals[e.module] = e.evidence || {};
00043:   }
00044: 
00045:   return {
00046:     score,
00047:     confidence,
00048:     reasons,
00049:     signals,
00050:   };
00051: }
00052: 
00053: function scoreItem(item = {}, context = {}) {
00054:   const collected = collectEvidence({
00055:     item,
00056:     context,
00057:     config: scoreConfig,
00058:   });
00059: 
00060:   const strength = calculateEvidenceStrength(collected.evidence);
00061: 
00062:   return {
00063:     ...item,
00064:     score: strength.score,
00065:     confidence: strength.confidence,
00066:     reasons: strength.reasons,
00067:     signals: strength.signals,
00068:     evidenceCount: collected.count,
00069:     evidenceModules: collected.modules,
00070:   };
00071: }
00072: 
00073: function scoreRanking(items = [], context = {}) {
00074: 
00075:   return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])
00076:     .map(item => scoreItem(item, context))
00077:     .sort((a, b) => {
00078: 
00079:       if (b.score !== a.score)
00080:         return b.score - a.score;
00081: 
00082:       if (b.confidence !== a.confidence)
00083:         return b.confidence - a.confidence;
00084: 
00085:       return (Number(b.scoreProb || 0) - Number(a.scoreProb || 0));
00086: 
00087:     });
00088: 
00089: }

00041:   for (const e of list) {
00042:     signals[e.module] = e.evidence || {};
00043:   }
00044: 
00045:   return {
00046:     score,
00047:     confidence,
00048:     reasons,
00049:     signals,
00050:   };
00051: }
00052: 
00053: function scoreItem(item = {}, context = {}) {
00054:   const collected = collectEvidence({
00055:     item,
00056:     context,
00057:     config: scoreConfig,
00058:   });
00059: 
00060:   const strength = calculateEvidenceStrength(collected.evidence);
00061: 
00062:   const probability = Math.max(
00063:     0,
00064:     Math.min(
00065:       100,
00066:       Number(item.scoreProb || item.rawScoreProb || 0) * 100
00067:     )
00068:   );
00069: 
00070:   const finalScore = Math.round(
00071:     (strength.score * 0.45) +
00072:     (probability * 0.55)
00073:   );
00074: 
00075:   const finalConfidence = Math.round(
00076:     (strength.confidence * 0.40) +
00077:     (probability * 0.60)
00078:   );
00079: 
00080:   return {
00081:     ...item,
00082: 
00083:     score: finalScore,
00084: 
00085:     confidence: finalConfidence,
00086: 
00087:     reasons: [
00088:       ...strength.reasons,
00089:       `Probabilidade V3: ${probability.toFixed(2)}%`,
00090:     ],
00091: 
00092:     signals: {
00093:       ...strength.signals,
00094:       probability,
00095:     },
00096: 
00097:     evidenceCount: collected.count,
00098: 
00099:     evidenceModules: collected.modules,
00100:   };
00101: }
00102: 
00103: function scoreRanking(items = [], context = {}) {
00104: 
00105:   return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])
00106:     .map(item => scoreItem(item, context))
00107:     .sort((a, b) => {
00108: 
00109:       if (b.score !== a.score)
00110:         return b.score - a.score;
00111: 
00112:       if (b.confidence !== a.confidence)
00113:         return b.confidence - a.confidence;
00114: 
00115:       return (Number(b.scoreProb || 0) - Number(a.scoreProb || 0));
00116: 
00117:     });
00118: 
00119: }
00120:

00124:   calculateEvidenceStrength,
00125: };

00042: function firstFiniteNumber(...values) {
00043:   for (const v of values) {
00044:     const n = Number(v);
00045:     if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;
00046:   }
00047:

00051: function sanitizeTop3(top) {
00052:   const out = [];
00053:   const seen = new Set();
00054: 
00055:   for (const item of Array.isArray(top) ? top : []) {
00056:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
00057: 
00058:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) continue;
00059: 
00060:     const grupo = Math.trunc(g);
00061:     if (seen.has(grupo)) continue;
00062: 
00063:     const confidence = firstFiniteNumber(
00064:       item?.displayConfidence,
00065:       item?.confidence,
00066:       item?.scoreProb,
00067:       item?.prob,
00068:       0
00069:     );
00070: 
00071:     if (!Number.isFinite(confidence) || confidence < 0) continue;
00072: 
00073:     seen.add(grupo);
00074: 
00075:     out.push({
00076:       ...item,
00077:       grupo,
00078:       displayConfidence: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.displayConfidence))
00079:         ? Number(item.displayConfidence)
00080:         : confidence,
00081:       confidence: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.confidence))
00082:         ? Number(item.confidence)
00083:         : confidence,
00084:       scoreProb: Number.isFinite(Number(item?.scoreProb))
00085:         ? Number(item.scoreProb)
00086:         : confidence,
00087:     });
00088: 
00089:     if (out.length >= 3) break;
00090:   }
00091: 
00092:   return out;
00093: }

00020: function safeInt(v, fallback = 0) {
00021:   const n = Number(v);
00022:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
00023: }
00024: 
00025: function drawSortTs(draw) {
00026:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00027:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00028: 
00029:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00030: 
00031:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00032:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00033: 
00034:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map(Number);
00035:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00036: 
00037:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00038: }
00039: 
00040: function slotTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00041:   const safeYmd = String(ymd || "").trim();
00042:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00043: 
00044:   if (!isYMD(safeYmd) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00045: 
00046:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00047:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00048: 
00049:   const [Y, M, D] = safeYmd.split("-").map(Number);
00050:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00051: 
00052:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00053: }

00055: function dedupeAndSortDraws(draws) {
00056:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00057:   const map = new Map();
00058: 
00059:   for (const d of list) {
00060:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00061:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00062:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00063: 
00064:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
00065: 
00066:     const key =
00067:       String(d?.id || d?.drawId || "").trim() ||
00068:       (isYMD(y) && h ? `${y}|${h}` : "");
00069: 
00070:     if (!key) continue;
00071: 
00072:     const prev = map.get(key);
00073: 
00074:     if (!prev || ts < drawSortTs(prev)) {
00075:       map.set(key, d);
00076:     }
00077:   }
00078: 
00079:   return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => drawSortTs(a) - drawSortTs(b));
00080: }

00082: function makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour) {
00083:   const from = toHourBucket(fromHour);
00084:   const to = toHourBucket(toHour);
00085: 
00086:   if (!from || !to) return "";
00087: 
00088:   return `${from}->${to}`;
00089: }

00091: function getNestedMap(map, key) {
00092:   if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, new Map());
00093:   return map.get(key);
00094: }

00096: function getHistoryBeforeTarget(draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket) {

00101:

00103:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00104:     return Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < target;

00108: export function computeChainTransitions(draws) {
00109:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00110:   const transitionsAny = new Map();
00111:   const transitionsByEdge = new Map();
00112: 
00113:   for (let i = 0; i < list.length - 1; i += 1) {
00114:     const fromDraw = list[i];
00115:     const toDraw = list[i + 1];
00116: 
00117:     const fromGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(fromDraw));
00118:     const toGrupo = Number(pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(toDraw));
00119:     const fromHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(fromDraw));
00120:     const toHour = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(toDraw));
00121: 
00122:     if (!Number.isFinite(fromGrupo) || !Number.isFinite(toGrupo)) continue;
00123:     if (fromGrupo < 1 || fromGrupo > 25) continue;
00124:     if (toGrupo < 1 || toGrupo > 25) continue;
00125:     if (!fromHour || !toHour) continue;
00126: 
00127:     const anyRow = getNestedMap(transitionsAny, fromGrupo);
00128:     anyRow.set(toGrupo, safeInt(anyRow.get(toGrupo), 0) + 1);
00129: 
00130:     const edgeKey = makeEdgeKey(fromHour, toHour);
00131:     if (!edgeKey) continue;
00132: 
00133:     const edgeMap = getNestedMap(transitionsByEdge, edgeKey);
00134:     const edgeRow = getNestedMap(edgeMap, fromGrupo);
00135:     edgeRow.set(toGrupo, safeInt(edgeRow.get(toGrupo), 0) + 1);
00136:   }
00137: 
00138:   return { transitionsAny, transitionsByEdge };
00139: }

00141: function findPreviousDrawForTarget(draws, targetYmd, targetHourBucket) {
00142:   const list = dedupeAndSortDraws(draws);
00143:   if (!list.length) return null;
00144: 
00145:   const target = slotTs(targetYmd, targetHourBucket);
00146:   if (!Number.isFinite(target)) return null;
00147: 
00148:   let prev = null;
00149: 
00150:   for (const d of list) {
00151:     const ts = drawSortTs(d);
00152:     if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue;
00153: 
00154:     if (ts < target) {
00155:       prev = d;
00156:     } else {
00157:       break;
00158:     }
00159:   }
00160: 
00161:   return prev;
00162: }

00164: function rankTransitionMap(rowMap, basedOnGrupo, topN) {
00165:   if (!rowMap || !rowMap.size) return [];
00166: 
00167:   const total = Array.from(rowMap.values()).reduce(
00168:     (acc, n) => acc + safeInt(n, 0),
00169:     0
00170:   );
00171: 
00172:   if (total <= 0) return [];
00173: 
00174:   return Array.from(rowMap.entries())
00175:     .sort((a, b) => {
00176:       if (Number(b[1]) !== Number(a[1])) return Number(b[1]) - Number(a[1]);
00177:       return Number(a[0]) - Number(b[0]);
00178:     })
00179:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, safeInt(topN, 3)))
00180:     .map(([grupo, freq], i) => {
00181:       const prob = Number(freq) / total;
00182: 
00183:       return {
00184:         rank: i + 1,
00185:         grupo: Number(grupo),
00186:         freq: Number(freq),
00187:         prob,
00188:         probPct: Number((prob * 100).toFixed(2)),
00189:         basedOnGrupo: Number(basedOnGrupo),
00190:         totalTransitionsFromGrupo: total,
00191:       };
00192:     });
00193: }

00195: export function predictNextGrupoFromChain(arg1, arg2 = 3) {

00198:     const topN = arg2;

00032: function findPreviousValidDraw(draws, currentYmd, currentHour) {
00033:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00034:   const targetY = safeStr(currentYmd);
00035:   const targetH = toHourBucket(currentHour);
00036: 
00037:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH) return null;
00038: 
00039:   const targetTs = ymdHourToTs(targetY, targetH);
00040: 
00041:   return list
00042:     .filter((draw) => Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) && draw.prizes.length > 0)
00043:     .map((draw) => {
00044:       const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00045:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00046:       return { draw, ts: ymdHourToTs(y, h) };
00047:     })
00048:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.ts) && x.ts < targetTs)
00049:     .sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts)[0]?.draw || null;
00050: }

00056: function grupoFromDezena2(dezena2) {
00057:   const s = safeStr(dezena2);
00058:   if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(s)) return null;
00059: 
00060:   const n = Number(s);
00061:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || n > 99) return null;
00062:   if (n === 0) return 25;
00063: 
00064:   const g = Math.ceil(n / 4);
00065:   return g >= 1 && g <= 25 ? g : null;
00066: }

00068: function drawQualityScore(draw) {
00069:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00070:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00071:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00072: 
00073:   let score = 0;
00074:   if (isYMD(y)) score += 20;
00075:   if (h) score += 20;
00076:   score += Math.min(10, prizes.length) * 10;
00077: 
00078:   const hasP1 = prizes.some((p) => guessPrizePos(p) === 1);
00079:   if (hasP1) score += 15;
00080: 
00081:   return score;
00082: }

00088:       ? Number(p.posicao)
00089:       : Number.isFinite(Number(p?.pos))
00090:         ? Number(p.pos)
00091:         : Number.isFinite(Number(p?.colocacao))
00092:           ? Number(p.colocacao)
00093:           : null;
00094: 
00095:   return pos;

00190: function getDayOfMonth(ymd) {
00191:   if (!isYMD(ymd)) return NaN;
00192:   return Number(String(ymd).slice(8, 10));

00195: function ymdHourToTs(ymd, hourBucket) {
00196:   const y = safeStr(ymd);
00197:   const h = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00198: 
00199:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00200: 
00201:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00202:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00203:     return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00204:   }
00205: 
00206:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00207:   const base = Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D);
00208: 
00209:   return base + mins * 60 * 1000;
00210: }

00261: export function findLastDrawInList(draws, schedule) {
00262:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00263:   if (!list.length) return null;
00264: 
00265:   const sorted = [...list]
00266:     .filter((d) => isHourInSchedule(schedule, pickDrawHour(d)))
00267:     .sort((a, b) => {
00268:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(pickDrawYMD(a), toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(a)));
00269:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(pickDrawYMD(b), toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(b)));
00270:       return tb - ta;
00271:     });
00272: 
00273:   return sorted[0] || null;
00274: }

00276: export function findPrevDrawBeforeTargetInSameDay(
00277:   draws,
00278:   targetHourBucket,
00279:   schedule
00280: ) {
00281:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00282:   if (!list.length) return null;
00283: 
00284:   const t = hourToInt(targetHourBucket);
00285:   if (t < 0) return null;
00286: 
00287:   const candidates = list
00288:     .filter((d) => isHourInSchedule(schedule, pickDrawHour(d)))
00289:     .map((d) => ({ d, h: hourToInt(toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d))) }))
00290:     .filter((x) => x.h >= 0 && x.h < t)
00291:     .sort((a, b) => b.h - a.h);
00292: 
00293:   return candidates.length ? candidates[0].d : null;
00294: }

00297:   getKingResultsByDate,

00437: export function findNextExistingDrawFromSlot({
00438:   lotteryKey,
00439:   startSlot,
00440:   drawsIndex,
00441:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00442:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00443:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00444:   maxSteps = TOP3_NEXTDRAW_SCAN_MAX_STEPS,
00445:   maxDays = TOP3_NEXTDRAW_SCAN_MAX_DAYS,
00446: }) {
00447:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
00448:   const y0 = safeStr(startSlot?.ymd);
00449:   const h0 = toHourBucket(startSlot?.hour);
00450: 
00451:   if (!isYMD(y0) || !h0 || !(drawsIndex instanceof Map)) {
00452:     return { slot: null, draw: null };
00453:   }
00454: 
00455:   if (key === "FEDERAL") {
00456:     let curY = y0;
00457:     let steps = 0;
00458:     let daysWalked = 0;
00459: 
00460:     while (steps < maxSteps && daysWalked <= maxDays) {
00461:       const sch = getScheduleForLottery({
00462:         lotteryKey: key,
00463:         ymd: curY,
00464:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00465:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00466:         FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00467:       });
00468: 
00469:       if (Array.isArray(sch) && sch.length) {
00470:         const hh = toHourBucket(sch[0]);
00471:         const d = drawsIndex.get(`${curY}|${hh}`) || null;
00472:         if (d) return { slot: { ymd: curY, hour: hh }, draw: d };
00473:       }
00474: 
00475:       curY = addDaysYMD(curY, 1);
00476:       daysWalked += 1;
00477:       steps += 1;
00478:     }
00479: 
00480:     return { slot: null, draw: null };
00481:   }
00482: 
00483:   let curY = y0;
00484:   let curH = h0;
00485:   let steps = 0;
00486:   let daysWalked = 0;
00487: 
00488:   while (steps < maxSteps && daysWalked <= maxDays) {
00489:     const drawKey = `${curY}|${toHourBucket(curH)}`;
00490:     let d = drawsIndex.get(drawKey) || null;
00491: 
00492:     if (!d) {
00493:       const curTs = ymdHourToTs(curY, curH);
00494:       const curYLocked = curY;
00495:       d = Array.from(drawsIndex.entries())
00496:         .map(([k, v]) => {
00497:           const [ky, kh] = String(k).split("|");
00498:           return { ymd: ky, hour: kh, draw: v, ts: ymdHourToTs(ky, kh) };
00499:         })
00500:         .filter((x) => x.ymd === curYLocked)
00501:         .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.ts) && x.ts >= curTs)
00502:         .sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts)[0]?.draw || null;
00503:     }
00504: 
00505:     if (d) return { slot: { ymd: curY, hour: toHourBucket(curH) }, draw: d };
00506: 
00507:     const sch = getScheduleForLottery({
00508:       lotteryKey: key,
00509:       ymd: curY,
00510:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00511:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00512:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00513:     });
00514: 
00515:     const arr = Array.isArray(sch) ? sch.map(toHourBucket) : [];
00516:     const curBucket = toHourBucket(curH);
00517:     const idx = arr.indexOf(curBucket);
00518: 
00519:     if (idx >= 0 && idx < arr.length - 1) {
00520:       curH = arr[idx + 1];
00521:     } else {
00522:       curY = addDaysYMD(curY, 1);
00523:       daysWalked += 1;
00524: 
00525:       const sch2 = getScheduleForLottery({
00526:         lotteryKey: key,
00527:         ymd: curY,
00528:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00529:         PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00530:         FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00531:       });
00532: 
00533:       const arr2 = Array.isArray(sch2) ? sch2.map(toHourBucket) : [];
00534:       if (!arr2.length) break;
00535:       curH = arr2[0];
00536:     }
00537: 
00538:     steps += 1;
00539:   }
00540: 
00541:   return { slot: null, draw: null };
00542: }

00548: export function indexDrawsByYmdHour(draws) {
00549:   const map = new Map();
00550:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00551: 
00552:   for (const d of list) {
00553:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00554:     const rawH = pickDrawHour(d);
00555:     const h = toHourBucket(rawH);
00556: 
00557:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
00558: 
00559:     const drawKey = `${y}|${h}`;
00560:     const prev = map.get(drawKey);
00561: 
00562:     if (!prev) {
00563:       map.set(drawKey, d);
00564:       continue;
00565:     }
00566: 
00567:     if (drawQualityScore(d) >= drawQualityScore(prev)) {
00568:       map.set(drawKey, d);
00569:     }
00570:   }
00571: 
00572:   return map;
00573: }

00575: export function computeLastSeenByGrupo(draws) {
00576:   const last = new Map();
00577:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00578: 
00579:   for (const d of list) {
00580:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00581:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00582:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
00583: 
00584:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
00585:     const ps = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00586: 
00587:     for (const p of ps) {
00588:       const pos = guessPrizePos(p);
00589:       if (!Number.isFinite(Number(pos)) || Number(pos) < 1 || Number(pos) > 5) {
00590:         continue;
00591:       }
00592: 
00593:       const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p);
00594:       if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) <= 0) continue;
00595: 
00596:       const gg = Number(g);
00597:       const prev = last.get(gg);
00598: 
00599:       if (!Number.isFinite(prev) || ts > prev) {
00600:         last.set(gg, ts);
00601:       }
00602:     }
00603:   }
00604: 
00605:   return last;
00606: }

00608: export function countAparicoesByGrupoInDraw(draw) {
00609:   const counts = new Map();
00610:   const ps = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00611:   for (const p of ps) {
00612:     const pos = guessPrizePos(p);
00613:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(pos)) || Number(pos) < 1 || Number(pos) > 5) {
00614:       continue;
00615:     }
00616:     const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p);
00617:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) <= 0) continue;
00618:     const gg = Number(g);
00619:     counts.set(gg, (counts.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
00620:   }
00621:   return counts;
00622: }
00623: 
00624: function getFirstGrupoFromDraw(draw) {
00625:   const ps = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00626:   const p1 = ps.find((p) => guessPrizePos(p) === 1) || null;
00627:   if (p1) {
00628:     const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p1);
00629:     return Number.isFinite(Number(g)) ? Number(g) : null;
00630:   }
00631:   return pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(draw);
00632: }
00633: 
00634: function getAllTop5Groups(draw) {
00635:   const out = [];
00636:   const ps = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
00637:   for (const p of ps) {
00638:     const pos = guessPrizePos(p);
00639:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(pos)) || Number(pos) < 1 || Number(pos) > 5) {
00640:       continue;
00641:     }
00642:     const g = guessPrizeGrupo(p);
00643:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) <= 0) continue;
00644:     out.push({ pos: Number(pos), grupo: Number(g) });
00645:   }
00646:   return out.sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
00647: }
00648: 
00649: function buildFreqAndFirstMaps(nextDraw) {
00650:   const freq = new Map();
00651:   const firstMap = new Map();
00652:   const items = getAllTop5Groups(nextDraw);
00653: 
00654:   for (const it of items) {
00655:     freq.set(it.grupo, (freq.get(it.grupo) || 0) + 1);
00656:     if (it.pos === 1) {
00657:       firstMap.set(it.grupo, (firstMap.get(it.grupo) || 0) + 1);
00658:     }
00659:   }
00660: 
00661:   return { freq, firstMap };
00662: }
00663: 
00664: function mergeMapsAdd(target, source) {
00665:   for (const [k, v] of source.entries()) {
00666:     target.set(Number(k), Number(target.get(Number(k)) || 0) + Number(v || 0));
00667:   }
00668: }

00670: function probFromFreq(freq, samples, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
00671:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00672:   const denom = Math.max(1, Number(samples || 0) * 5);
00673:   const out = new Map();
00674: 
00675:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00676:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
00677:     out.set(g, n / denom);
00678:   }
00679: 
00680:   return out;
00681: }
00682: 
00683: function computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
00684:   draws,
00685:   lotteryKey,
00686:   targetHour,
00687:   targetDow,
00688:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
00689: ) {
00690:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00691:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
00692:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
00693:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00694: 
00695:   const freq = new Map();
00696:   let totalSamples = 0;
00697: 
00698:   for (const d of list) {
00699:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00700:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00701:     if (!h || !y) continue;
00702: 
00703:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
00704:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
00705:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
00706:     } else {
00707:       if (h !== target) continue;
00708:     }
00709: 
00710:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00711:     if (!items.length) continue;
00712: 
00713:     totalSamples += 1;
00714: 
00715:     for (const it of items) {
00716:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00717:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00718:       freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00719:     }
00720:   }
00721: 
00722:   const out = new Map();
00723:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples * 5);
00724: 
00725:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00726:     const n = Number(freq.get(g) || 0);
00727:     out.set(g, n / denom);
00728:   }
00729: 
00730:   return { scoreProb: out, totalSamples };
00731: }

00737: function sortDrawsAsc(draws) {
00738:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00739:   return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
00740:     const ya = pickDrawYMD(a);
00741:     const yb = pickDrawYMD(b);
00742:     const ha = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(a));
00743:     const hb = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(b));
00744:     const tsa = ymdHourToTs(ya, ha);
00745:     const tsb = ymdHourToTs(yb, hb);
00746:     return tsa - tsb;
00747:   });
00748: }
00749: 
00750: function getRecentDrawsBefore(draws, drawLast, count = 6) {
00751:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(draws);
00752:   const lastY = pickDrawYMD(drawLast);
00753:   const lastH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(drawLast));
00754:   const lastTs = ymdHourToTs(lastY, lastH);
00755: 
00756:   const prev = list.filter((d) => {
00757:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
00758:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
00759:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
00760:     return Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < lastTs;
00761:   });
00762: 
00763:   return prev.slice(-Math.max(1, Number(count || 6)));
00764: }

00766: function computeRecentPressureMetrics(recentDraws, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
00767:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00768:   const out = new Map();
00769: 
00770:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
00771:     out.set(g, {
00772:       recentTop5: 0,
00773:       recentIndirect: 0,
00774:       recentFirst: 0,
00775:       recentLast1First: 0,
00776:       recentLast2Top5: 0,
00777:     });
00778:   }
00779: 
00780:   const list = Array.isArray(recentDraws) ? recentDraws : [];
00781:   const last1 = list.length ? [list[list.length - 1]] : [];
00782:   const last2 = list.slice(-2);
00783: 
00784:   for (const d of list) {
00785:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00786: 
00787:     for (const it of items) {
00788:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00789:       const pos = Number(it.pos);
00790:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00791: 
00792:       const row = out.get(g);
00793:       row.recentTop5 += 1;
00794: 
00795:       if (pos >= 2 && pos <= 4) row.recentIndirect += 1;
00796:       if (pos === 1) row.recentFirst += 1;
00797:     }
00798:   }
00799: 
00800:   for (const d of last1) {
00801:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00802:     for (const it of items) {
00803:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00804:       const pos = Number(it.pos);
00805:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00806:       if (pos === 1) {
00807:         out.get(g).recentLast1First += 1;
00808:       }
00809:     }
00810:   }
00811: 
00812:   for (const d of last2) {
00813:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
00814:     const seen = new Set();
00815:     for (const it of items) {
00816:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
00817:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
00818:       if (seen.has(g)) continue;
00819:       seen.add(g);
00820:       out.get(g).recentLast2Top5 += 1;
00821:     }
00822:   }
00823: 
00824:   return out;
00825: }
00826: 
00827: function normalizeMetric(value, maxValue) {
00828:   const v = Number(value || 0);
00829:   const m = Number(maxValue || 0);
00830:   if (!Number.isFinite(v) || !Number.isFinite(m) || m <= 0) return 0;
00831:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v / m));
00832: }
00833: 
00834: function clamp01(v) {
00835:   const n = Number(v);
00836:   if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return 0;
00837:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n));
00838: }
00839: 
00840: function buildZeroProbMap(groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
00841:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
00842:   return new Map(Array.from({ length: k }, (_, i) => [i + 1, 0]));
00843: }
00844: 
00845: function confidenceFromSamples(samples, fullConfidenceAt = 8) {
00846:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
00847:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullConfidenceAt || 8));
00848:   return clamp01(n / lim);
00849: }

00966: function buildConditionalLayerDistribution({
00967:   lotteryKey,
00968:   drawsRange,
00969:   targetHour,
00970:   targetDow,
00971:   targetDayOfMonth,
00972:   prevHour,
00973:   prevGrupo,
00974:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
00975:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
00976:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
00977: }) {
00978:   const list = Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : [];
00979:   const drawsIndex = indexDrawsByYmdHour(list);
00980: 
00981:   const layers = buildLayerConfigs({
00982:     lotteryKey,
00983:     targetDayOfMonth,
00984:     targetDow,
00985:     prevHour,
00986:     prevGrupo,
00987:     targetHour,
00988:   });
00989: 
00990:   const layerResults = layers.map((layer) => ({
00991:     key: layer.key,
00992:     label: layer.label,
00993:     minSamples: layer.minSamples,
00994:     samples: 0,
00995:     freq: new Map(),
00996:     firstFreq: new Map(),
00997:     matchingDraws: [],
00998:   }));
00999: 
01000:   for (const d of list) {
01001:     const prevY = pickDrawYMD(d);
01002:     const prevH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01003:     if (!isYMD(prevY) || !prevH) continue;
01004: 
01005:     const prevG = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01006:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(prevG)) || Number(prevG) <= 0) continue;
01007: 
01008:     const ns = getNextSlotForLottery({
01009:       lotteryKey,
01010:       ymd: prevY,
01011:       hourBucket: prevH,
01012:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01013:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01014:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01015:     });
01016: 
01017:     if (!ns?.ymd || !ns?.hour) continue;
01018: 
01019:     const found = findNextExistingDrawFromSlot({
01020:       lotteryKey,
01021:       startSlot: { ymd: ns.ymd, hour: ns.hour },
01022:       drawsIndex,
01023:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01024:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01025:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01026:     });
01027: 
01028:     const nextDraw = found?.draw || null;
01029:     const nextSlot = found?.slot || null;
01030:     if (!nextDraw || !nextSlot?.ymd || !nextSlot?.hour) continue;
01031: 
01032:     const ctx = {
01033:       prevYmd: prevY,
01034:       prevHour: prevH,
01035:       prevGrupo: Number(prevG),
01036:       targetYmd: safeStr(nextSlot.ymd),
01037:       targetHour: toHourBucket(nextSlot.hour),
01038:       targetDow: getDowKey(nextSlot.ymd),
01039:       targetDayOfMonth: getDayOfMonth(nextSlot.ymd),
01040:     };
01041: 
01042:     const nextMaps = buildFreqAndFirstMaps(nextDraw);
01043: 
01044:     for (let i = 0; i < layers.length; i += 1) {
01045:       const layer = layers[i];
01046:       if (!layer.match(ctx)) continue;
01047: 
01048:       layerResults[i].samples += 1;
01049:       layerResults[i].matchingDraws.push(nextDraw);
01050:       mergeMapsAdd(layerResults[i].freq, nextMaps.freq);
01051:       mergeMapsAdd(layerResults[i].firstFreq, nextMaps.firstMap);
01052:     }
01053:   }
01054: 
01055:   let chosen =
01056:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples >= x.minSamples && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01057:     layerResults.find((x) => x.samples > 0 && x.freq.size > 0) ||
01058:     null;
01059: 
01060:   if (!chosen) {
01061:     chosen = {
01062:       key: "NONE",
01063:       label: "sem amostra",
01064:       minSamples: 0,
01065:       samples: 0,
01066:       freq: new Map(),
01067:       firstFreq: new Map(),
01068:       matchingDraws: [],
01069:     };
01070:   }
01071: 
01072:   return {
01073:     chosen,
01074:     layers: layerResults,
01075:   };
01076: }

01082: export function computeConditionalNextTop3({
01083:   lotteryKey,
01084:   drawsRange,
01085:   drawLast,
01086:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01087:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01088:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01089:   topN = 3,
01090:   targetYmdOverride = "",
01091:   targetHourOverride = "",
01092: }) {
01093:   const list = Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : [];
01094:   if (!list.length || !drawLast) {
01095:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01096:   }
01097: 
01098:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01099: 
01100:   const lastY = pickDrawYMD(drawLast);
01101:   const lastH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(drawLast));
01102:   const prevGrupo = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(drawLast);
01103: 
01104:   if (
01105:     !isYMD(lastY) ||
01106:     !lastH ||
01107:     !Number.isFinite(Number(prevGrupo)) ||
01108:     Number(prevGrupo) <= 0
01109:   ) {
01110:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01111:   }
01112: 
01113:   const nextSlot = getNextSlotForLottery({
01114:     lotteryKey,
01115:     ymd: lastY,
01116:     hourBucket: lastH,
01117:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01118:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01119:     FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01120:   });
01121: 
01122:   const forcedTargetY = safeStr(targetYmdOverride);
01123:   const forcedTargetH = toHourBucket(targetHourOverride);
01124: 
01125:   const targetY = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
01126:     ? forcedTargetY
01127:     : safeStr(nextSlot?.ymd);
01128: 
01129:   const targetH = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
01130:     ? forcedTargetH
01131:     : toHourBucket(nextSlot?.hour);
01132:   const targetDow = getDowKey(targetY);
01133:   const targetDayOfMonth = getDayOfMonth(targetY);
01134:   const transition = `${lastH}->${targetH}`;
01135: 
01136:   const useFirstFocusedRanking =
01137:     key !== "FEDERAL" &&
01138:     (transition === "11h->14h" || transition === "14h->16h");
01139: 
01140:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH || !Number.isFinite(targetDow)) {
01141:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01142:   }
01143: 
01144:   const layerOut = buildConditionalLayerDistribution({
01145:     lotteryKey,
01146:     drawsRange: list,
01147:     targetHour: targetH,
01148:     targetDow,
01149:     targetDayOfMonth,
01150:     prevHour: lastH,
01151:     prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01152:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01153:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01154:     FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01155:   });
01156: 
01157:   const chosen = layerOut.chosen;
01158:   const samples = Number(chosen?.samples || 0);
01159:   const freq = chosen?.freq || new Map();
01160:   const firstFreq = chosen?.firstFreq || new Map();
01161:   const probCond = probFromFreq(freq, samples, TOP3_GROUPS_K);
01162: 
01163:   const structural = computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
01164:     list,
01165:     key,
01166:     targetH,
01167:     targetDow,
01168:     TOP3_GROUPS_K
01169:   );
01170:   const probBase = structural?.scoreProb || new Map();
01171: 
01172:   const condWeight =
01173:     key === "FEDERAL"
01174:       ? samples >= 8
01175:         ? 0.55
01176:         : samples >= 4
01177:           ? 0.4
01178:           : 0.25
01179:       : samples >= 12
01180:         ? 0.65
01181:         : samples >= 6
01182:           ? 0.55
01183:           : 0.45;
01184: 
01185:   const baseWeight = 1 - condWeight;
01186: 
01187:   const lastSeen = computeLastSeenByGrupo(list);
01188:   const nowTs = ymdHourToTs(lastY, lastH);
01189: 
01190:   const finiteLastSeen = Array.from(lastSeen.values()).filter((v) =>
01191:     Number.isFinite(Number(v))
01192:   );
01193:   const minLastSeenTs = finiteLastSeen.length ? Math.min(...finiteLastSeen) : nowTs;
01194:   const maxGapMsBase =
01195:     Number.isFinite(nowTs) && Number.isFinite(minLastSeenTs)
01196:       ? Math.max(1, nowTs - minLastSeenTs)
01197:       : 1;
01198: 
01199:   const recentDraws = getRecentDrawsBefore(list, drawLast, 6);
01200:   const recentMetrics = computeRecentPressureMetrics(recentDraws, TOP3_GROUPS_K);
01201: 
01202:   const recentMaxTop5 = Math.max(
01203:     1,
01204:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentTop5 || 0))
01205:   );
01206:   const recentMaxIndirect = Math.max(
01207:     1,
01208:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentIndirect || 0))
01209:   );
01210:   const recentMaxFirst = Math.max(
01211:     1,
01212:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentFirst || 0))
01213:   );
01214: 
01215:   const ranked = Array.from({ length: safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25) }, (_, idx) => {
01216:     const grupo = idx + 1;
01217:     const aparicoes = Number(freq.get(grupo) || 0);
01218:     const primeiros = Number(firstFreq.get(grupo) || 0);
01219:     const pCond = Number(probCond.get(grupo) || 0);
01220:     const pBase = Number(probBase.get(grupo) || 0);
01221:     const pFinal = (pCond * condWeight) + (pBase * baseWeight);
01222: 
01223:     const ls = lastSeen.get(grupo);
01224:     const lastSeenTs = Number.isFinite(ls) ? ls : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
01225: 
01226:     const gapMs =
01227:       Number.isFinite(nowTs) &&
01228:       Number.isFinite(lastSeenTs) &&
01229:       lastSeenTs !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
01230:         ? Math.max(0, nowTs - lastSeenTs)
01231:         : maxGapMsBase;
01232: 
01233:     const taxaPrimeiro = samples > 0 ? primeiros / samples : 0;
01234:     const lateBonusRaw = Math.max(0, gapMs) / Math.max(1, maxGapMsBase);
01235:     const lateBonus = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, lateBonusRaw));
01236: 
01237:     const rm = recentMetrics.get(grupo) || {
01238:       recentTop5: 0,
01239:       recentIndirect: 0,
01240:       recentFirst: 0,
01241:       recentLast1First: 0,
01242:       recentLast2Top5: 0,
01243:     };
01244: 
01245:     const recentTop5Norm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentTop5, recentMaxTop5);
01246:     const recentIndirectNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentIndirect, recentMaxIndirect);
01247:     const recentFirstNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentFirst, recentMaxFirst);
01248:     const recentLast1FirstNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentLast1First, 1);
01249:     const recentLast2Top5Norm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentLast2Top5, 2);
01250: 
01251:     const recencyCoolingFactor =
01252:       rm.recentLast1First > 0
01253:         ? 0.72
01254:         : rm.recentFirst >= 2
01255:           ? 0.84
01256:           : 1.0;
01257: 
01258:     const smartLateBoost =
01259:       lateBonus *
01260:       (0.45 + (recentIndirectNorm * 0.35) + (recentLast2Top5Norm * 0.2)) *
01261:       recencyCoolingFactor;
01262: 
01263:     const recentComposite =
01264:       (recentTop5Norm * 0.45) +
01265:       (recentIndirectNorm * 0.35) +
01266:       (recentFirstNorm * 0.2);
01267: 
01268:     const baseScore =
01269:       key === "FEDERAL"
01270:         ? (pFinal * 145) +
01271:           (pBase * 85) +
01272:           (primeiros * 42) +
01273:           (aparicoes * 18) +
01274:           (recentComposite * 26) +
01275:           (smartLateBoost * 10)
01276:         : useFirstFocusedRanking
01277:           ? (pFinal * 125) +
01278:             (aparicoes * 155) +
01279:             (primeiros * 70) +
01280:             (taxaPrimeiro * 34) +
01281:             (recentComposite * 18) +
01282:             (recentLast1FirstNorm * 10) +
01283:             (smartLateBoost * 16)
01284:           : (pFinal * 125) +
01285:             (aparicoes * 135) +
01286:             (primeiros * 62) +
01287:             (recentComposite * 24) +
01288:             (recentLast1FirstNorm * 8) +
01289:             (smartLateBoost * 18);
01290: 
01291:     return {
01292:       grupo,
01293:       aparicoes,
01294:       primeiros,
01295:       taxaPrimeiro,
01296:       scoreProb: pFinal,
01297:       probCond: pCond,
01298:       probBase: pBase,
01299:       score: baseScore,
01300:       lateBonus,
01301:       smartLateBoost,
01302:       recentTop5: rm.recentTop5,
01303:       recentIndirect: rm.recentIndirect,
01304:       recentFirst: rm.recentFirst,
01305:       recentLast1First: rm.recentLast1First,
01306:       recentLast2Top5: rm.recentLast2Top5,
01307:       recentComposite,
01308:       lastSeenTs,
01309:       gapMs,
01310:     };
01311:   })
01312:     .sort((a, b) => {
01313:       if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
01314:       if (b.scoreProb !== a.scoreProb) return b.scoreProb - a.scoreProb;
01315:       if (b.primeiros !== a.primeiros) return b.primeiros - a.primeiros;
01316:       if (b.aparicoes !== a.aparicoes) return b.aparicoes - a.aparicoes;
01317:       return a.grupo - b.grupo;
01318:     })
01319:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(topN || 3)));
01320: 
01321:   const reasonsBase = [
01322:     `Camada usada: ${chosen?.label || "—"}`,
01323:     `Amostra histórica condicional: ${samples}`,
01324:     `Amostra estrutural: ${Number(structural?.totalSamples || 0)}`,
01325:     `Pesos: condicional=${(condWeight * 100).toFixed(0)}% | estrutural=${(baseWeight * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
01326:     `Estado atual: prev=${String(prevGrupo).padStart(2, "0")} @ ${lastH} → alvo ${targetH}`,
01327:     `Data alvo: ${targetY} | DOW=${targetDow} | dia=${String(targetDayOfMonth).padStart(2, "0")}`,
01328:   ];
01329: 
01330:   const top = ranked.map((x, idx) => {
01331:     const g2 = String(x.grupo).padStart(2, "0");
01332:     const pct = (x.scoreProb * 100).toFixed(2);
01333:     const pctCond = (x.probCond * 100).toFixed(2);
01334:     const pctBase = (x.probBase * 100).toFixed(2);
01335: 
01336:     return {
01337:       rank: idx + 1,
01338:       title:
01339:         idx === 0
01340:           ? "Mais provável"
01341:           : idx === 1
01342:             ? "2º mais provável"
01343:             : "3º mais provável",
01344:       grupo: x.grupo,
01345:       scoreProb: Number(x.scoreProb || 0),
01346:       probCond: Number(x.probCond || 0),
01347:       probBase: Number(x.probBase || 0),
01348:       lateBonus: Number(x.lateBonus || 0),
01349:       freq: x.aparicoes,
01350:       freqCond: x.aparicoes,
01351:       freqBase: 0,
01352:       freqZeroWhy:
01353:         x.aparicoes <= 0
01354:           ? `Sem ocorrência nesta camada (${chosen?.label || "—"}).`
01355:           : "",
01356:       reasons: [
01357:         ...reasonsBase,
01358:         `Grupo G${g2}: aparições=${x.aparicoes} em ${samples} amostras do próximo sorteio`,
01359:         `Grupo G${g2}: primeiros lugares=${x.primeiros}`,
01360:         `Probabilidade final estimada no TOP3: ${pct}%`,
01361:         `Composição da probabilidade: condicional=${pctCond}% | estrutural=${pctBase}%`,
01362:         `Presença indireta recente (2º-4º): ${x.recentIndirect}`,
01363:         `Persistência curta recente: ${x.recentTop5}`,
01364:         `Bônus de atraso ajustado: ${(Number(x.smartLateBoost || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
01365:       ],
01366:       meta: {
01367:         trigger: {
01368:           ymd: lastY,
01369:           hour: lastH,
01370:           grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01371:         },
01372:         next: {
01373:           ymd: safeStr(targetY),
01374:           hour: safeStr(targetH),
01375:         },
01376:         samples,
01377:         scenario: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01378:         explain: {
01379:           layerKey: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01380:           layerLabel: chosen?.label || "—",
01381:           layerSamples: samples,
01382:           baseSamples: Number(structural?.totalSamples || 0),
01383:           condWeight,
01384:           baseWeight,
01385:           targetDow,

01387:           prevHour: lastH,

01389:           recentTop5: x.recentTop5,

01391:           recentFirst: x.recentFirst,
01392:           recentLast1First: x.recentLast1First,

01395:             key: layer.key,

01399:           })),

01445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
01446:   draws,
01447:   lotteryKey,
01448:   targetHour,
01449:   targetDow,
01450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01451: ) {
01452:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01456: 
01457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01458:   let totalSamples = 0;
01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {
01461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
01464: 
01465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
01467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471: 
01472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
01474: 
01475:     totalSamples += 1;
01476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
01477:   }
01478: 
01479:   const prob = new Map();
01480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01481: 
01482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01484:   }
01485: 
01486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
01487: }

01489: function getComparableDrawsForTargetContext(
01490:   draws,
01491:   lotteryKey,
01492:   targetHour,
01493:   targetDow
01494: ) {
01495:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(draws);
01496:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01497:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01498: 
01499:   return list.filter((d) => {
01500:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01501:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01502:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return false;
01503: 
01504:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01505:       return isFederalDrawDay(y) && Number(getDowKey(y)) === Number(targetDow);
01506:     }
01507: 
01508:     return h === target;
01509:   });
01510: }

01546: function getStateFromComparableSequenceBeforeTs(seq, beforeTs, count = 3) {

01552:     .slice(-n)

01554:     .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

01578: function buildMemoryStateDistribution({
01579:   drawsRange,
01580:   lotteryKey,
01581:   targetHour,
01582:   targetDow,
01583:   currentState,
01584:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K,
01585: }) {
01586:   const seq = buildComparableFirstSequence(
01587:     drawsRange,
01588:     lotteryKey,
01589:     targetHour,
01590:     targetDow
01591:   );
01592: 
01593:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01594:   const freq = new Map();
01595: 
01596:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01597:     freq.set(g, 0);
01598:   }
01599: 
01600:   let totalWeight = 0;
01601:   let matchedSamples = 0;
01602: 
01603:   for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
01604:     const target = seq[i];
01605:     const histState = [];
01606: 
01607:     for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && histState.length < 3; j -= 1) {
01608:       histState.push(Number(seq[j].grupo));
01609:     }
01610: 
01611:     const matchDepth = countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState);
01612:     if (matchDepth <= 0) continue;
01613: 
01614:     const weight =
01615:       matchDepth >= 3 ? 4.0 :
01616:       matchDepth === 2 ? 2.5 :
01617:       1.0;
01618: 
01619:     const g = Number(target.grupo);
01620:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01621: 
01622:     freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
01623:     totalWeight += weight;
01624:     matchedSamples += 1;
01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,
01639:     state: Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [],
01640:     sequenceSamples: seq.length,
01641:   };
01642: }

01644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
01645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
01646:   const groups = list
01647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
01648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
01649: 
01650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
01651:     return {
01652:       regime: "neutral",
01653:       repeatRate: 0,
01654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
01655:       samples: groups.length,
01656:     };
01657:   }
01658: 
01659:   let repeats = 0;
01660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
01661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
01662:   }
01663: 
01664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
01665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
01666: 
01667:   let regime = "neutral";
01668: 
01669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
01670:     regime = "repeat";
01671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
01672:     regime = "spread";
01673:   }
01674: 
01675:   return {
01676:     regime,
01677:     repeatRate,
01678:     uniqueRate,
01679:     samples: groups.length,
01680:   };
01681: }

01683: function computeComparableTop5Distribution(
01684:   draws,
01685:   lotteryKey,

01702:     freq.set(g, 0);

01792: function computeRecentBichoMetrics(draws, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
01793:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01794:   const out = new Map();
01795: 
01796:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01797:     out.set(g, {
01798:       recentTop5: 0,
01799:       recentFirst: 0,
01800:       recentDupDraws: 0,
01801:       recentLast1Top5: 0,
01802:       recentLast2Top5: 0,
01803:       recentLast3Top5: 0,
01804:     });
01805:   }
01806: 
01807:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01808:   const last1 = list.length ? [list[list.length - 1]] : [];
01809:   const last2 = list.slice(-2);
01810:   const last3 = list.slice(-3);
01811: 
01812:   for (const d of list) {
01813:     const items = getAllTop5Groups(d);
01814:     const perDrawCounts = new Map();
01815: 
01816:     for (const it of items) {
