01078: /* =========================
01079:    Motor principal V1
01080: ========================= */
01081: 
01082: export function computeConditionalNextTop3({
01083:   lotteryKey,
01084:   drawsRange,
01085:   drawLast,
01086:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01087:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01088:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01089:   topN = 3,
01090:   targetYmdOverride = "",
01091:   targetHourOverride = "",
01092: }) {
01093:   const list = Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : [];
01094:   if (!list.length || !drawLast) {
01095:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01096:   }
01097: 
01098:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01099: 
01100:   const lastY = pickDrawYMD(drawLast);
01101:   const lastH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(drawLast));
01102:   const prevGrupo = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(drawLast);
01103: 
01104:   if (
01105:     !isYMD(lastY) ||
01106:     !lastH ||
01107:     !Number.isFinite(Number(prevGrupo)) ||
01108:     Number(prevGrupo) <= 0
01109:   ) {
01110:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01111:   }
01112: 
01113:   const nextSlot = getNextSlotForLottery({
01114:     lotteryKey,
01115:     ymd: lastY,
01116:     hourBucket: lastH,
01117:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01118:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01119:     FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01120:   });
01121: 
01122:   const forcedTargetY = safeStr(targetYmdOverride);
01123:   const forcedTargetH = toHourBucket(targetHourOverride);
01124: 
01125:   const targetY = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
01126:     ? forcedTargetY
01127:     : safeStr(nextSlot?.ymd);
01128: 
01129:   const targetH = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
01130:     ? forcedTargetH
01131:     : toHourBucket(nextSlot?.hour);
01132:   const targetDow = getDowKey(targetY);
01133:   const targetDayOfMonth = getDayOfMonth(targetY);
01134:   const transition = `${lastH}->${targetH}`;
01135: 
01136:   const useFirstFocusedRanking =
01137:     key !== "FEDERAL" &&
01138:     (transition === "11h->14h" || transition === "14h->16h");
01139: 
01140:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH || !Number.isFinite(targetDow)) {
01141:     return { top: [], meta: null };
01142:   }
01143: 
01144:   const layerOut = buildConditionalLayerDistribution({
01145:     lotteryKey,
01146:     drawsRange: list,
01147:     targetHour: targetH,
01148:     targetDow,
01149:     targetDayOfMonth,
01150:     prevHour: lastH,
01151:     prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01152:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
01153:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
01154:     FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
01155:   });
01156: 
01157:   const chosen = layerOut.chosen;
01158:   const samples = Number(chosen?.samples || 0);
01159:   const freq = chosen?.freq || new Map();
01160:   const firstFreq = chosen?.firstFreq || new Map();
01161:   const probCond = probFromFreq(freq, samples, TOP3_GROUPS_K);
01162: 
01163:   const structural = computeStructuralBaseDistribution(
01164:     list,
01165:     key,
01166:     targetH,
01167:     targetDow,
01168:     TOP3_GROUPS_K
01169:   );
01170:   const probBase = structural?.scoreProb || new Map();
01171: 
01172:   const condWeight =
01173:     key === "FEDERAL"
01174:       ? samples >= 8
01175:         ? 0.55
01176:         : samples >= 4
01177:           ? 0.4
01178:           : 0.25
01179:       : samples >= 12
01180:         ? 0.65
01181:         : samples >= 6
01182:           ? 0.55
01183:           : 0.45;
01184: 
01185:   const baseWeight = 1 - condWeight;
01186: 
01187:   const lastSeen = computeLastSeenByGrupo(list);
01188:   const nowTs = ymdHourToTs(lastY, lastH);
01189: 
01190:   const finiteLastSeen = Array.from(lastSeen.values()).filter((v) =>
01191:     Number.isFinite(Number(v))
01192:   );
01193:   const minLastSeenTs = finiteLastSeen.length ? Math.min(...finiteLastSeen) : nowTs;
01194:   const maxGapMsBase =
01195:     Number.isFinite(nowTs) && Number.isFinite(minLastSeenTs)
01196:       ? Math.max(1, nowTs - minLastSeenTs)
01197:       : 1;
01198: 
01199:   const recentDraws = getRecentDrawsBefore(list, drawLast, 6);
01200:   const recentMetrics = computeRecentPressureMetrics(recentDraws, TOP3_GROUPS_K);
01201: 
01202:   const recentMaxPrizePresence = Math.max(
01203:     1,
01204:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentPrizePresence || 0))
01205:   );
01206:   const recentMaxIndirect = Math.max(
01207:     1,
01208:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentIndirect || 0))
01209:   );
01210:   const recentMaxFirst = Math.max(
01211:     1,
01212:     ...Array.from(recentMetrics.values()).map((x) => Number(x.recentFirst || 0))
01213:   );
01214: 
01215:   const ranked = Array.from({ length: safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25) }, (_, idx) => {
01216:     const grupo = idx + 1;
01217:     const aparicoes = Number(freq.get(grupo) || 0);
01218:     const primeiros = Number(firstFreq.get(grupo) || 0);
01219:     const pCond = Number(probCond.get(grupo) || 0);
01220:     const pBase = Number(probBase.get(grupo) || 0);
01221:     const pFinal = (pCond * condWeight) + (pBase * baseWeight);
01222: 
01223:     const ls = lastSeen.get(grupo);
01224:     const lastSeenTs = Number.isFinite(ls) ? ls : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
01225: 
01226:     const gapMs =
01227:       Number.isFinite(nowTs) &&
01228:       Number.isFinite(lastSeenTs) &&
01229:       lastSeenTs !== Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
01230:         ? Math.max(0, nowTs - lastSeenTs)
01231:         : maxGapMsBase;
01232: 
01233:     const taxaPrimeiro = samples > 0 ? primeiros / samples : 0;
01234:     const lateBonusRaw = Math.max(0, gapMs) / Math.max(1, maxGapMsBase);
01235:     const lateBonus = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, lateBonusRaw));
01236: 
01237:     const rm = recentMetrics.get(grupo) || {
01238:       recentPrizePresence: 0,
01239:       recentIndirect: 0,
01240:       recentFirst: 0,
01241:       recentLast1First: 0,
01242:       recentLast2PrizePresence: 0,
01243:     };
01244: 
01245:     const recentPrizePresenceNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentPrizePresence, recentMaxPrizePresence);
01246:     const recentIndirectNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentIndirect, recentMaxIndirect);
01247:     const recentFirstNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentFirst, recentMaxFirst);
01248:     const recentLast1FirstNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentLast1First, 1);
01249:     const recentLast2PrizePresenceNorm = normalizeMetric(rm.recentLast2PrizePresence, 2);
01250: 
01251:     const recencyCoolingFactor =
01252:       rm.recentLast1First > 0
01253:         ? 0.72
01254:         : rm.recentFirst >= 2
01255:           ? 0.84
01256:           : 1.0;
01257: 
01258:     const smartLateBoost =
01259:       lateBonus *
01260:       (0.45 + (recentIndirectNorm * 0.35) + (recentLast2PrizePresenceNorm * 0.2)) *
01261:       recencyCoolingFactor;
01262: 
01263:     const recentComposite =
01264:       (recentPrizePresenceNorm * 0.45) +
01265:       (recentIndirectNorm * 0.35) +
01266:       (recentFirstNorm * 0.2);
01267: 
01268:     const baseScore =
01269:       key === "FEDERAL"
01270:         ? (pFinal * 145) +
01271:           (pBase * 85) +
01272:           (primeiros * 42) +
01273:           (aparicoes * 18) +
01274:           (recentComposite * 26) +
01275:           (smartLateBoost * 10)
01276:         : useFirstFocusedRanking
01277:           ? (pFinal * 125) +
01278:             (aparicoes * 155) +
01279:             (primeiros * 70) +
01280:             (taxaPrimeiro * 34) +
01281:             (recentComposite * 18) +
01282:             (recentLast1FirstNorm * 10) +
01283:             (smartLateBoost * 16)
01284:           : (pFinal * 125) +
01285:             (aparicoes * 135) +
01286:             (primeiros * 62) +
01287:             (recentComposite * 24) +
01288:             (recentLast1FirstNorm * 8) +
01289:             (smartLateBoost * 18);
01290: 
01291:     return {
01292:       grupo,
01293:       aparicoes,
01294:       primeiros,
01295:       taxaPrimeiro,
01296:       scoreProb: pFinal,
01297:       probCond: pCond,
01298:       probBase: pBase,
01299:       score: baseScore,
01300:       lateBonus,
01301:       smartLateBoost,
01302:       recentPrizePresence: rm.recentPrizePresence,
01303:       recentIndirect: rm.recentIndirect,
01304:       recentFirst: rm.recentFirst,
01305:       recentLast1First: rm.recentLast1First,
01306:       recentLast2PrizePresence: rm.recentLast2PrizePresence,
01307:       recentComposite,
01308:       lastSeenTs,
01309:       gapMs,
01310:     };
01311:   })
01312:     .sort((a, b) => {
01313:       if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
01314:       if (b.scoreProb !== a.scoreProb) return b.scoreProb - a.scoreProb;
01315:       if (b.primeiros !== a.primeiros) return b.primeiros - a.primeiros;
01316:       if (b.aparicoes !== a.aparicoes) return b.aparicoes - a.aparicoes;
01317:       return a.grupo - b.grupo;
01318:     })
01319:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(topN || 3)));
01320: 
01321:   const reasonsBase = [
01322:     `Camada usada: ${chosen?.label || "—"}`,
01323:     `Amostra histórica condicional: ${samples}`,
01324:     `Amostra estrutural: ${Number(structural?.totalSamples || 0)}`,
01325:     `Pesos: condicional=${(condWeight * 100).toFixed(0)}% | estrutural=${(baseWeight * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
01326:     `Estado atual: prev=${String(prevGrupo).padStart(2, "0")} @ ${lastH} → alvo ${targetH}`,
01327:     `Data alvo: ${targetY} | DOW=${targetDow} | dia=${String(targetDayOfMonth).padStart(2, "0")}`,
01328:   ];
01329: 
01330:   const top = ranked.map((x, idx) => {
01331:     const g2 = String(x.grupo).padStart(2, "0");
01332:     const pct = (x.scoreProb * 100).toFixed(2);
01333:     const pctCond = (x.probCond * 100).toFixed(2);
01334:     const pctBase = (x.probBase * 100).toFixed(2);
01335: 
01336:     return {
01337:       rank: idx + 1,
01338:       title:
01339:         idx === 0
01340:           ? "Mais provável"
01341:           : idx === 1
01342:             ? "2º mais provável"
01343:             : "3º mais provável",
01344:       grupo: x.grupo,
01345:       scoreProb: Number(x.scoreProb || 0),
01346:       probCond: Number(x.probCond || 0),
01347:       probBase: Number(x.probBase || 0),
01348:       lateBonus: Number(x.lateBonus || 0),
01349:       freq: x.aparicoes,
01350:       freqCond: x.aparicoes,
01351:       freqBase: 0,
01352:       freqZeroWhy:
01353:         x.aparicoes <= 0
01354:           ? `Sem ocorrência nesta camada (${chosen?.label || "—"}).`
01355:           : "",
01356:       reasons: [
01357:         ...reasonsBase,
01358:         `Grupo G${g2}: aparições=${x.aparicoes} em ${samples} amostras do próximo sorteio`,
01359:         `Grupo G${g2}: primeiros lugares=${x.primeiros}`,
01360:         `Probabilidade final estimada no TOP3: ${pct}%`,
01361:         `Composição da probabilidade: condicional=${pctCond}% | estrutural=${pctBase}%`,
01362:         `Presença indireta recente (2º-4º): ${x.recentIndirect}`,
01363:         `Persistência curta recente: ${x.recentPrizePresence}`,
01364:         `Bônus de atraso ajustado: ${(Number(x.smartLateBoost || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
01365:       ],
01366:       meta: {
01367:         trigger: {
01368:           ymd: lastY,
01369:           hour: lastH,
01370:           grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01371:         },
01372:         next: {
01373:           ymd: safeStr(targetY),
01374:           hour: safeStr(targetH),
01375:         },
01376:         samples,
01377:         scenario: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01378:         explain: {
01379:           layerKey: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01380:           layerLabel: chosen?.label || "—",
01381:           layerSamples: samples,
01382:           baseSamples: Number(structural?.totalSamples || 0),
01383:           condWeight,
01384:           baseWeight,
01385:           targetDow,
01386:           targetDayOfMonth,
01387:           prevHour: lastH,
01388:           prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01389:           recentPrizePresence: x.recentPrizePresence,
01390:           recentIndirect: x.recentIndirect,
01391:           recentFirst: x.recentFirst,
01392:           recentLast1First: x.recentLast1First,
01393:           recentLast2PrizePresence: x.recentLast2PrizePresence,
01394:           allLayers: (layerOut?.layers || []).map((layer) => ({
01395:             key: layer.key,
01396:             label: layer.label,
01397:             samples: layer.samples,
01398:             minSamples: layer.minSamples,
01399:           })),
01400:         },
01401:       },
01402:     };
01403:   });
01404: 
01405:   return {
01406:     top,
01407:     meta: {
01408:       trigger: {
01409:         ymd: lastY,
01410:         hour: lastH,
01411:         grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01412:       },
01413:       next: {
01414:         ymd: safeStr(targetY),
01415:         hour: safeStr(targetH),
01416:       },
01417:       samples,
01418:       scenario: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01419:       explain: {
01420:         layerKey: chosen?.key || "NONE",
01421:         layerLabel: chosen?.label || "—",
01422:         layerSamples: samples,
01423:         baseSamples: Number(structural?.totalSamples || 0),
01424:         condWeight,
01425:         baseWeight,
01426:         targetDow,
01427:         targetDayOfMonth,
01428:         prevHour: lastH,
01429:         prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
01430:         allLayers: (layerOut?.layers || []).map((layer) => ({
01431:           key: layer.key,
01432:           label: layer.label,
01433:           samples: layer.samples,
01434:           minSamples: layer.minSamples,
01435:         })),
01436:       },
01437:     },
01438:   };
01439: }

01441: /* =========================
01442:    V2 — helpers focados em BICHO
01443: ========================= */
01444: 
01445: function computeStructuralFirstDistribution(
01446:   draws,
01447:   lotteryKey,
01448:   targetHour,
01449:   targetDow,
01450:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
01451: ) {
01452:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01453:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01454:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01455:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01456: 
01457:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01458:   let totalSamples = 0;
01459: 
01460:   for (const d of list) {
01461:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01462:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01463:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) continue;
01464: 
01465:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01466:       if (!isFederalDrawDay(y)) continue;
01467:       if (Number(getDowKey(y)) !== Number(targetDow)) continue;
01468:     } else {
01469:       if (h !== target) continue;
01470:     }
01471: 
01472:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01473:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > k) continue;
01474: 
01475:     totalSamples += 1;
01476:     firstFreq.set(Number(g), Number(firstFreq.get(Number(g)) || 0) + 1);
01477:   }
01478: 
01479:   const prob = new Map();
01480:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalSamples);
01481: 
01482:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01483:     prob.set(g, Number(firstFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01484:   }
01485: 
01486:   return { prob, firstFreq, totalSamples };
01487: }
01488: 
01489: function getComparableDrawsForTargetContext(
01490:   draws,
01491:   lotteryKey,
01492:   targetHour,
01493:   targetDow
01494: ) {
01495:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(draws);
01496:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
01497:   const target = toHourBucket(targetHour);
01498: 
01499:   return list.filter((d) => {
01500:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01501:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01502:     if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return false;
01503: 
01504:     if (key === "FEDERAL") {
01505:       return isFederalDrawDay(y) && Number(getDowKey(y)) === Number(targetDow);
01506:     }
01507: 
01508:     return h === target;
01509:   });
01510: }
01511: 
01512: function buildComparableFirstSequence(
01513:   draws,
01514:   lotteryKey,
01515:   targetHour,
01516:   targetDow
01517: ) {
01518:   return getComparableDrawsForTargetContext(
01519:     draws,
01520:     lotteryKey,
01521:     targetHour,
01522:     targetDow
01523:   )
01524:     .map((d) => {
01525:       const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
01526:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
01527:       const grupo = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01528:       return {
01529:         draw: d,
01530:         ymd: y,
01531:         hour: h,
01532:         ts: ymdHourToTs(y, h),
01533:         grupo: Number(grupo),
01534:       };
01535:     })
01536:     .filter((x) =>
01537:       isYMD(x.ymd) &&
01538:       x.hour &&
01539:       Number.isFinite(Number(x.ts)) &&
01540:       Number.isFinite(Number(x.grupo)) &&
01541:       Number(x.grupo) >= 1 &&
01542:       Number(x.grupo) <= 25
01543:     );
01544: }

01565: function countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState) {
01566:   const a = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
01567:   const b = Array.isArray(histState) ? histState : [];
01568:   const len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
01569: 
01570:   let matched = 0;
01571:   for (let i = 0; i < len; i += 1) {
01572:     if (Number(a[i]) !== Number(b[i])) break;
01573:     matched += 1;
01574:   }
01575:   return matched;
01576: }

01578: function buildMemoryStateDistribution({
01579:   drawsRange,
01580:   lotteryKey,
01581:   targetHour,
01582:   targetDow,
01583:   currentState,
01584:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K,
01585: }) {
01586:   const seq = buildComparableFirstSequence(
01587:     drawsRange,
01588:     lotteryKey,
01589:     targetHour,
01590:     targetDow
01591:   );
01592: 
01593:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01594:   const freq = new Map();
01595: 
01596:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01597:     freq.set(g, 0);
01598:   }
01599: 
01600:   let totalWeight = 0;
01601:   let matchedSamples = 0;
01602: 
01603:   for (let i = 0; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
01604:     const target = seq[i];
01605:     const histState = [];
01606: 
01607:     for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && histState.length < 3; j -= 1) {
01608:       histState.push(Number(seq[j].grupo));
01609:     }
01610: 
01611:     const matchDepth = countLeadingStateMatches(currentState, histState);
01612:     if (matchDepth <= 0) continue;
01613: 
01614:     const weight =
01615:       matchDepth >= 3 ? 4.0 :
01616:       matchDepth === 2 ? 2.5 :
01617:       1.0;
01618: 
01619:     const g = Number(target.grupo);
01620:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01621: 
01622:     freq.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
01623:     totalWeight += weight;
01624:     matchedSamples += 1;
01625:   }
01626: 
01627:   const prob = new Map();
01628:   const denom = Math.max(1, totalWeight);
01629: 
01630:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01631:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
01632:   }
01633: 
01634:   return {
01635:     prob,
01636:     freq,
01637:     totalWeight,
01638:     matchedSamples,
01639:     state: Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [],
01640:     sequenceSamples: seq.length,
01641:   };
01642: }

01644: function detectRegimeFromComparableSequence(seqRecent) {
01645:   const list = Array.isArray(seqRecent) ? seqRecent : [];
01646:   const groups = list
01647:     .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo))
01648:     .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= 25);
01649: 
01650:   if (groups.length <= 1) {
01651:     return {
01652:       regime: "neutral",
01653:       repeatRate: 0,
01654:       uniqueRate: groups.length ? 1 : 0,
01655:       samples: groups.length,
01656:     };
01657:   }
01658: 
01659:   let repeats = 0;
01660:   for (let i = 1; i < groups.length; i += 1) {
01661:     if (groups[i] === groups[i - 1]) repeats += 1;
01662:   }
01663: 
01664:   const repeatRate = repeats / Math.max(1, groups.length - 1);
01665:   const uniqueRate = new Set(groups).size / Math.max(1, groups.length);
01666: 
01667:   let regime = "neutral";
01668: 
01669:   if (repeatRate >= 0.34 || uniqueRate <= 0.5) {
01670:     regime = "repeat";
01671:   } else if (repeatRate === 0 && uniqueRate >= 0.84) {
01672:     regime = "spread";
01673:   }
01674: 
01675:   return {
01676:     regime,
01677:     repeatRate,
01678:     uniqueRate,
01679:     samples: groups.length,
01680:   };
01681: }

01792: function computeRecentBichoMetrics(draws, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
01793:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
01794:   const out = new Map();
01795: 
01796:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
01797:     out.set(g, {
01798:       recentPrizePresence: 0,
01799:       recentFirst: 0,
01800:       recentDupDraws: 0,
01801:       recentLast1PrizePresence: 0,
01802:       recentLast2PrizePresence: 0,
01803:       recentLast3PrizePresence: 0,
01804:     });
01805:   }
01806: 
01807:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01808:   const last1 = list.length ? [list[list.length - 1]] : [];
01809:   const last2 = list.slice(-2);
01810:   const last3 = list.slice(-3);
01811: 
01812:   for (const d of list) {
01813:     const items = getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d);
01814:     const perDrawCounts = new Map();
01815: 
01816:     for (const it of items) {
01817:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01818:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
01819: 
01820:       const row = out.get(g);
01821:       row.recentPrizePresence += 1;
01822: 
01823:       if (Number(it.pos) === 1) {
01824:         row.recentFirst += 1;
01825:       }
01826: 
01827:       perDrawCounts.set(g, Number(perDrawCounts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
01828:     }
01829: 
01830:     for (const [g, c] of perDrawCounts.entries()) {
01831:       if (Number(c) >= 2) {
01832:         out.get(Number(g)).recentDupDraws += 1;
01833:       }
01834:     }
01835:   }
01836: 
01837:   for (const d of last1) {
01838:     const seen = new Set();
01839:     for (const it of getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d)) {
01840:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01841:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01842:       seen.add(g);
01843:       out.get(g).recentLast1PrizePresence += 1;
01844:     }
01845:   }
01846: 
01847:   for (const d of last2) {
01848:     const seen = new Set();
01849:     for (const it of getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d)) {
01850:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01851:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01852:       seen.add(g);
01853:       out.get(g).recentLast2PrizePresence += 1;
01854:     }
01855:   }
01856: 
01857:   for (const d of last3) {
01858:     const seen = new Set();
01859:     for (const it of getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d)) {
01860:       const g = Number(it.grupo);
01861:       if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k || seen.has(g)) continue;
01862:       seen.add(g);
01863:       out.get(g).recentLast3PrizePresence += 1;
01864:     }
01865:   }
01866: 
01867:   return out;
01868: }

01870: function getDayDrivenWeights(mode) {
01871:   if (mode === "REPEAT") {
01872:     return {
01873:       transition: 0.25,
01874:       pair: 0.25,
01875:       memory: 0.2,
01876:       recent: 0.15,
01877:       structural: 0.1,

01880:   }
01881:

01883:     return {
01884:       transition: 0.2,
01885:       pair: 0.1,
01886:       memory: 0.1,
01887:       recent: 0.2,
01888:       structural: 0.3,
01889:       late: 0.1,
01890:     };
01891:   }
01892: 
01893:   return {
01894:     transition: 0.3,
01895:     pair: 0.15,
01896:     memory: 0.15,
01897:     recent: 0.15,
01898:     structural: 0.2,
01899:     late: 0.05,
01900:   };
01901: }

01903: function normalizeWeights(weights) {
01904:   const safe = {
01905:     transition: Number(weights?.transition || 0),
01906:     pair: Number(weights?.pair || 0),
01907:     memory: Number(weights?.memory || 0),
01908:     recent: Number(weights?.recent || 0),
01909:     structural: Number(weights?.structural || 0),
01910:     late: Number(weights?.late || 0),
01911:   };
01912: 
01913:   const total = Object.values(safe).reduce((acc, n) => acc + n, 0);
01914:   if (!Number.isFinite(total) || total <= 0) {
01915:     return {
01916:       transition: 0.3,
01917:       pair: 0.15,
01918:       memory: 0.15,
01919:       recent: 0.15,
01920:       structural: 0.2,
01921:       late: 0.05,
01922:     };
01923:   }
01924: 
01925:   return {
01926:     transition: safe.transition / total,
01927:     pair: safe.pair / total,
01928:     memory: safe.memory / total,
01929:     recent: safe.recent / total,
01930:     structural: safe.structural / total,
01931:     late: safe.late / total,
01932:   };
01933: }

01976: function buildDayContext(drawsToday = []) {
01977:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(Array.isArray(drawsToday) ? drawsToday : []);
01978:   const freq = new Map();
01979:   const firstFreq = new Map();
01980:   const seq = [];
01981: 
01982:   for (const d of list) {
01983:     const g = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
01984:     if (!Number.isFinite(Number(g)) || Number(g) < 1 || Number(g) > 25) continue;
01985: 
01986:     const gg = Number(g);
01987:     seq.push(gg);
01988:     freq.set(gg, Number(freq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01989: 
01990:     const items = getAllPrizePresenceGroups(d);
01991:     if (items.some((it) => Number(it.grupo) === gg && Number(it.pos) === 1)) {
01992:       firstFreq.set(gg, Number(firstFreq.get(gg) || 0) + 1);
01993:     }
01994:   }
01995: 
01996:   const total = seq.length;
01997:   const unique = new Set(seq).size;
01998:   const diversidade = total > 0 ? unique / total : 0;
01999: 
02000:   let dominante = null;
02001:   let dominanteCount = -1;
02002:   for (const [g, n] of freq.entries()) {
02003:     if (Number(n) > dominanteCount) {
02004:       dominante = Number(g);
02005:       dominanteCount = Number(n);
02006:     }
02007:   }
02008: 
02009:   const last1 = total >= 1 ? seq[total - 1] : null;
02010:   const last2 = total >= 2 ? seq[total - 2] : null;
02011:   const repeatNow =
02012:     Number.isFinite(Number(last1)) &&
02013:     Number.isFinite(Number(last2)) &&
02014:     Number(last1) === Number(last2);
02015: 
02016:   return {
02017:     total,
02018:     unique,
02019:     diversidade,
02020:     dominante,
02021:     dominanteCount: Math.max(0, dominanteCount),
02022:     repeatNow,
02023:     freq,
02024:     firstFreq,
02025:     seq,
02026:   };
02027: }

02029: function buildPairSequenceDistribution({
02030:   drawsRange,
02031:   lotteryKey,
02032:   targetHour,
02033:   targetDow,
02034:   targetDayOfMonth,
02035:   prevPair,
02036:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
02037:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
02038:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
02039:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K,
02040: }) {
02041:   const seq = buildComparableFirstSequence(
02042:     Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : [],
02043:     lotteryKey,
02044:     targetHour,
02045:     targetDow
02046:   );
02047: 
02048:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02049:   const outFreq = new Map();
02050: 
02051:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) outFreq.set(g, 0);
02052: 
02053:   const pair = Array.isArray(prevPair) ? prevPair : [];
02054:   if (pair.length < 2) {
02055:     return {
02056:       prob: buildZeroProbMap(k),
02057:       samples: 0,
02058:       weightedSamples: 0,
02059:       exactDomSamples: 0,
02060:       freq: outFreq,
02061:     };
02062:   }
02063: 
02064:   const pA = Number(pair[0]);
02065:   const pB = Number(pair[1]);
02066:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
02067: 
02068:   let matchedSamples = 0;
02069:   let weightedSamples = 0;
02070:   let exactDomSamples = 0;
02071: 
02072:   for (let i = 2; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
02073:     const a = Number(seq[i - 2]?.grupo);
02074:     const b = Number(seq[i - 1]?.grupo);
02075:     const g = Number(seq[i]?.grupo);
02076:     const y = safeStr(seq[i]?.ymd);
02077: 
02078:     if (!Number.isFinite(a) || !Number.isFinite(b) || !Number.isFinite(g)) continue;
02079:     if (a !== pA || b !== pB) continue;
02080:     if (!isYMD(y)) continue;
02081: 
02082:     matchedSamples += 1;
02083: 
02084:     let weight = 1;
02085: 
02086:     if (key !== "FEDERAL") {
02087:       const dom = Number(getDayOfMonth(y));
02088:       if (Number.isFinite(dom) && Number(dom) === Number(targetDayOfMonth)) {
02089:         weight = 1.35;
02090:         exactDomSamples += 1;
02091:       }
02092:     }
02093: 
02094:     weightedSamples += weight;
02095:     outFreq.set(g, Number(outFreq.get(g) || 0) + weight);
02096:   }
02097: 
02098:   const prob = new Map();
02099:   const denom = Math.max(1, weightedSamples);
02100: 
02101:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02102:     prob.set(g, Number(outFreq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
02103:   }
02104: 
02105:   return {
02106:     prob,
02107:     samples: matchedSamples,
02108:     weightedSamples,
02109:     exactDomSamples,
02110:     freq: outFreq,
02111:   };
02112: }

02114: function buildSeq2FirstDistribution(
02115:   comparableSeq,
02116:   currentState,
02117:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
02118: ) {
02119:   const seq = Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [];
02120:   const state = Array.isArray(currentState) ? currentState : [];
02121:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02122: 
02123:   const freq = new Map();
02124:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
02125: 
02126:   if (state.length < 2) {
02127:     const prob = new Map();
02128:     for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) prob.set(g, 0);
02129:     return { prob, freq, samples: 0, prev2: null, prev1: null };
02130:   }
02131: 
02132:   const prev1 = Number(state[0]);
02133:   const prev2 = Number(state[1]);
02134: 
02135:   let samples = 0;
02136: 
02137:   for (let i = 2; i < seq.length; i += 1) {
02138:     const gA = Number(seq[i - 2]?.grupo);
02139:     const gB = Number(seq[i - 1]?.grupo);
02140:     const gN = Number(seq[i]?.grupo);
02141: 
02142:     if (!Number.isFinite(gA) || !Number.isFinite(gB) || !Number.isFinite(gN)) continue;
02143:     if (gA !== prev2 || gB !== prev1) continue;
02144:     if (gN < 1 || gN > k) continue;
02145: 
02146:     samples += 1;
02147:     freq.set(gN, Number(freq.get(gN) || 0) + 1);
02148:   }
02149: 
02150:   const prob = new Map();
02151:   const denom = Math.max(1, samples);
02152: 
02153:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02154:     prob.set(g, Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / denom);
02155:   }
02156: 
02157:   return { prob, freq, samples, prev2, prev1 };
02158: }
02159: 
02160: function buildRecentRepeatBoostMap(
02161:   comparableSeq,
02162:   targetTs,
02163:   windowSize = 4,
02164:   groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K
02165: ) {
02166:   const seq = getComparableRecentDrawsBeforeTs(
02167:     Array.isArray(comparableSeq) ? comparableSeq : [],
02168:     targetTs,
02169:     windowSize
02170:   );
02171: 
02172:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
02173:   const counts = new Map();
02174:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) counts.set(g, 0);
02175: 
02176:   for (const item of seq) {
02177:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
02178:     if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > k) continue;
02179:     counts.set(g, Number(counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
02180:   }
02181: 
02182:   const boost = new Map();
02183:   const maxCount = Math.max(1, ...Array.from(counts.values()).map((n) => Number(n || 0)));
02184: 
02185:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02186:     const c = Number(counts.get(g) || 0);
02187:     boost.set(g, c >= 2 ? c / maxCount : 0);
02188:   }
02189: 
02190:   return {
02191:     boost,
02192:     counts,
02193:     windowSize,
02194:     considered: Array.isArray(seq) ? seq.length : 0,
02195:   };
02196: }

02701:         ...reasonsBase,
02702:         `Grupo G${g2}: transição para 1º=${(x.probTransition * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
02703:         `Grupo G${g2}: estrutural de 1º=${(x.probStructuralFirst * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,

02713:         `Grupo G${g2}: 1ºs estruturais=${x.structuralFirstCount}`,
02714:         `Grupo G${g2}: TOP3 estruturais=${x.structuralPrizePresenceCount}`,
02715:         `Grupo G${g2}: draws com duplicação=${x.duplicationCount}`,
02716:         `Grupo G${g2}: peso de memória=${Number(x.memoryWeight || 0).toFixed(2)}`,
02717:         `Grupo G${g2}: frequência no dia=${x.dayFreq}`,
02718:         `Grupo G${g2}: 1ºs no dia=${x.dayFirstFreq}`,
02719:         `Grupo G${g2}: dominante no dia=${x.isDominantToday ? "sim" : "não"}`,
02720:         `Grupo G${g2}: score do fluxo do dia=${Number(x.dayFlowScore || 0).toFixed(2)} | confiança=${(Number(x.dayFlowConfidence || 0) * 100).toFixed(0)}%`,
02721:         `Grupo G${g2}: sequência ${Array.isArray(prevPair) && prevPair.length === 2 ? prevPair.map((n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0")).join("→") : "--"} | amostras=${x.pairSamples} | amostras ponderadas=${Number(x.pairWeightedSamples || 0).toFixed(2)} | DOM exato=${x.pairExactDomSamples} | ocorrências=${Number(x.pairCount || 0).toFixed(2)} | prob=${(Number(x.pairProb || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}% | score=${Number(x.pairSequenceScore || 0).toFixed(2)}`,
02722:         `Probabilidade final BICHO=${(x.scoreProb * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
02723:       ],
02724:       meta: {
02725:         trigger: {
02726:           ymd: lastY,
02727:           hour: lastH,
02728:           grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
02729:         },
02730:         next: {
02731:           ymd: safeStr(targetY),
02732:           hour: safeStr(targetH),
02733:         },
02734:         samples: condSamples,
02735:         scenario: `V2_BICHO_${safeStr(regime).toUpperCase()}`,
02736:         explain: {
02737:           engine: "V2_BICHO",
02738:           mode,
02739:           regime,
02740:           repeatRate: Number(regimeInfo?.repeatRate || 0),
02741:           uniqueRate: Number(regimeInfo?.uniqueRate || 0),
02742:           weights: adjustedWeights,
02743:           layerKey: chosen?.key || "NONE",
02744:           layerLabel: chosen?.label || "—",
02745:           layerSamples: condSamples,
02746:           structuralFirstSamples: Number(structuralFirst?.totalSamples || 0),
02747:           structuralPrizePresenceSamples: Number(structuralPrizePresence?.totalSamples || 0),
02748:           duplicationSamples: Number(duplication?.totalSamples || 0),
02749:           memoryMatchedSamples: Number(memoryOut?.matchedSamples || 0),
02750:           memoryTotalWeight: Number(memoryOut?.totalWeight || 0),
02751:           seq2Samples: Number(seq2Out?.samples || 0),
02752:           seq2Prev2: Number(seq2Out?.prev2 || 0),
02753:           seq2Prev1: Number(seq2Out?.prev1 || 0),
02754:           pairSamples: Number(pairOut?.samples || 0),
02755:           pairWeightedSamples: Number(pairOut?.weightedSamples || 0),
02756:           pairExactDomSamples: Number(pairOut?.exactDomSamples || 0),
02757:           pairConfidence,
02758:           repeatWindowSize: Number(repeatBoostOut?.windowSize || 0),
02759:           repeatWindowConsidered: Number(repeatBoostOut?.considered || 0),
02760:           currentState,
02761:           targetDow,
02762:           targetDayOfMonth,
02763:           prevHour: lastH,
02764:           prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
02765:           dayContextTotal: Number(dayContext?.total || 0),
02766:           dayFlowConfidence,
02767:           dominanceScore: x.dominanceScore,
02768:           recentComposite: x.recentComposite,
02769:           recentPrizePresence: x.recentPrizePresence,
02770:           recentFirst: x.recentFirst,
02771:           recentDupDraws: x.recentDupDraws,
02772:           allLayers: (layerOut?.layers || []).map((layer) => ({
02773:             key: layer.key,
02774:             label: layer.label,
02775:             samples: layer.samples,
02776:             minSamples: layer.minSamples,
02777:           })),
02778:         },
02779:       },
02780:     };
02781:   });
02782: 
02783:   return {
02784:     top,
02785:     meta: {
02786:       trigger: {
02787:         ymd: lastY,
02788:         hour: lastH,
02789:         grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
02790:       },

02792:         ymd: safeStr(targetY),
02793:         hour: safeStr(targetH),
02794:       },
02795:       samples: condSamples,
02796:       scenario: `V2_BICHO_${safeStr(regime).toUpperCase()}`,
02797:       explain: {
02798:         engine: "V2_BICHO",
02799:         mode,
02800:         regime,
02801:         repeatRate: Number(regimeInfo?.repeatRate || 0),
02802:         uniqueRate: Number(regimeInfo?.uniqueRate || 0),
02803:         weights: adjustedWeights,
02804:         layerKey: chosen?.key || "NONE",
02805:         layerLabel: chosen?.label || "—",
02806:         layerSamples: condSamples,
02807:         structuralFirstSamples: Number(structuralFirst?.totalSamples || 0),
02808:         structuralPrizePresenceSamples: Number(structuralPrizePresence?.totalSamples || 0),
02809:         duplicationSamples: Number(duplication?.totalSamples || 0),
02810:         memoryMatchedSamples: Number(memoryOut?.matchedSamples || 0),
02811:         memoryTotalWeight: Number(memoryOut?.totalWeight || 0),
02812:         pairSamples: Number(pairOut?.samples || 0),
02813:         pairWeightedSamples: Number(pairOut?.weightedSamples || 0),
02814:         pairExactDomSamples: Number(pairOut?.exactDomSamples || 0),
02815:         pairConfidence,

02824:           key: layer.key,

02833: 
02834: 
02835: /* =========================
02836:    Motor principal V3 (ESTATISTICO AUDITAVEL)
02837: ========================= */
02838: 
02839: function incMap(map, key, value = 1) {
02840:   const k = Number(key);
02841:   if (!Number.isFinite(k) || k < 1 || k > TOP3_GROUPS_K) return;
02842:   map.set(k, Number(map.get(k) || 0) + Number(value || 0));
02843: }
02844: 
02845: function emptyGroupMap() {
02846:   const out = new Map();
02847:   for (let g = 1; g <= safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25); g += 1) out.set(g, 0);
02848:   return out;
02849: }
02850: 
02851: function getPrizePresenceGroupSet(draw) {
02852:   return new Set(
02853:     getAllPrizePresenceGroups(draw)
02854:       .map((x) => Number(x.grupo))
02855:       .filter((g) => Number.isFinite(g) && g >= 1 && g <= TOP3_GROUPS_K)
02856:   );
02857: }
02858: 
02859: function layerProbability(freqMap, samples, alpha = TOP3_SMOOTH_ALPHA) {
02860:   const out = new Map();
02861:   const k = safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25);
02862:   const a = Math.max(0, Number(alpha || 0));
02863:   const base = Math.max(0, Number(samples || 0));
02864:   const denom = Math.max(1, base + (a * k));
02865: 
02866:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
02867:     const count = Math.max(0, Number(freqMap?.get?.(g) || 0));
02868:     out.set(g, (count + a) / denom);
02869:   }
02870: 
02871:   return out;
02872: }
02873: 
02874: function sampleConfidence(samples, fullAt = 30) {
02875:   const n = Number(samples || 0);
02876:   const lim = Math.max(1, Number(fullAt || 30));
02877:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n / lim));
02878: }
02879: 
02880: export function computeStatisticalTop3V3({
02881:   lotteryKey,
02882:   drawsRange,
02883:   drawLast,
02884:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
02885:   PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
02886:   FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
02887:   topN = 3,
02888:   targetYmdOverride = "",
02889:   targetHourOverride = "",
02890: }) {
02891:   const list = sortDrawsAsc(Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : []);
02892:   if (!list.length || !drawLast) return { top: [], meta: null };
02893: 
02894:   const key = safeStr(lotteryKey).toUpperCase();
02895: 
02896:   const lastY = pickDrawYMD(drawLast);
02897:   const lastH = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(drawLast));
02898:   const prevGrupo = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(drawLast);
02899: 
02900:   if (
02901:     !isYMD(lastY) ||
02902:     !lastH ||
02903:     !Number.isFinite(Number(prevGrupo)) ||
02904:     Number(prevGrupo) < 1 ||
02905:     Number(prevGrupo) > TOP3_GROUPS_K
02906:   ) {
02907:     return { top: [], meta: null };
02908:   }
02909: 
02910:   const nextSlot = getNextSlotForLottery({
02911:     lotteryKey: key,
02912:     ymd: lastY,
02913:     hourBucket: lastH,
02914:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
02915:     PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
02916:     FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
02917:   });
02918: 
02919:   const forcedTargetY = safeStr(targetYmdOverride);
02920:   const forcedTargetH = toHourBucket(targetHourOverride);
02921: 
02922:   const targetY = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
02923:     ? forcedTargetY
02924:     : safeStr(nextSlot?.ymd);
02925: 
02926:   const targetH = isYMD(forcedTargetY) && forcedTargetH
02927:     ? forcedTargetH
02928:     : toHourBucket(nextSlot?.hour);
02929:   const targetDow = getDowKey(targetY);
02930:   const targetDayOfMonth = getDayOfMonth(targetY);
02931:   const targetTs = ymdHourToTs(targetY, targetH);
02932: 
02933:   if (!isYMD(targetY) || !targetH || !Number.isFinite(Number(targetDow))) {
02934:     return { top: [], meta: null };
02935:   }
02936: 
02937:   const history = list.filter((d) => {
02938:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
02939:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
02940:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
02941:     return isYMD(y) && h && Number.isFinite(ts) && ts < targetTs;
02942:   });
02943: 
02944:   const layers = {
02945:     hour: { label: `frequência no horário ${targetH}`, samples: 0, first: emptyGroupMap(), prizePresence: emptyGroupMap(), weight: 0.33 },
02946:     dowHour: { label: `frequência no dia da semana + horário`, samples: 0, first: emptyGroupMap(), prizePresence: emptyGroupMap(), weight: 0.27 },
02947:     dayMonth: { label: `frequência no dia ${String(targetDayOfMonth).padStart(2, "0")}`, samples: 0, first: emptyGroupMap(), prizePresence: emptyGroupMap(), weight: 0.04 },
02948:     transition: { label: `transição G${String(prevGrupo).padStart(2, "0")} @ ${lastH} → ${targetH}`, samples: 0, first: emptyGroupMap(), prizePresence: emptyGroupMap(), weight: 0.26 },
02949:     recent: { label: `recência comparável`, samples: 0, first: emptyGroupMap(), prizePresence: emptyGroupMap(), weight: 0.10 },
02950:   };
02951: 
02952:   for (const d of history) {
02953:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
02954:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
02955:     const dow = getDowKey(y);
02956:     const dom = getDayOfMonth(y);
02957:     const g1 = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
02958:     const prizePresenceSet = getPrizePresenceGroupSet(d);
02959: 
02960:     const addToLayer = (layer) => {
02961:       layer.samples += 1;
02962:       incMap(layer.first, g1, 1);
02963:       for (const g of prizePresenceSet) incMap(layer.prizePresence, g, 1);
02964:     };
02965: 
02966:     if (h === targetH) addToLayer(layers.hour);
02967:     if (h === targetH && Number(dow) === Number(targetDow)) addToLayer(layers.dowHour);
02968:     if (Number(dom) === Number(targetDayOfMonth)) addToLayer(layers.dayMonth);
02969:   }
02970: 
02971:   const indexed = indexDrawsByYmdHour(history);
02972: 
02973:   for (const prev of history) {
02974:     const py = pickDrawYMD(prev);
02975:     const ph = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(prev));
02976:     const pg = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(prev);
02977: 
02978:     if (!isYMD(py) || !ph || Number(pg) !== Number(prevGrupo)) continue;
02979: 
02980:     const ns = getNextSlotForLottery({
02981:       lotteryKey: key,
02982:       ymd: py,
02983:       hourBucket: ph,
02984:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_NORMAL,
02985:       PT_RIO_SCHEDULE_WED_SAT,
02986:       FEDERAL_SCHEDULE,
02987:     });
02988: 
02989:     if (toHourBucket(ns?.hour) !== targetH) continue;
02990:     if (ph !== lastH) continue;
02991: 
02992:     const nextDraw = indexed.get(`${safeStr(ns?.ymd)}|${toHourBucket(ns?.hour)}`) || null;
02993:     if (!nextDraw) continue;
02994: 
02995:     const g1 = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(nextDraw);
02996:     const prizePresenceSet = getPrizePresenceGroupSet(nextDraw);
02997: 
02998:     layers.transition.samples += 1;
02999:     incMap(layers.transition.first, g1, 1);
03000:     for (const g of prizePresenceSet) incMap(layers.transition.prizePresence, g, 1);
03001:   }
03002: 
03003:   const recentComparable = history
03004:     .filter((d) => {
03005:       const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
03006:       const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
03007:       return h === targetH && Number(getDowKey(y)) === Number(targetDow);
03008:     })
03009:     .slice(-20);
03010: 
03011:   for (const d of recentComparable) {
03012:     const g1 = getFirstGrupoFromDraw(d);
03013:     const prizePresenceSet = getPrizePresenceGroupSet(d);
03014: 
03015:     layers.recent.samples += 1;
03016:     incMap(layers.recent.first, g1, 1);
03017:     for (const g of prizePresenceSet) incMap(layers.recent.prizePresence, g, 1);
03018:   }
03019: 
03020:   const currentScene = buildSceneFromDraw(drawLast);
03021:   const sceneRanking = buildHistoricalSceneRanking(history, currentScene, 80);
03022:   const sceneHypothesis = buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, TOP3_GROUPS_K);
03023:   const sceneWeight =
03024:     sampleConfidence(sceneHypothesis?.samples || 0, TOP3_SCENE_SAMPLE_TARGET) *
03025:     TOP3_SCENE_WEIGHT;
03026: 
03027: 
03028:   const activeWeights = {};
03029:   let totalWeight = 0;
03030: 
03031:   for (const [keyLayer, layer] of Object.entries(layers)) {
03032:     const conf =
03033:       keyLayer === "transition"
03034:         ? sampleConfidence(layer.samples, 8)
03035:         : keyLayer === "recent"
03036:           ? sampleConfidence(layer.samples, 12)
03037:           : sampleConfidence(layer.samples, 30);
03038: 
03039:     const w = layer.samples > 0 ? layer.weight * conf : 0;
03040:     activeWeights[keyLayer] = w;
03041:     totalWeight += w;
03042:   }
03043: 
03044:   if (totalWeight <= 0) {
03045:     activeWeights.hour = 1;
03046:     totalWeight = 1;
03047:   }
03048: 
03049:   for (const keyLayer of Object.keys(activeWeights)) {
03050:     activeWeights[keyLayer] = activeWeights[keyLayer] / totalWeight;
03051:   }
03052: 
03053:   const ranked = Array.from({ length: safeInt(TOP3_GROUPS_K, 25) }, (_, idx) => {
03054:     const grupo = idx + 1;
03055: 
03056:     let scoreProb = 0;
03057:     const details = {};
03058: 
03059:     for (const [keyLayer, layer] of Object.entries(layers)) {
03060:       const pFirst = Number(layerProbability(layer.first, layer.samples).get(grupo) || 0);
03061:       const pPrizePresence = Number(layerProbability(layer.prizePresence, layer.samples).get(grupo) || 0);
03062: 
03063:       const pLayer = (pFirst * 0.92) + (pPrizePresence * 0.08);
03064:       const w = Number(activeWeights[keyLayer] || 0);
03065: 
03066:       scoreProb += pLayer * w;
03067: 
03068:       details[keyLayer] = {
03069:         label: layer.label,
03070:         samples: layer.samples,
03071:         firstCount: Number(layer.first.get(grupo) || 0),
03072:         top3Count: Number(layer.prizePresence.get(grupo) || 0),
03073:         probability: pLayer,
03074:         weight: w,
03075:       };
03076:     }
03077: 
03078:     const pSceneRaw = Number(sceneHypothesis?.prob?.get?.(grupo) || 0);
03079:     const pScene =
03080:       (pSceneRaw * TOP3_SCENE_BLEND_SCENE) +
03081:       ((1 / TOP3_GROUPS_K) * TOP3_SCENE_BLEND_UNIFORM);
03082: 
03083:     if (sceneWeight > 0) {
03084:       scoreProb = (scoreProb * (1 - sceneWeight)) + (pScene * sceneWeight);
03085:     }
03086: 
03087:     details.scene = {
03088:       label: "analogia histórica de cena",
03089:       samples: Number(sceneHypothesis?.samples || 0),
03090:       firstCount: Number(sceneHypothesis?.freq?.get?.(grupo) || 0),
03091:       top3Count: 0,
03092:       probability: pScene,
03093:       weight: sceneWeight,
03094:     };
03095: 
03096:     return {
03097:       grupo,
03098:       scoreProb,
03099:       score: scoreProb * 1000,
03100:       details,
03101:     };
03102:   })
03103:     .sort((a, b) => {
03104:       if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;
03105:       return a.grupo - b.grupo;
03106:     })
03107:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(topN || 3)));
03108: 
03109:   const rankedScored = scoreRanking(
03110:     ranked,
03111:     {
03112:       lotteryKey,
03113:       targetYmd: targetY,
03114:       targetHour: targetH,
03115:       previousGroup: prevGrupo,
03116:       totalDraws: history.length,
03117:     }
03118:   );
03119: 
03120:   const top = rankedScored.map((x, idx) => {
03121:     const g2 = String(x.grupo).padStart(2, "0");
03122:     const rawScoreProb = Number(x.scoreProb || 0);
03123: 
03124:     const strongest = Object.values(x.details)
03125:       .filter((d) => Number(d.probability || 0) > 0)
03126:       .sort((a, b) => (b.probability * b.weight) - (a.probability * a.weight))
03127:       .slice(0, 3);
03128: 
03129:     return {
03130:       rank: idx + 1,
03131:       title:
03132:         idx === 0
03133:           ? "Mais provável"
03134:           : idx === 1
03135:             ? "2º mais provável"
03136:             : "3º mais provável",
03137:       grupo: x.grupo,
03138:       scoreProb: Number(rawScoreProb || 0),
03139:       rawScoreProb: Number(rawScoreProb || 0),
03140:       probCond: Number(x.details.transition?.probability || 0),
03141:       probBase: Number(x.details.hour?.probability || 0),
03142:       lateBonus: 0,
03143:       freq: Number(x.details.hour?.firstCount || 0),
03144:       freqCond: Number(x.details.transition?.firstCount || 0),
03145:       freqBase: Number(x.details.hour?.firstCount || 0),
03146:       freqZeroWhy: "",
03147:       reasons: [
03148:         `Motor: V3_STATISTICAL`,
03149:         `Alvo: ${targetY} ${targetH} | DOW=${targetDow} | dia=${String(targetDayOfMonth).padStart(2, "0")}`,
03150:         `Base: G${String(prevGrupo).padStart(2, "0")} @ ${lastH}`,
03151:         `Probabilidade final G${g2}: ${(Number(rawScoreProb || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`,
03152:         ...strongest.map((d) =>
03153:           `${d.label}: ${d.firstCount}x em 1º | ${d.top3Count}x no TOP3 | amostras=${d.samples} | peso=${(d.weight * 100).toFixed(0)}%`
03154:         ),
03155:       ],
03156:       meta: {
03157:         trigger: {
03158:           ymd: lastY,
03159:           hour: lastH,
03160:           grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
03161:         },
03162:         next: {
03163:           ymd: safeStr(targetY),
03164:           hour: safeStr(targetH),
03165:         },
03166:         samples: history.length,
03167:         period: {
03168:           from: pickDrawYMD(history[0]) || "",
03169:           to: pickDrawYMD(history[history.length - 1]) || "",
03170:         },
03171:         scenario: "V3_STATISTICAL",
03172:         explain: {
03173:           engine: "V3_STATISTICAL",
03174:           targetDow,
03175:           targetDayOfMonth,
03176:           prevHour: lastH,
03177:           prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
03178:           activeWeights,
03179:           scene: {
03180:             samples: Number(sceneHypothesis?.samples || 0),
03181:             totalWeight: Number(sceneHypothesis?.totalWeight || 0),
03182:             weight: Number(sceneWeight || 0),
03183:             currentSignature: currentScene?.signature || "",
03184:           },
03185:           layers: Object.fromEntries(
03186:             Object.entries(layers).map(([k, v]) => [
03187:               k,
03188:               {
03189:                 label: v.label,
03190:                 samples: v.samples,
03191:                 weight: activeWeights[k],
03192:               },
03193:             ])
03194:           ),
03195:           details: x.details,
03196:         },
03197:       },
03198:     };
03199:   });
03200: 
03201:   return {
03202:     top,
03203:     meta: {
03204:       trigger: {
03205:         ymd: lastY,
03206:         hour: lastH,
03207:         grupo: Number(prevGrupo),
03208:       },
03209:       next: {
03210:         ymd: safeStr(targetY),
03211:         hour: safeStr(targetH),
03212:       },
03213:       samples: history.length,
03214:       scenario: "V3_STATISTICAL",
03215:       explain: {
03216:         engine: "V3_STATISTICAL",
03217:         targetDow,
03218:         targetDayOfMonth,
03219:         prevHour: lastH,
03220:         prevGrupo: Number(prevGrupo),
03221:         activeWeights,
03222:         layers: Object.fromEntries(
03223:           Object.entries(layers).map(([k, v]) => [
03224:             k,
03225:             {
03226:               label: v.label,
03227:               samples: v.samples,
03228:               weight: activeWeights[k],
03229:             },
03230:           ])
03231:         ),
03232:       },
03233:     },
03234:   };
03235: }

03238: 
03239: /* =========================
03240:    TOP3 SCENE READER
03241: ========================= */
03242: 
03243: function scenePickMilhar4(prize) {
03244:   const candidates = [
03245:     prize?.milhar,
03246:     prize?.milhar4,
03247:     prize?.numero,
03248:     prize?.number,
03249:     prize?.value,
03250:     prize?.result,
03251:     prize?.resultado,
03252:     prize?.premio,
03253:   ];
03254: 
03255:   for (const v of candidates) {
03256:     const dig = String(v ?? "").replace(/\D+/g, "");
03257:     if (dig) return dig.length >= 4 ? dig.slice(-4) : dig.padStart(4, "0");
03258:   }
03259: 
03260:   return "";
03261: }
03262: 
03263: function sceneGrupoFromMilhar4(m4) {
03264:   const s = String(m4 || "").replace(/\D+/g, "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4);
03265:   if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(s)) return null;
03266: 
03267:   const dzRaw = Number(s.slice(-2));
03268:   if (!Number.isFinite(dzRaw)) return null;
03269: 
03270:   const dz = dzRaw === 0 ? 100 : dzRaw;
03271:   const grupo = Math.ceil(dz / 4);
03272: 
03273:   return grupo >= 1 && grupo <= 25 ? grupo : null;
03274: }
03275: 
03276: function buildSceneFromDraw(draw) {
03277:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
03278: 
03279:   const rows = prizes
03280:     .map((p) => {
03281:       const pos = Number(guessPrizePos(p));
03282:       const milhar = scenePickMilhar4(p);
03283:       const grupo = sceneGrupoFromMilhar4(milhar);
03284: 
03285:       return {
03286:         pos,
03287:         milhar: String(milhar || "").replace(/\D+/g, "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4),
03288:         centena: getCentena3(milhar),
03289:         dezena: getDezena2(milhar),
03290:         grupo,
03291:       };
03292:     })
03293:     .filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x.pos) && x.pos >= 1 && x.pos <= 7)
03294:     .sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
03295: 
03296:   const grupos = rows.map((x) => x.grupo).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x));
03297:   const dezenas = rows.map((x) => x.dezena).filter(Boolean);
03298:   const centenas = rows.map((x) => x.centena).filter(Boolean);
03299:   const milhares = rows.map((x) => x.milhar).filter(Boolean);
03300: 
03301:   const countMap = (arr) => {
03302:     const m = new Map();
03303:     for (const x of arr) m.set(String(x), (m.get(String(x)) || 0) + 1);
03304:     return Array.from(m.entries())
03305:       .filter(([, n]) => n > 1)
03306:       .map(([value, count]) => ({ value, count }));
03307:   };
03308: 
03309:   return {
03310:     ymd: pickDrawYMD(draw),
03311:     hour: toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw)),
03312:     firstGrupo: grupos[0] ?? null,
03313:     grupos,
03314:     dezenas,
03315:     centenas,
03316:     milhares,
03317:     repeatedGroups: countMap(grupos),
03318:     repeatedDezenas: countMap(dezenas),
03319:     repeatedCentenas: countMap(centenas),
03320:     rows,
03321:     signature: grupos.map((g) => String(g).padStart(2, "0")).join("-"),
03322:   };
03323: }
03324: 
03325: 
03326: 
03327: function compareScenes(a, b, explain = false) {
03328:   if (!a || !b) return explain ? { score: 0, details: {} } : 0;
03329: 
03330:   let score = 0;
03331:   const details = {};
03332: 
03333:   const add = (key, value) => {
03334:     if (!value) return;
03335:     score += value;
03336:     details[key] = value;
03337:   };
03338: 
03339:   const ag = Array.isArray(a.grupos) ? a.grupos : [];
03340:   const bg = Array.isArray(b.grupos) ? b.grupos : [];
03341: 
03342:   const ad = Array.isArray(a.dezenas) ? a.dezenas : [];
03343:   const bd = Array.isArray(b.dezenas) ? b.dezenas : [];
03344: 
03345:   const ac = Array.isArray(a.centenas) ? a.centenas : [];
03346:   const bc = Array.isArray(b.centenas) ? b.centenas : [];
03347: 
03348:   if (Number(a.firstGrupo) === Number(b.firstGrupo))
03349:     add("firstGrupo",45);
03350: 
03351:   for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ag.length,bg.length,7); i++) {
03352:     if (Number(ag[i]) === Number(bg[i]))
03353:       add("order_"+i, i===0 ? 20 : 10);
03354:   }
03355: 
03356:   add(
03357:     "groupOverlap",
03358:     new Set(ag.filter(g => bg.includes(g))).size * 6
03359:   );
03360: 
03361:   add(
03362:     "dezenaOverlap",
03363:     new Set(ad.filter(d => bd.includes(d))).size * 3
03364:   );
03365: 
03366:   add(
03367:     "centenaOverlap",
03368:     new Set(ac.filter(c => bc.includes(c))).size * 1.5
03369:   );
03370: 
03371:   const repA = Array.isArray(a.repeatedGroups) ? a.repeatedGroups.length : 0;
03372:   const repB = Array.isArray(b.repeatedGroups) ? b.repeatedGroups.length : 0;
03373: 
03374:   if (repA > 0 && repB > 0)
03375:     add("repeatExists",8);
03376: 
03377:   if (repA === repB && repA > 0)
03378:     add("repeatEqual",6);
03379: 
03380:   if (String(a.signature||"") === String(b.signature||""))
03381:     add("signature",60);
03382: 
03383:   if (a.hour === b.hour)
03384:     add("hour",8);
03385: 
03386:   return explain ? { score, details } : score;
03387: }
03388:

03390: 
03391: 
03392: function buildHistoricalSceneRanking(draws, currentScene, limit = 100) {
03393:   const list = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
03394:   if (!currentScene) return [];
03395: 
03396:   const ordered = list
03397:     .map((draw) => ({
03398:       draw,
03399:       scene: buildSceneFromDraw(draw),
03400:     }))
03401:     .filter((x) => x.scene)
03402:     .sort((a, b) => {
03403:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(a.scene?.ymd, a.scene?.hour);
03404:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(b.scene?.ymd, b.scene?.hour);
03405:       return Number(ta || 0) - Number(tb || 0);
03406:     });
03407: 
03408:   return ordered
03409:     .map((item, idx) => {
03410:       const next = ordered[idx + 1] || null;
03411:       const score = compareScenes(currentScene, item.scene);
03412: 
03413:       return {
03414:         draw: item.draw,
03415:         scene: item.scene,
03416:         nextDraw: next?.draw || null,
03417:         nextScene: next?.scene || null,
03418:         score,
03419:       };
03420:     })
03421:     .filter((x) => x.scene && x.nextDraw && Number(x.score) > 0)
03422:     .sort((a, b) => {
03423:       if (Number(b.score) !== Number(a.score)) {
03424:         return Number(b.score) - Number(a.score);
03425:       }
03426: 
03427:       const ta = ymdHourToTs(a.scene?.ymd, a.scene?.hour);
03428:       const tb = ymdHourToTs(b.scene?.ymd, b.scene?.hour);
03429:       return Number(tb || 0) - Number(ta || 0);
03430:     })
03431:     .slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(limit || 100)));
03432: }

03436: 
03437: function buildSceneHypothesisDistribution(sceneRanking, groupsK = TOP3_GROUPS_K) {
03438:   const ranking = Array.isArray(sceneRanking) ? sceneRanking : [];
03439:   const k = safeInt(groupsK, 25);
03440: 
03441:   const freq = new Map();
03442:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) freq.set(g, 0);
03443: 
03444:   let totalWeight = 0;
03445: 
03446:   for (const item of ranking) {
03447:     const score = Math.max(0, Number(item?.score || 0));
03448:     const nextGrupo = Number(item?.nextDraw ? pickPrize1GrupoFromDraw(item.nextDraw) : null);
03449: 
03450:     if (!Number.isFinite(nextGrupo) || nextGrupo < 1 || nextGrupo > k) continue;
03451:     if (score <= 0) continue;
03452: 
03453:     freq.set(nextGrupo, Number(freq.get(nextGrupo) || 0) + score);
03454:     totalWeight += score;
03455:   }
03456: 
03457:   const prob = new Map();
03458:   for (let g = 1; g <= k; g += 1) {
03459:     prob.set(g, totalWeight > 0 ? Number(freq.get(g) || 0) / totalWeight : 0);
03460:   }
03461: 
03462:   return {
03463:     freq,
03464:     prob,
03465:     samples: ranking.length,
03466:     totalWeight,
03467:   };
03468: }

03488:     rows: scene.rows,

03493: /* =========================
03494:    16/20 milhares (por grupo) — POR TERMINAÇÃO (CORRETO)
03495: ========================= */
03496: 
03497: function getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(grupo2) {
03498:   const g = Number(grupo2);
03499:   if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) return [];
03500: 
03501:   const start = (g - 1) * 4 + 1;
03502:   const out = [];
03503: 
03504:   for (let i = 0; i < 4; i += 1) {
03505:     out.push(wrapToDezena2(start + i));
03506:   }
03507: 
03508:   return out.filter(Boolean);
03509: }
03510: 
03511: 
03512: export function buildMilharesForGrupo({
03513:   rangeDraws,
03514:   analysisHourBucket,
03515:   schedule,
03516:   grupo2,
03517:   count = 20,
03518:   targetYmd = "",
03519: }) {
03520:   const list = Array.isArray(rangeDraws) ? rangeDraws : [];
03521:   const target = toHourBucket(analysisHourBucket);
03522:   const schSet = scheduleSet(schedule);
03523:   const targetDay = safeStr(targetYmd);
03524:   const targetDow = isYMD(targetDay) ? getDowKey(targetDay) : null;
03525: 
03526:   const N = Number.isFinite(Number(count))
03527:     ? Math.max(4, Math.trunc(Number(count)))
03528:     : 20;
03529: 
03530:   const grupoNum = Number(grupo2);
03531: 
03532:   if (!Number.isFinite(grupoNum) || grupoNum < 1 || grupoNum > 25 || !list.length) {
03533:     return { dezenas: [], slots: [] };
03534:   }
03535: 
03536:   const dezenasFixas = getDezenasFixasFromGrupo(grupoNum);
03537:   if (!dezenasFixas.length) return { dezenas: [], slots: [] };
03538: 
03539:   const perDezena = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(N / dezenasFixas.length));
03540:   const byMilhar = new Map();
03541: 
03542:   for (const d of list) {
03543:     const y = pickDrawYMD(d);
03544:     const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(d));
03545:     if (!h) continue;
03546: 
03547:     const isTargetHour = target && h === target;
03548:     const isScheduleHour = schSet.size && schSet.has(h);
03549:     const isSameDow = targetDow !== null && Number(getDowKey(y)) === Number(targetDow);
03550:     const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);
03551: 
03552:     const ps = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
03553: 
03554:     for (const prize of ps) {
03555:       const pos = Number(guessPrizePos(prize));
03556:       if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 7) continue;
03557: 
03558:       const g = Number(guessPrizeGrupo(prize));
03559:       if (g !== grupoNum) continue;
03560: 
03561:       const m4 = String(pickPrizeMilhar4(prize) || "").replace(/\D+/g, "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4);
03562:       if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(m4)) continue;
03563: 
03564:       const dz = getDezena2(m4);
03565:       const c3 = getCentena3(m4);
03566: 
03567:       if (!dz || !c3 || !dezenasFixas.includes(dz)) continue;
03568: 
03569:       const current = byMilhar.get(m4) || {
03570:         milhar: m4,
03571:         dezena: dz,
03572:         centena: c3,
03573:         freq: 0,
03574:         score: 0,
03575:         targetHits: 0,
03576:         scheduleHits: 0,
03577:         sameDowHits: 0,
03578:         firstPrizeHits: 0,
03579:         lastTs: 0,
03580:       };
03581: 
03582:       let inc = 1;
03583: 
03584:       if (isTargetHour) {
03585:         inc += 8;
03586:         current.targetHits += 1;
03587:       }
03588: 
03589:       if (isScheduleHour) {
03590:         inc += 3;
03591:         current.scheduleHits += 1;
03592:       }
03593: 
03594:       if (isSameDow) {
03595:         inc += 2;
03596:         current.sameDowHits += 1;
03597:       }
03598: 
03599:       if (pos === 1) {
03600:         inc += 3;
03601:         current.firstPrizeHits += 1;
03602:       } else if (pos <= 3) {
03603:         inc += 1;
03604:       }
03605: 
03606:       current.freq += 1;
03607:       current.score += inc;
03608: 
03609:       if (Number.isFinite(ts)) {
03610:         current.lastTs = Math.max(Number(current.lastTs || 0), ts);
03611:       }
03612: 
03613:       byMilhar.set(m4, current);
03614:     }
03615:   }
03616: 
03617:   const ranked = Array.from(byMilhar.values())
03618:     .map((m) => {
03619:       const freq = Number(m.freq || 0);
03620:       const targetHits = Number(m.targetHits || 0);
03621:       const scheduleHits = Number(m.scheduleHits || 0);
03622:       const sameDowHits = Number(m.sameDowHits || 0);
03623:       const firstPrizeHits = Number(m.firstPrizeHits || 0);
03624:       const recencyBoost = Number(m.lastTs || 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0;
03625: 
03626:       return {
03627:         ...m,
03628:         score:
03629:           freq * 100 +
03630:           targetHits * 70 +
03631:           scheduleHits * 35 +
03632:           sameDowHits * 25 +
03633:           firstPrizeHits * 45 +
03634:           recencyBoost * 5,
03635:       };
03636:     })
03637:     .sort((a, b) => {
03638:       if (Number(b.score) !== Number(a.score)) return Number(b.score) - Number(a.score);
03639:       if (Number(b.targetHits) !== Number(a.targetHits)) return Number(b.targetHits) - Number(a.targetHits);
03640:       if (Number(b.freq) !== Number(a.freq)) return Number(b.freq) - Number(a.freq);
03641:       if (Number(b.lastTs) !== Number(a.lastTs)) return Number(b.lastTs) - Number(a.lastTs);
03642:       return milharCompareAsc(a.milhar, b.milhar);
03643:     });
03644: 
03645:   const centenaStats = new Map();
03646: 
03647:   for (const item of ranked) {
03648:     const centena = String(item?.centena || "").trim();
03649:     if (!centena) continue;
03650: 
03651:     const current = centenaStats.get(centena) || {
03652:       centena,
03653:       freq: 0,
03654:       score: 0,
03655:       targetHits: 0,
03656:       sameDowHits: 0,
03657:       firstPrizeHits: 0,
03658:       lastTs: 0,
03659:     };
03660: 
03661:     current.freq += Number(item.freq || 0);
03662:     current.score += Number(item.score || 0);
03663:     current.targetHits += Number(item.targetHits || 0);
03664:     current.sameDowHits += Number(item.sameDowHits || 0);
03665:     current.firstPrizeHits += Number(item.firstPrizeHits || 0);
03666:     current.lastTs = Math.max(Number(current.lastTs || 0), Number(item.lastTs || 0));
03667: 
03668:     centenaStats.set(centena, current);
03669:   }
03670: 
03671:   const centenaScoreMap = new Map();
03672: 
03673:   for (const c of centenaStats.values()) {
03674:     centenaScoreMap.set(
03675:       c.centena,
03676:       Number(c.score || 0) +
03677:         Number(c.freq || 0) * 25 +
03678:         Number(c.targetHits || 0) * 60 +
03679:         Number(c.sameDowHits || 0) * 30 +
03680:         Number(c.firstPrizeHits || 0) * 40 +
03681:         (Number(c.lastTs || 0) > 0 ? 10 : 0)
03682:     );
03683:   }
03684: 
03685:   const usedMilhares = new Set();
03686:   const slots = [];
03687: 
03688:   function pickDiversifiedMilharesForDezena(dz, limit) {
03689:     const candidates = ranked
03690:       .filter((x) => x.dezena === dz && !usedMilhares.has(x.milhar))
03691:       .map((x) => {
03692:         const milhar = String(x.milhar || "").padStart(4, "0").slice(-4);
03693:         const prefix = milhar.slice(0, 1);
03694:         const centena = milhar.slice(1);
03695:         const centenaScore = Number(centenaScoreMap.get(centena) || 0);
03696: 
03697:         return {
03698:           ...x,
03699:           milhar,
03700:           prefix,
03701:           centena,
03702:           centenaScore,
03703:           adjustedScore:
03704:             centenaScore * 2 +
03705:             Number(x.score || 0) -
03706:             (prefix === "0" ? 80 : 0),
03707:         };
03708:       });
03709: 
03710:     const byCentena = new Map();
03711: 
03712:     for (const item of candidates) {
03713:       if (!byCentena.has(item.centena)) byCentena.set(item.centena, []);
03714:       byCentena.get(item.centena).push(item);
03715:     }
03716: 
03717:     const centenaGroups = Array.from(byCentena.entries())
03718:       .map(([centena, items]) => {
03719:         const sortedItems = items.slice().sort((a, b) => {
03720:           if (Number(b.adjustedScore) !== Number(a.adjustedScore)) {
03721:             return Number(b.adjustedScore) - Number(a.adjustedScore);
03722:           }
03723:           if (Number(b.score) !== Number(a.score)) return Number(b.score) - Number(a.score);
03724:           if (Number(b.targetHits) !== Number(a.targetHits)) return Number(b.targetHits) - Number(a.targetHits);
03725:           if (Number(b.freq) !== Number(a.freq)) return Number(b.freq) - Number(a.freq);
03726:           return milharCompareAsc(a.milhar, b.milhar);
03727:         });
03728: 
03729:         const top = sortedItems[0] || {};
03730: 
03731:         return {
03732:           centena,
03733:           centenaScore: Number(top.centenaScore || 0),
03734:           bestScore: Number(top.adjustedScore || 0),
03735:           items: sortedItems,
03736:         };
03737:       })
03738:       .sort((a, b) => {
03739:         if (Number(b.centenaScore) !== Number(a.centenaScore)) {
03740:           return Number(b.centenaScore) - Number(a.centenaScore);
03741:         }
03742:         if (Number(b.bestScore) !== Number(a.bestScore)) {
03743:           return Number(b.bestScore) - Number(a.bestScore);
03744:         }
03745:         return String(a.centena).localeCompare(String(b.centena));
03746:       });
03747: 
03748:     const picked = [];
03749:     const usedPrefixes = new Set();
03750:     const usedCentenas = new Set();
03751: 
03752:     // Fase 1: uma melhor milhar por centena forte, evitando repetir prefixo.
03753:     for (const group of centenaGroups) {
03754:       if (picked.length >= limit) break;
03755: 
03756:       const item = group.items.find((x) => !usedPrefixes.has(x.prefix));
03757:       if (!item) continue;
03758: 
03759:       picked.push(item);
03760:       usedPrefixes.add(item.prefix);
03761:       usedCentenas.add(item.centena);
03762:     }
03763: 
03764:     // Fase 2: se faltar, pega novas centenas fortes mesmo repetindo prefixo.
03765:     for (const group of centenaGroups) {
03766:       if (picked.length >= limit) break;
03767:       if (usedCentenas.has(group.centena)) continue;
03768: 
03769:       const item = group.items.find((x) => !picked.some((p) => p.milhar === x.milhar));
03770:       if (!item) continue;
03771: 
03772:       picked.push(item);
03773:       usedPrefixes.add(item.prefix);
03774:       usedCentenas.add(item.centena);
03775:     }
03776: 
03777:     // Fase 3: se ainda faltar, permite mais de uma milhar da mesma centena.
03778:     for (const group of centenaGroups) {
03779:       if (picked.length >= limit) break;
03780: 
03781:       for (const item of group.items) {
03782:         if (picked.length >= limit) break;
03783:         if (picked.some((p) => p.milhar === item.milhar)) continue;
03784: 
03785:         picked.push(item);
03786:       }
03787:     }
03788: 
03789:     return picked.slice(0, limit);
03790:   }
03791: 
03792:   for (const dz of dezenasFixas) {
03793:     const items = pickDiversifiedMilharesForDezena(dz, perDezena);
03794: 
03795:     let pushed = 0;
03796: 
03797:     for (const item of items) {
03798:       usedMilhares.add(item.milhar);
03799:       slots.push({
03800:         dezena: dz,
03801:         milhar: item.milhar,
03802:         score: item.score,
03803:         adjustedScore: item.adjustedScore,
03804:         centena: item.centena,
03805:         centenaScore: item.centenaScore,
03806:         freq: item.freq,
03807:         targetHits: item.targetHits,
03808:         scheduleHits: item.scheduleHits,
03809:         sameDowHits: item.sameDowHits,
03810:         firstPrizeHits: item.firstPrizeHits,
03811:       });
03812:       pushed += 1;
03813:     }
03814: 
03815:     while (pushed < perDezena) {
03816:       slots.push({ dezena: dz, milhar: "" });
03817:       pushed += 1;
03818:     }
03819:   }
03820: 
03821:   while (slots.length < N) slots.push({ dezena: "", milhar: "" });
03822: 
03823:   return { dezenas: dezenasFixas, slots: slots.slice(0, N) };
03824: }

03840: export function auditTop3Timeline({
03841:   timeline,
03842:   lotteryKey = "",
03843: }) {
03844:   const rows = Array.isArray(timeline) ? timeline : [];
03845: 
03846:   const validated = rows.filter((slot) => {
03847:     const status = String(slot?.status || "").toLowerCase();
03848:     return status === "validated" && Number.isFinite(Number(slot?.resultGrupo));
03849:   });
03850: 
03851:   const total = validated.length;
03852: 
03853:   const top1Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03854:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03855:     const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03856:     return Number.isFinite(first) && first === result;
03857:   }).length;
03858: 
03859:   const top3Hits = validated.filter((slot) => {
03860:     const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03861:     return (Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03862:       .slice(0, 3)
03863:       .some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result);
03864:   }).length;
03865: 
03866:   function pct(n, d) {
03867:     if (!d) return 0;
03868:     return Number(((Number(n || 0) / Number(d || 1)) * 100).toFixed(2));
03869:   }
03870: 
03871:   function groupBy(keyFn) {
03872:     const map = new Map();
03873: 
03874:     for (const slot of validated) {
03875:       const key = keyFn(slot);
03876:       const current = map.get(key) || {
03877:         key,
03878:         total: 0,
03879:         top1Hits: 0,
03880:         top3Hits: 0,
03881:       };
03882: 
03883:       const result = Number(slot.resultGrupo);
03884:       const first = Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo);
03885:       const picks = Array.isArray(slot?.top3) ? slot.top3.slice(0, 3) : [];
03886: 
03887:       current.total += 1;
03888:       if (Number.isFinite(first) && first === result) current.top1Hits += 1;
03889:       if (picks.some((item) => Number(item?.grupo) === result)) current.top3Hits += 1;
03890: 
03891:       map.set(key, current);
03892:     }
03893: 
03894:     return Array.from(map.values())
03895:       .map((x) => ({
03896:         ...x,
03897:         top1Rate: pct(x.top1Hits, x.total),
03898:         top3Rate: pct(x.top3Hits, x.total),
03899:       }))
03900:       .sort((a, b) => {
03901:         if (b.top3Rate !== a.top3Rate) return b.top3Rate - a.top3Rate;
03902:         return b.total - a.total;
03903:       });
03904:   }
03905: 
03906:   return {
03907:     lotteryKey,
03908:     total,
03909:     top1Hits,
03910:     top3Hits,
03911:     top1Rate: pct(top1Hits, total),
03912:     top3Rate: pct(top3Hits, total),
03913:     byHour: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetHour || "")),
03914:     byDate: groupBy((slot) => String(slot?.targetYmd || "")),
03915:     rows: validated.map((slot) => ({
03916:       ymd: slot.targetYmd,
03917:       hour: slot.targetHour,
03918:       baseYmd: slot.baseYmd,
03919:       baseHour: slot.baseHour,
03920:       resultGrupo: slot.resultGrupo,
03921:       top3: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03922:         .slice(0, 3)
03923:         .map((x) => Number(x?.grupo)),
03924:       top1Hit:
03925:         Number(slot?.top3?.[0]?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo),
03926:       top3Hit: (Array.isArray(slot.top3) ? slot.top3 : [])
03927:         .slice(0, 3)
03928:         .some((x) => Number(x?.grupo) === Number(slot.resultGrupo)),
03929:       historyStats: slot.historyStats || null,
03930:     })),
03931:   };
03932: }

04020:         const ts = ymdHourToTs(y, h);

04097:       let d90 = 0;

00212: export function toHourBucket(hhmm) {
00213:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
00214:   if (!s) return "";
00215: 
00216:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00217:   if (!m) return "";
00218: 
00219:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00220:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00221: 
00222:   if (!isValidHourMinute(hh, mm)) return "";
00223: 
00224:   return `${pad2(hh)}h`;
00225: }
00226: 
00227: /**
00228:  * Converte hora em minutos.
00229:  */
00230: export function hourToInt(hhmm) {
00231:   const raw = safeStr(hhmm);
00232:   if (!raw) return -1;
00233: 
00234:   const s = normalizeHourLike(raw);
00235:   const m = safeStr(s).match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00236: 
00237:   if (m) {
00238:     const hh = Number(m[1]);
00239:     const mm = Number(m[2]);
00240: 
00241:     if (!isValidHourMinute(hh, mm)) return -1;
00242: 
00243:     return hh * 60 + mm;
00244:   }
00245: 
00246:   const b = safeStr(raw).match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00247:   if (b) {
00248:     const hh = Number(b[1]);
00249:     return isValidHourMinute(hh, 0) ? hh * 60 : -1;
00250:   }
00251: 
00252:   return -1;
00253: }
00254: 
00255: export function getDowKey(ymd) {
00256:   const y = safeStr(ymd);
00257:   if (!isYMD(y)) return NaN;
00258: 
00259:   const [Y, M, D] = y.split("-").map((x) => Number(x));
00260:   const dt = new Date(Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D));
00261: 
00262:   return dt.getUTCDay(); // 0=dom ... 3=qua ... 6=sáb
00263: }

00269: export function pickPrizeMilhar4(p) {
00270:   const raw =
00271:     p?.milhar ??
00272:     p?.milhar4 ??
00273:     p?.numero ??
00274:     p?.number ??
00275:     p?.mil ??
00276:     p?.num ??
00277:     p?.valor ??
00278:     "";
00279: 
00280:   const digits = safeStr(raw).replace(/\D+/g, "");
00281:   if (!digits) return null;
00282: 
00283:   const last4 = digits.slice(-4).padStart(4, "0");
00284:   return /^\d{4}$/.test(last4) ? last4 : null;
00285: }

00287: export function getDezena2(milhar4) {
00288:   const s = safeStr(milhar4);
00289:   if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(s)) return null;
00290:   return s.slice(2, 4);
00291: }

00293: export function getCentena3(milhar4) {
00294:   const s = safeStr(milhar4);
00295:   if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(s)) return null;
00296:   return s.slice(1, 4);

00299: export function milharCompareAsc(a, b) {
00300:   return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), "en", { numeric: true });
00301: }
00302: 
00303: export function dezenaCompareAsc(a, b) {
00304:   return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), "en", { numeric: true });
00305: }
00306: 
00307: export function milharCompareByCentenaAsc(a, b) {
00308:   const ca = getCentena3(a);
00309:   const cb = getCentena3(b);
00310: 
00311:   if (ca && cb && ca !== cb) {
00312:     return String(ca).localeCompare(String(cb), "en", { numeric: true });
00313:   }
00314: 
00315:   return milharCompareAsc(a, b);
00316: }
00317: 
00318: /**
00319:  * Wrap cíclico de 2 dígitos para montagem de grupos.
00320:  */
00321: export function wrapToDezena2(n) {
00322:   const x = Number(n);
00323:   if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return null;
00324: 
00325:   const d = ((x % 100) + 100) % 100;
00326:   return pad2(d);
00327: }
00328: 
00329: /**
00330:  * Dezenas de um grupo (1..25) no padrão do bicho.
00331:  */
00332: export function dezenasFromGrupo(grupo) {
00333:   const g = Number(grupo);
00334:   if (!Number.isFinite(g) || g < 1 || g > 25) return [];
00335: 
00336:   const start = (g - 1) * 4 + 1;
00337: 
00338:   return [0, 1, 2, 3]
00339:     .map((i) => wrapToDezena2(start + i))
00340:     .filter(Boolean);
00341: }

00079: function drawTs(draw) {
00080:   const y = pickDrawYMD(draw);
00081:   const h = toHourBucket(pickDrawHour(draw));
00082: 
00083:   if (!isYMD(y) || !h) return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
00084: 
00085:   const [Y, M, D] = String(y).split("-").map(Number);
00086:   const mins = hourToInt(h);
00087: 
00088:   if (!Number.isFinite(mins) || mins < 0) {
00089:     return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
00090:   }
00091: 
00092:   return Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D) + mins * 60 * 1000;
00093: }

00111: function mergeBaseIntoRange(rangeDraws, baseDraw) {
00112:   const list = Array.isArray(rangeDraws) ? rangeDraws : [];

00115:   if (!key) return list;
