00003: export function normalizeImgSrc(src) {
00004:   const s = String(src || "").trim();
00005:   if (!s) return "";
00006: 
00007:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
00008: 
00009:   const base = String(process.env.PUBLIC_URL || "").trim();
00010:   const root = base && base !== "/" ? base : "";
00011: 
00012:   if (s.startsWith("/")) return `${root}${s}`;
00013:   if (s.startsWith("public/")) return `${root}/${s.slice(7)}`;
00014:   if (s.startsWith("img/")) return `${root}/${s}`;
00015: 
00016:   return `${root}/${s}`;
00017: }

00049:       out.push(clean.replace(/\.jpg$/i, ".png"));

00248:   const milhar = normalizeMilharStr(resultMilhar);
00249:   const centena = milhar ? milhar.slice(-3) : "";
00250: 
00251:   const hasGrupo = Number.isFinite(grupoNum) && grupoNum >= 1 && grupoNum <= 25;
00252:   const hasMilhar = /^\d{4}$/.test(milhar);
00253: 
00254:   if (!hasGrupo && !hasMilhar) {
00255:     return { type: "none", score: 0, position: -1, matchedValue: "" };
00256:   }
00257: 
00258:   let best = { type: "miss", score: 0, position: -1, matchedValue: "" };
00259: 
00260:   top3.forEach((item, idx) => {
00261:     const g = Number(item?.grupo);
00262: 
00263:     const milharesRaw = Array.isArray(item?.milhares20)
00264:       ? item.milhares20
00265:       : Array.isArray(item?.milhares)
00266:         ? item.milhares
00267:         : [];
00268: 
00269:     const milhares = milharesRaw
00270:       .map((m) => normalizeMilharStr(m))
00271:       .filter((m) => /^\d{4}$/.test(m));
00272: 
00273:     const centenas = milhares
00274:       .map((m) => centenaFromMilhar(m))
00275:       .filter((c) => /^\d{3}$/.test(c));
00276: 
00277:     let score = 0;
00278:     let type = "miss";
00279:     let matchedValue = "";
00280: 
00281:     if (hasMilhar && milhares.includes(milhar)) {
00282:       score = 100;
00283:       type = "hit_exact";
00284:       matchedValue = milhar;
00285:     } else if (centena && centenas.includes(centena)) {
00286:       score = 66.67;
00287:       type = "hit_centena";
00288:       matchedValue = centena;
00289:     } else if (hasGrupo && g === grupoNum) {
00290:       score = 33.33;
00291:       type = "hit_grupo";
00292:       matchedValue = hasMilhar ? milhar.slice(-2) : formatGrupo(grupoNum);
00293:     }
00294: 
00295:     if (score > best.score) {
00296:       best = {
00297:         type,
00298:         score,
00299:         position: idx + 1,
00300:         matchedValue,
00301:       };
00302:     }
00303:   });
00304: 
00305:   return best;
00306: }

00308: function ImgWithFallback({ srcs, alt, size = 84, style }) {
00309:   const list = useMemo(
00310:     () => (Array.isArray(srcs) ? srcs.filter(Boolean) : []),
00311:     [srcs]
00312:   );
00313: 
00314:   const [i, setI] = useState(0);
00315:   const listKey = useMemo(() => list.join("|"), [list]);
00316: 
00317:   useEffect(() => {
00318:     setI(0);
00319:   }, [listKey]);
00320: 
00321:   const src = list[i] || "";
00322: 
00323:   const onError = () => {
00324:     setI((prev) => (prev < list.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev));
00325:   };
00326: 
00327:   return (
00328:     <div
00329:       style={{
00330:         width: size,
00331:         height: size,
00332:         borderRadius: 16,
00333:         border: "1px solid rgba(201,168,62,0.36)",
00334:         background:
00335:           "linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.04), rgba(0,0,0,0.28))",
00336:         display: "grid",
00337:         placeItems: "center",
00338:         overflow: "hidden",
00339:         boxShadow: "inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)",
00340:         ...style,
00341:       }}
00342:     >
00343:       {src ? (
00344:         <img
00345:           src={src}
00346:           alt={alt || ""}
00347:           width={size}
00348:           height={size}
00349:           onError={onError}
00350:           style={{
00351:             width: "100%",
00352:             height: "100%",
00353:             objectFit: "cover",
00354:             display: "block",
00355:             imageRendering: "auto",
00356:           }}
00357:         />
00358:       ) : (
00359:         <div style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)", fontSize: 12 }}>
00360:           sem imagem
00361:         </div>
00362:       )}
00363:     </div>
00364:   );
00365: }

01069: function TimelineSlot({

00128: function build20ByDezena({ grupo, baseMilhares, perCol = 5 }) {

00242: function analyzeTop3Hit(top3, resultGrupo, resultMilhar) {

00076:  * Normaliza hora para comparação segura:
00077:  * - "10h" -> "10:00"
00078:  * - "10"  -> "10:00"
00079:  * - "10:9" -> "10:09"
00080:  * - "10:09" mantém
00081:  */
00082: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00083:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00084:   if (!s) return null;
00085: 
00086:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00087:   if (m1) return `${String(m1[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00088: 
00089:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00090:   if (m2) return `${String(m2[1]).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;
00091: 
00092:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})$/);
00093:   if (m3) {
00094:     const hh = String(m3[1]).padStart(2, "0");
00095:     const mm = String(m3[2]).padStart(2, "0");
00096:     return `${hh}:${mm}`;
00097:   }
00098: 
00099:   return s;
00100: }
00101: 
00102: /**
00103:  * Valida se está em formato HH:MM (00..23:00..59)
00104:  */
00105: function isValidHHMM(value) {
00106:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00107:   if (!s) return false;
00108:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00109:   if (!m) return false;
00110:   const hh = Number(m[1]);
00111:   const mm = Number(m[2]);
00112:   return (
00113:     Number.isFinite(hh) &&
00114:     Number.isFinite(mm) &&
00115:     hh >= 0 &&
00116:     hh <= 23 &&
00117:     mm >= 0 &&
00118:     mm <= 59
00119:   );
00120: }
00121: 
00122: /**
00123:  * Normaliza "qualquer data" para YYYY-MM-DD (ou null).
00124:  * Aceita:
00125:  * - "YYYY-MM-DD"
00126:  * - "DD/MM/YYYY"
00127:  * - ISO "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss..."
00128:  * - Timestamp-like { seconds }
00129:  * - Date
00130:  * - Firestore Timestamp (toDate)
00131:  */
00132: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00133:   if (!input) return null;
00134: 
00135:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
00136:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00137:     const d = input.toDate();
00138:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00139:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
00140:     }
00141:   }
00142: 
00143:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
00144:   if (
00145:     typeof input === "object" &&
00146:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00147:   ) {
00148:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00149:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00150:       : Number(input._seconds);
00151: 
00152:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00153:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00154:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
00155:     }
00156:   }
00157: 
00158:   // Date
00159:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00160:     return `${input.getFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00161:       input.getDate()
00162:     )}`;
00163:   }
00164: 
00165:   const s = String(input).trim();
00166:   if (!s) return null;
00167: 
00168:   // YYYY-MM-DD...
00169:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00170:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00171: 
00172:   // DD/MM/YYYY
00173:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00174:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00175: 
00176:   return null;
00177: }
00178: 
00179: /* =========================
00180:    ✅ DEDUPE (blindagem anti-duplicidade)
00181:    - usa id/drawId quando existir
00182:    - fallback: uf/lottery + ymd + close_hour_norm
00183:    - se nada existir, NÃO elimina (evita colisão massiva)
00184: ========================= */
00185: 
00186: function dedupeDraws(drawsRaw) {
00187:   const arr = Array.isArray(drawsRaw) ? drawsRaw : [];
00188:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00189: 
00190:   const seen = new Set();
00191:   const out = [];
00192: 
00193:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00194:     const d = arr[i];
00195: 
00196:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d)) || "";
00197:     const hh = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d)) || "";
00198: 
00199:     const { uf, lottery } = extractDrawScope(d);
00200: 
00201:     const idLike =
00202:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00203:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00204:       "";
00205: 
00206:     let key = idLike;
00207: 
00208:     if (!key) {
00209:       // chave composta (mais segura do que só ymd+hora)
00210:       const scope = `${uf || ""}__${lottery || ""}`.trim();
00211:       const core = `${ymd}__${hh}`.trim();
00212:       key = `${scope}__${core}`.replace(/^__+|__+$/g, "");
00213:     }
00214: 
00215:     // Se ainda assim está “vazia” (sem info), não deduplica para evitar apagar tudo
00216:     if (!key || key === "__" || key === "____") {
00217:       out.push(d);
00218:       continue;
00219:     }
00220: 
00221:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00222:     seen.add(key);
00223:     out.push(d);
00224:   }
00225: 
00226:   return out;
00227: }
00228: 
00229: /**
00230:  * draws: [
00231:  *  { date|ymd|..., close_hour|..., prizes: [{ grupo, animal, position? }] }
00232:  * ]
00233:  *
00234:  * options:
00235:  *  - position: 1|2|3|4|5 (opcional)
00236:  *  - hour: "11:00" | "11h" | "11" (opcional)
00237:  *  - matchHourOnly: boolean (opcional)
00238:  */
00239: export function auditCountsByGrupo(drawsRaw, options = {}) {
00240:   // ✅ blindagem: evita inflação por draw duplicado
00241:   const draws = dedupeDraws(drawsRaw);
00242: 
00243:   const posOpt = options?.position;
00244:   const positionFilter =
00245:     posOpt === null || posOpt === undefined || posOpt === ""
00246:       ? null
00247:       : Number(posOpt);
00248: 
00249:   const matchHourOnly = Boolean(options?.matchHourOnly); // default: false
00250: 
00251:   // normaliza filtro de hora; se inválido, ignora para não "zerar" por engano
00252:   const rawHourFilter = normalizeHourLike(options?.hour);
00253:   let hourFilter = rawHourFilter;
00254: 
00255:   if (hourFilter != null) {
00256:     if (matchHourOnly) {
00257:       const hh = String(hourFilter).slice(0, 2);
00258:       if (!/^\d{2}$/.test(hh)) hourFilter = null;
00259:     } else {
00260:       if (!isValidHHMM(hourFilter)) hourFilter = null;
00261:     }
00262:   }
00263: 
00264:   const counts = new Map(); // "01" -> count
00265:   const integrityIssues = [];
00266:   let totalOcorrencias = 0;
00267: 
00268:   for (const d of draws || []) {
00269:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00270: 
00271:     // normaliza close_hour do draw (se existir)
00272:     const drawHour = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d));
00273: 
00274:     for (const p of prizes) {
00275:       const gNum = Number(p?.grupo ?? p?.group);
00276:       if (!Number.isFinite(gNum) || gNum < 1 || gNum > 25) continue;
00277: 
00278:       // filtro por posição (se aplicado)
00279:       if (positionFilter != null) {
00280:         const pos = Number(p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? 0);
00281:         if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos !== positionFilter) continue;
00282:       }
00283: 
00284:       // filtro por horário (se aplicado e válido)
00285:       if (hourFilter != null) {
00286:         if (!drawHour) continue;
00287: 
00288:         if (matchHourOnly) {
00289:           const hhDraw = String(drawHour).slice(0, 2);
00290:           const hhFilter = String(hourFilter).slice(0, 2);
00291:           if (hhDraw !== hhFilter) continue;
00292:         } else {
00293:           if (drawHour !== hourFilter) continue;
00294:         }
00295:       }
00296: 
00297:       const g = pad2(gNum);
00298: 
00299:       // integridade: grupo deve bater com animal oficial (quando animal existir no dado)
00300:       const bicho = safeGetBichoByGrupo(gNum);
00301:       const animalBase = bicho ? safeNormalizeAnimal(bicho.animal) : "";
00302: 
00303:       const rawAnimal = String(p?.animal ?? "");
00304:       // se vier mojibake/corrompido (ex.: "Le├úo", "Jacar├®"), ignora a checagem
00305:       const animalFromData = /[├ÃÂ�]/.test(rawAnimal)
00306:         ? ""
00307:         : safeNormalizeAnimal(rawAnimal);
00308: 
00309:       if (animalFromData && animalBase && animalFromData !== animalBase) {
00310:         integrityIssues.push({
00311:           date: extractRawDateFromDraw(d) || null,
00312:           date_ymd: normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d)),
00313:           close_hour: extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d) || null,
00314:           close_hour_norm: drawHour,
00315:           grupo: g,
00316:           animal_no_dado: p?.animal || "",
00317:           animal_oficial: bicho?.animal || "",
00318:           position: p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? null,
00319:         });
00320:       }
00321: 
00322:       counts.set(g, (counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00323:       totalOcorrencias += 1;
00324:     }
00325:   }
00326: 
00327:   // 01..25 sem sort (auditoria “linha a linha”)
00328:   const rowsByGrupo = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => {
00329:     const grupo = pad2(i + 1);
00330:     const val = counts.get(grupo) || 0;
00331:     const bicho = safeGetBichoByGrupo(i + 1);
00332: 
00333:     return {
00334:       grupo,
00335:       animal: bicho?.animal || "",
00336:       apar: val,
00337:       share: totalOcorrencias
00338:         ? `${Number((val / totalOcorrencias) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`
00339:         : "0.00%",
00340:     };
00341:   });
00342: 
00343:   // ranking desc (para UI)
00344:   const rowsSorted = [...rowsByGrupo].sort((a, b) => b.apar - a.apar);
00345: 
00346:   return {
00347:     rows: rowsSorted, // compat (UI)
00348:     rowsByGrupo, // auditoria 01..25
00349:     totalOcorrencias,
00350:     integrityIssues,
00351:     appliedFilters: {
00352:       position:
00353:         positionFilter != null && Number.isFinite(positionFilter)
00354:           ? positionFilter
00355:           : null,
00356:       hour: hourFilter,
00357:       matchHourOnly,
00358:     },
00359:   };
00360: }
00361: 
00362: /**
00363:  * Calcula totais básicos:
00364:  * - draws: quantidade de draws (sorteios)
00365:  * - uniqueDays: quantidade de dias únicos (com base em draw.date|ymd|...)
00366:  *
00367:  * ✅ Correção:
00368:  * - dedupe de draws para não inflar
00369:  */
00370: export function computeDrawTotals(drawsRaw) {
00371:   const list = dedupeDraws(drawsRaw);
00372: 
00373:   const unique = new Set();
00374:   for (const d of list) {
00375:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d));
00376:     if (ymd) unique.add(ymd);
00377:   }
00378: 
00379:   return {
00380:     draws: list.length,
00381:     uniqueDays: unique.size,
00382:   };
00383: }
00384: 
00385: /**
00386:  * AUDIT MASTER (resumo de integridade)
00387:  */
00388: export function auditDatasetSummary(drawsRaw, options = {}) {
00389:   const draws = dedupeDraws(drawsRaw);
00390:   const sampleLimit = Number(options?.sampleLimit ?? 20);
00391: 
00392:   let drawsWithPrizes = 0;
00393:   let drawsWithoutPrizes = 0;
00394: 
00395:   let prizesTotal = 0;
00396: 
00397:   let invalidDateCount = 0;
00398:   let invalidCloseHourCount = 0;
00399: 
00400:   let invalidGrupoCount = 0;
00401:   let missingGrupoCount = 0;
00402: 
00403:   let missingPositionCount = 0;
00404:   let invalidPositionCount = 0;
00405: 
00406:   for (const d of draws) {
00407:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00408: 
00409:     if (prizes.length) drawsWithPrizes += 1;
00410:     else drawsWithoutPrizes += 1;
00411: 
00412:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(extractRawDateFromDraw(d));
00413:     if (!ymd) invalidDateCount += 1;
00414: 
00415:     const hhmm = normalizeHourLike(extractRawCloseHourFromDraw(d));
00416:     if (!hhmm || !isValidHHMM(hhmm)) invalidCloseHourCount += 1;
00417: 
00418:     prizesTotal += prizes.length;
00419: 
00420:     for (const p of prizes) {
00421:       const gNum = Number(p?.grupo ?? p?.group);
00422:       if (!Number.isFinite(gNum)) {
00423:         missingGrupoCount += 1;
00424:       } else if (gNum < 1 || gNum > 25) {
00425:         invalidGrupoCount += 1;
00426:       }
00427: 
00428:       const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position;
00429:       if (posRaw === null || posRaw === undefined || posRaw === "") {
00430:         missingPositionCount += 1;
00431:       } else {
00432:         const pos = Number(posRaw);
00433:         if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || pos < 1 || pos > 10) {
00434:           invalidPositionCount += 1;
00435:         }
00436:       }
00437:     }
00438:   }
00439: 
00440:   const byGrupo = auditCountsByGrupo(draws, {
00441:     position: options?.position ?? null,
00442:     hour: options?.hour ?? null,
00443:     matchHourOnly: options?.matchHourOnly ?? false,
00444:   });
00445: 
00446:   const animalMismatchCount = byGrupo.integrityIssues.length;
00447:   const integrityIssuesSample = byGrupo.integrityIssues.slice(
00448:     0,
00449:     Math.max(0, Number.isFinite(sampleLimit) ? sampleLimit : 20)
00450:   );
00451: 
00452:   const totals = computeDrawTotals(draws);
00453: 
00454:   return {
00455:     totals: {
00456:       draws: draws.length,
00457:       uniqueDays: totals.uniqueDays,
00458:       drawsWithPrizes,
00459:       drawsWithoutPrizes,
00460:       prizesTotal,
00461:     },
00462:     issues: {
00463:       invalidDateCount,
00464:       invalidCloseHourCount,
00465:       missingGrupoCount,
00466:       invalidGrupoCount,
00467:       missingPositionCount,
00468:       invalidPositionCount,
00469:       animalMismatchCount,
00470:     },
00471:     byGrupo: {
00472:       rowsByGrupo: byGrupo.rowsByGrupo,
00473:       rowsSorted: byGrupo.rows,
00474:       totalOcorrencias: byGrupo.totalOcorrencias,
00475:       appliedFilters: byGrupo.appliedFilters,
00476:     },
00477:     integrityIssuesSample,
00478:     auditOptions: {
00479:       position: options?.position ?? null,
00480:       hour: options?.hour ?? null,
00481:       matchHourOnly: Boolean(options?.matchHourOnly),
00482:       sampleLimit: Number.isFinite(sampleLimit) ? sampleLimit : 20,
00483:     },
00484:   };
00485: }

00028:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
00029: 
00030:   if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
00031:     const n = Math.trunc(value);
00032:     return n >= min && n <= max ? n : null;

00036:   if (!s) return null;
00037: 
00038:   if (/^\d+$/.test(s)) {
00039:     const n = Number(s);

00044:   if (!m) return null;

00150: export function sortPrizesByPosition(prizes) {
00151:   return [...(prizes || [])].sort((a, b) => {
00152:     const pa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.position)) ? Number(a.position) : 999;
00153:     const pb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.position)) ? Number(b.position) : 999;
00154:     return pa - pb;
00155:   });
00156: }

00160:   const set = new Set(positionsArr.map(Number));

00197: /**
00198:  * ✅ Normaliza "horário" para HH:MM
00199:  */
00200: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00201:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
00202:   if (!s0) return "";
00203: 
00204:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
00205: 
00206:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
00207:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
00208: 
00209:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00210:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
00211: 
00212:   const mHm = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
00213:   if (mHm) {
00214:     const hh = String(mHm[1]).slice(0, -2);
00215:     const mm = String(mHm[1]).slice(-2);
00216:     if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(hh) && /^\d{2}$/.test(mm)) {
00217:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${mm}`;
00218:     }
00219:   }
00220: 
00221:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00222:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
00223: 
00224:   return s0.trim();
00225: }

00227: function mhxToInt(v) {
00228:   const n = Number(v);
00229:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
00230: }

00232: /**
00233:  * ✅ Bucket "09h", "11h"…
00234:  */
00235: function toHourBucket(value) {
00236:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00237:   if (!s || s.toLowerCase() === "todos") return null;
00238: 
00239:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00240:   if (mh) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(mh[1]))}h`;
00241: 
00242:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
00243:   if (m1) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m1[1]))}h`;
00244: 
00245:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00246:   if (m2) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m2[1]))}h`;
00247: 
00248:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00249:   if (m3) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m3[1]))}h`;
00250: 
00251:   const m4 = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
00252:   if (m4) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(String(m4[1]).slice(0, -2)))}h`;
00253: 
00254:   return null;
00255: }

00264: function resolveHourFilter({ closeHour = null, closeHourBucket = null }) {

00375: /**
00376:  * ✅ DEDUPE
00377:  * - chave lógica: ymd + hour (+ lottery_code quando existir)
00378:  * - se não houver ymd/hour, cai no id/idx
00379:  *
00380:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00381:  * Não colapsar dois draws distintos do mesmo dia/horário com lottery_code diferente.
00382:  */
00383: function dedupeDrawsLocal(draws) {
00384:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00385: 
00386:   const byKey = new Map();
00387:   const order = [];
00388: 
00389:   function score(d) {
00390:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00391:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
00392:       ? Number(d.prizesCount)
00393:       : 0;
00394:     const hasLogical = !!(d?.ymd && d?.close_hour);
00395:     return prizesLen * 1_000_000 + pc * 1_000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00396:   }
00397: 
00398:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00399:     const raw = arr[i] || {};
00400: 
00401:     const ymd = raw.ymd || normalizeToYMD(raw.date) || "";
00402:     const hour = normalizeHourLike(raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "");
00403: 
00404:     const lotCode = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(raw);
00405: 
00406:     const drawId = raw.drawId ?? raw.id ?? raw.__name__ ?? null;
00407:     const idStr = drawId != null ? String(drawId) : "";
00408: 
00409:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hour);
00410: 
00411:     const key = hasLogical
00412:       ? lotCode
00413:         ? `${ymd}__${hour}__${lotCode}`
00414:         : `${ymd}__${hour}`
00415:       : `id__${idStr || `idx_${i}`}`;
00416: 
00417:     const normalized = {
00418:       ...raw,
00419:       ymd: ymd || raw.ymd || null,
00420:       close_hour: hour || raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "",
00421:       closeHour: hour || raw.closeHour || raw.close_hour || "",
00422:       lottery_code: lotCode || raw.lottery_code || raw.lotteryCode || null,
00423:       drawId: raw.drawId || raw.id || raw.__name__ || null,
00424:       id: raw.id || raw.drawId || raw.__name__ || null,
00425:     };
00426: 
00427:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00428:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00429:       order.push(key);
00430:       continue;
00431:     }
00432: 
00433:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00434:     if (score(normalized) > score(prev)) {
00435:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00436:     }
00437:   }
00438: 
00439:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00440: }

00442: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00443:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00444:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00445:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00446:   let idx = 0;
00447: 
00448:   async function worker() {
00449:     while (true) {
00450:       const current = idx;
00451:       idx += 1;
00452:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00453:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00454:     }
00455:   }
00456: 
00457:   await Promise.all(
00458:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00459:   );
00460:   return results;
00461: }

00494:  * faz fallback e busca a subcollection draws/{id}/prizes.

00496: async function fetchPrizesForDraw(drawId, positionsArr, embeddedPrizes) {
00497:   const drawKey = String(drawId || "").trim();
00498:   if (!drawKey) return [];
00499: 
00500:   if (Array.isArray(embeddedPrizes) && embeddedPrizes.length) {
00501:     const normalized = embeddedPrizes.map((p, idx) =>
00502:       normalizePrize(p, p?.prizeId ?? `emb_${idx}`)
00503:     );
00504: 
00505:     const cleaned = normalized.filter(
00506:       (x) => isValidGrupo(x?.grupo) && isValidPosition(x?.position)
00507:     );
00508: 
00509:     if (cleaned.length) {
00510:       const allSorted = sortPrizesByPosition(cleaned);
00511:       return filterPrizesByPositions(allSorted, positionsArr);
00512:     }
00513:   }
00514: 
00515:   const allKey = prizesCacheKeyAll(drawKey);
00516:   const cachedAll = cacheGet(PRIZES_CACHE, allKey);
00517:   if (Array.isArray(cachedAll) && cachedAll.length > 0) {
00518:     return filterPrizesByPositions(cachedAll, positionsArr);
00519:   }
00520: 
00521:   const prizesCol = collection(db, "draws", drawKey, "prizes");
00522: 
00523:   const { snap, error } = await safeGetDocsSmart(prizesCol, { policy: "server" });
00524:   if (error) throw error;
00525: 
00526:   const allRaw = snap.docs.map((d) => normalizePrize(d.data(), d.id));
00527: 
00528:   // console.log("DEBUG allRaw:", allRaw);
00529: 
00530: const all = allRaw.filter(
00531:   (x) => isValidGrupo(x?.grupo) && isValidPosition(x?.position)
00532: );
00533: 
00534: // console.log("DEBUG allFiltered:", all);
00535: 
00536:   const allSorted = sortPrizesByPosition(all);
00537:   cacheSet(PRIZES_CACHE, allKey, allSorted);
00538: 
00539:   return filterPrizesByPositions(allSorted, positionsArr);
00540: }

00713: function pickMinMaxFromMapped(mapped) {
00714:   let minYmd = null;
00715:   let maxYmd = null;
00716: 
00717:   for (const d of mapped) {
00718:     const y = d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date);
00719:     if (!y || !isYMD(y)) continue;
00720:     if (!minYmd || y < minYmd) minYmd = y;
00721:     if (!maxYmd || y > maxYmd) maxYmd = y;
00722:   }
00723: 
00724:   return { minYmd, maxYmd };
00725: }

00727: /**
00728:  * ✅ “Prova de vida” do maxYmd sem depender de índice composto nem de docId:
00729:  * tenta dias recentes (==) desc até achar pelo menos 1 draw.
00730:  */
00731: async function probeRecentMaxYmd(uf, lookbackDays = 45) {
00732:   const base = utcTodayYmd();
00733:   const n = Math.max(3, Math.min(120, Number(lookbackDays) || 45));
00734: 
00735:   for (let i = 0; i <= n; i += 1) {
00736:     const day = addDaysUTCLocal(base, -i);
00737:     const { docs, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00738:       uf,
00739:       extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", day)],
00740:       policy: "server",
00741:       extraLimit: limit(5),
00742:     });
00743:     if (error) return { ok: false, maxYmd: null, error };
00744:     if (docs && docs.length) return { ok: true, maxYmd: day, error: null };
00745:   }
00746: 
00747:   return { ok: false, maxYmd: null, error: null };
00748: }

00750: /**
00751:  * ✅ API bounds (backend) — fonte única preferencial
00752:  */
00753: async function fetchBoundsFromApi(ufOrObj) {
00754:   const uf = String(extractUfParam(ufOrObj) || "").trim();
00755:   if (!uf) return { ok: false, error: new Error("uf vazio") };
00756: 
00757:   const lot = canonicalScopeKey(uf) || String(uf).trim().toUpperCase();
00758:   const url = apiUrl(`/api/bounds?lottery=${encodeURIComponent(lot)}`);
00759:   try {
00760:     const r = await fetch(url, { method: "GET" });
00761:     const j = await r.json().catch(() => null);
00762: 
00763:     if (!r.ok || !j || !j.ok) {
00764:       return {
00765:         ok: false,
00766:         error: new Error(`bounds api not ok: ${j?.message || r.status}`),
00767:         payload: j || null,
00768:       };
00769:     }
00770: 
00771:     const minYmd = String(j.minYmd || "").trim();
00772:     const maxYmd = String(j.maxYmd || "").trim();
00773:     if (!isYMD(minYmd) || !isYMD(maxYmd)) {
00774:       return {
00775:         ok: false,
00776:         error: new Error("bounds api retornou min/max inválidos"),
00777:         payload: j,
00778:       };
00779:     }
00780: 
00781:     return {
00782:       ok: true,
00783:       uf,
00784:       lottery: String(j.lottery || lot).trim(),
00785:       minYmd,
00786:       maxYmd,
00787:       minDocId: j.minDocId || null,
00788:       maxDocId: j.maxDocId || null,
00789:       source: String(j.source || "api_bounds"),
00790:     };
00791:   } catch (e) {
00792:     return { ok: false, error: e };
00793:   }

00796: export async function getKingBoundsByUf(ufOrObj) {
00797:   const uf = String(extractUfParam(ufOrObj) || "").trim();
00798:   if (!uf) throw new Error("Parâmetro obrigatório: uf");
00799: 
00800:   const apiTry = await fetchBoundsFromApi(ufOrObj);
00801:   if (apiTry?.ok) {
00802:     const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
00803:     const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKey, {
00804:       minYmd: apiTry.minYmd,
00805:       maxYmd: apiTry.maxYmd,
00806:     });
00807: 
00808:     return {
00809:       ok: true,
00810:       uf,
00811: 
00812:       minYmd: floored.minYmd,
00813:       maxYmd: floored.maxYmd,
00814: 
00815:       minDate: floored.minYmd,
00816:       maxDate: floored.maxYmd,
00817: 
00818:       minDocId: apiTry.minDocId || null,
00819:       maxDocId: apiTry.maxDocId || null,
00820: 
00821:       source: `api_bounds:${apiTry.source}`,
00822:     };
00823:   }
00824: 
00825:   const SCAN_LIMIT = 50;
00826:   const FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT = 600;
00827: 
00828:   let firstTryError = null;
00829: 
00830:   const DOC_ID = documentId();
00831: 
00832:   async function sampleEdgesByDocId(fieldName, ufValue) {
00833:     const asc = await queryDrawsByField({
00834:       fieldName,
00835:       uf: ufValue,
00836:       extraOrderBy: [orderBy(DOC_ID)],
00837:       extraLimit: limit(FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT),
00838:       policy: "server",
00839:     });
00840: 
00841:     const last = await queryDrawsByField({
00842:       fieldName,
00843:       uf: ufValue,
00844:       extraOrderBy: [orderBy(DOC_ID)],
00845:       extraLimit: limitToLast(FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT),
00846:       policy: "server",
00847:     });
00848: 
00849:     const mappedA = (asc?.snap?.docs || []).map(mapDrawDoc);
00850:     const mappedB = (last?.snap?.docs || []).map(mapDrawDoc);
00851: 
00852:     const merged = dedupeDrawsLocal([...mappedA, ...mappedB]);
00853: 
00854:     return {
00855:       merged,
00856:       ok: merged.length > 0,
00857:       errors: [asc?.error, last?.error].filter(Boolean),
00858:       sources: [asc?.source, last?.source].filter(Boolean),
00859:     };
00860:   }
00861: 
00862:   {
00863:     const orderAsc = [orderBy("ymd", "asc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
00864:     const orderDesc = [orderBy("ymd", "desc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
00865: 
00866:     const {
00867:       docs: minDocs,
00868:       usedField: usedMin,
00869:       error: eMin,
00870:     } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00871:       uf,
00872:       extraOrderBy: orderAsc,
00873:       extraLimit: limit(SCAN_LIMIT),
00874:       policy: "server",
00875:     });
00876: 
00877:     const {
00878:       docs: maxDocs,
00879:       usedField: usedMax,
00880:       error: eMax,
00881:     } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00882:       uf,
00883:       extraOrderBy: orderDesc,
00884:       extraLimit: limit(SCAN_LIMIT),
00885:       policy: "server",
00886:     });
00887: 
00888:     if (eMin || eMax) {
00889:       if (!isIndexError(eMin) && !isIndexError(eMax)) firstTryError = eMin || eMax;
00890:     }
00891: 
00892:     if (minDocs.length && maxDocs.length && !eMin && !eMax) {
00893:       const mappedMin = minDocs.map(mapDrawDoc);
00894:       const mappedMax = maxDocs.map(mapDrawDoc);
00895: 
00896:       const { minYmd } = pickMinMaxFromMapped(mappedMin);
00897:       const { maxYmd } = pickMinMaxFromMapped(mappedMax);
00898: 
00899:       if (minYmd && maxYmd) {
00900:         return {
00901:           ok: true,
00902:           uf,
00903:           minYmd,
00904:           maxYmd,
00905:           minDate: minYmd,
00906:           maxDate: maxYmd,
00907:           source: `ymd_scan${SCAN_LIMIT}:${usedMin}/${usedMax}`,
00908:         };
00909:       }
00910:     }
00911:   }
00912: 
00913:   const recentProbe = await probeRecentMaxYmd(uf, 60);
00914:   const recentMaxYmd = recentProbe?.ok ? recentProbe.maxYmd : null;
00915: 
00916:   const scopeKeyBounds = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
00917:   {
00918:     const idxInfo = (() => {
00919:       const code = String(firstTryError?.code || "");
00920:       const msg = String(firstTryError?.message || "");
00921:       if (!code && !msg) return "";
00922:       return `:firstTryError=${code || "err"}`;
00923:     })();
00924: 
00925:     const a = await sampleEdgesByDocId("uf", String(uf).toUpperCase());
00926: 
00927:     const ufUp = String(uf || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00928: 
00929:     if (!a.ok && isFederalInput(ufUp)) {
00930:       for (const lk of FEDERAL_LOTTERY_KEYS) {
00931:         const b = await sampleEdgesByDocId("lottery_key", lk);
00932:         if (b.ok) {
00933:           const mm = pickMinMaxFromMapped(b.merged);
00934: 
00935:           const maxFixed =
00936:             recentMaxYmd && (!mm.maxYmd || recentMaxYmd > mm.maxYmd)
00937:               ? recentMaxYmd
00938:               : mm.maxYmd;
00939: 
00940:           const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKeyBounds, {
00941:             minYmd: mm.minYmd || null,
00942:             maxYmd: maxFixed || null,
00943:           });
00944: 
00945:           return {
00946:             ok: !!(floored.minYmd && floored.maxYmd),
00947:             uf,
00948: 
00949:             minYmd: floored.minYmd,
00950:             maxYmd: floored.maxYmd,
00951: 
00952:             minDate: floored.minYmd,
00953:             maxDate: floored.maxYmd,
00954: 
00955:             source: `fallback_edges_docId_limit=${FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT}:lottery_key(${lk}):sampleCount=${b.merged.length}${
00956:               recentMaxYmd ? ":max_probe" : ""
00957:             }${idxInfo}`,
00958:           };
00959:         }
00960:       }
00961:     }
00962: 
00963:     const lotteryKey =
00964:       ufUp === RJ_STATE_CODE ? RJ_LOTTERY_KEY : resolveLotteryKeyForQuery(uf);
00965: 
00966:     const b = a.ok
00967:       ? null
00968:       : await sampleEdgesByDocId("lottery_key", String(lotteryKey).toUpperCase());
00969: 
00970:     const merged = a.ok ? a.merged : b?.merged || [];
00971:     const mm = pickMinMaxFromMapped(merged);
00972: 
00973:     const maxFixed =
00974:       recentMaxYmd && (!mm.maxYmd || recentMaxYmd > mm.maxYmd)
00975:         ? recentMaxYmd
00976:         : mm.maxYmd;
00977: 
00978:     const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKeyBounds, {
00979:       minYmd: mm.minYmd || null,
00980:       maxYmd: maxFixed || null,
00981:     });
00982: 
00983:     return {
00984:       ok: !!(floored.minYmd && floored.maxYmd),
00985:       uf,
00986: 
00987:       minYmd: floored.minYmd,
00988:       maxYmd: floored.maxYmd,
00989: 
00990:       minDate: floored.minYmd,
00991:       maxDate: floored.maxYmd,
00992: 
00993:       source: `fallback_edges_docId_limit=${FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT}:${
00994:         a.ok ? "uf" : "lottery_key"
00995:       }:sampleCount=${merged.length}${recentMaxYmd ? ":max_probe" : ""}${idxInfo}`,
00996:     };
00997:   }
00998: }

01001:    API: Day

01004: function buildPrizeSignature(draw) {
01005:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
01006:   if (!prizes.length) return "";
01007: 
01008:   const parts = prizes
01009:     .map((p) => {
01010:       const pos = Number(p?.position);
01011:       const grupo = Number(p?.grupo);
01012:       const numero = toPrizeDigitsByPosition(
01013:         p?.numero ?? p?.milhar ?? p?.number ?? p?.num ?? p?.valor ?? "",
01014:         pos
01015:       );
01016: 
01017:       if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || !Number.isFinite(grupo) || !numero) return "";
01018:       return `${pad2(pos)}:${pad2(grupo)}:${numero}`;
01019:     })
01020:     .filter(Boolean)
01021:     .sort();
01022: 
01023:   return parts.join("|");
01024: }
01025: 
01026: function federalHourPriority(draw) {
01027:   const h = normalizeHourLike(
01028:     draw?.close_hour || draw?.closeHour || draw?.hour || draw?.hora || ""
01029:   );
01030:   const ymd = String(draw?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(draw?.date) || "").trim();
01031:   const n = hourToNumSafe(h);
01032: 
01033:   const prefer20h = getFederalPreferredHourForYmd(ymd) === "20:00";
01034: 
01035:   if (prefer20h) {
01036:     if (h === "20:00") return 200000 + n;
01037:     if (h === "19:00") return 190000 + n;
01038:     return 100000 + n;
01039:   }
01040: 
01041:   if (h === "19:00") return 200000 + n;
01042:   if (h === "20:00") return 190000 + n;
01043:   return 100000 + n;
01044: }
01045: 
01046: function pickBetterFederalClone(a, b) {
01047:   const pa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.prizesCount))
01048:     ? Number(a.prizesCount)
01049:     : Array.isArray(a?.prizes)
01050:     ? a.prizes.length
01051:     : 0;
01052: 
01053:   const pb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.prizesCount))
01054:     ? Number(b.prizesCount)
01055:     : Array.isArray(b?.prizes)
01056:     ? b.prizes.length
01057:     : 0;
01058: 
01059:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
01060: 
01061:   const ha = federalHourPriority(a);
01062:   const hb = federalHourPriority(b);
01063:   if (ha !== hb) return hb > ha ? b : a;
01064: 
01065:   const ia = String(a?.drawId || a?.id || "");
01066:   const ib = String(b?.drawId || b?.id || "");
01067:   return ib.localeCompare(ia) > 0 ? b : a;
01068: }
01069: 
01070: function collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(draws) {
01071:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01072:   const byKey = new Map();
01073: 
01074:   for (const d of arr) {
01075:     const ymd = String(d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date) || "").trim();
01076:     const sig = buildPrizeSignature(d);
01077: 
01078:     if (!ymd || !sig) {
01079:       const fallbackKey = `id::${String(
01080:         d?.drawId || d?.id || Math.random()
01081:       )}`;
01082:       if (!byKey.has(fallbackKey)) byKey.set(fallbackKey, d);
01083:       continue;
01084:     }
01085: 
01086:     const key = `${ymd}__${sig}`;
01087:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
01088: 
01089:     if (!prev) byKey.set(key, d);
01090:     else byKey.set(key, pickBetterFederalClone(prev, d));
01091:   }
01092: 
01093:   return sortDrawsLocal(Array.from(byKey.values()));
01094: }

01096: function drawsCacheKeyDay({ scopeKey, ymd, positionsArr, hourFilter }) {
01097:   const p = positionsArr && positionsArr.length ? positionsArr.join(",") : "all";
01098:   const h =
01099:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01100:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01101:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01102:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01103:       : "all";
01104:   return `day::${scopeKey}::${ymd}::pos=${p}::h=${h}`;
01105: }

01107: export async function getKingResultsByDate({
01108:   uf,
01109:   date,
01110:   closeHour = null,
01111:   closeHourBucket = null,
01112:   positions = null,
01113: }) {
01114:   if (!uf || !date) throw new Error("Parâmetros obrigatórios: uf e date");
01115: 
01116:   const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
01117: 
01118:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01119:   const ymdDate = normalizeToYMD(date);
01120:   if (!ymdDate) return [];
01121: 
01122:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01123: 
01124:   const dayKey = drawsCacheKeyDay({
01125:     scopeKey,
01126:     ymd: ymdDate,
01127:     positionsArr,
01128:     hourFilter,
01129:   });
01130: 
01131:   const forceFreshServer = shouldForceFreshServerRead(ymdDate);
01132:   const allowMemoryCache = !forceFreshServer;
01133: 
01134:   if (allowMemoryCache) {
01135:     const cached = cacheGet(DRAWS_CACHE, dayKey);
01136:     if (cached) return cached;
01137:   }
01138: 
01139:   const readPolicy = forceFreshServer ? "server" : DEFAULT_READ_POLICY;
01140: 
01141:   const docCandidates = [];
01142: 
01143:   {
01144:     const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01145:       uf,
01146:       extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", ymdDate)],
01147:       policy: readPolicy,
01148:     });
01149:     if (error) throw error;
01150:     if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01151:   }
01152: 
01153:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01154:     const rawDate = String(date || "").trim();
01155:     if (rawDate) {
01156:       const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01157:         uf,
01158:         extraWheres: [where("date", "==", rawDate)],
01159:         policy: readPolicy,
01160:       });
01161:       if (error) throw error;
01162:       if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01163:     }
01164:   }
01165: 
01166:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01167:     const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01168:       uf,
01169:       extraWheres: [where("date", "==", ymdDate)],
01170:       policy: readPolicy,
01171:     });
01172:     if (error) throw error;
01173:     if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01174:   }
01175: 
01176:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01177:     const brDate = ymdToBR(ymdDate);
01178:     if (brDate) {
01179:       const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01180:         uf,
01181:         extraWheres: [where("date", "==", brDate)],
01182:         policy: readPolicy,
01183:       });
01184:       if (error) throw error;
01185:       if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01186:     }
01187:   }
01188: 
01189:   if (!docCandidates.length) return [];
01190: 
01191:   let baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docCandidates.map(mapDrawDoc));
01192:   baseAll = baseAll.filter((x) => (x.ymd || normalizeToYMD(x.date)) === ymdDate);
01193: 
01194:   const orderedAll = sortDrawsLocal(baseAll);
01195: 
01196:   const hydratedAll = await mapWithConcurrency(orderedAll, 6, async (item) => {
01197:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01198:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01199:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01200:   });
01201: 
01202:   let dayAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(hydratedAll);
01203: 
01204: if (scopeKey === FEDERAL_SCOPE_CODE) {
01205:   dayAll = collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(dayAll);
01206: }
01207: 
01208:   const base = hourFilter?.kind
01209:     ? dayAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01210:     : dayAll;
01211: 
01212:   let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01213: 
01214: if (scopeKey === FEDERAL_SCOPE_CODE) {
01215:   out = collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(out);
01216: }
01217: 
01218:   if (allowMemoryCache) {
01219:     cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, dayKey, out);
01220:   }
01221: 
01222:   return out;
01223: }
01224: 
01225: /* =========================
01226:    API: Range
01227: ========================= */
01228: 
01229: function drawsCacheKeyRange({
01230:   scopeKey,
01231:   from,
01232:   to,
01233:   positionsArr,
01234:   hourFilter,
01235:   mode,
01236: }) {
01237:   const p = positionsArr && positionsArr.length ? positionsArr.join(",") : "all";
01238:   const h =
01239:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01240:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01241:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01242:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01243:       : "all";
01244:   const m = mode ? String(mode) : "detailed";
01245:   return `range::${scopeKey}::${from}..${to}::pos=${p}::h=${h}::mode=${m}`;
01246: }
01247: 
01248: function chooseRangeConcurrency(drawCount) {
01249:   if (!Number.isFinite(drawCount)) return 6;
01250:   if (drawCount <= 50) return 4;
01251:   if (drawCount <= 300) return 6;
01252:   if (drawCount <= 1200) return 8;
01253:   return 10;
01254: }
01255: 
01256: export function decideKingRangeMode({ dateFrom, dateTo, mode = "detailed" }) {
01257:   const ymdFrom = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01258:   const ymdTo = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01259:   if (!ymdFrom || !ymdTo) return "detailed";
01260: 
01261:   if (mode === "detailed" || mode === "aggregated") return mode;
01262:   if (mode !== "auto") return "detailed";
01263: 
01264:   const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01265:   if (!Number.isFinite(days) || days <= 0) return "detailed";
01266:   return "detailed";
01267: }

01269: /**
01270:  * ✅ Fallback barato (SEM prizes): usado quando falta índice composto no RANGE,
01271:  * ou quando você quer aggregated sem custo de hidratar.
01272:  */
01273: async function fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd }) {
01274:   const readPolicy = shouldForceFreshServerRead(dayYmd) ? "server" : DEFAULT_READ_POLICY;
01275: 
01276:   const { docs, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01277:     uf,
01278:     extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", dayYmd)],
01279:     policy: readPolicy,
01280:   });
01281:   if (error) throw error;
01282:   if (!docs || !docs.length) return [];
01283: 
01284:   let baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docs.map(mapDrawDoc));
01285:   baseAll = baseAll.filter((x) => (x.ymd || normalizeToYMD(x.date)) === dayYmd);
01286: 
01287:   const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(baseAll);
01288: 
01289:   return ordered.map((d) => {
01290:     const embedded = normalizeEmbeddedPrizesForAggregated(d?.prizes);
01291:     return {
01292:       ...d,
01293:       prizes: embedded,
01294:       prizesCount: embedded.length || Number(d?.prizesCount || 0),
01295:       __mode: "aggregated",
01296:     };
01297:   });
01298: }

01300: export async function getKingResultsByRange({
01301:   uf,
01302:   dateFrom,
01303:   dateTo,
01304:   closeHour = null,
01305:   closeHourBucket = null,
01306:   positions = null,
01307:   mode = "detailed",
01308:   readPolicy = DEFAULT_READ_POLICY,
01309:   bypassCache = false,
01310: }) {
01311:   if (!uf || !dateFrom || !dateTo) {
01312:     throw new Error("Parâmetros obrigatórios: uf, dateFrom, dateTo");
01313:   }
01314: 
01315:   const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
01316: 
01317:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01318: 
01319:   const ymdFrom = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01320:   const ymdTo = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01321:   if (!ymdFrom || !ymdTo) return [];
01322: 
01323:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01324: 
01325:   const effectiveMode = decideKingRangeMode({
01326:     dateFrom: ymdFrom,
01327:     dateTo: ymdTo,
01328:     mode,
01329:   });
01330: 
01331:   const rangeKey = drawsCacheKeyRange({
01332:     scopeKey,
01333:     from: ymdFrom,
01334:     to: ymdTo,
01335:     positionsArr,
01336:     hourFilter,
01337:     mode: effectiveMode,
01338:   });
01339:   if (!bypassCache) {
01340:     const cached = cacheGet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey);
01341:     if (cached) return cached;
01342:   }
01343: 
01344:   const DOC_ID = documentId();
01345:   const rangeOrder = [orderBy("ymd", "asc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
01346: 
01347:   const { docs, error, usedField } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01348:     uf,
01349:     extraWheres: [where("ymd", ">=", ymdFrom), where("ymd", "<=", ymdTo)],
01350:     extraOrderBy: rangeOrder,
01351:     policy: readPolicy,
01352:   });
01353: 
01354:   if (error) {
01355:     if (isIndexError(error)) {
01356:       const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01357:       const MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS = 31;
01358: 
01359:       if (Number.isFinite(days) && days > 0 && days <= MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS) {
01360:         if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01361:           const all = [];
01362:           for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01363:             const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01364:             const dayDraws = await fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd: day });
01365:             if (dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01366:           }
01367: 
01368:           const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01369:           const base = hourFilter?.kind
01370:             ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01371:             : baseAll;
01372: 
01373:           let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01374: 
01375:           if (!bypassCache) {
01376:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01377:     }
01378:           return out;
01379:         }
01380: 
01381:         const all = [];
01382:         for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01383:           const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01384:           const dayDraws = await getKingResultsByDate({
01385:             uf,
01386:             date: day,
01387:             closeHour,
01388:             closeHourBucket,
01389:             positions: positionsArr,
01390:           });
01391:           if (Array.isArray(dayDraws) && dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01392:         }
01393: 
01394:         const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01395:         const base = hourFilter?.kind
01396:           ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01397:           : baseAll;
01398: 
01399:         let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01400: 
01401:         if (!bypassCache) {
01402:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01403:     }
01404:         return out;
01405:       }
01406: 
01407:       const rawCode = String(error?.code || "");
01408:       const rawMsg = String(error?.message || "");
01409: 
01410:       throw new Error(
01411:         `Firestore: falta índice composto para RANGE (campo ${usedField} + ymd).\n` +
01412:           `Crie/valide o índice no console (Collection: draws | Fields: ${usedField} ASC, ymd ASC, __name__ (documentId) ASC).\n` +
01413:           `Obs: fallback automático só é aplicado para ranges até ${MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS} dias.\n` +
01414:           (rawCode || rawMsg ? `Detalhe: ${rawCode} ${rawMsg}` : "")
01415:       );
01416:     }
01417: 
01418:     throw error;
01419:   }
01420: 
01421:   if (!docs || !docs.length) {
01422:     const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01423:     const MAX_EMPTY_RANGE_FALLBACK_DAYS = 120;
01424: 
01425:     if (
01426:       Number.isFinite(days) &&
01427:       days > 0 &&
01428:       days <= MAX_EMPTY_RANGE_FALLBACK_DAYS
01429:     ) {
01430:       if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01431:         const all = [];
01432:         for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01433:           const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01434:           const dayDraws = await fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd: day });
01435:           if (dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01436:         }
01437: 
01438:         const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01439:         const base = hourFilter?.kind
01440:           ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01441:           : baseAll;
01442: 
01443:         let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01444: 
01445:         if (!bypassCache) {
01446:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01447:     }
01448:         return out;
01449:       }
01450: 
01451:       const all = [];
01452:       for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01453:         const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01454:         const dayDraws = await getKingResultsByDate({
01455:           uf,
01456:           date: day,
01457:           closeHour,
01458:           closeHourBucket,
01459:           positions: positionsArr,
01460:         });
01461:         if (Array.isArray(dayDraws) && dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01462:       }
01463: 
01464:       const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01465:       const base = hourFilter?.kind
01466:         ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01467:         : baseAll;
01468: 
01469:       const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(base);
01470: 
01471:       const conc = chooseRangeConcurrency(ordered.length);
01472:       const results = await mapWithConcurrency(ordered, conc, async (item) => {
01473:         const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01474:         const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01475:         return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01476:       });
01477: 
01478:       const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01479:       if (!bypassCache) {
01480:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01481:     }
01482:       return out;
01483:     }
01484: 
01485:     return [];
01486:   }
01487: 
01488:   const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docs.map(mapDrawDoc));
01489:   const base = hourFilter?.kind
01490:     ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01491:     : baseAll;
01492: 
01493:   const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(base);
01494: 
01495:   if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01496:     const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(
01497:       ordered.map((d) => {
01498:         const embedded = normalizeEmbeddedPrizesForAggregated(d?.prizes);
01499:         return {
01500:           ...d,
01501:           prizes: embedded,
01502:           prizesCount: Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
01503:             ? Number(d.prizesCount)
01504:             : embedded.length || 0,
01505:           __mode: "aggregated",
01506:         };
01507:       })
01508:     );
01509:     if (!bypassCache) {
01510:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01511:     }
01512:     return out;
01513:   }
01514: 
01515:   const conc = chooseRangeConcurrency(ordered.length);
01516: 
01517:   const results = await mapWithConcurrency(ordered, conc, async (item) => {
01518:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01519:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01520:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01521:   });
01522: 
01523:   const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01524:   if (!bypassCache) {
01525:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01526:     }
01527:   return out;
01528: }

01530: /* =========================
01531:    ✅ Hidratação de prizes (para UX no "Todos")
01532: ========================= */
01533: 
01534: export async function hydrateKingDrawsWithPrizes({
01535:   draws,
01536:   positions = null,
01537:   concurrency = null,
01538: }) {
01539:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01540:   if (!arr.length) return [];
01541: 
01542:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01543: 
01544:   const conc =
01545:     Number.isFinite(Number(concurrency)) && Number(concurrency) > 0
01546:       ? Number(concurrency)
01547:       : chooseRangeConcurrency(arr.length);
01548: 
01549:   const results = await mapWithConcurrency(arr, conc, async (item) => {
01550:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01551:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01552:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01553:   });
01554: 
01555:   return dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01556: }

01558: /* =========================
01559:    ✅ ATRASADOS (Late) — 100% baseado na SUA base
01560: ========================= */
01561: 
01562: function normalizeLotteriesList(lotteries) {
01563:   const arr = Array.isArray(lotteries) ? lotteries : [];
01564:   const cleaned = arr
01565:     .map((x) => String(x ?? "").trim().toUpperCase())
01566:     .filter(Boolean);
01567:   return cleaned.length ? Array.from(new Set(cleaned)) : null;
01568: }
01569: 
01570: function drawPassesLotteriesFilter(draw, lotteriesArr) {
01571:   if (!lotteriesArr || !lotteriesArr.length) return true;
01572:   const code = String(draw?.lottery_code ?? "").trim().toUpperCase();
01573:   if (!code) return false;
01574:   return lotteriesArr.includes(code);
01575: }
01576: 
01577: function lateCacheKey({
01578:   scopeKey,
01579:   fromYmd,
01580:   toYmd,
01581:   baseYmd,
01582:   prizePosition,
01583:   hourFilter,
01584:   lotteriesArr,
01585:   chunkDays,
01586: }) {
01587:   const h =
01588:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01589:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01590:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01591:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01592:       : "all";
01593:   const lots = lotteriesArr && lotteriesArr.length ? lotteriesArr.join(",") : "all";
01594:   const cd = Number(chunkDays) || 15;
01595:   const pos = Number(prizePosition) || 1;
01596:   return `late::${scopeKey}::${fromYmd}..${toYmd}::base=${baseYmd}::pos=${pos}::h=${h}::lots=${lots}::chunk=${cd}`;
01597: }
01598: 
01599: function hourToNumSafe(hhmm) {
01600:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
01601:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
01602:   if (!m) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
01603:   return Number(m[1]) * 100 + Number(m[2]);
01604: }
01605: 
01606: export async function getKingLateByRange({
01607:   uf,
01608:   dateFrom,
01609:   dateTo,
01610:   baseDate = null,
01611:   lotteries = null,
01612:   prizePosition = 1,
01613:   closeHour = null,
01614:   closeHourBucket = null,
01615:   chunkDays = 15,
01616: }) {
01617:   if (!uf || !dateFrom || !dateTo) {
01618:     throw new Error("Parâmetros obrigatórios: uf, dateFrom, dateTo");
01619:   }
01620: 
01621:   const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
01622: 
01623:   const fromYmd = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01624:   const toYmd = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01625:   if (!fromYmd || !toYmd) return [];
01626: 
01627:   const baseYmd = normalizeToYMD(baseDate) || toYmd;
01628: 
01629:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01630:   const lotteriesArr = normalizeLotteriesList(lotteries);
01631: 
01632:   const cacheKey = lateCacheKey({
01633:     scopeKey,
01634:     fromYmd,
01635:     toYmd,
01636:     baseYmd,
01637:     prizePosition,
01638:     hourFilter,
01639:     lotteriesArr,
01640:     chunkDays,
01641:   });
01642: 
01643:   const cached = cacheGet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey);
01644:   if (cached) return cached;
01645: 
01646:   const posNum = Number(prizePosition) || 1;
01647: 
01648:   const lastSeen = new Map();
01649: 
01650:   let cursorTo = toYmd;
01651:   const chunk = Math.max(3, Math.min(60, Number(chunkDays) || 15));
01652: 
01653:   if (cursorTo < fromYmd) {
01654:     const outEmpty = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => ({
01655:       pos: i + 1,
01656:       grupo: i + 1,
01657:       lastYmd: null,
01658:       lastHour: null,
01659:       lastDrawId: null,
01660:       lastLottery: null,
01661:       atrasoDias: null,
01662:     }));
01663:     cacheSet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey, outEmpty);
01664:     return outEmpty;
01665:   }
01666: 
01667:   while (cursorTo >= fromYmd && lastSeen.size < 25) {
01668:     let chunkFrom = addDaysUTC(cursorTo, -(chunk - 1));
01669:     if (chunkFrom < fromYmd) chunkFrom = fromYmd;
01670: 
01671:     const draws = await getKingResultsByRange({
01672:       uf,
01673:       dateFrom: chunkFrom,
01674:       dateTo: cursorTo,
01675:       closeHour,
01676:       closeHourBucket,
01677:       positions: [posNum],
01678:       mode: "detailed",
01679:     });
01680: 
01681:     const desc = sortDrawsLocalDesc(dedupeDrawsLocal(draws));
01682: 
01683:     for (const d of desc) {
01684:       if (!d) continue;
01685: 
01686:       if (hourFilter?.kind && !drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter)) continue;
01687:       if (lotteriesArr && !drawPassesLotteriesFilter(d, lotteriesArr)) continue;
01688: 
01689:       const ymd = d.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d.date);
01690:       if (!ymd || !isYMD(ymd)) continue;
01691: 
01692:       const p = Array.isArray(d.prizes)
01693:         ? d.prizes.find(
01694:             (x) => Number(x?.position) === posNum && isValidGrupo(x?.grupo)
01695:           )
01696:         : null;
01697: 
01698:       const g = p?.grupo;
01699:       if (!isValidGrupo(g)) continue;
01700: 
01701:       if (!lastSeen.has(g)) {
01702:         lastSeen.set(g, {
01703:           ymd,
01704:           hour: d.close_hour || d.closeHour || "",
01705:           drawId: d.drawId || d.id || null,
01706:           lottery_code: d.lottery_code || null,
01707:         });
01708: 
01709:         if (lastSeen.size >= 25) break;
01710:       }
01711:     }
01712: 
01713:     cursorTo = addDaysUTC(chunkFrom, -1);
01714:   }
01715: 
01716:   const rows = [];
01717:   for (let g = 1; g <= 25; g += 1) {
01718:     const seen = lastSeen.get(g) || null;
01719:     const lastYmd = seen?.ymd || null;
01720:     const diff = lastYmd ? daysDiffUTC(lastYmd, baseYmd) : NaN;
01721:     const atrasoDias =
01722:       lastYmd && Number.isFinite(diff) ? Math.max(0, diff) : null;
01723: 
01724:     rows.push({
01725:       pos: 0,
01726:       grupo: g,
01727:       lastYmd,
01728:       lastHour: seen?.hour ? normalizeHourLike(seen.hour) : null,
01729:       lastDrawId: seen?.drawId || null,
01730:       lastLottery: seen?.lottery_code || null,
01731:       atrasoDias,
01732:     });
01733:   }
01734: 
01735:   const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
01736:     const aa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(a.atrasoDias) : -1;
01737:     const bb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(b.atrasoDias) : -1;
01738:     if (bb !== aa) return bb - aa;
01739: 
01740:     const ha = hourToNumSafe(a?.lastHour);
01741:     const hb = hourToNumSafe(b?.lastHour);
01742:     if (ha !== hb) return ha - hb;
01743: 
01744:     return Number(a?.grupo || 0) - Number(b?.grupo || 0);
01745:   });
01746: 
01747:   const out = sorted.map((r, idx) => ({ ...r, pos: idx + 1 }));
01748: 
01749:   cacheSet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey, out);
01750:   return out;
01751: }

00053: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00054:   if (!input) return null;
00055: 
00056:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00057:     return `${input.getFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00058:       input.getDate()
00059:     )}`;
00060:   }
00061: 
00062:   // ✅ Timestamp-like / objetos com toDate()
00063:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00064:     const d = input.toDate();
00065:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00066:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00067:         d.getDate()
00068:       )}`;
00069:     }
00070:   }
00071: 
00072:   if (
00073:     typeof input === "object" &&
00074:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) ||
00075:       Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00076:   ) {
00077:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00078:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00079:       : Number(input._seconds);
00080: 
00081:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00082:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00083:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(
00084:         d.getDate()
00085:       )}`;
00086:     }
00087:   }
00088: 
00089:   const s = safeStr(input);
00090:   if (!s) return null;
00091: 
00092:   // ISO com ou sem hora
00093:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00094:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00095: 
00096:   // BR "dd/mm/yyyy"
00097:   const y = brToYMD(s);
00098:   if (y) return y;
00099: 
00100:   return null;
00101: }

00107: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00108:   const s0 = safeStr(value);
00109:   if (!s0) return "";
00110:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
00111: 
00112:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
00113:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
00114: 
00115:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00116:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
00117: 
00118:   const mHm = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
00119:   if (mHm) {
00120:     const hh = String(mHm[1]).slice(0, -2);
00121:     const mm = String(mHm[1]).slice(-2);
00122:     if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(hh) && /^\d{2}$/.test(mm)) {
00123:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${mm}`;
00124:     }
00125:   }
00126: 
00127:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00128:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
00129: 
00130:   return s0;
00131: }

00288: export function computeTop3Signals({
00289:   drawsRange,

00293:   prevGrupo,
00294:   weights,
00295:   mins,
00296: }) {
00297:   const list = Array.isArray(drawsRange) ? drawsRange : [];
00298:   const schSet = scheduleSet(schedule);
00299: 
00300:   const target = toHourBucket(hourBucket);
00301:   if (!target) {

00303:   }

00306:   const curDow = getDowKey(curYmd);
00307:   const curDom = getDomNumber(curYmd);

00313:     base: 1.0,

00323:     dow: 4,
00324:     dom: 3,
00325:     ...(mins || {}),
00326:   };

00328:   // map `${ymd}__${hour}` -> grupo1

00330:

00349: 
00350:   // (A2) Base global (todos horários da grade)
00351:   const globalCounts = new Map();
00352:   let globalTotal = 0;
00353: 
00354:   for (const [k, g] of byKey.entries()) {
00355:     const hour = k.split("__")[1] || "";
00356: 
00357:     globalTotal += 1;
00358:     globalCounts.set(g, (globalCounts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00359: 
00360:     if (hour === target) {
00361:       baseTotal += 1;
00362:       baseCounts.set(g, (baseCounts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
00363:     }
00364:   }

00366:   if (baseTotal <= 0 && globalTotal <= 0) {
00367:     return {
00368:       top: [],
00369:       scored: [],

00371:         reason: "no_samples_any",

00439:

00441:

00454:     Number.isFinite(Number(g))

00458: 
00459:   const scored = candidates.map((g) => {

00461:     const pBase = prob(baseHit, baseTotal);
00462: 
00463:     const globHit = globalCounts.get(g) || 0;
00464:     const pGlob = prob(globHit, globalTotal);

00467:     const pTrans = prob(transHit, transTotal);

00470:     const pDow = prob(dowHit, transTotalDow);

00473:     const pDom = prob(domHit, transTotalDom);
00474: 
00475:     const bonusTrans = useTrans ? clamp(pTrans, 0, 0.55) : 0;
00476:     const bonusDow = useDow ? clamp(pDow, 0, 0.40) : 0;
00477:     const bonusDom = useDom ? clamp(pDom, 0, 0.32) : 0;
00478: 
00479:     const finalScore =
00480:       W.base * pBase +
00481:       (useGlobalBoost ? W.global * pGlob : 0) +
00482:       W.trans * bonusTrans +
00483:       W.dow * bonusDow +
00484:       W.dom * bonusDom;
00485: 
00486:     const reasons = [];
00487: 
00488:     if (baseTotal > 0) {
00489:       reasons.push(
00490:         `Base do horário ${target}: ${baseHit}/${baseTotal} (${Math.round(
00491:           pBase * 100
00492:         )}%)`
00493:       );
00494:     } else {
00495:       reasons.push(`Base do horário ${target}: sem amostra (0)`);
00496:     }
00497: 
00498:     reasons.push(
00499:       `Base global (grade): ${globHit}/${globalTotal} (${Math.round(
00500:         pGlob * 100
00501:       )}%)`
00502:     );
00503: 
00504:     if (prevG == null) {
00505:       reasons.push(`Transição: sem sorteio anterior válido (camada desligada)`);
00506:     } else if (!useTrans) {
00507:       reasons.push(
00508:         `Transição (G${pad2(prevG)}→?): amostra pequena (${transTotal}), mínimo ${MIN.trans}`
00509:       );
00510:     } else {
00511:       reasons.push(
00512:         `Transição (G${pad2(prevG)}→G${pad2(g)}): ${transHit}/${transTotal} (${Math.round(
00513:           pTrans * 100
00514:         )}%)`
00515:       );
00516:     }
00517: 
00518:     if (useDow) {
00519:       reasons.push(
00520:         `DOW: ${dowHit}/${transTotalDow} (${Math.round(pDow * 100)}%)`
00521:       );
00522:     } else if (prevG != null) {
00523:       reasons.push(`DOW: amostra pequena (${transTotalDow}), mínimo ${MIN.dow}`);
00524:     }
00525: 
00526:     if (useDom) {
00527:       reasons.push(
00528:         `DOM: ${domHit}/${transTotalDom} (${Math.round(pDom * 100)}%)`
00529:       );
00530:     } else if (prevG != null) {
00531:       reasons.push(`DOM: amostra pequena (${transTotalDom}), mínimo ${MIN.dom}`);
00532:     }
00533: 
00534:     return {
00535:       grupo: g,
00536:       baseHit,
00537:       baseTotal,
00538:       globalHit: globHit,
00539:       globalTotal,
00540:       prevGrupo: prevG,
00541:       transHit,
00542:       transTotal,
00543:       dowHit,
00544:       transTotalDow,
00545:       domHit,
00546:       transTotalDom,
00547:       useTrans,
00548:       useDow,
00549:       useDom,
00550:       pBase,
00551:       pGlob,
00552:       pTrans,
00553:       pDow,
00554:       pDom,
00555:       finalScore,
00556:       reasons,
00557:     };
00558:   });
00559: 
00560:   scored.sort(
00561:     (a, b) =>
00562:       b.finalScore - a.finalScore ||
00563:       b.baseHit - a.baseHit ||
00564:       b.globalHit - a.globalHit ||
00565:       a.grupo - b.grupo
00566:   );
00567: 
00568:   const best = scored.slice(0, 3);
00569: 
00570:   while (best.length < 3) {
00571:     const g = allGroups25().find(
00572:       (x) => !best.some((b) => Number(b.grupo) === Number(x))
00573:     );
00574:     if (!g) break;
00575:     best.push({
00576:       grupo: g,
00577:       baseHit: 0,
00578:       baseTotal,
00579:       globalHit: 0,
00580:       globalTotal,
00581:       prevGrupo: prevG,
00582:       transHit: 0,
00583:       transTotal,
00584:       dowHit: 0,
00585:       transTotalDow,
00586:       domHit: 0,
00587:       transTotalDom,
00588:       useTrans,
00589:       useDow,
00590:       useDom,
00591:       pBase: 0,
00592:       pGlob: 0,
00593:       pTrans: 0,
00594:       pDow: 0,
00595:       pDom: 0,
00596:       finalScore: 0,
00597:       reasons: [`Fallback: completando Top3 (sem amostra suficiente)`],
00598:     });
00599:   }
00600: 
00601:   // ✅ percentuais estáveis: fecha em 100 sem ruído de arredondamento
00602:   const rawSum =
00603:     best.reduce((acc, x) => acc + (Number(x.finalScore) || 0), 0) || 1;
00604: 
00605:   const rawPcts = best.map((x) => (((Number(x.finalScore) || 0) / rawSum) * 100));
00606:   const floored = rawPcts.map((x) => Math.floor(x));
00607:   let remainder = 100 - floored.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
00608: 
00609:   const order = rawPcts
00610:     .map((x, i) => ({ i, frac: x - Math.floor(x) }))
00611:     .sort((a, b) => b.frac - a.frac);
00612: 
00613:   const pctFinal = [...floored];
00614:   for (let i = 0; i < order.length && remainder > 0; i += 1) {
00615:     pctFinal[order[i].i] += 1;
00616:     remainder -= 1;
00617:   }
00618: 
00619:   const top = best.map((x, idx) => {
00620:     return {
00621:       ...x,
00622:       rank: idx + 1,
00623:       pct: pctFinal[idx] ?? 0,
00624:       title:
00625:         idx === 0 ? "Principal" : idx === 1 ? "Alternativa" : "Terceira opção",
00626:     };
00627:   });
00628: 
00629:   return {
00630:     top,
00631:     scored,
00632:     meta: {
00633:       targetHour: target,
00634:       baseTotal,
00635:       globalTotal,
00636:       prevGrupo: prevG,
00637:       transTotal,
00638:       transTotalDow,
00639:       transTotalDom,
00640:       useTrans,
00641:       useDow,
00642:       useDom,
00643:       weights: W,
00644:       mins: MIN,
00645:       dayContext: { ymd: curYmd, dow: curDow, dom: curDom },
00646:       fallback: {
00647:         baseCandidates: baseCounts.size,
00648:         usedGlobalToComplete: baseCounts.size < 3,
00649:       },
00650:       useGlobalBoost,
00651:     },
00652:   };
00653: }

00007: function toNumber(v) {
00008:   const n = Number(v);
00009:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;
00010: }
00011: 
00012: /**
00013:  * Normaliza qualquer formato de grupo para "01".."25".
00014:  * Aceita:
00015:  * - 7, "7", "07"
00016:  * - "Grupo 7", "GRUPO 07", "G7", "G-07"
00017:  * - "25 - VACA", "grupo:25"
00018:  *
00019:  * Retorna "00" se inválido.
00020:  */
00021: function normalizeGrupo(g) {
00022:   const s0 = String(g ?? "").trim();
00023:   if (!s0) return "00";
00024: 
00025:   // 1) se já vier exatamente "07"
00026:   if (/^\d{2}$/.test(s0)) {
00027:     const n = Number(s0);
00028:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00029:     return pad2(n);
00030:   }
00031: 
00032:   // 2) se vier "7"
00033:   if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(s0)) {
00034:     const n = Number(s0);
00035:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00036:     return pad2(n);
00037:   }
00038: 
00039:   // 3) extrai 1-2 dígitos de dentro do texto (ex.: "Grupo 25", "25 - VACA")
00040:   const m = s0.match(/(\d{1,2})/);
00041:   if (m) {
00042:     const n = Number(m[1]);
00043:     if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1 || n > 25) return "00";
00044:     return pad2(n);
00045:   }
00046: 
00047:   return "00";
00048: }

00050: export function validateRankingLineByLine(expectedCounts, rankingRows) {
00051:   const issues = [];
00052:   const gotMap = new Map();
00053: 
00054:   const ignoredExpectedKeys = [];
00055:   const ignoredRows = [];
00056: 
00057:   // expectedCounts normalizado
00058:   const expectedNorm = {};
00059:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(expectedCounts || {})) {
00060:     const g = normalizeGrupo(k);
00061:     if (g === "00") {
00062:       ignoredExpectedKeys.push(String(k));
00063:       continue;
00064:     }
00065:     expectedNorm[g] = toNumber(v);
00066:   }
00067: 
00068:   // soma rows por grupo
00069:   for (const r of rankingRows || []) {
00070:     const rawG = r?.grupo ?? r?.group;
00071:     const g = normalizeGrupo(rawG);
00072:     if (g === "00") {
00073:       ignoredRows.push({ rawGrupo: rawG, row: r });
00074:       continue;
00075:     }
00076: 
00077:     const val = toNumber(r?.apar ?? r?.total ?? r?.count ?? r?.value ?? 0);
00078:     gotMap.set(g, toNumber(gotMap.get(g)) + val);
00079:   }
00080: 
00081:   const allGroups = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => pad2(i + 1));
00082: 
00083:   let okCount = 0;
00084:   let diffCount = 0;
00085: 
00086:   for (const g of allGroups) {
00087:     const expected = toNumber(expectedNorm?.[g] ?? 0);
00088:     const got = toNumber(gotMap.get(g) ?? 0);
00089:     const delta = got - expected;
00090: 
00091:     const status = delta === 0 ? "OK" : "DIF";
00092:     if (status === "OK") okCount += 1;
00093:     else diffCount += 1;
00094: 
00095:     issues.push({ grupo: g, esperado: expected, obtido: got, delta, status });
00096:   }
00097: 
00098:   const totalEsperado = allGroups.reduce(
00099:     (acc, g) => acc + toNumber(expectedNorm?.[g] ?? 0),
00100:     0
00101:   );
00102: 
00103:   const totalObtido = Array.from(gotMap.values()).reduce(
00104:     (acc, v) => acc + toNumber(v),
00105:     0
00106:   );
00107: 
00108:   const gotMapObj = {};
00109:   for (const g of allGroups) gotMapObj[g] = toNumber(gotMap.get(g) ?? 0);
00110: 
00111:   return {
00112:     issues,
00113:     okCount,
00114:     diffCount,
00115:     totalEsperado,
00116:     totalObtido,
00117:     totalDelta: totalObtido - totalEsperado,
00118:     gotMapObj,
00119: 
00120:     // extras p/ debug
00121:     ignoredExpectedKeys,
00122:     ignoredRowsCount: ignoredRows.length,
00123:   };
00124: }

00004:  * buildPalpite (PalPitaco) — V1 (Opção C) [FECHADO]
00005:  * ============================================================
00006:  *
00007:  * Objetivo:
00008:  * - Gerar palpite 4 dígitos ("milhar") POR GRUPO (01..25)

00018:  * - Empate: mais recente
00019:  *
00020:  * Contrato:
00021:  * - Não inventa dados

00024:  * ============================================================

00027:  * buildPalpiteV2 — (NOVO) Palpite por FREQUÊNCIA + ANTIGUIDADE
00028:  * ============================================================
00029:  *
00030:  * Objetivo (conforme combinado AGORA):
00031:  * - Gerar palpite 4 dígitos ("milhar") POR GRUPO (01..25)
00032:  * - Respeitar o RECORTE ATUAL (global ou filtrado), sem janela "mais recente"
00033:  *
00034:  * Critérios:
00035:  * - Dezena: mais frequente
00036:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA (primeira aparição no tempo)
00037:  * - Unidade de centena (3º dígito da direita): mais frequente
00038:  * - Empate: mais ANTIGA

00042:  * Montagem:

00044:  *
00045:  * Contrato:
00046:  * - Deduplica draws para evitar inflação estatística
00047:  * - Não inventa dados: se não houver números no recorte, retorna null para o grupo

00233: function dedupeDraws(draws) {
00234:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00235:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00236: 
00237:   const seen = new Set();
00238:   const out = [];
00239: 
00240:   for (const d of arr) {
00241:     const key =
00242:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00243:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00244:       `${getDrawYmd(d) || ""}__${normalizeHourLike(getDrawCloseHour(d) || "")}`;
00245: 
00246:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00247:     seen.add(key);
00248:     out.push(d);
00249:   }

00251:   return out;
00252: }

00254: function sortDrawsChrono(draws) {

00260:     return toHourNum(normalizeHourLike(getDrawCloseHour(a))) - toHourNum(normalizeHourLike(getDrawCloseHour(b)));
00261:   });
00262:   return list;

00285:  * ✅ V2: desempate por ANTIGUIDADE
00286:  * - Maior frequência vence
00287:  * - Empate: menor firstSeen vence (mais antigo)
00288:  */
00289: function pickTopByFreqAndOldest(freqMap) {
00290:   let bestKey = null;
00291:   let bestCount = -1;
00292:   let bestFirst = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
00293: 
00294:   for (const [k, v] of freqMap.entries()) {
00295:     const c = Number(v?.count || 0);
00296:     const first = Number(v?.firstSeen ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY);
00297: 
00298:     if (c > bestCount || (c === bestCount && first < bestFirst)) {
00299:       bestKey = k;
00300:       bestCount = c;
00301:       bestFirst = first;
00302:     }
00303:   }
00304: 
00305:   return bestKey;
00306: }
00307: 
00308: /**
00309:  * ✅ Helper (fora de loops) para evitar ESLint no-loop-func
00310:  */
00311: function bumpFreqFirstSeen(map, key, seq) {
00312:   if (key == null) return;
00313:   const k = String(key);
00314:   const cur = map.get(k) || { count: 0, firstSeen: seq };
00315:   cur.count += 1;
00316:   if (!Number.isFinite(Number(cur.firstSeen)) || seq < cur.firstSeen) cur.firstSeen = seq;
00317:   map.set(k, cur);
00318: }
