00320: /**
00321:  * buildPalpite (V1)
00322:  *
00323:  * opts:
00324:  * - closeHourBucket: "09h" | "11h" | etc
00325:  * - minDraws: default 400
00326:  * - maxDraws: default 2000
00327:  */
00328: export function buildPalpite(draws, opts = {}) {
00329:   const closeHourBucket = opts.closeHourBucket ? String(opts.closeHourBucket).trim() : null;
00330: 
00331:   const minDraws = Number.isFinite(+opts.minDraws) ? Math.max(1, +opts.minDraws) : 400;
00332:   const maxDraws = Number.isFinite(+opts.maxDraws) ? Math.max(minDraws, +opts.maxDraws) : 2000;
00333: 
00334:   let base = dedupeDraws(draws);
00335: 
00336:   if (closeHourBucket) {
00337:     base = base.filter((d) => toHourBucketLabel(getDrawCloseHour(d)) === closeHourBucket);
00338:   }
00339: 
00340:   const ordered = sortDrawsChrono(base);
00341: 
00342:   const total = ordered.length;
00343:   const windowed = total > maxDraws ? ordered.slice(total - maxDraws) : ordered;
00344: 
00345:   const perGrupo = new Map();
00346: 
00347:   const ensure = (g) => {
00348:     if (!perGrupo.has(g)) {
00349:       perGrupo.set(g, { dez: new Map(), cent: new Map(), milhar: new Map() });
00350:     }
00351:     return perGrupo.get(g);
00352:   };
00353: 
00354:   let seq = 0;
00355:   for (const d of windowed) {
00356:     seq += 1;
00357:     for (const p of d?.prizes || []) {
00358:       const g = getGrupoNumFromPrize(p);
00359:       if (!g) continue;
00360: 
00361:       const milhar = extractMilharFromPrize(p);
00362:       if (!milhar) continue;
00363: 
00364:       const holder = ensure(pad2(g));
00365:       const dez = milhar.slice(-2);
00366:       const cent = milhar.slice(-3);
00367: 
00368:       for (const [map, key] of [
00369:         [holder.dez, dez],
00370:         [holder.cent, cent],
00371:         [holder.milhar, milhar],
00372:       ]) {
00373:         const cur = map.get(key) || { count: 0, lastSeen: 0 };
00374:         cur.count += 1;
00375:         cur.lastSeen = seq;
00376:         map.set(key, cur);
00377:       }
00378:     }
00379:   }
00380: 
00381:   const palpitesByGrupo = {};
00382:   const debugByGrupo = {};
00383: 
00384:   for (let i = 1; i <= 25; i++) {
00385:     const g = pad2(i);
00386:     const h = perGrupo.get(g);
00387: 
00388:     if (!h || h.dez.size === 0) {
00389:       palpitesByGrupo[g] = null;
00390:       debugByGrupo[g] = { reason: "no_numbers_in_sample" };
00391:       continue;
00392:     }
00393: 
00394:     const dezWin = pickTopByFreqAndRecency(h.dez);
00395:     const centFiltered = new Map([...h.cent].filter(([k]) => k.endsWith(dezWin)));
00396:     const milharFiltered = new Map([...h.milhar].filter(([k]) => k.endsWith(dezWin)));
00397: 
00398:     const milharWin = pickTopByFreqAndRecency(milharFiltered);
00399:     const centWin = milharWin ? null : pickTopByFreqAndRecency(centFiltered);
00400: 
00401:     const palpite = milharWin
00402:       ? milharWin
00403:       : centWin
00404:       ? centWin.padStart(4, "0")
00405:       : `00${dezWin}`.padStart(4, "0");
00406: 
00407:     palpitesByGrupo[g] = palpite;
00408:     debugByGrupo[g] = { dezWin, milharWin, centWin };
00409:   }
00410: 
00411:   return {
00412:     palpitesByGrupo,
00413:     sampleDrawsUsed: windowed.length,
00414:     hasMinSample: windowed.length >= minDraws,
00415:     totalCandidates: ordered.length,
00416:     usedBucket: closeHourBucket || null,
00417:     debugByGrupo,
00418:   };
00419: }
00420: 
00421: /**
00422:  * buildPalpiteV2 (NOVO)
00423:  *
00424:  * opts:
00425:  * - closeHourBucket: "09h" | "11h" | etc (opcional)
00426:  *
00427:  * Observação:
00428:  * - NÃO usa janela "mais recente" (usa TODO o recorte recebido).
00429:  * - Desempate por ANTIGUIDADE (primeira aparição).
00430:  */
00431: export function buildPalpiteV2(draws, opts = {}) {
00432:   const closeHourBucket = opts.closeHourBucket ? String(opts.closeHourBucket).trim() : null;
00433: 
00434:   let base = dedupeDraws(draws);
00435: 
00436:   if (closeHourBucket) {
00437:     base = base.filter((d) => toHourBucketLabel(getDrawCloseHour(d)) === closeHourBucket);
00438:   }
00439: 
00440:   // Cronológico para "antiguidade" ser objetiva
00441:   const ordered = sortDrawsChrono(base);
00442: 
00443:   // Estrutura por grupo:
00444:   // - dez: "00".."99"
00445:   // - centDigit: "0".."9" (3º da direita)
00446:   // - milDigit: "0".."9" (4º da direita)
00447:   const perGrupo = new Map();
00448: 
00449:   const ensure = (g) => {
00450:     if (!perGrupo.has(g)) {
00451:       perGrupo.set(g, { dez: new Map(), centDigit: new Map(), milDigit: new Map() });
00452:     }
00453:     return perGrupo.get(g);
00454:   };
00455: 
00456:   // seq = índice cronológico (1..N) para medir "primeira aparição"
00457:   let seq = 0;
00458: 
00459:   for (const d of ordered) {
00460:     seq += 1;
00461: 
00462:     const prizes = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : [];
00463:     for (const p of prizes) {
00464:       const gNum = getGrupoNumFromPrize(p);
00465:       if (!gNum) continue;
00466: 
00467:       const milhar = extractMilharFromPrize(p);
00468:       if (!milhar) continue;
00469: 
00470:       const dez = milhar.slice(-2);
00471:       const centDigit = milhar.slice(-3, -2); // unidade de centena
00472:       const milDigit = milhar.slice(-4, -3); // unidade de milhar
00473: 
00474:       const holder = ensure(pad2(gNum));
00475: 
00476:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.dez, dez, seq);
00477:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.centDigit, centDigit, seq);
00478:       bumpFreqFirstSeen(holder.milDigit, milDigit, seq);
00479:     }
00480:   }
00481: 
00482:   const palpitesByGrupo = {};
00483:   const debugByGrupo = {};
00484: 
00485:   for (let i = 1; i <= 25; i++) {
00486:     const g = pad2(i);
00487:     const h = perGrupo.get(g);
00488: 
00489:     if (!h || h.dez.size === 0) {
00490:       palpitesByGrupo[g] = null;
00491:       debugByGrupo[g] = { reason: "no_numbers_in_slice" };
00492:       continue;
00493:     }
00494: 
00495:     const dezWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.dez);
00496:     const centDigitWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.centDigit);
00497:     const milDigitWin = pickTopByFreqAndOldest(h.milDigit);
00498: 
00499:     if (!dezWin || centDigitWin == null || milDigitWin == null) {
00500:       palpitesByGrupo[g] = null;
00501:       debugByGrupo[g] = {
00502:         reason: "incomplete_components",
00503:         dezWin,
00504:         centDigitWin,
00505:         milDigitWin,
00506:       };
00507:       continue;
00508:     }
00509: 
00510:     const palpite = `${String(milDigitWin)}${String(centDigitWin)}${String(dezWin)}`.padStart(
00511:       4,
00512:       "0"
00513:     );
00514: 
00515:     palpitesByGrupo[g] = palpite;
00516:     debugByGrupo[g] = { dezWin, centDigitWin, milDigitWin };
00517:   }
00518: 
00519:   return {
00520:     palpitesByGrupo,
00521:     sampleDrawsUsed: ordered.length,
00522:     totalCandidates: ordered.length,
00523:     usedBucket: closeHourBucket || null,
00524:     debugByGrupo,
00525:   };
00526: }

00079: function normalizeToYMD(input) {
00080:   if (!input) return null;
00081: 
00082:   // Firestore Timestamp com toDate()
00083:   if (typeof input === "object" && typeof input.toDate === "function") {
00084:     const d = input.toDate();
00085:     if (d instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00086:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
00087:     }
00088:   }
00089: 
00090:   // Timestamp-like { seconds } / { _seconds }
00091:   if (
00092:     typeof input === "object" &&
00093:     (Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds)) || Number.isFinite(Number(input._seconds)))
00094:   ) {
00095:     const sec = Number.isFinite(Number(input.seconds))
00096:       ? Number(input.seconds)
00097:       : Number(input._seconds);
00098: 
00099:     const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
00100:     if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
00101:       return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
00102:     }
00103:   }
00104: 
00105:   // Date
00106:   if (input instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) {
00107:     return `${input.getFullYear()}-${pad2(input.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(input.getDate())}`;
00108:   }
00109: 
00110:   const s = String(input).trim();
00111:   if (!s) return null;
00112: 
00113:   // YYYY-MM-DD...
00114:   const iso = s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
00115:   if (iso) return `${iso[1]}-${iso[2]}-${iso[3]}`;
00116: 
00117:   // DD/MM/YYYY
00118:   const br = s.match(/^(\d{2})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{4})$/);
00119:   if (br) return `${br[3]}-${br[2]}-${br[1]}`;
00120: 
00121:   return null;
00122: }
00123: 
00124: function getDrawYmdRaw(d) {
00125:   if (!d) return null;

00129: function getDrawHourRaw(d) {
00130:   if (!d) return "";
00131:   return String(d.close_hour ?? d.closeHour ?? d.hour ?? d.hora ?? "").trim();

00134: /**
00135:  * ✅ DEDUP DE DRAWS (CORREÇÃO CRÍTICA)
00136:  * - Prioriza a chave LÓGICA (ymd + close_hour) para eliminar duplicidade real
00137:  * - Só cai para id/drawId se NÃO conseguir montar (ymd/hour)
00138:  * - Se ainda assim ficar sem chave, usa fallback com índice (não colapsa tudo em "__")
00139:  */
00140: function dedupeDraws(draws) {
00141:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00142:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00143: 
00144:   const seen = new Set();
00145:   const out = [];
00146: 
00147:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00148:     const d = arr[i];
00149: 
00150:     const ymd =
00151:       String(d?.ymd || "").trim() ||
00152:       normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d)) ||
00153:       "";
00154: 
00155:     const hour = getDrawHourRaw(d);
00156: 
00157:     const logicalKey = ymd && hour ? `${ymd}__${hour}` : "";
00158:     const fallbackKey =
00159:       (d?.drawId != null && String(d.drawId)) ||
00160:       (d?.id != null && String(d.id)) ||
00161:       "";
00162: 
00163:     const key = logicalKey || fallbackKey || `${ymd || "nodate"}__${hour || "nohour"}__idx${i}`;
00164: 
00165:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00166:     seen.add(key);
00167:     out.push(d);
00168:   }
00169: 
00170:   return out;
00171: }
00172: 
00173: /**
00174:  * ✅ Dedup defensivo de prizes dentro do mesmo draw
00175:  * - prioridade: prizeId (se existir)
00176:  * - fallback: position + grupo + animal
00177:  * - se position vier vazio, ainda assim diferencia por "idx" para não colapsar tudo
00178:  */
00179: function dedupePrizes(prizes) {
00180:   const arr = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes : [];
00181:   if (!arr.length) return arr;
00182: 
00183:   const seen = new Set();
00184:   const out = [];
00185: 
00186:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00187:     const p = arr[i];
00188: 
00189:     const grupoRaw = p?.grupo ?? p?.group ?? "";
00190:     const animalRaw = p?.animal ?? "";
00191:     const posRaw = p?.posicao ?? p?.position ?? "";
00192: 
00193:     const baseFallback = `${String(posRaw)}__${String(grupoRaw)}__${normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw)}`;
00194:     const key =
00195:       (p?.prizeId != null && String(p.prizeId)) ||
00196:       (String(posRaw).trim() ? baseFallback : `${baseFallback}__idx${i}`);
00197: 
00198:     if (seen.has(key)) continue;
00199:     seen.add(key);
00200:     out.push(p);
00201:   }
00202: 
00203:   return out;
00204: }

00209: export function buildRanking(draws, opts = {}) {
00210:   // ✅ correção: dedup no nível de draws ANTES de qualquer métrica
00211:   const list = dedupeDraws(Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : []);
00212: 
00213:   // Padrão atual (mantido): conta por prize
00214:   const countMode = String(opts.countMode || "byPrize"); // "byPrize" | "byDraw"
00215:   const maxIntegrityIssues = Number.isFinite(Number(opts.maxIntegrityIssues))
00216:     ? Math.max(0, Number(opts.maxIntegrityIssues))
00217:     : 300;
00218: 
00219:   const totalDraws = list.length;
00220: 
00221:   // metas de período
00222:   const daySet = new Set();
00223:   let minDate = null;
00224:   let maxDate = null;
00225: 
00226:   for (const d of list) {
00227:     const ymd = normalizeToYMD(getDrawYmdRaw(d));
00228:     if (!ymd) continue;
00229: 
00230:     daySet.add(ymd);
00231:     if (!minDate || ymd < minDate) minDate = ymd;
00232:     if (!maxDate || ymd > maxDate) maxDate = ymd;
00233:   }
00234: 
00235:   const uniqueDays = daySet.size;
00236: 
00237:   // ranking
00238:   const map = new Map();
00239:   let totalOcorrencias = 0;
00240: 
00241:   // auditoria de consistência grupo x animal
00242:   const integrityIssues = [];
00243: 
00244:   for (const draw of list) {
00245:     const prizes = dedupePrizes(draw?.prizes);
00246: 
00247:     // se countMode = byDraw, evitamos contar o mesmo grupo mais de 1x por draw
00248:     const countedGroupsThisDraw = countMode === "byDraw" ? new Set() : null;
00249: 
00250:     for (const prize of prizes) {
00251:       const grupoRaw = prize?.grupo ?? prize?.group;
00252:       const animalRaw = prize?.animal;
00253: 
00254:       if (grupoRaw == null) continue;
00255: 
00256:       const grupoNum = Number(grupoRaw);
00257:       if (!Number.isFinite(grupoNum)) continue;
00258:       if (grupoNum < 1 || grupoNum > 25) continue;
00259: 
00260:       if (countedGroupsThisDraw) {
00261:         const k = String(grupoNum);
00262:         if (countedGroupsThisDraw.has(k)) continue;
00263:         countedGroupsThisDraw.add(k);
00264:       }
00265: 
00266:       const official = getOfficialByGrupo(grupoNum);
00267:       const grupo = official?.grupo || pad2(grupoNum);
00268: 
00269:       const animalFromData = animalRaw ? normalizeAnimalLocal(animalRaw) : "";
00270:       const animalOfficial = official?.animal || "";
00271:       const animalLabel = animalFromData || animalOfficial || "";
00272: 
00273:       let entry = map.get(grupo);
00274:       if (!entry) {
00275:         entry = {
00276:           grupo,                 // "01".."25" (string)
00277:           grupoNum: grupoNum,    // 1..25 (number)
00278:           animal: animalLabel,   // "GATO"
00279:           slug: official?.slug || "",
00280:           dezenas: official?.dezenas || [],
00281:           total: 0,
00282:         };
00283:         map.set(grupo, entry);
00284:       } else {
00285:         // completa metadados se necessário
00286:         if (!entry.grupoNum) entry.grupoNum = grupoNum;
00287:         if (!entry.slug && official?.slug) entry.slug = official.slug;
00288:         if ((!entry.dezenas || !entry.dezenas.length) && official?.dezenas?.length) {
00289:           entry.dezenas = official.dezenas;
00290:         }
00291:         if (!entry.animal && animalLabel) entry.animal = animalLabel;
00292:       }
00293: 
00294:       // auditoria: se veio animal no dado e diverge do oficial, registra e “trava” no oficial
00295:       if (
00296:         animalFromData &&
00297:         animalOfficial &&
00298:         animalFromData !== animalOfficial &&
00299:         integrityIssues.length < maxIntegrityIssues
00300:       ) {
00301:         integrityIssues.push({
00302:           drawId: draw?.drawId ?? draw?.id ?? null,
00303:           date: getDrawYmdRaw(draw),
00304:           close_hour: getDrawHourRaw(draw) || null,
00305:           grupo,
00306:           grupoNum,
00307:           animal_no_dado: animalRaw,
00308:           animal_normalizado: animalFromData,
00309:           animal_oficial: animalOfficial,
00310:         });
00311: 
00312:         if (animalOfficial) entry.animal = animalOfficial;
00313:       }
00314: 
00315:       entry.total += 1;
00316:       totalOcorrencias += 1;
00317:     }
00318:   }
00319: 
00320:   // garante 01..25 sempre presentes
00321:   for (let i = 1; i <= 25; i += 1) {
00322:     const official = getOfficialByGrupo(i);
00323:     const g = official?.grupo || pad2(i);
00324: 
00325:     let entry = map.get(g);
00326: 
00327:     if (!entry) {
00328:       map.set(g, {
00329:         grupo: g,
00330:         grupoNum: i,
00331:         animal: official?.animal || "",
00332:         slug: official?.slug || "",
00333:         dezenas: official?.dezenas || [],
00334:         total: 0,
00335:       });
00336:     } else {
00337:       if (!entry.grupoNum) entry.grupoNum = i;
00338:       if (!entry.animal) entry.animal = official?.animal || "";
00339:       if (!entry.slug) entry.slug = official?.slug || "";
00340:       if ((!entry.dezenas || !entry.dezenas.length) && official?.dezenas?.length) {
00341:         entry.dezenas = official.dezenas;
00342:       }
00343:     }
00344:   }
00345: 
00346:   const ranking = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => {
00347:     const dt = Number(b.total) - Number(a.total);
00348:     if (dt !== 0) return dt;
00349:     return String(a.grupo).localeCompare(String(b.grupo));
00350:   });
00351: 
00352:   return {
00353:     ranking,
00354:     top3: ranking.slice(0, 3),
00355:     totalOcorrencias,
00356:     integrityIssues,
00357:     totalDraws,
00358:     uniqueDays,

00360:     maxDate,

--- CONTEXTO DAS LINHAS 1 A 30 ---
00001: export function applyScoreEngine(ranking = [], opts = {}) {
00002:   const weights = {
00003:     aparicoes: 1,
00004:     ...opts.weights,
00005:   };
00006: 
00007:   const scored = (Array.isArray(ranking) ? ranking : []).map((item) => {
00008:     const aparicoes = Number(item.total ?? item.apar ?? 0) || 0;
00009: 
00010:     const score =
00011:       aparicoes * Number(weights.aparicoes || 0);
00012: 
00013:     return {
00014:       ...item,
00015:       score,
00016:       scoreDetails: {
00017:         aparicoes,
00018:         weights,
00019:       },
00020:     };
00021:   });
00022: 
00023:   scored.sort((a, b) => {
00024:     const ds = Number(b.score || 0) - Number(a.score || 0);
00025:     if (ds !== 0) return ds;
00026:     return Number(a.grupoNum || a.grupo || 0) - Number(b.grupoNum || b.grupo || 0);
00027:   });
00028: 
00029:   return scored;
00030: }

00002: 
00003: export function normalizeDigitsOnly(v) {
00004:   return String(v ?? "").replace(/\D+/g, "");
00005: }
00006: 
00007: export function normalizeCpfDigits(cpf) {
00008:   return normalizeDigitsOnly(cpf).slice(0, 11);
00009: }
00010: 
00011: /**
00012:  * SHA-256 -> hex (robusto)
00013:  * - tenta WebCrypto (window.crypto.subtle)
00014:  * - fallback: CryptoJS (npm i crypto-js)
00015:  */
00016: async function sha256Hex(str) {
00017:   const input = String(str || "");
00018: 
00019:   // 1) WebCrypto (preferido)
00020:   try {
00021:     const subtle = globalThis?.crypto?.subtle;
00022:     if (subtle) {
00023:       const enc = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
00024:       const buf = await subtle.digest("SHA-256", enc);
00025:       const arr = Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf));
00026:       return arr.map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
00027:     }
00028:   } catch {
00029:     // cai pro fallback abaixo
00030:   }
00031: 
00032:   // 2) Fallback via CryptoJS
00033:   // Requer: npm i crypto-js
00034:   const { default: CryptoJS } = await import("crypto-js");
00035:   return CryptoJS.SHA256(input).toString(CryptoJS.enc.Hex);
00036: }
00037: 
00038: /**
00039:  * userId determinístico e não sensível
00040:  * Ex: "cpf:ab12cd..."
00041:  */
00042: export async function userIdFromCpfDigits(cpfDigits11) {
00043:   const cpf = String(cpfDigits11 || "").trim();
00044:   if (cpf.length !== 11) return null;
00045: 
00046:   const h = await sha256Hex(cpf);
00047:   return `cpf:${h}`;
00048: }
